// دالة التنفيذ
function buildProjectStructure() {
  console.log('🚀 بدء بناء هيكلة مشروع Gherbi.Ai POS...\n');

  // 1. إنشاء المجلدات
  folders.forEach(folder => {
    const folderPath = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, folder);
    if (!fs.existsSync(folderPath)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(folderPath, { recursive: true });
      console.log(`📁 تم إنشاء المجلد: ${folder || 'Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean (الجذر)'}`);
    }
  });

  console.log('\n----------------------------------------\n');

  // 2. إنشاء الملفات فارغة
  let filesCreated = 0;
  files.forEach(file => {
    const filePath = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, file);
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      // كتابة ملف فارغ
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, '', 'utf8');
      filesCreated++;
    }
  });

  console.log(`📄 تم إنشاء ${filesCreated} ملف برمجي فارغ جاهز للعمل.`);
  console.log('\n🎉 اكتمل بناء الهيكلة بنجاح!');
  console.log(`📂 مسار المشروع الخاص بك هو: ${PROJECT_ROOT}`);
}

buildProjectStructure();

## `extract_code.py`

```python
import os

# ==============================
# الإعدادات
# ==============================

OUTPUT_FILE = "project_structuregherbiaiposCLEANnew2.md"
MAX_DEPTH = 3                 # أقصى عمق للشجرة
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5000 * 1024    # 200KB

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".github", 
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
    "fet-engine",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "release",
    "out",
    "target",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "coverage",
    ".next"
}

IGNORE_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    ".gitignore",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db"
}

IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif",
    ".svg", ".ico",
    ".pdf",
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav",
    ".exe", ".dll",
    ".pyc",
    ".log"
}

CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
}


def language(ext):
    ext = ext.lower()

    if ext == ".py":
        return "python"

    if ext in [".js", ".jsx"]:
        return "javascript"

    if ext in [".ts", ".tsx"]:
        return "typescript"

    if ext == ".css":
        return "css"

    if ext == ".html":
        return "html"

    if ext == ".json":
        return "json"

    if ext == ".sql":
        return "sql"

    if ext == ".md":
        return "markdown"

    return "text"


def generate(directory):

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        ##################################################
        # Project Tree
        ##################################################

        f.write("# Project Structure\n\n")
        f.write("```text\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = sorted([d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS])

            level = os.path.relpath(root, directory).count(os.sep)

            if level > MAX_DEPTH:
                dirs.clear()
                continue

            indent = "    " * level

            folder = os.path.basename(root)

            if root == directory:
                f.write(f"{os.path.basename(directory)}/\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"{indent}├── {folder}/\n")

            sub = "    " * (level + 1)

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext in IGNORE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                f.write(f"{sub}├── {file}\n")

        f.write("```\n\n")

        ##################################################
        # Source Code
        ##################################################

        f.write("\n---\n\n")
        f.write("# Source Code\n\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS]

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext not in CODE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                path = os.path.join(root, file)

                if os.path.getsize(path) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    continue

                relative = os.path.relpath(path, directory)

                f.write(f"## `{relative}`\n\n")

                f.write(f"```{language(ext)}\n")

                try:
                    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as code:
                        f.write(code.read())
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    f.write("// Unable to read file (encoding).")
                except Exception as e:
                    f.write(f"// {e}")

                f.write("\n```\n\n---\n\n")

    print("Done!")
    print("Output:", OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate(os.getcwd())
```

    const filePath = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, file);

  console.log(`📂 مسار المشروع الخاص بك هو: ${PROJECT_ROOT}`);
}

buildProjectStructure();

<!DOCTYPE html>

    <div id="licenseBadgeBox" class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-3">
      <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-400">workspace_premium</span>
      <div class="text-xs">
        <div class="font-bold text-emerald-300">النسخة الاحترافية الكاملة (PRO Lifetime)</div>
        <div id="licenseStatusText" class="text-slate-400 mt-0.5">مفعلة مدى الحياة على هذا الجهاز</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- المعرف المادي للجهاز HWID -->
    <div class="space-y-1.5">
      <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">المعرف المادي للجهاز (HWID)</label>
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <input id="hwidInput" type="text" readonly
          class="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-center font-mono text-xs text-blue-400 tracking-wider">
        <button onclick="copyHwid()"
          class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">content_copy</span>
          <span>نسخ</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- إدخال مفتاح الترخيص -->
    <div class="space-y-1.5">
      <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">مفتاح الترخيص (License Key)</label>
      <input id="licenseKeyInput" type="text" placeholder="GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME"
        class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-center font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-white">
    </div>

    <div id="feedbackMessage" class="text-xs font-bold text-center min-h-[1.25rem]"></div>

    <!-- أزرار التحكم -->
    <div class="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
      <button onclick="activateNow()"
        class="w-full py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25">
        <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">key</span>
        <span>تفعيل أو دخول للنظام</span>
      </button>

      <button onclick="activateOfflineFile()"
        class="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">upload_file</span>
        <span>استيراد ملف رخصة محلي (Offline)</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const bridge = window.activationAPI || window.api || {};

    async function loadLicenseState() {
      try {
        if (typeof bridge.getHWID === 'function') {
          document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = bridge.getHWID() || '';
        }
        if (typeof bridge.getStatus === 'function') {
          const st = await bridge.getStatus();
          if (st && st.hwid) document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = st.hwid;
          if (st && st.code) document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value = st.code;
        } else if (typeof bridge.getLicenseStatus === 'function') {
          const st = await bridge.getLicenseStatus();
          if (st && st.hwid) document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = st.hwid;
          if (st && st.code) document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value = st.code;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('License init error:', err);
      }
    }

    function copyHwid() {
      const val = document.getElementById('hwidInput').value;
      if (!val) return;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
      const msg = document.getElementById('feedbackMessage');
      msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-400';
      msg.textContent = 'تم نسخ معرف الجهاز إلى الحافظة';
    }

    async function activateNow() {
      const code = document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value.trim() || 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME';
      const msg = document.getElementById('feedbackMessage');
      try {
        const fn = bridge.activate || bridge.activateSoftware;
        if (typeof fn === 'function') {
          await fn(code);
        }
        msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-400';
        msg.textContent = 'تم التفعيل بنجاح! جاري فتح النظام...';
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = 'index.html';
        }, 500);
      } catch (err) {
        msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-rose-400';
        msg.textContent = err.message || 'تعذر التحقق من المفتاح';
      }
    }

    async function activateOfflineFile() {
      const fn = bridge.activateOffline || bridge.activateSoftwareOffline;
      if (typeof fn === 'function') {
        const res = await fn();
        if (res && res.success) {
          window.location.href = 'index.html';
        }
      }
    }

    loadLicenseState();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\analytics-queries.js`

```javascript
/**
 * analytics-queries.js
 * محرك التحليلات المالية، حساب تكلفة البضاعة المباعة (COGS)، التدفقات النقدية،
 * أعمار الديون، تقييم المخزون، تحليلات الشرائح، حاسبة الزكاة، وتوصيات Gherbi.Ai Copilot
 */

'use strict';

function normalizeDateRange(params = {}) {
  const rawFrom = params.dateFrom || params.date_from || null;
  const rawTo = params.dateTo || params.date_to || null;
  return {
    dateFrom: rawFrom ? String(rawFrom).trim().slice(0, 10) : null,
    dateTo: rawTo ? String(rawTo).trim().slice(0, 10) : null
  };
}

function queryGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  if (typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row || {})));
  });
}

function queryAll(db, sql, params = []) {
  if (typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

/**
 * دمج خصائص الكائن داخل مصفوفة هجينة بحيث تعمل دوال المصفوفات (.forEach / .map)
 * والوصول المباشر للخصائص (obj.bucket_0_30) في آنٍ واحد دون أي تعارض
 */
function createHybridArrayObject(propsObj = {}, arrayItems = []) {
  const arr = Array.isArray(arrayItems) ? arrayItems.slice() : [];
  return Object.assign(arr, propsObj);
}

/**
 * المحرك الرئيسي للوحة القيادة والإحصائيات الشاملة
 */
async function getAnalytics(db, params = {}, callback) {
  if (typeof params === 'function') {
    callback = params;
    params = {};
  }

  const runAnalysis = async () => {
    const { dateFrom, dateTo } = normalizeDateRange(params);
    const custDebtPage = Math.max(0, parseInt(params.custDebtPage ?? 0, 10) || 0);
    const supDebtPage = Math.max(0, parseInt(params.supDebtPage ?? 0, 10) || 0);
    const debtPageSize = Math.max(1, parseInt(params.debtPageSize ?? 10, 10) || 10);

    const salesConds = ['s.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const salesParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) {
      salesConds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)');
      salesParams.push(dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      salesConds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)');
      salesParams.push(dateTo);
    }
    const salesWhere = salesConds.join(' AND ');

    const purchConds = ['pi.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const purchParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) {
      purchConds.push('date(pi.date) >= date(?)');
      purchParams.push(dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      purchConds.push('date(pi.date) <= date(?)');
      purchParams.push(dateTo);
    }
    const purchWhere = purchConds.join(' AND ');

    // 1. مؤشرات المبيعات والمرتجعات والضرائب والطابع الجبائي
    const salesSummary = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total >= 0 THEN s.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total < 0 THEN ABS(s.total) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returns_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.total), 0) AS net_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.discount), 0) AS total_discounts,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.tax_percentage > 0 THEN (s.total * s.tax_percentage / (100.0 + s.tax_percentage)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sales_tax_collected,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.stamp_amount), 0) AS total_stamp_duty,
        COUNT(*) AS total_sales_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN s.total < 0 THEN 1 END) AS returns_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(s.payment_method, 'cash')) = 'cash' THEN s.paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cash_sales_paid,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total > s.paid_amount THEN (s.total - s.paid_amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credit_sales_unpaid
      FROM sales s
      WHERE ${salesWhere}
      `,
      salesParams
    )) || {};

    // 2. تكلفة البضاعة المباعة (COGS)
    const cogsRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS cogs
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
      WHERE si.deleted_at IS NULL AND ${salesWhere}
      `,
      salesParams
    )) || {};

    // 3. ملخص المشتريات
    const purchasesSummary = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(pi.total), 0) AS total_purchases,
        COALESCE(SUM(pi.additional_costs), 0) AS additional_costs,
        COALESCE(SUM(pi.subtotal * pi.tax_percentage / 100.0), 0) AS purchase_tax_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS total_purchases_count
      FROM purchase_invoices pi
      WHERE ${purchWhere}
      `,
      purchParams
    )) || {};

    // 4. التدفق النقدي الداخل والخارج
    const spConds = ['sp.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const spParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { spConds.push('date(sp.date) >= date(?)'); spParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { spConds.push('date(sp.date) <= date(?)'); spParams.push(dateTo); }

    const ctConds = ['ct.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const ctParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { ctConds.push('date(COALESCE(ct.updated_at, ct.created_at)) >= date(?)'); ctParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { ctConds.push('date(COALESCE(ct.updated_at, ct.created_at)) <= date(?)'); ctParams.push(dateTo); }

    const srConds = ['sr.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const srParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { srConds.push('date(sr.date) >= date(?)'); srParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { srConds.push('date(sr.date) <= date(?)'); srParams.push(dateTo); }

    const cashInRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cash_in), 0) AS cash_in FROM (
        SELECT SUM(sp.amount) AS cash_in FROM sale_payments sp WHERE ${spConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(ct.amount) AS cash_in FROM caisse_transactions ct
        WHERE ct.type IN ('cash_in', 'order_deposit') AND ${ctConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(sr.refund_amount) AS cash_in FROM supplier_returns sr WHERE ${srConds.join(' AND ')}
      )
      `,
      [...spParams, ...ctParams, ...srParams]
    )) || {};

    const ipConds = ['ip.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const ipParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { ipConds.push('date(ip.date) >= date(?)'); ipParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { ipConds.push('date(ip.date) <= date(?)'); ipParams.push(dateTo); }

    const expConds = ['e.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const expParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { expConds.push('date(e.date) >= date(?)'); expParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { expConds.push('date(e.date) <= date(?)'); expParams.push(dateTo); }

    const cashOutRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cash_out), 0) AS cash_out FROM (
        SELECT SUM(ip.amount) AS cash_out FROM invoice_payments ip WHERE ${ipConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(ct.amount) AS cash_out FROM caisse_transactions ct
        WHERE ct.type IN ('cash_out', 'sale_refund') AND ${ctConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(e.amount) AS cash_out FROM expenses e WHERE ${expConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT SUM(ct.amount) AS cash_out FROM caisse_transactions ct
        WHERE ct.type = 'expense' AND ct.reference_id IS NULL AND ct.reference_uuid IS NULL AND ${ctConds.join(' AND ')}
      )
      `,
      [...ipParams, ...ctParams, ...expParams, ...ctParams]
    )) || {};

    // 5. المصاريف حسب الفئة ورأس المال
    const expensesByCategory = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT category, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total
      FROM (
        SELECT e.category AS category, e.amount AS amount
        FROM expenses e
        WHERE ${expConds.join(' AND ')}
        UNION ALL
        SELECT COALESCE(ct.category, 'عام') AS category, ct.amount AS amount
        FROM caisse_transactions ct
        WHERE ct.type = 'expense'
          AND ct.reference_id IS NULL
          AND ct.reference_uuid IS NULL
          AND ${ctConds.join(' AND ')}
      )
      GROUP BY category
      ORDER BY total DESC
      `,
      [...expParams, ...ctParams]
    );

    const totalExpenses = expensesByCategory.reduce((sum, r) => sum + Number(r.total || 0), 0);

    const capConds = ['c.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const capParams = [];
    if (dateFrom) { capConds.push('date(c.date) >= date(?)'); capParams.push(dateFrom); }
    if (dateTo) { capConds.push('date(c.date) <= date(?)'); capParams.push(dateTo); }

    const capitalRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.amount), 0) AS total FROM capital_injections c WHERE ${capConds.join(' AND ')}`,
      capParams
    )) || {};

    // 6. ديون الزبائن وديون الموردين وأعمار الديون (Debt Aging)
    const totalCustomerDebtRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debt), 0) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM (
        SELECT
          c.id,
          (COALESCE(SUM(s.total - s.paid_amount), 0) + (COALESCE(c.initial_debt, 0) - COALESCE(c.initial_debt_paid, 0))) AS debt
        FROM customers c
        LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.customer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY c.id
        HAVING debt > 0.009
      )
      `
    )) || {};

    const customerDebts = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.phone,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.total), 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.paid_amount), 0) AS total_paid,
        (COALESCE(SUM(s.total - s.paid_amount), 0) + (COALESCE(c.initial_debt, 0) - COALESCE(c.initial_debt_paid, 0))) AS debt,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN (s.total - s.paid_amount) > 0.009 THEN 1 END) AS open_invoices,
        MIN(CASE WHEN (s.total - s.paid_amount) > 0.009 THEN s.sale_date END) AS oldest_unpaid
      FROM customers c
      LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.customer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY c.id
      HAVING debt > 0.009
      ORDER BY debt DESC, c.id ASC
      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
      `,
      [debtPageSize, custDebtPage * debtPageSize]
    );

    const totalSupplierDebtRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debt), 0) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM (
        SELECT
          sup.id,
          (
            COALESCE(SUM(pi.total - pi.paid_amount), 0) +
            (COALESCE(sup.initial_debt, 0) - COALESCE(sup.initial_debt_paid, 0)) -
            COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sr.credit_applied) FROM supplier_returns sr WHERE sr.supplier_id = sup.id AND sr.deleted_at IS NULL), 0)
          ) AS debt
        FROM suppliers sup
        LEFT JOIN purchase_invoices pi ON sup.id = pi.supplier_id AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE sup.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY sup.id
        HAVING debt > 0.009
      )
      `
    )) || {};

    const supplierDebts = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        sup.id,
        sup.name,
        sup.phone,
        COALESCE(SUM(pi.total), 0) AS total_purchases,
        COALESCE(SUM(pi.paid_amount), 0) AS total_paid,
        (
          COALESCE(SUM(pi.total - pi.paid_amount), 0) +
          (COALESCE(sup.initial_debt, 0) - COALESCE(sup.initial_debt_paid, 0)) -
          COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sr.credit_applied) FROM supplier_returns sr WHERE sr.supplier_id = sup.id AND sr.deleted_at IS NULL), 0)
        ) AS debt,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN (pi.total - pi.paid_amount) > 0.009 THEN 1 END) AS open_invoices,
        MIN(CASE WHEN (pi.total - pi.paid_amount) > 0.009 THEN pi.date END) AS oldest_unpaid
      FROM suppliers sup
      LEFT JOIN purchase_invoices pi ON sup.id = pi.supplier_id AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE sup.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY sup.id
      HAVING debt > 0.009
      ORDER BY debt DESC, sup.id ASC
      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
      `,
      [debtPageSize, supDebtPage * debtPageSize]
    );

    const allCustomerDebtsForAging = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        (COALESCE(SUM(s.total - s.paid_amount), 0) + (COALESCE(c.initial_debt, 0) - COALESCE(c.initial_debt_paid, 0))) AS debt,
        COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN (s.total - s.paid_amount) > 0.009 THEN s.sale_date END), c.created_at) AS oldest_date
      FROM customers c
      LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.customer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY c.id
      HAVING debt > 0.009
      `
    );

    const debtAgingProps = {
      bucket_0_30: 0,
      bucket_31_60: 0,
      bucket_61_90: 0,
      bucket_90_plus: 0,
      current: 0,
      days30: 0,
      days60: 0,
      days90: 0
    };
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    for (const r of allCustomerDebtsForAging) {
      const amt = Number(r.debt || 0);
      const dt = r.oldest_date ? new Date(r.oldest_date).getTime() : nowMs;
      const days = Number.isFinite(dt) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((nowMs - dt) / 86400000)) : 0;
      if (days <= 30) {
        debtAgingProps.bucket_0_30 += amt;
        debtAgingProps.current += amt;
      } else if (days <= 60) {
        debtAgingProps.bucket_31_60 += amt;
        debtAgingProps.days30 += amt;
      } else if (days <= 90) {
        debtAgingProps.bucket_61_90 += amt;
        debtAgingProps.days60 += amt;
      } else {
        debtAgingProps.bucket_90_plus += amt;
        debtAgingProps.days90 += amt;
      }
    }

    const debtAgingHybrid = createHybridArrayObject(debtAgingProps, [
      { label: '0-30', bucket: '0-30', amount: debtAgingProps.bucket_0_30, total: debtAgingProps.bucket_0_30 },
      { label: '31-60', bucket: '31-60', amount: debtAgingProps.bucket_31_60, total: debtAgingProps.bucket_31_60 },
      { label: '61-90', bucket: '61-90', amount: debtAgingProps.bucket_61_90, total: debtAgingProps.bucket_61_90 },
      { label: '90+', bucket: '90+', amount: debtAgingProps.bucket_90_plus, total: debtAgingProps.bucket_90_plus }
    ]);

    // 7. تقييم المخزون والتنبيهات
    const invValuation = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock * ib.cost_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cost_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock * ib.selling_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_units,
        COUNT(*) AS batches_count
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      `
    )) || {};

    const prodCountRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      'SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL'
    )) || {};

    const lowStockProducts = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.min_stock,
        p.unit,
        COALESCE(SUM(ib.stock), 0) AS current_stock
      FROM products p
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON p.id = ib.product_id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY p.id
      HAVING current_stock <= COALESCE(p.min_stock, 5)
      ORDER BY current_stock ASC, p.id ASC
      LIMIT 100
      `
    );

    const expiringBatches = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        ib.id AS batch_id,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name,
        ib.stock,
        ib.expiry_date,
        ib.selling_price,
        ib.cost_price
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND ib.stock > 0
        AND ib.expiry_date IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(ib.expiry_date) <> ''
        AND date(ib.expiry_date) <= date('now', '+30 days')
      ORDER BY date(ib.expiry_date) ASC
      LIMIT 100
      `
    );

    // 8. الترتيب والرسوم البيانية
    const topProducts = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        p.id,
        COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج مخصص') AS name,
        COALESCE(p.category, 'عام') AS category,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS qty_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS cost,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal) - SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS profit
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
      WHERE si.deleted_at IS NULL AND ${salesWhere}
      GROUP BY COALESCE(si.product_id, si.custom_product_name)
      ORDER BY revenue DESC
      LIMIT 20
      `,
      salesParams
    );

    const topCustomers = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.phone,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total > 0 THEN s.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(s.id) AS purchase_count
      FROM customers c
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.customer_id = c.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND ${salesWhere}
      GROUP BY c.id
      ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
      LIMIT 20
      `,
      salesParams
    );

    const salesByCategory = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.category), ''), 'غير مصنف') AS category,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS qty_sold
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      WHERE si.deleted_at IS NULL AND ${salesWhere}
      GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.category), ''), 'غير مصنف')
      ORDER BY revenue DESC
      `,
      salesParams
    );

    const dailySalesTrend = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        date(s.sale_date) AS date,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.total), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sales s
      WHERE ${salesWhere}
      GROUP BY date(s.sale_date)
      ORDER BY date(s.sale_date) ASC
      `,
      salesParams
    );

    const hourlySales = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        strftime('%H', s.sale_date) AS hour,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.total), 0) AS revenue
      FROM sales s
      WHERE ${salesWhere}
      GROUP BY strftime('%H', s.sale_date)
      ORDER BY hour ASC
      `,
      salesParams
    );

    const netRevenue = Number(salesSummary.net_revenue || 0);
    const cogs = Number(cogsRow.cogs || 0);
    const grossProfit = Number((netRevenue - cogs).toFixed(2));
    const netProfit = Number((grossProfit - totalExpenses).toFixed(2));

    const cashIn = Number(cashInRow.cash_in || 0);
    const cashOut = Number(cashOutRow.cash_out || 0);
    const netCashFlow = Number((cashIn - cashOut).toFixed(2));

    const totalCustomerDebt = Number(totalCustomerDebtRow.total || 0);
    const totalSupplierDebt = Number(totalSupplierDebtRow.total || 0);

    const costValue = Number(invValuation.cost_value || 0);
    const sellValue = Number(invValuation.sell_value || 0);
    const zakatPool = Math.max(
      0,
      Number((Math.max(0, netCashFlow) + costValue + totalCustomerDebt - totalSupplierDebt).toFixed(2))
    );
    const zakatAmount = Number((zakatPool * 0.025).toFixed(2));

    const inventoryHybrid = createHybridArrayObject({
      cost_value: costValue,
      sell_value: sellValue,
      total_units: Number(invValuation.total_units || 0),
      batches_count: Number(invValuation.batches_count || 0),
      expected_profit: Number((sellValue - costValue).toFixed(2))
    });

    return {
      sales: createHybridArrayObject({
        revenue: Number(salesSummary.revenue || 0),
        returns_value: Number(salesSummary.returns_value || 0),
        net_revenue: netRevenue,
        total_discounts: Number(salesSummary.total_discounts || 0),
        sales_tax_collected: Number(salesSummary.sales_tax_collected || 0),
        total_sales_count: Number(salesSummary.total_sales_count || 0),
        returns_count: Number(salesSummary.returns_count || 0),
        cash_sales_paid: Number(salesSummary.cash_sales_paid || 0),
        credit_sales_unpaid: Number(salesSummary.credit_sales_unpaid || 0)
      }),
      purchases: createHybridArrayObject({
        total_purchases: Number(purchasesSummary.total_purchases || 0),
        additional_costs: Number(purchasesSummary.additional_costs || 0),
        purchase_tax_paid: Number(purchasesSummary.purchase_tax_paid || 0),
        total_purchases_count: Number(purchasesSummary.total_purchases_count || 0)
      }),
      revenue: Number(salesSummary.revenue || 0),
      returns_value: Number(salesSummary.returns_value || 0),
      net_revenue: netRevenue,
      total_discounts: Number(salesSummary.total_discounts || 0),
      sales_tax_collected: Number(salesSummary.sales_tax_collected || 0),
      total_stamp_duty: Number(salesSummary.total_stamp_duty || 0),
      total_sales_count: Number(salesSummary.total_sales_count || 0),
      returns_count: Number(salesSummary.returns_count || 0),
      cogs,
      gross_profit: grossProfit,
      net_profit: netProfit,
      total_purchases: Number(purchasesSummary.total_purchases || 0),
      additional_costs: Number(purchasesSummary.additional_costs || 0),
      purchase_tax_paid: Number(purchasesSummary.purchase_tax_paid || 0),
      total_purchases_count: Number(purchasesSummary.total_purchases_count || 0),
      totalExpenses,
      expensesByCategory,
      expenses: expensesByCategory,
      totalCapital: Number(capitalRow.total || 0),
      cash_in: cashIn,
      cash_out: cashOut,
      net_cash_flow: netCashFlow,
      totalCustomerDebt,
      totalCustomerDebtsCount: Number(totalCustomerDebtRow.cnt || 0),
      customerDebts,
      totalSupplierDebt,
      totalSupplierDebtsCount: Number(totalSupplierDebtRow.cnt || 0),
      supplierDebts,
      debtAging: debtAgingHybrid,
      inventory: inventoryHybrid,
      inventoryValuation: inventoryHybrid,
      productsCount: Number(prodCountRow.c || 0),
      lowStock: lowStockProducts,
      lowStockProducts,
      expiring: expiringBatches,
      expiringBatches,
      topProducts,
      topCustomers,
      salesByCategory,
      dailySalesTrend,
      hourlySales,
      zakat: createHybridArrayObject({
        pool: zakatPool,
        amount: zakatAmount,
        rate: 0.025
      })
    };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    runAnalysis().then((res) => callback(null, res)).catch((err) => callback(err));
    return;
  }
  return runAnalysis();
}

function buildSegmentFilterSql(params = {}) {
  const scopeType = String(params.scopeType || params.scope_type || 'all').toLowerCase();
  const category = params.category ? String(params.category).trim() : null;
  const family = params.family ? String(params.family).trim() : null;
  const productIds = Array.isArray(params.productIds)
    ? params.productIds.map(Number).filter(Boolean)
    : [];

  const conds = ['1=1'];
  const sqlParams = [];

  if (scopeType === 'category' && category) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    sqlParams.push(category);
  } else if (scopeType === 'family' && family) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    sqlParams.push(family);
  } else if (scopeType === 'products' && productIds.length > 0) {
    conds.push(`p.id IN (${productIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`);
    sqlParams.push(...productIds);
  } else {
    if (category) {
      conds.push('p.category = ?');
      sqlParams.push(category);
    }
    if (family) {
      conds.push('p.family = ?');
      sqlParams.push(family);
    }
    if (productIds.length > 0) {
      conds.push(`p.id IN (${productIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`);
      sqlParams.push(...productIds);
    }
  }

  return { whereExpr: conds.join(' AND '), sqlParams };
}

/**
 * تحليلات الشرائح المتقدمة (Segment Analytics)
 */
async function getSegmentAnalytics(db, params = {}, callback) {
  if (typeof params === 'function') {
    callback = params;
    params = {};
  }

  const work = async () => {
    const { dateFrom, dateTo } = normalizeDateRange(params);
    const { whereExpr, sqlParams } = buildSegmentFilterSql(params);

    const dateConds = ['s.deleted_at IS NULL', 'si.deleted_at IS NULL', whereExpr];
    const queryParams = [...sqlParams];

    if (dateFrom) {
      dateConds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)');
      queryParams.push(dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      dateConds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)');
      queryParams.push(dateTo);
    }
    const fullWhere = dateConds.join(' AND ');

    const summary = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.quantity > 0 THEN si.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_qty,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.quantity < 0 THEN -si.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returned_qty,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS net_qty,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.subtotal > 0 THEN si.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.subtotal < 0 THEN -si.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returns_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS net_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS cogs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS invoices_count
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
      WHERE ${fullWhere}
      `,
      queryParams
    )) || {};

    const dailyTrend = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        date(s.sale_date) AS date,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS qty
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      WHERE ${fullWhere}
      GROUP BY date(s.sale_date)
      ORDER BY date(s.sale_date) ASC
      `,
      queryParams
    );

    const topCustomers = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.phone,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.subtotal > 0 THEN si.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS purchase_count
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
      INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      WHERE ${fullWhere}
      GROUP BY c.id
      ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
      LIMIT 15
      `,
      queryParams
    );

    const inventoryStats = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock * ib.cost_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cost_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock * ib.selling_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ib.stock > 0 THEN ib.stock ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units,
        COUNT(ib.id) AS batches_count
      FROM products p
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ${whereExpr}
      `,
      sqlParams
    )) || {};

    const productBreakdownData = await getSegmentProducts(db, {
      ...params,
      productPage: params.productPage ?? 0,
      productPageSize: params.productPageSize ?? 25
    });

    const netRev = Number(summary.net_revenue || 0);
    const cogs = Number(summary.cogs || 0);

    return {
      summary: {
        ...summary,
        profit: Number((netRev - cogs).toFixed(2))
      },
      dailySalesTrend: dailyTrend,
      topCustomers,
      inventory: inventoryStats,
      productBreakdown: productBreakdownData.items,
      productTotal: productBreakdownData.total
    };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((res) => callback(null, res)).catch((err) => callback(err));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

/**
 * تفصيل المنتجات داخل شريحة محددة مع الترقيم (Pagination)
 */
async function getSegmentProducts(db, params = {}, callback) {
  if (typeof params === 'function') {
    callback = params;
    params = {};
  }

  const work = async () => {
    const { dateFrom, dateTo } = normalizeDateRange(params);
    const { whereExpr, sqlParams } = buildSegmentFilterSql(params);
    const page = Math.max(0, parseInt(params.productPage ?? params.page ?? 0, 10) || 0);
    const pageSize = Math.max(1, parseInt(params.productPageSize ?? params.pageSize ?? 25, 10) || 25);

    const dateConds = ['s.deleted_at IS NULL', 'si.deleted_at IS NULL', whereExpr];
    const queryParams = [...sqlParams];

    if (dateFrom) {
      dateConds.push('date(s.sale_date) >= date(?)');
      queryParams.push(dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      dateConds.push('date(s.sale_date) <= date(?)');
      queryParams.push(dateTo);
    }
    const fullWhere = dateConds.join(' AND ');

    const countRow = (await queryGet(
      db,
      `
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM (
        SELECT p.id
        FROM sale_items si
        INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
        WHERE ${fullWhere}
        GROUP BY p.id
      )
      `,
      queryParams
    )) || {};

    const items = await queryAll(
      db,
      `
      SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.family,
        p.unit,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS qty_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS cost,
        COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal) - SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, si.custom_cost_price, 0)), 0) AS profit
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
      INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
      LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
      WHERE ${fullWhere}
      GROUP BY p.id
      ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.id ASC
      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
      `,
      [...queryParams, pageSize, page * pageSize]
    );

    return {
      items,
      total: Number(countRow.c || 0),
      page,
      pageSize
    };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((res) => callback(null, res)).catch((err) => callback(err));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

/**
 * محرك توصيات Gherbi.Ai Copilot المحلي (تحليل البضاعة الراكدة، سرعة الدوران، وتوقعات إعادة الطلب)
 */
async function getAiCopilotInsights(db) {
  // 1. المنتجات سريعة النفاد التي تحتاج إعادة طلب عاجلة بناءً على معدل السحب في آخر 14 يوماً
  const reorderSuggestions = await queryAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.name,
      p.category,
      p.supplier,
      COALESCE(st.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock,
      COALESCE(vel.sold_14d, 0) AS sold_14d,
      ROUND(COALESCE(vel.sold_14d, 0) / 14.0, 2) AS daily_velocity,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(vel.sold_14d, 0) > 0
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(st.current_stock, 0) / (vel.sold_14d / 14.0), 1)
        ELSE 999
      END AS days_of_supply
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT product_id, SUM(stock) AS current_stock
      FROM inventory_batches
      WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY product_id
    ) st ON st.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT si.product_id, SUM(si.quantity) AS sold_14d
      FROM sale_items si
      INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE si.deleted_at IS NULL AND date(s.sale_date) >= date('now', '-14 days')
      GROUP BY si.product_id
    ) vel ON vel.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(vel.sold_14d, 0) > 0
      AND (COALESCE(st.current_stock, 0) / (vel.sold_14d / 14.0)) <= 7
    ORDER BY days_of_supply ASC
    LIMIT 25
    `
  );

  // 2. البضاعة الراكدة (Dead Stock) التي لم تُبع منذ 30 يوماً ولها رصيد مجمد
  const deadStock = await queryAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.name,
      p.category,
      COALESCE(SUM(ib.stock), 0) AS stock_qty,
      COALESCE(SUM(ib.stock * ib.cost_price), 0) AS tied_capital
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
    WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND ib.stock > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sale_items si
        INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE si.product_id = p.id AND si.deleted_at IS NULL AND date(s.sale_date) >= date('now', '-30 days')
      )
    GROUP BY p.id
    HAVING stock_qty > 0
    ORDER BY tied_capital DESC
    LIMIT 25
    `
  );

  return {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    reorderSuggestions,
    deadStock
  };
}

module.exports = {
  getAnalytics,
  computeAnalytics: getAnalytics,
  getSegmentAnalytics,
  computeSegmentAnalytics: getSegmentAnalytics,
  getSegmentProducts,
  computeSegmentProducts: getSegmentProducts,
  getAiCopilotInsights
};
```

'use strict';

class LanApiClient {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.serverIp = options.serverIp || '192.168.1.15';
    this.serverPort = options.serverPort || 8080;
    this.timeout = options.timeout || 25000;
    this.deviceId = options.deviceId || 'lan-client';
    this._rebuild();
  }

  _rebuild() {
    this.baseURL = `http://${this.serverIp}:${this.serverPort}`;
    this.http = axios.create({
      baseURL: this.baseURL,
      timeout: this.timeout,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Device-Id': this.deviceId,
        'X-Client-Type': 'gherbi-lan-client'
      }
    });
  }

  setTarget(serverIp, serverPort = 8080, deviceId = null) {
    if (serverIp) this.serverIp = String(serverIp).trim();
    if (serverPort) this.serverPort = Number(serverPort) || 8080;
    if (deviceId) this.deviceId = String(deviceId).trim();
    this._rebuild();
  }

  async _req(method, url, data = undefined, params = undefined) {
    try {
      const res = await this.http.request({ method, url, data, params });
      return res.data;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.response && err.response.data) {
        const d = err.response.data;
        throw new Error(typeof d === 'object' ? d.error || d.message || JSON.stringify(d) : String(d));

      throw new Error(`LAN_ERROR: ${err.message}`);

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\batch-alloc.js`

```javascript
/**
 * batch-alloc.js
 * محرك تخصيص دفعات المخزون بطريقة الوارد أولاً يصرف أولاً (FIFO / FEFO)
 * وإدارة البيع بالسالب وتسوية ديون المخزون تلقائياً
 */

'use strict';

const RESTORE_STOCK_SQL = `
  UPDATE inventory_batches
  SET stock = stock + ?
  WHERE id = COALESCE(
    (SELECT id FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL),
    (
      SELECT b2.id FROM inventory_batches b2
      WHERE b2.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = ?)
        AND b2.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY (b2.expiry_date IS NULL), b2.expiry_date ASC, b2.created_at ASC, b2.id ASC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  )
`;

function fetchFifoBatches(db, { productId, variantId = null, onlyPositive = false }, callback) {
  const params = [Number(productId)];
  let variantCond = '';

  if (variantId !== null && variantId !== undefined && variantId !== '') {
    variantCond = 'AND variant_id = ?';
    params.push(Number(variantId));
  }

  const positiveCond = onlyPositive ? 'AND COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0' : '';

  const sql = `
    SELECT
      id,
      uuid,
      product_id,
      variant_id,
      COALESCE(stock, 0) AS stock,
      COALESCE(cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      wholesale_price,
      expiry_date,
      location,
      display_code,
      supplier_id,
      created_at
    FROM inventory_batches
    WHERE product_id = ?
      AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ${variantCond}
      ${positiveCond}
    ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
  `;

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    return db.all(sql, params, callback);
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

async function deductFromBatch(db, options = {}, callback) {
  const work = async () => {
    const productId = Number(options.productId || options.product_id);
    const variantId = options.variantId !== undefined ? options.variantId : options.variant_id ?? null;
    const preferredBatchId = options.batchId !== undefined ? options.batchId : options.batch_id ?? null;
    const requestedQty = Number(options.quantity ?? 0);

    if (!productId || !Number.isFinite(requestedQty) || requestedQty === 0) {
      return {
        allocations: [],
        deductedQty: 0,
        shortfallQty: 0,
        soldWithoutStock: 0,
        primaryBatchId: preferredBatchId || null,
        costPrice: null
      };
    }

    // حالة إرجاع المبيعات (كمية سالبة)
    if (requestedQty < 0) {
      const returnQty = Math.abs(requestedQty);
      const batches = await fetchFifoBatches(db, { productId, variantId, onlyPositive: false });
      const targetBatch =
        (preferredBatchId && batches.find((b) => Number(b.id) === Number(preferredBatchId))) ||
        batches[0] ||
        null;

      if (targetBatch) {
        await db.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = COALESCE(stock, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', [
          returnQty,
          targetBatch.id
        ]);
      }

      return {
        allocations: [
          {
            batchId: targetBatch ? targetBatch.id : preferredBatchId,
            quantity: -returnQty,
            costPrice: targetBatch ? targetBatch.cost_price : null,
            soldWithoutStock: 0
          }
        ],
        deductedQty: -returnQty,
        shortfallQty: 0,
        soldWithoutStock: 0,
        primaryBatchId: targetBatch ? targetBatch.id : preferredBatchId,
        costPrice: targetBatch ? targetBatch.cost_price : null
      };
    }

    // حالة البيع القياسية (كمية موجبة)
    const batches = await fetchFifoBatches(db, { productId, variantId, onlyPositive: false });
    const ordered = batches.slice();

    if (preferredBatchId) {
      const idx = ordered.findIndex((b) => Number(b.id) === Number(preferredBatchId));
      if (idx > 0) {
        const [picked] = ordered.splice(idx, 1);
        ordered.unshift(picked);
      }
    }

    let remaining = requestedQty;
    const allocations = [];

    for (const batch of ordered) {
      if (remaining <= 0) break;
      const avail = Math.max(0, Number(batch.stock || 0));
      if (avail <= 0) continue;

      const take = Math.min(avail, remaining);
      await db.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = COALESCE(stock, 0) - ? WHERE id = ?', [
        take,
        batch.id
      ]);

      allocations.push({
        batchId: batch.id,
        variantId: batch.variant_id ?? variantId ?? null,
        quantity: take,
        costPrice: batch.cost_price,
        sellingPrice: batch.selling_price,
        soldWithoutStock: 0
      });

      remaining = Number((remaining - take).toFixed(6));
    }

    let shortfallQty = 0;
    if (remaining > 0.000001) {
      shortfallQty = remaining;
      const fallback =
        (preferredBatchId && ordered.find((b) => Number(b.id) === Number(preferredBatchId))) ||
        ordered[0] ||
        null;

      allocations.push({
        batchId: fallback ? fallback.id : preferredBatchId || null,
        variantId: fallback ? fallback.variant_id : variantId || null,
        quantity: shortfallQty,
        costPrice: fallback ? fallback.cost_price : null,
        sellingPrice: fallback ? fallback.selling_price : null,
        soldWithoutStock: 1
      });
    }

    const primaryBatchId =
      allocations.length > 0
        ? allocations[0].batchId
        : preferredBatchId || (ordered[0] && ordered[0].id) || null;

    const primaryCost =
      allocations.length > 0 && allocations[0].costPrice !== null
        ? allocations[0].costPrice
        : ordered[0]
          ? ordered[0].cost_price
          : null;

    return {
      allocations,
      deductedQty: Number((requestedQty - shortfallQty).toFixed(6)),
      shortfallQty,
      soldWithoutStock: shortfallQty > 0 ? 1 : 0,
      primaryBatchId,
      costPrice: primaryCost
    };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((r) => callback(null, r)).catch((e) => callback(e));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

async function restoreBatch(db, { batchId, quantity, soldWithoutStock = 0 }, callback) {
  const work = async () => {
    const qty = Number(quantity || 0);
    if (!batchId || !Number.isFinite(qty) || qty === 0 || Number(soldWithoutStock) === 1) {
      return { restored: 0 };
    }
    const res = await db.dbRun(RESTORE_STOCK_SQL, [qty, batchId, batchId]);
    return { restored: qty, changes: res.changes };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((r) => callback(null, r)).catch((e) => callback(e));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

async function reconcileStockDebt(db, productId, targetBatchId = null, callback) {
  const work = async () => {
    if (!productId) return { reconciled: 0 };

    const openDebts = await db.dbAll(
      `SELECT id, quantity, batch_id, variant_id, sale_id
       FROM stock_debt
       WHERE product_id = ? AND resolved = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
       ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC`,
      [Number(productId)]
    );

    if (openDebts.length === 0) return { reconciled: 0 };

    const batchParams = [Number(productId)];
    let batchCond = '';
    if (targetBatchId) {
      batchCond = 'AND id = ?';
      batchParams.push(Number(targetBatchId));
    }

    const batches = await db.dbAll(
      `SELECT id, stock, variant_id
       FROM inventory_batches
       WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0
       ${batchCond}
       ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC`,
      batchParams
    );

    if (batches.length === 0) return { reconciled: 0 };

    let totalReconciled = 0;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    for (const batch of batches) {
      let avail = Number(batch.stock || 0);
      if (avail <= 0) continue;

      for (const debt of openDebts) {
        if (avail <= 0) break;
        if (debt._done) continue;
        if (batch.variant_id && debt.variant_id && Number(batch.variant_id) !== Number(debt.variant_id)) {
          continue;
        }

        const debtQty = Number(debt.quantity || 0);
        if (debtQty <= 0) continue;

        if (avail >= debtQty) {
          await db.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [debtQty, batch.id]);
          await db.dbRun('UPDATE stock_debt SET resolved = 1, resolved_at = ? WHERE id = ?', [nowIso, debt.id]);
          avail = Number((avail - debtQty).toFixed(6));
          debt._done = true;
          totalReconciled = Number((totalReconciled + debtQty).toFixed(6));
        } else {
          const partial = avail;
          const rem = Number((debtQty - partial).toFixed(6));
          await db.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [partial, batch.id]);
          await db.dbRun('UPDATE stock_debt SET quantity = ?, resolved = 1, resolved_at = ? WHERE id = ?', [
            partial,
            nowIso,
            debt.id
          ]);
          await db.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO stock_debt (product_id, variant_id, batch_id, sale_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
            [Number(productId), debt.variant_id || null, debt.batch_id || batch.id, debt.sale_id || null, rem]
          );
          debt.quantity = rem;
          avail = 0;
          totalReconciled = Number((totalReconciled + partial).toFixed(6));
        }
      }
    }

    return { reconciled: totalReconciled };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((r) => callback(null, r)).catch((e) => callback(e));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

async function voidBatches(db, batchIds = [], options = {}, callback) {
  if (typeof options === 'function') {
    callback = options;
    options = {};
  }

  const work = async () => {
    const cleanIds = Array.from(
      new Set((Array.isArray(batchIds) ? batchIds : [batchIds]).map(Number).filter(Boolean))
    );
    if (cleanIds.length === 0) {
      return { blocked: false, voidedIds: [], deletedIds: [], soldBatchIds: [] };
    }

    const placeholders = cleanIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
    const soldRows = await db.dbAll(
      `SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM sale_items WHERE batch_id IN (${placeholders}) AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      cleanIds
    );
    const soldBatchIds = soldRows.map((r) => Number(r.batch_id)).filter(Boolean);

    if (options.refuseIfSold && soldBatchIds.length > 0) {
      return { blocked: true, soldBatchIds, voidedIds: [], deletedIds: [] };
    }

    await db.dbRun(
      `UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = 0 WHERE id IN (${placeholders}) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(stock, 0) <> 0`,
      cleanIds
    );

    const deletableIds = options.keepSoldRowsActive
      ? cleanIds.filter((id) => !soldBatchIds.includes(id))
      : cleanIds;

    if (deletableIds.length > 0) {
      await db.dbRun(
        `DELETE FROM inventory_batches WHERE id IN (${deletableIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`,
        deletableIds
      );
    }

    return { blocked: false, soldBatchIds, voidedIds: cleanIds, deletedIds: deletableIds };
  };

  if (typeof callback === 'function') {
    work().then((r) => callback(null, r)).catch((e) => callback(e));
    return;
  }
  return work();
}

module.exports = {
  RESTORE_STOCK_SQL,
  fetchFifoBatches,
  deductFromBatch,
  restoreBatch,
  reconcileStockDebt,
  voidBatches
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-db-sync.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-db-sync.js
 * محرك المزامنة السحابية الثنائية للجداول (Bi-Directional LWW Cloud DB Sync)
 */

'use strict';

const { signedRequest } = require('./device-auth');
const stockLedger = require('./stock-ledger');

const SYNC_TABLES_ORDER = [
  'shop_info',
  'users',
  'custom_templates',
  'suppliers',
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'inventory_batches',
  'product_serials',
  'stock_movements',
  'stock_debt',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items',
  'expenses',
  'capital_injections',
  'caisse_transactions'
];

const IMAGE_TABLES = ['products', 'product_variants', 'product_bundles'];

function createCloudDbSync({ db, getSetting, setSetting, getMainWindow }) {
  let pushTimer = null;
  let pullTimer = null;
  let isSyncing = false;
  let lastStatus = {
    enabled: false,
    syncing: false,
    lastPushAt: null,
    lastPullAt: null,
    lastError: null,
    dirtyCount: 0
  };

  function emitStatus() {
    const win = typeof getMainWindow === 'function' ? getMainWindow() : null;
    if (win && !win.isDestroyed() && win.webContents) {
      win.webContents.send('cloud-sync:status', lastStatus);
    }
  }

  function emitDataChanged(changedTables = []) {
    const win = typeof getMainWindow === 'function' ? getMainWindow() : null;
    if (win && !win.isDestroyed() && win.webContents) {
      win.webContents.send('cloud-sync:data-changed', { tables: changedTables });
    }
  }

  async function countTotalDirty() {
    let total = 0;
    for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
      try {
        const r = await db.dbGet(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ${tbl} WHERE dirty = 1`);
        total += Number((r && r.n) || 0);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    lastStatus.dirtyCount = total;
    return total;
  }

  async function gatherTableBatch(tableName, limit = 150) {
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    return await db.dbAll(
      `
      SELECT t.*
      FROM ${tableName} t
      LEFT JOIN sync_row_errors qe ON qe.table_name = ? AND qe.uuid = t.uuid
      WHERE t.dirty = 1
        AND t.uuid IS NOT NULL AND t.uuid <> ''
        AND (qe.next_retry_ms IS NULL OR qe.next_retry_ms <= ?)
      ORDER BY t.id ASC
      LIMIT ?
      `,
      [tableName, nowMs, limit]
    );
  }

  async function applyPulledRow(tableName, rowData) {
    if (!rowData || !rowData.uuid) return false;
    const colInfo = await db.dbAll(`PRAGMA table_info(${tableName})`);
    const validCols = new Set(colInfo.map((c) => c.name));

    const cols = [];
    const vals = [];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rowData)) {
      if (k === 'id') continue;
      if (validCols.has(k)) {
        cols.push(k);
        vals.push(v);
      }
    }

    if (validCols.has('dirty')) {
      const idx = cols.indexOf('dirty');
      if (idx === -1) {
        cols.push('dirty');
        vals.push(0);
      } else {
        vals[idx] = 0;
      }
    }

    const placeholders = cols.map(() => '?').join(', ');
    const updates = cols
      .filter((c) => c !== 'uuid')
      .map((c) => `${c} = excluded.${c}`)
      .join(', ');

    await db.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO ${tableName} (${cols.join(', ')})
      VALUES (${placeholders})
      ON CONFLICT(uuid) DO UPDATE SET
        ${updates}
      WHERE ${tableName}.updated_at IS NULL
         OR excluded.updated_at IS NULL
         OR datetime(excluded.updated_at) >= datetime(${tableName}.updated_at)
      `,
      vals
    );
    return true;
  }

  async function pushDirtyRows() {
    const payloadTables = {};
    let totalGathered = 0;

    for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
      const rows = await gatherTableBatch(tbl, 150);
      if (rows.length > 0) {
        payloadTables[tbl] = rows;
        totalGathered += rows.length;
      }
      if (totalGathered >= 400) break;
    }

    if (totalGathered === 0) return { pushed: 0 };

    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/api/cloud/sync/push',
      data: { tables: payloadTables }
    });

    const accepted = (res && res.accepted) || {};
    for (const [tbl, uuids] of Object.entries(accepted)) {
      if (Array.isArray(uuids) && uuids.length > 0) {
        const ph = uuids.map(() => '?').join(',');
        await db.dbRun(`UPDATE ${tbl} SET dirty = 0 WHERE uuid IN (${ph})`, uuids);
        await db.dbRun(`DELETE FROM sync_row_errors WHERE table_name = ? AND uuid IN (${ph})`, [tbl, ...uuids]);
      }
    }

    lastStatus.lastPushAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return { pushed: totalGathered };
  }

  async function pullRemoteChanges() {
    const cursorRows = await db.dbAll('SELECT table_name, last_rev FROM sync_cursors');
    const cursors = {};
    for (const r of cursorRows) cursors[r.table_name] = Number(r.last_rev || 0);

    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(cursors));
    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/api/cloud/sync/pull?cursors=${encoded}&include_self=1`
    });
    if (!res) return { pulled: 0 };

    const serverTables = (res && res.tables) || {};
    const changedTables = [];
    let totalPulled = 0;

    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
        const tData = serverTables[tbl];
        if (!tData || !Array.isArray(tData.rows) || tData.rows.length === 0) continue;

        changedTables.push(tbl);
        let maxRev = cursors[tbl] || 0;

        for (const row of tData.rows) {
          try {
            await applyPulledRow(tbl, row);
            totalPulled += 1;
            if (row.server_rev && Number(row.server_rev) > maxRev) {
              maxRev = Number(row.server_rev);
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO sync_cursors (table_name, last_rev, last_pulled_at)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?)
           ON CONFLICT(table_name) DO UPDATE SET last_rev = excluded.last_rev, last_pulled_at = excluded.last_pulled_at`,
          [tbl, maxRev, new Date().toISOString()]
        );
      }
    });

    if (changedTables.length > 0) {
      emitDataChanged(changedTables);
    }
    lastStatus.lastPullAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return { pulled: totalPulled, changedTables };
  }

  async function triggerNow() {
    const token = await getSetting('cloud_token', '');
    if (!token) {
      lastStatus.enabled = false;
      emitStatus();
      return { ok: false, reason: 'no_cloud_token' };
    }
    if (isSyncing) return { ok: true, busy: true };

    isSyncing = true;
    lastStatus.enabled = true;
    lastStatus.syncing = true;
    emitStatus();

    try {
      const pushRes = await pushDirtyRows();
      const pullRes = await pullRemoteChanges();
      await countTotalDirty();
      lastStatus.lastError = null;
      return { ok: true, ...pushRes, ...pullRes };
    } catch (err) {
      lastStatus.lastError = err.message;
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    } finally {
      isSyncing = false;
      lastStatus.syncing = false;
      emitStatus();
    }
  }

  async function runFreshBootstrap() {
    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM fresh_bootstrap_images');
    for (const tbl of IMAGE_TABLES) {
      await db.dbRun(
        `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fresh_bootstrap_images (tbl, uuid, image)
         SELECT ?, uuid, image FROM ${tbl}
         WHERE image IS NOT NULL AND image != '' AND uuid IS NOT NULL AND uuid != ''`,
        [tbl]
      );
    }

    const tablesToWipe = [...SYNC_TABLES_ORDER].reverse().filter((t) => t !== 'users');
    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      for (const tbl of tablesToWipe) {
        await db.dbRun(`DELETE FROM ${tbl}`);
      }
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
    });

    let pages = 0;
    while (pages < 50) {
      const pullRes = await pullRemoteChanges();
      pages += 1;
      if (!pullRes || pullRes.pulled === 0) break;
    }

    for (const tbl of IMAGE_TABLES) {
      await db.dbRun(
        `UPDATE ${tbl}
         SET image = (SELECT b.image FROM fresh_bootstrap_images b WHERE b.tbl = ? AND b.uuid = ${tbl}.uuid)
         WHERE (image IS NULL OR image = '') AND uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM fresh_bootstrap_images WHERE tbl = ?)`,
        [tbl, tbl]
      );
    }

    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM fresh_bootstrap_images');
    await stockLedger.recomputeAllBatches(db);
    return { ok: true, pagesPulled: pages };
  }

  function start() {
    stop();
    lastStatus.enabled = true;
    pushTimer = setInterval(() => triggerNow(), 8000);
    pullTimer = setInterval(() => triggerNow(), 15000);
    setTimeout(() => triggerNow(), 1500);
  }

  function stop() {
    if (pushTimer) clearInterval(pushTimer);
    if (pullTimer) clearInterval(pullTimer);
    pushTimer = null;
    pullTimer = null;
    lastStatus.enabled = false;
    emitStatus();
  }

  return {
    start,
    stop,
    triggerNow,
    getStatus: async () => {
      await countTotalDirty();
      return lastStatus;
    },
    setMode: async (mode) => {
      if (mode === 'cloud' || mode === 'both') start();
      else stop();
      return lastStatus;
    },
    pushSnapshot: async () => {
      for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
        await db.dbRun(`UPDATE ${tbl} SET dirty = 1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`);
      }
      return await triggerNow();
    },
    wipeCloudData: async () => {
      const res = await signedRequest(db, { method: 'POST', path: '/api/cloud/sync/wipe', data: {} });
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      return res || { ok: true };
    },
    runFreshBootstrap,
    backfillFromOwner: async () => {
      await stockLedger.repairMissingMovements(db);
      return await triggerNow();
    },
    resetAndResync: async () => {
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      return await triggerNow();
    }
  };
}

module.exports = {
  SYNC_TABLES_ORDER,
  createCloudDbSync
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-diagnostics.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-diagnostics.js
 * أداة الفحص الهندسي العميق لسلامة الجداول، المشغلات (Triggers)، ودفتر حركات المخزون
 */

'use strict';

const { signedRequest } = require('./device-auth');

async function deepDiagnose(db) {
  const triggers = await db.dbAll(
    "SELECT name, tbl_name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'trigger' ORDER BY name ASC"
  );

  const counts = await db.dbGet(`
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_products,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_batches,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE COALESCE(stock, 0) <> 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS batches_with_stock,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_movements,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_sales
  `);

  const recentMovements = await db.dbAll(
    `SELECT id, uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, delta, reason, origin_device, occurred_at
     FROM stock_movements
     ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25`
  );

  const syncErrors = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM sync_row_errors LIMIT 50');

  return {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    counts,
    triggersCount: triggers.length,
    triggers,
    recentMovements,
    syncErrors
  };
}

async function sendDiagnostics(db, extraPayload = {}) {
  const report = await deepDiagnose(db);
  try {
    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/api/cloud/diagnostics',
      data: { ...extraPayload, report }
    });
    return { ok: true, serverResponse: res, report };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err.message, report };
  }
}

module.exports = {
  deepDiagnose,
  sendDiagnostics
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-sync.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-sync.js
 * محرك مزامنة طابور الأحداث الصادرة (sync_outbox) مع الخادم السحابي
 */

'use strict';

const axios = require('axios');

async function postSyncEvent(cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId, eventType, payload) {
  const cleanUrl = String(cloudUrl || 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const res = await axios.post(
    `${cleanUrl}/api/pos/sync/event`,
    {
      instance_id: instanceId,
      event_type: eventType,
      payload
    },
    {
      timeout: 15000,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${cloudToken}`
      }
    }
  );
  return res.data;
}

async function runCloudSync(db, options = {}) {
  const maxBatch = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBatch || 50));
  const cloudUrl = await db.getSetting('cloud_url', 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai');
  const cloudToken = await db.getSetting('cloud_token', '');
  const instanceId = await db.getSetting('instance_id', '');

  if (!cloudToken) {
    return { synced: 0, skipped: true, reason: 'missing_cloud_token' };
  }

  const pending = await db.dbAll(
    'SELECT id, event_type, payload_json FROM sync_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?',
    [maxBatch]
  );

  let synced = 0;
  for (const row of pending) {
    try {
      let payload = {};
      try {
        payload = JSON.parse(row.payload_json || '{}');
      } catch (_) {}

      await postSyncEvent(cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId, row.event_type, payload);
      await db.dbRun('UPDATE sync_outbox SET sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?', [row.id]);
      synced += 1;
    } catch (err) {
      return { synced, error: 'send_failed', message: err.message };
    }
  }

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.dbRun("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('last_cloud_sync_at', ?)", [
    nowIso
  ]);

  return { synced, lastSyncAt: nowIso };
}

module.exports = {
  postSyncEvent,
  runCloudSync
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\data-revision.js`

```javascript
/**
 * data-revision.js
 * متتبع مراجعات البيانات اللحظي لتحديث واجهة الكاشير وعملاء الشبكة المحلية فور حدوث أي تغيير
 */

'use strict';

const EventEmitter = require('events');

const IGNORED_TABLES = new Set([
  'sync_cursors',
  'sync_outbox',
  'sync_row_errors',
  'pull_row_errors',
  'pending_fk_fixups',
  'device_registry',
  'fresh_bootstrap_images',
  'document_print_log',
  'sqlite_sequence'
]);

const IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS = new Set([
  'last_cloud_sync_at',
  '_skip_stock_ledger',
  'cloud_sync_epoch',
  'cloud_snapshot_done'
]);

const PRODUCT_TABLES = new Set([
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components'
]);

const STOCK_TABLES = new Set([
  'inventory_batches',
  'stock_movements',
  'stock_debt',
  'product_serials',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items'
]);

const SALES_TABLES = new Set([
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'caisse_transactions'
]);

const PARTY_TABLES = new Set([
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'suppliers',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items'
]);

class DataRevisionTracker extends EventEmitter {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.revision = 1;
    this.productsRev = 1;
    this.stockRev = 1;
    this.salesRev = 1;
    this.partiesRev = 1;
    this.settingsRev = 1;
    this.lastTable = 'init';
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions = Object.create(null);
  }

  extractTargetTable(sql) {
    if (typeof sql !== 'string') return null;
    const s = sql.trim();

    let m = /^(?:INSERT(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+INTO|REPLACE\s+INTO)\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^UPDATE(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^DELETE\s+FROM\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    return null;
  }

  isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params = []) {
    if (!table || IGNORED_TABLES.has(table)) return true;

    if (table === 'settings') {
      const str = String(sql || '');
      for (const k of IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS) {
        if (str.includes(`'${k}'`) || (Array.isArray(params) && params[0] === k)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    if (/^UPDATE\b/i.test(String(sql || '').trim())) {
      const setMatch = /\bSET\s+([\s\S]+?)(?:\bWHERE\b|$)/i.exec(sql);
      if (setMatch) {
        const cols = setMatch[1]
          .split(',')
          .map((c) => c.split('=')[0].trim().toLowerCase())
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (cols.length > 0 && cols.every((c) => c === 'dirty' || c === 'server_rev')) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  bump(table = 'general') {
    const tbl = String(table || 'general').toLowerCase();
    if (IGNORED_TABLES.has(tbl)) return this.getSnapshot();

    this.revision += 1;
    this.lastTable = tbl;
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions[tbl] = (this.tableRevisions[tbl] || 0) + 1;

    if (PRODUCT_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.productsRev += 1;
    if (STOCK_TABLES.has(tbl)) {
      this.stockRev += 1;
      this.productsRev += 1;
    }
    if (SALES_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.salesRev += 1;
    if (PARTY_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.partiesRev += 1;
    if (tbl === 'settings' || tbl === 'shop_info' || tbl === 'custom_templates') {
      this.settingsRev += 1;
    }

    const snapshot = this.getSnapshot();
    this.emit('changed', snapshot);
    return snapshot;
  }

  getSnapshot() {
    return {
      revision: this.revision,
      products: this.productsRev,
      stock: this.stockRev,
      sales: this.salesRev,
      parties: this.partiesRev,
      settings: this.settingsRev,
      lastTable: this.lastTable,
      updatedAt: this.lastUpdatedAt,
      tables: { ...this.tableRevisions }
    };
  }
}

const defaultTracker = new DataRevisionTracker();

function installDataRevisionHook(db, tracker = defaultTracker) {
  if (!db || db._dataRevisionInstalled) return tracker;

  const prevRun = db.run.bind(db);

  db.run = function hookedRevisionRun(sql, ...args) {
    const table = tracker.extractTargetTable(sql);
    const params = Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : [];
    const shouldBump = table && !tracker.isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params);

    if (!shouldBump) {
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    const lastIdx = args.length - 1;
    if (lastIdx >= 0 && typeof args[lastIdx] === 'function') {
      const origCb = args[lastIdx];
      args[lastIdx] = function wrappedCallback(err, ...cbArgs) {
        if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
        return origCb.call(this, err, ...cbArgs);
      };
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    return prevRun(sql, ...args, function autoCallback(err) {
      if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
    });
  };

  db._dataRevisionTracker = tracker;
  db._dataRevisionInstalled = true;
  return tracker;
}

module.exports = {
  DataRevisionTracker,
  tracker: defaultTracker,
  getDataRevision: () => defaultTracker.getSnapshot(),
  bumpRevision: (tbl) => defaultTracker.bump(tbl),
  installDataRevisionHook
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\database.js`

```javascript
/**
 * database.js
 * المخطط الشامل لقاعدة بيانات Gherbi.Ai POS (42 جدولاً، فهارس الأداء، ومشغلات المزامنة والمخزون)
 */

'use strict';

const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { attachWriteQueue } = require('./db-write-queue');
const { installSoftDeleteShim } = require('./soft-delete');
const { installDataRevisionHook, tracker: dataRevisionTracker } = require('./data-revision');

function resolveDatabaseFilePath() {
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      const dir = app.getPath('userData');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      return path.join(dir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  if (!fs.existsSync(fallbackDir)) fs.mkdirSync(fallbackDir, { recursive: true });
  return path.join(fallbackDir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
}

const dbPath = resolveDatabaseFilePath();
const db = new sqlite3.Database(dbPath);

attachWriteQueue(db);
installSoftDeleteShim(db);
installDataRevisionHook(db);

const SYNCED_TABLES = [
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'product_serials',
  'inventory_batches',
  'stock_debt',
  'suppliers',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items',
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'caisse_transactions',
  'expenses',
  'capital_injections',
  'bom_recipes',
