## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\preload.js`

```javascript
/**
 * preload.js
 * جسر الربط الآمن والنظيف 100% (ContextBridge) بين العملية الرئيسية والواجهة الأمامية
 * خالٍ تماماً من أي تشويش، ويدعم جميع استدعاءات النظام والوحدات الفرعية
 */

'use strict';

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

const invoke = (channel, ...args) => ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, ...args);

function createEventSubscriber(channel) {
  return (callback) => {
    if (typeof callback !== 'function') return () => {};
    const handler = (_event, payload) => callback(payload);
    ipcRenderer.on(channel, handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, handler);
  };
}

const api = {
  // 1. المراجعات، الإعدادات، ومعلومات التطبيق
  getDataRevision: () => invoke('get-data-revision'),
  getAppVersion: () => invoke('get-app-version'),
  checkUpdate: () => invoke('check-update'),
  openExternalLink: (url) => invoke('open-external-link', url),
  openYoutubeVideo: (url) => invoke('open-youtube-video', url),
  relaunchApp: () => invoke('app-relaunch'),
  getSettings: () => invoke('get-settings'),
  updateSettings: (settingsObj) => invoke('update-settings', settingsObj),
  resetSystem: () => invoke('reset-system'),
  seedDemoData: () => invoke('seed-demo-data'),
  getPerformanceMetrics: () => invoke('get-performance-metrics'),

  // 2. المستخدمون والحسابات
  checkFirstRun: () => invoke('check-first-run'),
  setupFirstAdmin: (...args) => invoke('setup-first-admin', ...args),
  loginUser: (...args) => invoke('login-user', ...args),
  getUsers: () => invoke('get-users'),
  addUser: (userData) => invoke('add-user', userData),
  updateUser: (...args) => invoke('update-user', ...args),
  deleteUser: (id) => invoke('delete-user', id),
  updateAccount: (...args) => invoke('update-account', ...args),

  // 3. المنتجات، الدفعات، الباركودات، والمتغيرات
  getCategories: () => invoke('get-categories'),
  getFamilies: () => invoke('get-families'),
  getProductSuppliers: () => invoke('get-product-suppliers'),
  getProducts: (filters) => invoke('get-products', filters),
  getPosStock: () => invoke('get-pos-stock'),
  getProductFull: (productId) => invoke('get-product-full', productId),
  getProductAnalytics: (productId) => invoke('get-product-analytics', productId),
  addProduct: (productData) => invoke('add-product', productData),
  updateProduct: (...args) => invoke('update-product', ...args),
  deleteProduct: (productId) => invoke('delete-product', productId),
  addBatch: (...args) => invoke('add-batch', ...args),
  updateBatch: (...args) => invoke('update-batch', ...args),
  deleteBatch: (batchId) => invoke('delete-batch', batchId),
  saveProductVariants: (productId, variantData) =>
    invoke('save-product-variants', productId, variantData),
  getVariantTemplates: () => invoke('get-variant-templates'),

  processSale: (saleData) => invoke('process-sale', saleData),

  getCustomers: (filters) => invoke('get-customers', filters),
  getCustomersDebt: () => invoke('get-customers-debt'),
  addCustomer: (customerData) => invoke('add-customer', customerData),
  updateCustomer: (...args) => invoke('update-customer', ...args),
```

```html
  </div>
</body>
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\print-engine.js`

```javascript
/**
 * print-engine.js
 * محرك الطباعة وتوليد المستندات الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * يدعم:
 * - تحميل قوالب HTML الـ 40+ ومعالجة الشروط {{#if}} / {{#unless}} والمتغيرات {{KEY}}
 * - تفقيط المبالغ المالية باللغات الثلاث (العربية، الفرنسية، الإنجليزية) عبر NumberToWords
 * - توليد صور الباركود لملصقات المنتجات، بطاقات الزبائن، والوصولات الحرارية
 * - حساب حجم السعر التلقائي في وضع «ملصق السعر للرفوف» (computePriceSize)
 * - المعاينة الحية، الطباعة الصامتة المباشرة، وتصدير PDF
 */

'use strict';

if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
  module.exports = {};
} else {
  const PrintEngine = (function () {
    const templateCache = new Map();

    // خريطة أسماء ملفات القوالب القياسية
    const TEMPLATE_FILES = {
      template1: 'invoice_template_1.html',
      template2: 'invoice_template_2.html',
      template3: 'invoice_template_3.html',
      template4: 'invoice_template_4.html',
      template5: 'invoice_template_5.html',
      template6: 'invoice_template_6.html',
      template7: 'invoice_template_7.html',
      template8: 'invoice_template_8.html',
      template9: 'invoice_template_9.html',
      a5: 'invoice_template_a5.html',
      detailed: 'invoice_template_detailed.html',
      thermal80: 'invoice_thermal_80.html',
      receipt1_ar: 'receipt_template_1.html',
      receipt1_fr: 'receipt_template_1_fr.html',
      receipt1_en: 'receipt_template_1_en.html',
      receipt2_ar: 'receipt_template_2.html',
      receipt2_fr: 'receipt_template_2_fr.html',
      receipt2_en: 'receipt_template_2_en.html',
      receipt3_ar: 'receipt_template_3.html',
      receipt3_fr: 'receipt_template_3_fr.html',
      receipt3_en: 'receipt_template_3_en.html',
      receipt4_ar: 'receipt_template_4.html',
      receipt4_fr: 'receipt_template_4_fr.html',
      receipt4_en: 'receipt_template_4_en.html',
      receipt5_ar: 'receipt_template_5.html',
      receipt5_fr: 'receipt_template_5_fr.html',
      receipt5_en: 'receipt_template_5_en.html',
      credit_note_ar: 'credit_note_ar.html',
      credit_note_fr: 'credit_note_fr.html',
      credit_note_en: 'credit_note_en.html',
      delivery_ar: 'delivery_note_ar.html',
      delivery_fr: 'delivery_note_fr.html',
      delivery_en: 'delivery_note_en.html',
      delivery_a5: 'delivery_note_a5.html',
      delivery_thermal: 'delivery_note_thermal.html',
      order_ar: 'order_receipt_ar.html',
      order_fr: 'order_receipt_fr.html',
      proforma_ar: 'proforma_invoice_ar.html',
      proforma_fr: 'proforma_invoice_fr.html',
      payment_ar: 'payment_receipt_ar.html',
      payment_fr: 'payment_receipt_fr.html',
      recap_ar: 'recap_invoice_ar.html',
      recap_fr: 'recap_invoice_fr.html',
      recap_en: 'recap_invoice_en.html',
      reception_ar: 'reception_note_ar.html',
      reception_fr: 'reception_note_fr.html',
      reception_en: 'reception_note_en.html',
      sales_summary_ar: 'sales_summary_ar.html',
      sales_summary_fr: 'sales_summary_fr.html',
      sales_summary_en: 'sales_summary_en.html',
      price_list: 'price_list.html',
      barcode_label: 'barcode_label_template_1.html'
    };

    function formatMoney(value, decimals = 2) {
      const num = Number(value || 0);
      if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '0.00';
      return num.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals
      });
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      return String(str ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    /**
     * تحميل محتوى قالب HTML من الملف المحلي مع التخزين المؤقت
     */
    async function loadTemplateHtml(fileNameOrKey) {
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[fileNameOrKey] || fileNameOrKey;
      if (templateCache.has(fileName)) {
        return templateCache.get(fileName);
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`./${fileName}`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const text = await res.text();
        templateCache.set(fileName, text);
        return text;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[PrintEngine] Could not load template ${fileName}:`, err.message);
        return '';
      }
    }

    /**
     * تقييم الشروط {{#if KEY}}...{{/if}} و {{#unless KEY}}...{{/unless}} واستبدال {{KEY}}
     */
    function compileTemplate(rawHtml, data = {}) {
      if (!rawHtml) return '';
      let out = String(rawHtml);

      // معالجة {{#if KEY}} ... {{/if}}
      out = out.replace(/\{\{#if\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/if\}\}/g, (_match, key, inner) => {
        const val = data[key];
        const isTruthy =
          val !== undefined &&
          val !== null &&
          val !== false &&
          val !== '' &&
          val !== '0' &&
          val !== '0.00';
        return isTruthy ? inner : '';
      });

      // معالجة {{#unless KEY}} ... {{/unless}}
      out = out.replace(
        /\{\{#unless\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/unless\}\}/g,
        (_match, key, inner) => {
          const val = data[key];
          const isTruthy =
            val !== undefined &&
            val !== null &&
            val !== false &&
            val !== '' &&
            val !== '0' &&
            val !== '0.00';
          return !isTruthy ? inner : '';
        }
      );

      // استبدال المتغيرات {{KEY}}
      out = out.replace(/\{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/g, (_match, key) => {
        const val = data[key];
        return val !== undefined && val !== null ? String(val) : '';
      });

      return out;
    }

    /**
     * بناء البيانات المشتركة للمتجر (Company Header Data) من الإعدادات
     */
    function buildCompanyVars(settings = {}) {
      return {
        COMPANY_NAME: settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
        COMPANY_DESCRIPTION: settings.shop_description || '',
        COMPANY_ADDRESS: settings.shop_address || '',
        COMPANY_PHONE: settings.shop_phone || '',
        COMPANY_FAX: settings.shop_fax || '',
        COMPANY_EMAIL: settings.shop_email || '',
        COMPANY_RC: settings.shop_rc || '-',
        COMPANY_NIF: settings.shop_nif || '-',
        COMPANY_AI: settings.shop_ai || '-',
        COMPANY_NIS: settings.shop_nis || '-',
        COMPANY_LOGO: settings.shop_logo || ''
      };
    }

    /**
     * توليد HTML فاتورة بيع أو شراء (A4 / A5 / Detailed / Thermal 80mm)
     */
    async function renderInvoiceHtml(invoiceData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || settings.app_lang || 'ar';
      const templateKey = options.template || settings.invoice_template || 'template1';
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[templateKey] || 'invoice_template_1.html';
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(invoiceData.items) ? invoiceData.items : [];
      const taxPercent = Number(invoiceData.tax_percentage || 0);
      const subtotal = Number(invoiceData.subtotal ?? invoiceData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(invoiceData.discount || 0);
      const stampAmount = Number(invoiceData.stamp_amount || 0);
      const taxTotal = Number(((subtotal - discount) * (taxPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
      const netToPay = Number(invoiceData.total ?? (subtotal - discount + taxTotal + stampAmount));
      const paidAmount = Number(invoiceData.paid_amount ?? netToPay);
      const remainingDebt = Math.max(0, Number((netToPay - paidAmount).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(invoiceData.old_balance || 0);
      const totalDebt = Number((oldBalance + remainingDebt).toFixed(2));

      const isThermal = fileName.includes('thermal');
      const isTemplate9 = fileName.includes('template_9');

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it, idx) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || it.id || idx + 1);
        const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineTotal = Number(it.subtotal ?? (qty * price));

        if (isThermal) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <div class="t-item">
              <div class="t-name">${idx + 1}. ${name}</div>
              <div class="t-line">
                <span class="muted2">${qty} × ${formatMoney(price)}</span>
                <span class="b">${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        } else if (isTemplate9) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${ref}</td>
              <td class="desig">${name}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '-'}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        } else {
          itemsRowsHtml += `

              <td>${unit}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '0%'}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        }
      });

      const totalInWords =

          : `${formatMoney(netToPay)} DZD`;

      const labelsByLang = {

          LBL_N_INDEX: 'الرقم',

          LBL_TVA: 'TVA',
          LBL_TOTAL_HT: 'المجموع',
          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'المجموع الفرعي :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'التخفيض :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `الضريبة (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'حق الطابع :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'الصافي للدفع :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'الدين السابق :',
          LBL_REMAINING_PAY: 'الباقي من الفاتورة :',
          LBL_TOTAL_DEBT: 'إجمالي الدين الحالي :',
          LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT: 'طريقة الدفع :',
          LBL_SIGNATURE: 'الإمضاء والختم',
          LBL_DATE: 'التاريخ :',
          LBL_TEL: 'الهاتف',
          LBL_FAX: 'الفاكس',
          LBL_EMAIL: 'البريد',
          LBL_ADDRESS: 'العنوان :',
          LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX: 'أوقفت هذه الفاتورة على مبلغ :'
        },
        fr: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'FACTURE',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: invoiceData.is_purchase ? "FACTURE D'ACHAT" : 'FACTURE',
          CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL: invoiceData.is_purchase ? 'Fournisseur' : 'Client',
          LBL_N_INDEX: 'N°',
          LBL_REF: 'Réf',
          LBL_DESIGNATION: 'Désignation',
          LBL_QTY: 'Qté',
          LBL_UNIT: 'Unité',
          LBL_UNIT_PRICE: 'P.U. HT',
          LBL_TVA: 'TVA',
          LBL_TOTAL_HT: 'Montant HT',
          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'Total HT :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'Remise :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `TVA (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'Timbre :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'Net à Payer TTC :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'Ancien Solde :',
          LBL_REMAINING_PAY: 'Reste sur Facture :',

        },
        en: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'INVOICE',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: invoiceData.is_purchase ? 'PURCHASE INVOICE' : 'SALES INVOICE',
          CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL: invoiceData.is_purchase ? 'Supplier' : 'Customer',
          LBL_N_INDEX: '#',
          LBL_REF: 'Ref',
          LBL_DESIGNATION: 'Description',
          LBL_QTY: 'Qty',
          LBL_UNIT: 'Unit',
          LBL_UNIT_PRICE: 'Unit Price',
          LBL_TVA: 'VAT',
          LBL_TOTAL_HT: 'Total',
          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'Subtotal :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'Discount :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `VAT (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'Stamp Duty :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'Net to Pay :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'Previous Balance :',
          LBL_REMAINING_PAY: 'Remaining Due :',
          LBL_TOTAL_DEBT: 'Total Balance Due :',
          LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT: 'Payment Method :',
          LBL_SIGNATURE: 'Stamp & Signature',

    /**
     * توليد وصل البيع الحراري السريع (Thermal Receipt 80mm / 58mm)
     */
    async function renderReceiptHtml(saleData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || 'ar';
      const baseNum = String(options.template || settings.receipt_template || 'receipt1').replace(/\D/g, '') || '1';
      const suffix = lang === 'fr' ? '_fr' : lang === 'en' ? '_en' : '';
      const fileName = `receipt_template_${baseNum}${suffix}.html`;
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
      const subtotal = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? saleData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(saleData.discount || 0);
      const total = Number(saleData.total ?? (subtotal - discount));
      const paid = Number(saleData.paid_amount ?? total);
      const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
      const change = Math.max(0, Number((paid - total).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(saleData.old_balance || 0);

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineSub = Number(it.subtotal ?? (qty * price));
        itemsRowsHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${name}</td>
            <td>${qty}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(lineSub)}</td>
          </tr>`;
      });

      const now = new Date(saleData.sale_date || Date.now());
      const dateStr = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const timeStr = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);

      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        RECEIPT_NUMBER: saleData.doc_number || saleData.id || '0001',
        DATE: dateStr,
        TIME: timeStr,
        CLIENT_NAME: saleData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        CLIENT_CODE: saleData.customer_id || '-',
        SELLER_NAME: saleData.seller_name || 'البائع',
        ITEMS_COUNT: items.length,
        ITEMS_ROWS: itemsRowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotal),
        DISCOUNT: formatMoney(discount),
        TOTAL: formatMoney(total),
        PAID: formatMoney(paid),
        RECEIPT_REST: formatMoney(rest),
        REST: formatMoney( oldBalance + rest),
        OLD_BALANCE: formatMoney(oldBalance),
        CHANGE: formatMoney(change),
        PAYMENT_MODE: saleData.payment_method || 'نقداً',
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS:
          window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function'
            ? window.NumberToWords.toWords(total, lang)
            : ''
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    /**
     * توليد ملصق الباركود أو ملصق سعر الرفوف (barcode_label_template_1.html)
     */
    async function renderBarcodeLabelHtml(labelData = {}, settings = {}) {
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml('barcode_label_template_1.html');
      const labelW = Number(labelData.widthMm || settings.label_width_mm || 40);
      const labelH = Number(labelData.heightMm || settings.label_height_mm || 25);
      const barcodeH = Number(labelData.barcodeHeightMm || settings.label_barcode_height_mm || 11);
      const isPriceMode = Boolean(labelData.priceOnlyMode);

      let barcodeImg = labelData.barcodeImage || '';
      if (!barcodeImg && !isPriceMode && labelData.barcode && window.api && window.api.generateBarcodeImage) {
        barcodeImg = await window.api.generateBarcodeImage(labelData.barcode, {
          bcid: 'code128',
          height: barcodeH,
          scale: 3
        });
      }

      const priceStr = labelData.price !== undefined ? `${formatMoney(labelData.price)} د.ج` : '';
      const computedPriceSize = Math.max(4.5, Math.min(11, (labelW / Math.max(6, priceStr.length)) * 1.45)).toFixed(1);

      const vars = {
        LABEL_W: labelW,
        LABEL_H: labelH,
        BARCODE_H: barcodeH,
        PRICE_SIZE: computedPriceSize,
        MODE_CLASS: isPriceMode ? 'mode-price' : '',
        SHOP_NAME: escapeHtml(settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS'),
        PRODUCT_NAME: escapeHtml(labelData.name || ''),
        BARCODE_IMAGE: barcodeImg || '',
        BARCODE_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.barcode || ''),
        PRICE_TEXT: priceStr,
        PRICE_TYPE: escapeHtml(labelData.priceType || ''),
        DISCOUNT_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.discountText || ''),
        VARIANTS_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.variantsText || ''),
        PLU_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.plu || ''),
        CUST_PHONE: escapeHtml(labelData.custPhone || ''),
        CUST_DEBT: escapeHtml(labelData.custDebt || ''),
        CUST_DATE: escapeHtml(labelData.custDate || ''),
        HIDE_SHOP: labelData.showShop ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_NAME: labelData.showName === false ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_BARCODE: isPriceMode || !barcodeImg ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_BCTEXT: isPriceMode || labelData.showBarcodeText === false ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_PRICE: labelData.showPrice ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_PRICETYPE: labelData.showPriceType && labelData.priceType ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_DISCOUNT: labelData.showDiscount && labelData.discountText ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_VARIANTS: labelData.showVariants && labelData.variantsText ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_PLU: labelData.showPlu && labelData.plu ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTPHONE: labelData.custPhone ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTDEBT: labelData.custDebt ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTDATE: labelData.custDate ? '' : 'hidden'
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    /**
     * طباعة أي محتوى HTML (إما صامتاً عبر Electron أو عبر نافذة معاينة)
     */
    async function printHtmlDocument(htmlContent, options = {}) {
      if (!htmlContent) return { success: false, error: 'empty_html' };
      const silent = Boolean(options.silent);

      if (silent && window.api && typeof window.api.printSilent === 'function') {
        return await window.api.printSilent({
          html: htmlContent,
          silent: true,
          printerName: options.printerName || undefined
        });
      }

      // فتح في نافذة معاينة/طباعة منبثقة
      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
      iframe.style.right = '0';
      iframe.style.bottom = '0';
      iframe.style.width = '0';
      iframe.style.height = '0';
      iframe.style.border = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(iframe);

      const doc = iframe.contentWindow.document;
      doc.open();
      doc.write(htmlContent);
      doc.close();

      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
      iframe.contentWindow.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow.print();

      setTimeout(() => {
        if (iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
      }, 2000);

      return { success: true };
    }

    return {
      TEMPLATE_FILES,
      formatMoney,
      loadTemplateHtml,
      compileTemplate,
      renderInvoiceHtml,
      renderReceiptHtml,
      renderBarcodeLabelHtml,
      printHtmlDocument
    };
  })();

  window.PrintEngine = PrintEngine;
}
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\product-write.js`

```javascript
/**
 * product-write.js
 * محرك كتابة وتحديث المنتجات، الباركودات الإضافية، مستويات الأسعار، ومصفوفة المتغيرات (Variants)
 */

'use strict';

const { processImage } = require('./imageUtils');

function createProductWriter(db) {
  function rawGet(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawGet ? db._rawGet.bind(db) : db.get.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  function rawRun(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawRun ? db._rawRun.bind(db) : db.run.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  }

  async function freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode) {
    const clean = String(barcode || '').trim();
    if (!clean) return;

    const prod = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM products WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (prod && prod.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE products SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [prod.id]
      );
    }

    const pb = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM product_barcodes WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (pb && pb.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE product_barcodes SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [pb.id]
      );
    }

    const pv = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM product_variants WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (pv && pv.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE product_variants SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [pv.id]
      );
    }
  }

  async function insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices(productId, extraBarcodes = [], extraPrices = []) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_barcodes WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_prices WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);

    for (const item of Array.isArray(extraBarcodes) ? extraBarcodes : []) {
      const bc = String((typeof item === 'object' ? item.barcode : item) || '').trim();
      const priceLabel = typeof item === 'object' && item.price_label ? String(item.price_label).trim() : null;
      if (!bc) continue;

      await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(bc);
      const existing = await rawGet('SELECT id FROM product_barcodes WHERE barcode = ?', [bc]);
      if (existing) {
        await rawRun(
          "UPDATE product_barcodes SET product_id = ?, price_label = ?, deleted_at = NULL, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
          [pid, priceLabel, existing.id]
        );
      } else {
        await db.dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO product_barcodes (product_id, barcode, price_label) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
          [pid, bc, priceLabel]
        );
      }
    }

    for (const pr of Array.isArray(extraPrices) ? extraPrices : []) {
      if (!pr || typeof pr !== 'object') continue;
      const label = String(pr.label || '').trim();
      const price = Number(pr.price);
      if (!label || !Number.isFinite(price)) continue;

      await db.dbRun('INSERT INTO product_prices (product_id, label, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [
        pid,
        label,
        price
      ]);
    }
  }

  async function insertVariantData(productId, optionGroups = [], variants = [], defaultLocation = null) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const groupValueMap = new Map();

    for (let gIdx = 0; gIdx < optionGroups.length; gIdx++) {
      const g = optionGroups[gIdx];
      const gName = String(g.name || '').trim();
      if (!gName) continue;

      const gIns = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_option_groups (product_id, name, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
        [pid, gName, gIdx]
      );
      const groupId = gIns.lastID;
      const valMap = new Map();

      const values = Array.isArray(g.values) ? g.values : [];
      for (let vIdx = 0; vIdx < values.length; vIdx++) {
        const rawVal = typeof values[vIdx] === 'object' ? values[vIdx].value : values[vIdx];
        const vLabel = String(rawVal || '').trim();
        if (!vLabel) continue;

        const vIns = await db.dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO product_option_values (option_group_id, value, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
          [groupId, vLabel, vIdx]
        );
        valMap.set(vLabel.toLowerCase(), vIns.lastID);
      }
      groupValueMap.set(gName.toLowerCase(), valMap);
    }

    for (const v of Array.isArray(variants) ? variants : []) {
      const vBarcode = v.barcode ? String(v.barcode).trim() : null;
      if (vBarcode) await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(vBarcode);

      const vImg = v.image ? processImage(v.image) : null;
      const isActive = v.is_active !== undefined ? (v.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1;

      const vIns = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_variants (product_id, barcode, sku, image, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        [pid, vBarcode, v.sku || null, vImg, isActive]
      );
      const variantId = vIns.lastID;

      const optVals = v.option_values || v.options || {};
      if (Array.isArray(optVals)) {
        for (const item of optVals) {
          const gKey = String(item.group_name || item.group || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const vKey = String(item.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const vMap = groupValueMap.get(gKey);
          const optValId = vMap ? vMap.get(vKey) : null;
          if (optValId) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO variant_option_values (variant_id, option_value_id) VALUES (?, ?)',
              [variantId, optValId]
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (typeof optVals === 'object' && optVals !== null) {
        for (const [gName, valLabel] of Object.entries(optVals)) {
          const vMap = groupValueMap.get(String(gName).trim().toLowerCase());
          const optValId = vMap ? vMap.get(String(valLabel).trim().toLowerCase()) : null;
          if (optValId) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO variant_option_values (variant_id, option_value_id) VALUES (?, ?)',
              [variantId, optValId]
            );
          }
        }
      }

      await db.dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
          product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          pid,
          variantId,
          Number(v.stock ?? 0),
          Number(v.cost_price ?? 0),
          Number(v.selling_price ?? 0),
          v.wholesale_price !== undefined && v.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(v.wholesale_price) : null,
          v.expiry_date || null,
          v.location || defaultLocation || null
        ]
      );
    }
  }

  async function rewriteProductVariants(productId, variantData = {}) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const optionGroups = variantData.option_groups || variantData.optionGroups || [];
    const variants = variantData.variants || [];
    const hasVariants = variants.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM variant_option_values WHERE variant_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = ?)',
        [pid]
      );
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM product_option_values WHERE option_group_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_option_groups WHERE product_id = ?)',
        [pid]
      );
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_option_groups WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM sale_items WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL)',
        [pid]
      );

      await db.dbRun('UPDATE products SET has_variants = ? WHERE id = ?', [hasVariants, pid]);

      if (hasVariants) {
        await insertVariantData(pid, optionGroups, variants, variantData.batch_location || null);
      }

      return { success: true, product_id: pid, has_variants: hasVariants };
    });
  }

  async function addProductBarcode(productId, barcode, priceLabel = null) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const clean = String(barcode || '').trim();
    if (!clean) throw new Error('barcode_required');

    await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(clean);
    await db.dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO product_barcodes (product_id, barcode, price_label) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      [pid, clean, priceLabel || null]
    );
    return { success: true, barcode: clean };
  }

  async function addVariantQuick(payload = {}) {
    const pid = Number(payload.productId || payload.product_id);
    const barcode = payload.barcode ? String(payload.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_variants (product_id, barcode, sku, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)',
        [pid, barcode, payload.sku || null]
      );
      const variantId = ins.lastID;

      await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        [
          pid,
          variantId,
          Number(payload.stock ?? 0),
          Number(payload.cost_price ?? 0),
          Number(payload.selling_price ?? 0)
        ]
      );

      await db.dbRun('UPDATE products SET has_variants = 1 WHERE id = ?', [pid]);
      return { success: true, variant_id: variantId };
    });
  }

  return {
    freeTombstonedProductBarcode,
    insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices,
    insertVariantData,
    rewriteProductVariants,
    addProductBarcode,
    addVariantQuick
  };
}

module.exports = {
  createProductWriter
};
```

```html
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>

          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}

          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>

        {{/if}}

      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>

  </div>
```

```html
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: 210mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
```
```html
      border-bottom: 3px solid #1e293b;
      
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #1e293b;
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid #1e293b;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #1e293b;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #1e293b;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: #1e293b;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #1e293b;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: #f8fafc;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid #1e293b;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #1e293b;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
```
```html
        <div class="doc-type">SUMMARY INVOICE</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>

```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\receipt_template_1.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>وصل بيع رقم {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: 80mm auto; margin: 2mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      width: 74mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .header { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000;  }
    .shop-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; }
    .meta { padding: 5px 0; font-size: 10.5px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000; }
    .meta-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 5px 0; }
    th { border-bottom: 1px solid #000; padding: 3px 2px; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
    td { padding: 4px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #cbd5e1; font-size: 10.5px; text-align: center; }
    td:first-child { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; }
    .totals { border-top: 1px dashed #000; padding-top: 5px; }
```

```html
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      width: 74mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background: #fff;
    }
    .header { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000;  }
    .shop-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; }
    .meta { padding: 5px 0; font-size: 10.5px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #000; }
    .meta-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 5px 0; }
    th { border-bottom: 1px solid #000; padding: 3px 2px; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
    td { padding: 4px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #cbd5e1; font-size: 10.5px; text-align: center; }
    td:first-child { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; }
    .totals { border-top: 1px dashed #000; padding-top: 5px; }
    .t-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; font-size: 11px; }
    .t-net { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 4px 0; margin: 4px 0; }
    .footer { text-align: center; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
    <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:38px;margin-bottom:3px;">
    {{/if}}
    <div class="shop-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
    {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div style="font-size:10px;">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
    {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<div style="font-size:10px;">{{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>{{/if}}
  </div>

  <div class="meta">
    <div class="meta-row"><span><strong>Receipt #:</strong> {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</span><span>{{DATE}} {{TIME}}</span></div>
    <div class="meta-row"><span><strong>Customer:</strong> {{CLIENT_NAME}}</span><span><strong>Cashier:</strong> {{SELLER_NAME}}</span></div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="text-align:left;">Item</th>
        <th>Qty</th>
        <th>Price</th>
        <th>Total</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="t-row"><span>Subtotal:</span><span>{{SUBTOTAL}}</span></div>
    {{#if DISCOUNT}}<div class="t-row"><span>Discount:</span><span>-{{DISCOUNT}}</span></div>{{/if}}
    <div class="t-row t-net"><span>TOTAL DUE:</span><span>{{TOTAL}}</span></div>
    <div class="t-row"><span>Paid:</span><span>{{PAID}}</span></div>
    {{#if CHANGE}}<div class="t-row"><span>Change:</span><span>{{CHANGE}}</span></div>{{/if}}
    {{#if RECEIPT_REST}}<div class="t-row"><span>Balance Due:</span><span>{{RECEIPT_REST}}</span></div>{{/if}}
  </div>
```

```html
  <div style="font-size:9.5px;margin-top:4px;text-align:center;">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
```
```html
  <div class="footer">Thank you for shopping with us!</div>
</body>
</html>

```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
```
```html
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: 210mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 3px solid #059669;
      
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #059669;
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid #059669;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #059669;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #059669;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: #059669;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #059669;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid #059669;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #059669;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">وصل استلام بضاعة (BON DE RÉCEPTION)</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>

```
