  app.post('/api/supplier-returns', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const data = req.body || {};
      const returnNum = data.return_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('supplier_return'));
      const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
      const total = Number(data.total ?? 0);

      const out = await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        const ins = await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO supplier_returns (
            return_number, supplier_id, subtotal, total, credit_applied, refund_amount, refund_method, reason, notes, date
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            returnNum,
            Number(data.supplier_id),
            total,
            total,
            Number(data.credit_applied ?? total),
            Number(data.refund_amount ?? 0),
            data.refund_method || 'credit',
            data.reason || null,
            data.notes || null,
            data.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
          ]
        );
        const returnId = ins.lastID;
        for (const it of items) {
          const qty = Number(it.quantity ?? 1);
          if (it.batch_id) {
            await db.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = MAX(0, COALESCE(stock, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?', [qty, Number(it.batch_id)]);
          }
          await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO supplier_return_items (return_id, product_id, variant_id, batch_id, quantity, cost_price, total_cost)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
            [returnId, Number(it.product_id), it.variant_id || null, it.batch_id || null, qty, Number(it.cost_price ?? 0), Number((qty * Number(it.cost_price ?? 0)).toFixed(2))]
          );
        }
        return { success: true, id: returnId, return_number: returnNum };
      });
      res.json(out);
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/purchases', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const data = req.body || {};
      const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
      const supplierId = data.supplier_id || data.supplierId ? Number(data.supplier_id || data.supplierId) : null;
      const subtotal = Number(data.subtotal ?? 0);
      const taxPercentage = Number(data.tax_percentage ?? 0);
      const additionalCosts = Number(data.additional_costs ?? 0);
      const total = Number(data.total ?? 0);
      const paidAmount = Number(data.paid_amount ?? 0);
      const invDate = data.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const invNumber = data.invoice_number || `ACH-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;

      const totalUnits = items.reduce((s, it) => s + Math.max(0, Number(it.quantity || 0)), 0);
      const extraCostPerUnit = totalUnits > 0 ? additionalCosts / totalUnits : 0;

      const out = await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        const ins = await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO purchase_invoices (
            invoice_number, supplier_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, additional_costs, total, paid_amount, due_date, date
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [invNumber, supplierId, subtotal, taxPercentage, additionalCosts, total, paidAmount, data.due_date || null, invDate]
        );
        const invoiceId = ins.lastID;

        if (paidAmount > 0) {
          await db.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO invoice_payments (invoice_id, supplier_id, amount, date, payment_method) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
            [invoiceId, supplierId, paidAmount, invDate, 'cash']
          );
        }

        for (const it of items) {
          const pid = Number(it.product_id || it.productId);
          const qty = Number(it.quantity ?? 1);
          const baseCost = Number(it.cost_price ?? 0);
          const effectiveUnitCost = Number((baseCost + extraCostPerUnit).toFixed(2));
          const sellPrice = Number(it.selling_price ?? 0);

          const batchIns = await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
              product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location, supplier_id
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
            [pid, it.variant_id || null, qty, effectiveUnitCost, sellPrice, it.wholesale_price || null, it.expiry_date || null, it.location || null, supplierId]
          );

          await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO purchase_items (
              invoice_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, cost_price, selling_price, total_cost
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
            [invoiceId, pid, batchIns.lastID, it.variant_id || null, qty, effectiveUnitCost, sellPrice, Number((qty * effectiveUnitCost).toFixed(2))]
          );

          await batchAlloc.reconcileStockDebt(db, pid, batchIns.lastID);
        }

        return { success: true, id: invoiceId, invoice_number: invNumber };
      });
      res.json(out);
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/proformas', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const d = req.body || {};
      const docNum = d.doc_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('proforma'));
      const items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
      const out = await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        const ins = await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO proforma_invoices (doc_number, customer_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, discount, total, validity_days, notes, status, user_id)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?)`,
          [docNum, d.customer_id || null, Number(d.subtotal ?? 0), Number(d.tax_percentage ?? 0), Number(d.discount ?? 0), Number(d.total ?? 0), Number(d.validity_days ?? 15), d.notes || null, d.user_id || null]
        );
        const pid = ins.lastID;

          await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO proforma_items (proforma_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price, subtotal, custom_product_name)

          );
        }

  app.get('/api/proformas/:id/stock-check', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const proformaId = Number(req.params.id);
      const items = await db.dbAll(
        `SELECT pi.product_id, pi.variant_id, pi.quantity, pi.custom_product_name, p.name AS product_name
         FROM proforma_items pi
         LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = pi.product_id
         WHERE pi.proforma_id = ? AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL`,
        [proformaId]
      );
      const shortages = [];
      for (const it of items) {
        if (!it.product_id) continue;
        const row = await db.dbGet(
          'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS available FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
          [it.product_id]
        );
        const avail = Number((row && row.available) || 0);
        if (avail < Number(it.quantity || 0)) {
          shortages.push({
            product_id: it.product_id,
            product_name: it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || 'منتج',
            requested: Number(it.quantity || 0),
            available: avail
          });
        }
      }
      res.json({ shortages });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

    try {
      const proformaId = Number(req.params.id);
      const head = await db.dbGet('SELECT * FROM proforma_invoices WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [proformaId]);
      if (!head) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'proforma_not_found' });
      const items = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM proforma_items WHERE proforma_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [proformaId]);
      const saleOut = await executeSaleTransaction({
        customer_id: head.customer_id,
        subtotal: head.subtotal,
        tax_percentage: head.tax_percentage,
        discount: head.discount,
        total: head.total,
        paid_amount: req.body && req.body.paid_amount !== undefined ? Number(req.body.paid_amount) : head.total,
        payment_method: (req.body && req.body.payment_method) || 'cash',
        items
      });
      await db.dbRun("UPDATE proforma_invoices SET status = 'converted', converted_to_sale_id = ? WHERE id = ?", [saleOut.saleId, proformaId]);
      res.json({ success: true, saleId: saleOut.saleId, docNumber: saleOut.docNumber });
    } catch (err) {

    }
  });

  app.post('/api/orders', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const d = req.body || {};
      const docNum = d.doc_number || (await generateNextDocNumber('order'));
      const items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
      const deposit = Number(d.deposit_amount ?? 0);

      const out = await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        const ins = await db.dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO customer_orders (
            doc_number, customer_id, subtotal, tax_percentage, discount, total,
            deposit_amount, expected_delivery_date, notes, status, reserves_stock, user_id
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?)`,
          [docNum, d.customer_id || null, Number(d.subtotal ?? 0), Number(d.tax_percentage ?? 0), Number(d.discount ?? 0), Number(d.total ?? 0), deposit, d.expected_delivery_date || null, d.notes || null, d.reserves_stock !== undefined ? (d.reserves_stock ? 1 : 0) : 1, d.user_id || null]
        );
        const oid = ins.lastID;
        for (const it of items) {
          await db.dbRun(
            `INSERT INTO customer_order_items (order_id, product_id, batch_id, variant_id, quantity, price, subtotal, custom_product_name)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
            [oid, it.product_id || null, it.batch_id || null, it.variant_id || null, Number(it.quantity ?? 1), Number(it.price ?? 0), Number(it.subtotal ?? 0), it.custom_product_name || it.name || null]
          );
          if (d.reserves_stock !== false && it.product_id) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO inventory_reservations (order_id, batch_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
              [oid, it.batch_id || null, Number(it.product_id), Number(it.quantity ?? 1)]
            );
          }
        }
        if (deposit > 0) {
          const activeSess = await tillLedger.resolveOpenSession(db, null, d.user_id);
          if (activeSess) {
            await db.dbRun(
              `INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id)
               VALUES (?, 'order_deposit', ?, 'orders', ?, ?)`,
              [activeSess, deposit, `عربون طلبية #${docNum}`, oid]
            );
          }
        }
        return { success: true, id: oid, doc_number: docNum };
      });
      res.json(out);
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/caisse/close', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const payload = req.body || {};
      const sessionId = Number(payload.sessionId || payload.session_id || payload.id);
      const closingBalance = Number(payload.closingBalance ?? payload.closing_balance ?? 0);
      const closeNote = payload.closeNote || payload.close_note || payload.note || null;
      const info = await tillLedger.computeSessionSummary(db, sessionId);
      const expected = info ? info.summary.expectedBalance : 0;
      const diff = Number((closingBalance - expected).toFixed(2));
      await db.dbRun(
        `UPDATE caisse_sessions
         SET closing_balance = ?, expected_balance = ?, difference = ?, status = 'closed', closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, close_note = ?
         WHERE id = ?`,
        [closingBalance, expected, diff, closeNote, sessionId]
      );
      res.json({ success: true, sessionId, expectedBalance: expected, closingBalance, difference: diff });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/bundles', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const data = req.body || {};
      const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
      const barcode = data.barcode ? String(data.barcode).trim() : null;
      if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);

      const out = await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        let bid = data.id ? Number(data.id) : null;
        if (bid) {
          await db.dbRun(
            'UPDATE product_bundles SET name = ?, barcode = ?, selling_price = ?, cost_price = ?, description = ?, is_active = ? WHERE id = ?',
            [String(data.name || '').trim(), barcode, Number(data.selling_price ?? 0), Number(data.cost_price ?? 0), data.description || null, data.is_active !== undefined ? (data.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1, bid]
          );
          await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = ?', [bid]);
        } else {
          const ins = await db.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO product_bundles (name, barcode, selling_price, cost_price, description, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)',
            [String(data.name || '').trim(), barcode, Number(data.selling_price ?? 0), Number(data.cost_price ?? 0), data.description || null]
          );
          bid = ins.lastID;
        }
        for (const it of items) {
          await db.dbRun('INSERT INTO bundle_items (bundle_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [bid, Number(it.product_id || it.productId), Number(it.quantity ?? 1)]);
        }
        return { success: true, id: bid };
      });
      res.json(out);
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.delete('/api/bundles/:id', async (req, res) => {

      const id = Number(req.params.id);

      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_bundles WHERE id = ?', [id]);

      );

        );

    }
  });

  const server = http.createServer(app);
  const wss = new WebSocket.Server({ server });

  wss.on('connection', (ws, req) => {
    const clientIp = req.socket.remoteAddress || 'ws-client';
    connectedClients.set(clientIp, {
      deviceId: clientIp,
      ip: clientIp,
      clientType: 'websocket',
      lastSeenAt: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'revision', data: getDataRevision() }));
  });

  revisionTracker.on('changed', (snap) => {
    const msg = JSON.stringify({ type: 'revision', data: snap });
    for (const client of wss.clients) {
      if (client.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        client.send(msg);
      }
    }
  });

  server.listen(port, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`[Gherbi.Ai POS Server] Listening on http://0.0.0.0:${port}`);
    if (typeof onStartedCallback === 'function') {
      onStartedCallback(null, { server, wss, port, getConnectedClients: () => Array.from(connectedClients.values()) });
    }
  });

  server.on('error', (err) => {
    console.warn(`[Gherbi.Ai POS Server] Port ${port} warning:`, err.message);
  });

  return {
    app,
    server,
    wss,
    getConnectedClients: () => Array.from(connectedClients.values())
  };
}

};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\setup-offline-assets.js`

```javascript
/**
 * setup-offline-assets.js
 * أداة التحميل والتجهيز التلقائي للمكتبات والخطوط المحلية (100% Offline-First Assets)
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const https = require('https');

const ROOT = __dirname;
const JS_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'js');
const FONTS_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'fonts');

[JS_DIR, FONTS_DIR].forEach((dir) => {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
});

const ASSETS_TO_FETCH = [
  {
    name: 'Tailwind CSS (Offline Script)',
    url: 'https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.1',
    dest: path.join(JS_DIR, 'tailwind.min.js'),
    fallback: '/* Tailwind Offline Fallback */ console.info("Tailwind local fallback loaded");'
  },
  {
    name: 'Chart.js UMD (Offline Charts)',
    url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js',
    dest: path.join(JS_DIR, 'chart.umd.min.js'),
    fallback: 'window.Chart = function(){ return { destroy: function(){}, update: function(){} }; };'
  }
];

function downloadFile(url, destPath, redirects = 0) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (redirects > 5) return reject(new Error('Too many redirects'));

    https
      .get(url, { timeout: 20000 }, (res) => {
        if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
          const nextUrl = res.headers.location.startsWith('http')
            ? res.headers.location
            : new URL(res.headers.location, url).href;
          return resolve(downloadFile(nextUrl, destPath, redirects + 1));
        }

        if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
          return reject(new Error(`HTTP Status ${res.statusCode}`));
        }

        const fileStream = fs.createWriteStream(destPath);
        res.pipe(fileStream);
        fileStream.on('finish', () => {
          fileStream.close(() => resolve(true));
        });
        fileStream.on('error', (err) => {
          fs.unlink(destPath, () => {});
          reject(err);
        });
      })
      .on('error', (err) => reject(err))
      .on('timeout', function onTimeout() {
        this.destroy();
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'));
      });
  });
}

async function prepareOfflineAssets() {
  console.log('📦 جاري تجهيز المكتبات والأصول المحلية لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS...\n');

  for (const item of ASSETS_TO_FETCH) {
    if (fs.existsSync(item.dest) && fs.statSync(item.dest).size > 1024) {
      console.log(`✅ موجود مسبقاً: ${item.name}`);
      continue;
    }

    try {
      process.stdout.write(`⏳ جاري تنزيل ${item.name}... `);
      await downloadFile(item.url, item.dest);
      console.log('تم بنجاح!');
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(`تعذر التنزيل (${err.message}) — تم إنشاء بديل محلي آمن.`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(item.dest) || fs.statSync(item.dest).size === 0) {
        fs.writeFileSync(item.dest, item.fallback, 'utf8');
      }
    }
  }

  console.log('\n🎉 اكتمل تجهيز الأصول المحلية بنجاح.');
}

prepareOfflineAssets();

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\soft-delete.js`

```javascript

/**
 * soft-delete.js
 * محرك الحذف الناعم (Soft Delete) وتحرير الحقول الفريدة (Unique Tombstone Release)
 * لضمان عمل المزامنة السحابية ومنع تعارض الباركودات أو أسماء المستخدمين المحذوفة
 */

'use strict';

const SOFT_DELETE_TABLES = new Set([
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'product_serials',
  'inventory_batches',
  'stock_debt',
  'suppliers',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items',
  'customers',
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'caisse_transactions',
  'expenses',
  'capital_injections',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items',
  'users',
  'shop_info',
  'custom_templates'
]);

const UNIQUE_TOMBSTONE_COLUMNS = {
  products: 'barcode',
  product_barcodes: 'barcode',
  product_variants: 'barcode',
  product_bundles: 'barcode',
  users: 'username'
};

/**
 * تحويل جملة DELETE قياسية إلى جملة UPDATE ناعمة مع تحرير العمود الفريد إن وجد
 */
function rewriteDeleteToSoftDelete(sql) {
  if (typeof sql !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = sql.trim();

  const match = /^DELETE\s+FROM\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?(?:\s+WHERE\s+([\s\S]+))?$/i.exec(
    trimmed
  );
  if (!match) return null;

  const table = match[1].toLowerCase();
  const whereClause = match[2] ? match[2].trim() : '';

  // إذا لم يكن هناك شرط WHERE (مثل مسح كامل الجدول أثناء استعادة نسخة)، نتركه حذفاً فعلياً
  if (!whereClause || !SOFT_DELETE_TABLES.has(table)) {
    return null;
  }

  const nowExpr = "strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')";
  const deviceExpr = "COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), origin_device)";
  const uniqueCol = UNIQUE_TOMBSTONE_COLUMNS[table];

  let uniqueReleaseAssignment = '';
  if (uniqueCol) {
    uniqueReleaseAssignment = `, ${uniqueCol} = CASE WHEN ${uniqueCol} IS NOT NULL AND ${uniqueCol} NOT LIKE '%~del~%' THEN ${uniqueCol} || '~del~' || id ELSE ${uniqueCol} END`;
  }

  return `UPDATE ${table} SET deleted_at = ${nowExpr}, updated_at = ${nowExpr}, origin_device = ${deviceExpr}, dirty = 1${uniqueReleaseAssignment} WHERE (${whereClause}) AND deleted_at IS NULL`;
}

/**
 * ربط محرك الحذف الناعم بدوال قاعدة البيانات
 */
function installSoftDeleteShim(db) {
  if (!db || db._softDeleteInstalled) return db;

  const origRun = db.run.bind(db);

  db.run = function patchedSoftDeleteRun(sql, ...args) {
    const rewritten = rewriteDeleteToSoftDelete(sql);
    if (rewritten) {
      return origRun(rewritten, ...args);
    }
    return origRun(sql, ...args);
  };

  db._softDeleteInstalled = true;
  return db;
}

module.exports = {
  SOFT_DELETE_TABLES,
  rewriteDeleteToSoftDelete,
  installSoftDeleteShim
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\stock-ledger.js`

```javascript
/**
 * stock-ledger.js
 * محرك دفتر الأستاذ الذري للمخزون (Immutable Stock Movement Ledger)
 * يضمن تطابق أرصدة الدفعات مع مجموع الحركات المسجلة عبر الأجهزة
 */

'use strict';

const crypto = require('crypto');

function rawGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawGet ? db._rawGet.bind(db) : db.get.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
  });
}

function rawAll(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawAll ? db._rawAll.bind(db) : db.all.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

function rawRun(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawRun ? db._rawRun.bind(db) : db.run.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * تنفيذ عملية على inventory_batches مع تعطيل مشغلات دفتر المخزون مؤقتاً
 */
async function withSkipStockLedger(db, workFn) {
  await rawRun(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('_skip_stock_ledger', '1')");
  try {
    return await workFn();
  } finally {
    await rawRun(db, "DELETE FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'");
  }
}

/**
 * بذر حركات الابتداء (init) للدفعات التي لها رصيد وليس لها حركات مسجلة
 */
async function seedStartupMovements(db) {
  await rawRun(
    db,
    "UPDATE inventory_batches SET uuid = lower(hex(randomblob(16))) WHERE uuid IS NULL OR uuid = ''"
  );

  const res = await rawRun(
    db,
    `
    INSERT INTO stock_movements (
      uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
      origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
    )
    SELECT
      lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
      ib.uuid,
      p.uuid,
      pv.uuid,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0),
      'init',
      COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
      strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
      strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
      1
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
    WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) <> 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid
      )
    `
  );
  return { seeded: res.changes };
}

/**
 * إضافة حركة مخزون صريحة
 */
async function appendMovement(db, {
  batchUuid,
  productUuid = null,
  variantUuid = null,
  delta,
  reason = 'manual',
  refType = null,
  refUuid = null
}) {
  const numDelta = Number(delta || 0);
  if (!batchUuid || Math.abs(numDelta) < 0.000001) return null;

  const instRow = await rawGet(db, "SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'");
  const originDevice = (instRow && instRow.value) || 'local';
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const moveUuid = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');

  await rawRun(
    db,
    `
    INSERT INTO stock_movements (
      uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
      ref_type, ref_uuid, origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
    `,
    [
      moveUuid,
      batchUuid,
      productUuid,
      variantUuid,
      numDelta,
      reason,
      refType,
      refUuid,
      originDevice,
      nowIso,
      nowIso
    ]
  );

  return moveUuid;
}

/**
 * مطابقة رصيد دفعة واحدة مع مجموع حركاتها في الدفتر
 */
async function reconcileBatchLedger(db, batchId, reason = 'reconcile', refType = null, refUuid = null) {
  if (!batchId) return;
  await rawRun(
    db,
    "UPDATE inventory_batches SET uuid = lower(hex(randomblob(16))) WHERE id = ? AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '')",
    [batchId]
  );

  const row = await rawGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      ib.uuid AS batch_uuid,
      p.uuid AS product_uuid,
      pv.uuid AS variant_uuid,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm
        WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0) AS gap
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
    WHERE ib.id = ?
    `,
    [batchId]
  );

  if (row && Math.abs(Number(row.gap || 0)) > 0.0001) {
    await appendMovement(db, {
      batchUuid: row.batch_uuid,
      productUuid: row.product_uuid,
      variantUuid: row.variant_uuid,
      delta: Number(row.gap),
      reason,
      refType,
      refUuid
    });
  }
}

/**
 * إعادة حساب رصيد جميع الدفعات من واقع حركات stock_movements
 */
async function recomputeAllBatches(db) {
  return await withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
    const res = await rawRun(
      db,
      `
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET stock = COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm
        WHERE sm.batch_uuid = inventory_batches.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0)
      WHERE uuid IS NOT NULL AND uuid <> ''
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm2 WHERE sm2.batch_uuid = inventory_batches.uuid)
      `
    );
    return { recomputedBatches: res.changes };
  });
}

/**
 * إصلاح الفروقات بين الرصيد المخزن والدفتر (cloud-sync:repair-ledger)
 */
async function repairMissingMovements(db) {
  await seedStartupMovements(db);

  const gaps = await rawAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      ib.id,
      ib.uuid AS batch_uuid,
      p.uuid AS product_uuid,
      pv.uuid AS variant_uuid,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm
        WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0) AS gap
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
    WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> ''
      AND ABS(COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm
        WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0)) > 0.0001
    `
  );

  for (const g of gaps) {
    await appendMovement(db, {
      batchUuid: g.batch_uuid,
      productUuid: g.product_uuid,
      variantUuid: g.variant_uuid,
      delta: g.gap,
      reason: 'repair'
    });
  }

  return { repaired: gaps.length };
}

/**
 * فحص حالة الدفتر (cloud-sync:inspect-ledger)
 */
async function inspectLedger(db) {
  const byReason = await rawAll(
    db,
    'SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_movements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY reason ORDER BY n DESC'
  );
  const items = await rawAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      ib.id,
      p.name AS product,
      p.unit AS unit,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) AS cached,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS ledger,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sm.delta) FROM stock_movements sm WHERE sm.batch_uuid = ib.uuid AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS gap
    FROM inventory_batches ib
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
    WHERE ib.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY ABS(gap) DESC, ib.id DESC
    LIMIT 100
    `
  );

  return { byReason, items };
}

module.exports = {
  withSkipStockLedger,
  seedStartupMovements,
  appendMovement,
  reconcileBatchLedger,
  recomputeAllBatches,
  repairMissingMovements,
  inspectLedger
};
```

/**

:root {

}

}

html, body {

}

}

::-webkit-scrollbar {

}

}

}

}

#app-container {
  display: flex;

  width: 100vw;
}

#sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-width);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f172a 0%, #020617 100%);

  transition: width 0.25s ease;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 40;

}

}

}

#main-content {

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
}

#top-header {
  height: var(--header-height);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
  z-index: 30;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

.view-section {
  display: none;
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}
.view-section.active {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease forwards;
}

.pos-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 410px;
  gap: 1rem;

}

.products-grid {
  display: grid;

}

.product-card {

.product-card:hover {

}

.cart-container {

  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;

.cart-items {

.modal-overlay {

  background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);

.modal-overlay.active {

}
.modal-content {

  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 1.25rem;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  max-width: 92vw;
  max-height: 90vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):not([type="color"]),
select,
textarea {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);

input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {

}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\till-ledger.js`

```javascript
/**
 * till-ledger.js
 * محرك إدارة جلسات الخزينة (Caisse Sessions) وحساب الأرصدة ومزامنة المبيعات النقدية
 */

'use strict';

function dbGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
  });
}

function dbAll(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

function dbRun(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * إيجاد الجلسة المفتوحة حالياً للمستخدم أو للجهاز الحالي
 */
async function resolveOpenSession(db, preferredSessionId = null, userId = null, deviceId = null) {
  if (preferredSessionId) {
    const row = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL",
      [Number(preferredSessionId)]
    );
    if (row && row.id) return row.id;
  }

  if (userId) {
    const userRow = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1",
      [Number(userId)]
    );
    if (userRow && userRow.id) return userRow.id;
  }

  if (deviceId) {
    const devRow = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE device_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1",
      [String(deviceId)]
    );
    if (devRow && devRow.id) return devRow.id;
  }

  const anyOpen = await dbGet(
    db,
    "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1"
  );
  return anyOpen ? anyOpen.id : null;
}

/**
 * حساب ملخص جلسة خزينة محددة والرصيد المتوقع في الدرج
 */
async function computeSessionSummary(db, sessionId) {
  const session = await dbGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT cs.*, u.name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role
    FROM caisse_sessions cs
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = cs.user_id
    WHERE cs.id = ? AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [Number(sessionId)]
  );
  if (!session) return null;

  const txs = await dbAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT *, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) AS created_at
    FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE session_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY id DESC
    `,
    [Number(sessionId)]
  );

  let totalSalesCash = 0;
  let totalDebtPayments = 0;
  let totalOrderDeposits = 0;
  let totalCashIn = 0;
  let totalCashOut = 0;
  let totalExpenses = 0;
  let totalRefunds = 0;

  for (const tx of txs) {
    const amt = Math.abs(Number(tx.amount || 0));
    switch (tx.type) {
      case 'sale_cash':
      case 'sale':
        totalSalesCash += amt;
        break;
      case 'debt_payment':
        totalDebtPayments += amt;
        break;
      case 'order_deposit':
        totalOrderDeposits += amt;
        break;
      case 'cash_in':
        totalCashIn += amt;
        break;
      case 'cash_out':
        totalCashOut += amt;
        break;
      case 'expense':
        totalExpenses += amt;
        break;
      case 'sale_refund':
        totalRefunds += amt;
        break;
      default:
        if (Number(tx.amount) >= 0) totalCashIn += amt;
        else totalCashOut += amt;
        break;
    }
  }

  const openingBalance = Number(session.opening_balance || 0);
  const currentBalance = Number(
    (
      openingBalance +
      totalSalesCash +
      totalDebtPayments +
      totalOrderDeposits +
      totalCashIn -
      totalCashOut -
      totalExpenses -
      totalRefunds
    ).toFixed(2)
  );

  return {
    session,
    transactions: txs,
    summary: {
      openingBalance,
      totalSalesCash: Number((totalSalesCash + totalDebtPayments + totalOrderDeposits).toFixed(2)),
      totalDebtPayments: Number(totalDebtPayments.toFixed(2)),
      totalOrderDeposits: Number(totalOrderDeposits.toFixed(2)),
      totalCashIn: Number(totalCashIn.toFixed(2)),
      totalCashOut: Number(totalCashOut.toFixed(2)),
      totalExpenses: Number(totalExpenses.toFixed(2)),
      totalRefunds: Number(totalRefunds.toFixed(2)),
      currentBalance,
      expectedBalance: currentBalance
    }
  };
}

/**
 * قيد أو تحديث الأثر النقدي لفاتورة بيع في جلسة الخزينة المفتوحة
 */
async function applySaleTillDelta(db, {
  saleId,
  sessionId = null,
  userId = null,
  paidAmount = 0,
  totalAmount = 0,
  paymentMethod = 'cash'
}) {
  if (!saleId) return null;

  // لا نقيد في درج النقدية إلا المدفوعات النقدية
  if (paymentMethod && String(paymentMethod).toLowerCase() !== 'cash') {
    await reverseSaleTill(db, saleId);
    return null;
  }

  const activeSessionId = await resolveOpenSession(db, sessionId, userId);
  if (!activeSessionId) return null;

  const isReturnSale = Number(totalAmount || 0) < 0 || Number(paidAmount || 0) < 0;
  const absPaid = Math.abs(Number(paidAmount || 0));

  const existingTx = await dbGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT id FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE reference_id = ? AND type IN ('sale_cash', 'sale_refund') AND deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT 1
    `,
    [Number(saleId)]
  );

  if (absPaid < 0.009) {
    if (existingTx) {
      await dbRun(db, 'DELETE FROM caisse_transactions WHERE id = ?', [existingTx.id]);
    }
    return activeSessionId;
  }

  const txType = isReturnSale ? 'sale_refund' : 'sale_cash';
  const desc = isReturnSale ? `مرتجع فاتورة بيع #${saleId}` : `مبيعات فاتورة #${saleId}`;

  if (existingTx) {
    await dbRun(
      db,
      'UPDATE caisse_transactions SET session_id = ?, type = ?, amount = ?, description = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [activeSessionId, txType, absPaid, desc, existingTx.id]
    );
  } else {
    await dbRun(
      db,
      `
      INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (
        session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id, reference_uuid
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'sales', ?, ?, (SELECT uuid FROM sales WHERE id = ?))
      `,
      [activeSessionId, txType, absPaid, desc, Number(saleId), Number(saleId)]
    );
  }

  return activeSessionId;
}

/**
 * إلغاء الأثر النقدي لفاتورة بيع عند حذفها
 */
async function reverseSaleTill(db, saleId) {
  if (!saleId) return;
  await dbRun(
    db,
    `
    DELETE FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE (reference_id = ? OR reference_uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM sales WHERE id = ?))
      AND type IN ('sale_cash', 'sale_refund')
    `,
    [Number(saleId), Number(saleId)]
  );
}

module.exports = {
  resolveOpenSession,
  computeSessionSummary,
  applySaleTillDelta,
  reverseSaleTill
};

```javascript
/**
 * verify-system.js
 * منظومة الفحص الهندسي والاختبار الآلي الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * تتحقق من سلامة الملفات، القواعد النحوية (Syntax)، وقواعد البيانات والمحركات الحسابية
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = __dirname;

const REQUIRED_CORE_FILES = [
  'package.json',
  'main.js',
  'preload.js',
  'preload-activation.js',
  'renderer.js',
  'server.js',
  'database.js',
  'db-write-queue.js',
  'soft-delete.js',
  'data-revision.js',
  'stock-ledger.js',
  'till-ledger.js',
  'batch-alloc.js',
  'product-write.js',
  'imageUtils.js',
  'analytics-queries.js',
  'api-client.js',
  'cloud-db-sync.js',
  'cloud-diagnostics.js',
  'cloud-sync.js',
  'device-auth.js',
  'licenseManager.js',
  'scale-bridge.js',
  'scale-protocols.js',
  'print-engine.js',
  'index.html',
  'activation.html',
  'styles.css',
  'manufacturing/production-guard.js',
  'manufacturing/pos-produce.js',
  'manufacturing/manufacturing.js',
  'manufacturing/manufacturing-ui.js',
  'stocktake/stocktake-guard.js',
  'stocktake/stocktake-ui.js',
  'template-designer/template-i18n.js',
  'template-designer/template-presets.js',
  'template-designer/template-renderer.js',
  'template-designer/template-builder.js',
  'assets/js/numberToWords.js',
  'assets/js/translations.js',
  'assets/css/fonts.css',
  'assets/css/material-symbols.css'
];

async function runFullVerification() {
  console.log('==============================================================');
  console.log('🔍 بدء الفحص الهندسي الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS');
  console.log('==============================================================\n');

  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  function recordResult(label, ok, detail = '') {
    if (ok) {
      passed += 1;
      console.log(`✅ [PASS] ${label}`);
    } else {
      failed += 1;
      console.error(`❌ [FAIL] ${label} ${detail ? '--> ' + detail : ''}`);
    }
  }

  // 1. فحص وجود الملفات الأساسية وعدم كونها فارغة
  console.log('--- 1. فحص الملفات الأساسية والوحدات البرمجية ---');
  for (const relPath of REQUIRED_CORE_FILES) {
    const fullPath = path.join(ROOT, relPath);
    const exists = fs.existsSync(fullPath);
    const size = exists ? fs.statSync(fullPath).size : 0;
    recordResult(`الملف ${relPath}`, exists && size > 10, !exists ? 'غير موجود' : size <= 10 ? 'ملف فارغ' : '');
  }

  // 2. فحص القواعد النحوية (JavaScript Syntax Validation) لجميع ملفات .js
  console.log('\n--- 2. فحص سلامة الكود البرمجي (JS Syntax Check) ---');
  const jsFiles = REQUIRED_CORE_FILES.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js'));
  for (const jsFile of jsFiles) {
    const fullPath = path.join(ROOT, jsFile);
    if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) continue;
    try {
      const code = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      new vm.Script(code, { filename: jsFile });
      recordResult(`سلامة القواعد النحوية في ${jsFile}`, true);
    } catch (err) {
      recordResult(`سلامة القواعد النحوية في ${jsFile}`, false, err.message);
    }
  }

  // 3. فحص قوالب الطباعة
  console.log('\n--- 3. فحص منظومة قوالب الطباعة HTML ---');
  const allRootFiles = fs.readdirSync(ROOT);
  const htmlTemplates = allRootFiles.filter(
    (f) => f.endsWith('.html') && f !== 'index.html' && f !== 'activation.html'
  );
  recordResult(
    `عدد قوالب الطباعة المولدة (${htmlTemplates.length} قالب)`,
    htmlTemplates.length >= 40,
    htmlTemplates.length < 40 ? 'يرجى تشغيل node generate-print-templates.js أولاً' : ''
  );

  // 4. اختبار المحركات البرمجية والمنطقية (Integration Tests)
  console.log('\n--- 4. اختبار المحركات الحسابية وقاعدة البيانات ---');
  try {
    // أ) اختبار محرك التفقيط باللغات الثلاث
    const tafqeet = require('./assets/js/numberToWords');
    const arWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'ar');
    const frWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'fr');
    const enWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'en');
    recordResult('محرك التفقيط المالي (العربية / الفرنسية / الإنجليزية)', Boolean(arWords && frWords && enWords));

    // ب) اختبار محرك الترجمة الثلاثي
    const { getTranslation } = require('./assets/js/translations');
    recordResult(
      'محرك الترجمة المركزي (RTL / LTR)',
      getTranslation('ar', 'nav_pos') === 'شاشة المبيعات' &&
        getTranslation('fr', 'nav_pos') === 'Point de Vente (POS)'
    );

    // ج) اختبار محرك التراخيص المفتوح للمالك
    const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');
    const licStatus = await licenseManager.getLicenseStatus();
    recordResult(
      'محرك الترخيص الدائم (PRO Lifetime)',
      Boolean(licStatus && licStatus.isActivated === true && licStatus.isTrial === false && licStatus.hwid)
    );

    // د) اختبار محرك تفكيك باركود الميزان
    const { parseScaleBarcode } = require('./scale-protocols');
    const scaleParsed = parseScaleBarcode('2000105012504', { scale_barcode_enabled: 'true' });
    recordResult(
      'محرك تفكيك باركود الميزان الإلكتروني (PLU & Weight)',
      Boolean(scaleParsed && scaleParsed.pluCode === '00105' && scaleParsed.weight === 1.25)
    );

    // هـ) اختبار قاعدة البيانات والمحركات الذرية (في حال تثبيت sqlite3)
    const db = require('./database');
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));

    const tables = await db.dbAll("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'");
    recordResult(`مخطط قاعدة البيانات SQLite WAL (${tables.length} جدولاً)`, tables.length >= 40);

    // اختبار الإحصائيات وحاسبة الزكاة والمساعد الذكي
    const analyticsQueries = require('./analytics-queries');
    const stats = await analyticsQueries.getAnalytics(db, {});
    const copilot = await analyticsQueries.getAiCopilotInsights(db);
    recordResult(
      'محرك الإحصائيات وحاسبة الزكاة و Gherbi.Ai Copilot',
      Boolean(stats && Array.isArray(stats.debtAging) && stats.zakat && copilot)
    );
  } catch (err) {
    recordResult('اختبار المحركات الخلفية', false, err.message);
  }

  console.log('\n==============================================================');
  console.log(`📊 النتيجة النهائية: نجح (${passed}) اختبار | فشل (${failed}) اختبار`);
  console.log('==============================================================');

  if (failed === 0) {
    console.log('🚀 النظام جاهز تماماً للتشغيل عبر: npm run dev');
  } else {
    console.log('⚠️ يرجى مراجعة الملاحظات أعلاه قبل التشغيل.');
  }
}

runFullVerification();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\assets\js\numberToWords.js`

```javascript
/**
 * assets/js/numberToWords.js
 * محرك التفقيط المالي (Financial Number to Words Engine) لـ Gherbi.Ai POS
 * يدعم: العربية (بقواعد النحو للإفراد والتثنية والجمع)، الفرنسية، والإنجليزية.
 * مخصص خصيصاً للعملة الجزائرية (الدينار والسنتيم).
 */

'use strict';

const NumberToWords = (function () {
    // ============================================================================
    // 1. القاموس العربي (Arabic Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const arUnits = ["", "واحد", "اثنان", "ثلاثة", "أربعة", "خمسة", "ستة", "سبعة", "ثمانية", "تسعة"];
    const arTeens = ["عشرة", "أحد عشر", "اثنا عشر", "ثلاثة عشر", "أربعة عشر", "خمسة عشر", "ستة عشر", "سبعة عشر", "ثمانية عشر", "تسعة عشر"];
    const arTens = ["", "عشرة", "عشرون", "ثلاثون", "أربعون", "خمسون", "ستون", "سبعون", "ثمانون", "تسعون"];
    const arHundreds = ["", "مائة", "مائتان", "ثلاثمائة", "أربعمائة", "خمسمائة", "ستمائة", "سبعمائة", "ثمانمائة", "تسعمائة"];

    function convertArabicGroup(num) {
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let t = Math.floor((num % 100) / 10);
        let u = num % 10;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += arHundreds[h];
        }

        let tensUnits = "";
        if (t === 0) {
            if (u > 0) tensUnits = arUnits[u];
        } else if (t === 1) {
            tensUnits = arTeens[u];
        } else {
            if (u > 0) {
                tensUnits = arUnits[u] + " و" + arTens[t];
            } else {
                tensUnits = arTens[t];
            }
        }

        if (tensUnits !== "") {
            if (str !== "") str += " و";
            str += tensUnits;
        }
        return str;
    }

    function tafqeetArabic(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "صفر دينار جزائري";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);

        let dinarStr = "";
        if (dinars === 1) dinarStr = "دينار جزائري واحد";
        else if (dinars === 2) dinarStr = "ديناران جزائريان";
        else if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) {
                if (billions === 1) parts.push("مليار");
                else if (billions === 2) parts.push("ملياران");
                else if (billions >= 3 && billions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليارات");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليار");
            }

            if (millions > 0) {
                if (millions === 1) parts.push("مليون");
                else if (millions === 2) parts.push("مليونان");
                else if (millions >= 3 && millions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " ملايين");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " مليون");
            }

            if (thousands > 0) {
                if (thousands === 1) parts.push("ألف");
                else if (thousands === 2) parts.push("ألفان");
                else if (thousands >= 3 && thousands <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " آلاف");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " ألف");
            }

            if (remainder > 0) {
                parts.push(convertArabicGroup(remainder));
            }

            dinarStr = parts.join(" و") + " دينار جزائري";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            if (centimes === 1) centimeStr = "سنتيم واحد";
            else if (centimes === 2) centimeStr = "سنتيمان";
            else if (centimes >= 3 && centimes <= 10) centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتميات";
            else centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتيماً";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " و " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 2. القاموس الفرنسي (French Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const frUnits = ["", "un", "deux", "trois", "quatre", "cinq", "six", "sept", "huit", "neuf"];
    const frTeens = ["dix", "onze", "douze", "treize", "quatorze", "quinze", "seize", "dix-sept", "dix-huit", "dix-neuf"];
    const frTens = ["", "dix", "vingt", "trente", "quarante", "cinquante", "soixante", "soixante-dix", "quatre-vingts", "quatre-vingt-dix"];

    function convertFrenchGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            if (h === 1) str += "cent ";
            else str += frUnits[h] + " cent " + (rem === 0 ? "s " : "");
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (rem < 10) str += frUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += frTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                if (t === 7) {
                    str += (u === 1 ? "soixante et onze" : "soixante-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : ""));
                } else if (t === 9) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : "");
                } else if (t === 8) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt" + (u === 0 ? "s" : "-" + frUnits[u]);
                } else {
                    str += frTens[t];
                    if (u === 1) str += " et un";
                    else if (u > 1) str += "-" + frUnits[u];
                }
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetFrench(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zéro Dinar Algérien";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(billions) + (billions > 1 ? " milliards" : " milliard"));
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(millions) + (millions > 1 ? " millions" : " million"));
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push((thousands === 1 ? "mille" : convertFrenchGroup(thousands) + " mille"));
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Dinars Algériens";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertFrenchGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        let result = "";
        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) result = dinarStr + " et " + centimeStr;
        else if (centimeStr) result = centimeStr;
        else result = dinarStr;

        // رسملة الحرف الأول
        return result.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + result.slice(1);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 3. القاموس الإنجليزي (English Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const enUnits = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"];
    const enTeens = ["Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"];
    const enTens = ["", "Ten", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];

    function convertEnglishGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += enUnits[h] + " Hundred ";
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (h > 0) str += "and ";
            if (rem < 10) str += enUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += enTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                str += enTens[t];
                if (u > 0) str += "-" + enUnits[u];
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetEnglish(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zero Algerian Dinars";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(billions) + " Billion");
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(millions) + " Million");
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(thousands) + " Thousand");
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Algerian Dinars";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertEnglishGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " and " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // التصدير للاستخدام العام (Public API)
    // ============================================================================
    return {
        /**
         * تحويل رقم مالي إلى حروف حسب اللغة المطلوبة
         * @param {number} num - المبلغ المالي
         * @param {string} lang - رمز اللغة ('ar', 'fr', 'en')
         * @returns {string} المبلغ مفقطاً بالحروف
         */
        toWords: function (num, lang = 'ar') {
            const cleanNum = Number(num);
            if (isNaN(cleanNum)) return "";

            const l = String(lang).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (l === 'fr') return tafqeetFrench(cleanNum);
            if (l === 'en') return tafqeetEnglish(cleanNum);
            
            // الافتراضي هو العربية
            return "فقط " + tafqeetArabic(cleanNum) + " لا غير.";
        }
    };
})();

  function convertSpanToSvg(el) {
    if (!el || el.dataset.svgRendered === '1') return;
    if (el.querySelector('svg')) {
      el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
      return;
    }
    const rawName = String(el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!rawName) return;

    const d = PATHS[rawName] || DEFAULT_PATH;
    el.dataset.iconName = rawName;
    el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
    el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${d}"/></svg>`;
  }

  function scanAndRenderIcons(root = document) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    const nodes = root.querySelectorAll('.material-symbols-rounded');
    nodes.forEach(convertSpanToSvg);
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      scanAndRenderIcons(document);
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const m of mutations) {
          for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('material-symbols-rounded')) {
                convertSpanToSvg(node);
              }
              scanAndRenderIcons(node);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
  }

  window.SvgIconEngine = { scanAndRenderIcons, convertSpanToSvg };
})();

function getTranslation(lang, key) {
    const defaultLang = 'ar';
    const langDict = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang];
    return langDict[key] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang][key] || key;
}

// التصدير للاستخدام في الخلفية أو الواجهة الأمامية
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = { TRANSLATIONS, getTranslation };
} else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.TRANSLATIONS = TRANSLATIONS;
    window.getTranslation = getTranslation;
}

        planned_qty: qty,
        produced_qty: qty,

      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم تنفيذ أمر الإنتاج وإضافة الدفعة للمخزون بنجاح', 'success');

    await renderManufacturingView();

  async function reverseOrder(orderId) {

  window.ManufacturingUI = {

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\manufacturing\manufacturing.js`

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/manufacturing.js
 * وحدة إدارة حالة التصنيع (BOM State & API Controller) في الواجهة الأمامية
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  const ManufacturingState = {
    recipes: [],
    orders: [],
    productsList: [],
    currentRecipe: null,
    currentAvailability: null,

    async fetchAllData(filters = {}) {
      if (!window.api) return;
      const [recipes, orders, products] = await Promise.all([
        window.api.getBomRecipes(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProductionOrders(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProducts({}).catch(() => [])
      ]);

      this.recipes = Array.isArray(recipes) ? recipes : [];
      this.orders = Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : [];
      this.productsList = Array.isArray(products) ? products : [];
      return {
        recipes: this.recipes,
        orders: this.orders,
        products: this.productsList
      };
    },

    async checkAvailability(recipeId, plannedQty = 1) {
      if (!window.api || !recipeId) return null;
      this.currentAvailability = await window.api.getRecipeAvailability({
        recipeId: Number(recipeId),
        plannedQty: Number(plannedQty || 1)
      });
      return this.currentAvailability;
    },

    async saveRecipe(recipePayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const saved = await window.api.saveBomRecipe(recipePayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return saved;
    },

    async removeRecipe(recipeId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      await window.api.deleteBomRecipe(Number(recipeId));
      await this.fetchAllData();
    },

    async createAndConfirmOrder(orderPayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.createProductionOrder(orderPayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async confirmDraftOrder(orderId, producedQty) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.confirmProductionOrder({
        orderId: Number(orderId),
        produced_qty: producedQty ? Number(producedQty) : undefined
      });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async reverseOrder(orderId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.reverseProductionOrder({ orderId: Number(orderId) });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    }
  };

  window.ManufacturingManager = ManufacturingState;
})();

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\manufacturing\pos-produce.js`

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/pos-produce.js
 * محرك التصنيع الآلي الفوري عند البيع في شاشة الكاشير (Auto-Manufacture on POS Sale)
 */

'use strict';

const productionGuard = require('./production-guard');

/**
 * فحص عناصر سلة المبيعات وتصنيع أي عجز تلقائياً إذا كان المنتج يمتلك وصفة مفعّل بها auto_on_sale
 */
async function autoProduceShortfallsForSale(db, saleItems = [], options = {}) {
  const globalAutoSetting = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_auto_on_sale', 'false');
  const isGlobalAutoEnabled =
    String(globalAutoSetting).toLowerCase() === 'true' || globalAutoSetting === '1';

  const producedOrders = [];

  for (const item of Array.isArray(saleItems) ? saleItems : []) {
    const productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
    const requestedQty = Number(item.quantity || 0);
    if (!productId || requestedQty <= 0) continue;

    // حساب الرصيد الحالي المتاح في الدفعات
    const stockRow = await db.dbGet(
      'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS current_stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [productId]
    );
    const currentStock = Number((stockRow && stockRow.current_stock) || 0);
    const shortfall = Number((requestedQty - currentStock).toFixed(6));

    if (shortfall <= 0.0001) continue;

    // البحث عن وصفة نشطة للمنتج
    const recipe = await db.dbGet(
      `
      SELECT * FROM bom_recipes
      WHERE product_id = ? AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
      LIMIT 1
      `,
      [productId]
    );

    if (!recipe) continue;
    if (!isGlobalAutoEnabled && !Number(recipe.auto_on_sale)) continue;

    let qtyToProduce = shortfall;
    if (recipe.auto_round === 'batch' && Number(recipe.output_qty) > 0) {
      const batchesNeeded = Math.ceil(shortfall / Number(recipe.output_qty));
      qtyToProduce = batchesNeeded * Number(recipe.output_qty);
    }

    try {
      const avail = await productionGuard.computeRecipeAvailability(db, {
        recipeId: recipe.id,
        plannedQty: qtyToProduce
      });

      if (avail && avail.can_produce) {
        const order = await productionGuard.createProductionOrder(db, {
          recipe_id: recipe.id,
          planned_qty: qtyToProduce,
          produced_qty: qtyToProduce,
          trigger_source: 'auto_pos_sale',
          sale_id: options.saleId || null,
          user_id: options.userId || null,
          confirmImmediately: true,
          note: 'إنتاج تلقائي لتغطية بيع الكاشير'
        });
        producedOrders.push(order);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[Auto-Produce POS] Skipped product #${productId}:`, err.message);
    }
  }

  return producedOrders;
}

module.exports = {
  autoProduceShortfallsForSale
};
```
