## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\data-revision.js`

```javascript
/**
 * data-revision.js
 * متتبع مراجعات البيانات اللحظي لتحديث واجهة الكاشير وعملاء الشبكة المحلية فور حدوث أي تغيير
 */

'use strict';

const EventEmitter = require('events');

const IGNORED_TABLES = new Set([
  'sync_cursors',
  'sync_outbox',
  'sync_row_errors',
  'pull_row_errors',
  'pending_fk_fixups',
  'device_registry',
  'fresh_bootstrap_images',
  'document_print_log',
  'sqlite_sequence'
]);

const IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS = new Set([
  'last_cloud_sync_at',
  '_skip_stock_ledger',
  'cloud_sync_epoch',
  'cloud_snapshot_done'
]);

const PRODUCT_TABLES = new Set([
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components'
]);

const STOCK_TABLES = new Set([
  'inventory_batches',
  'stock_movements',
  'stock_debt',
  'product_serials',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items'
]);

const SALES_TABLES = new Set([
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'caisse_transactions'
]);

const PARTY_TABLES = new Set([
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'suppliers',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items'
]);

class DataRevisionTracker extends EventEmitter {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.revision = 1;
    this.productsRev = 1;
    this.stockRev = 1;
    this.salesRev = 1;
    this.partiesRev = 1;
    this.settingsRev = 1;
    this.lastTable = 'init';
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions = Object.create(null);
  }

  extractTargetTable(sql) {
    if (typeof sql !== 'string') return null;
    const s = sql.trim();

    let m = /^(?:INSERT(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+INTO|REPLACE\s+INTO)\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^UPDATE(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^DELETE\s+FROM\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    return null;
  }

  isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params = []) {
    if (!table || IGNORED_TABLES.has(table)) return true;

    if (table === 'settings') {
      const str = String(sql || '');
      for (const k of IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS) {
        if (str.includes(`'${k}'`) || (Array.isArray(params) && params[0] === k)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    if (/^UPDATE\b/i.test(String(sql || '').trim())) {
      const setMatch = /\bSET\s+([\s\S]+?)(?:\bWHERE\b|$)/i.exec(sql);
      if (setMatch) {
        const cols = setMatch[1]
          .split(',')
          .map((c) => c.split('=')[0].trim().toLowerCase())
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (cols.length > 0 && cols.every((c) => c === 'dirty' || c === 'server_rev')) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  bump(table = 'general') {
    const tbl = String(table || 'general').toLowerCase();
    if (IGNORED_TABLES.has(tbl)) return this.getSnapshot();

    this.revision += 1;
    this.lastTable = tbl;
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions[tbl] = (this.tableRevisions[tbl] || 0) + 1;

    if (PRODUCT_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.productsRev += 1;
    if (STOCK_TABLES.has(tbl)) {
      this.stockRev += 1;
      this.productsRev += 1;
    }
    if (SALES_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.salesRev += 1;
    if (PARTY_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.partiesRev += 1;
    if (tbl === 'settings' || tbl === 'shop_info' || tbl === 'custom_templates') {
      this.settingsRev += 1;
    }

    const snapshot = this.getSnapshot();
    this.emit('changed', snapshot);
    return snapshot;
  }

  getSnapshot() {
    return {
      revision: this.revision,
      products: this.productsRev,
      stock: this.stockRev,
      sales: this.salesRev,
      parties: this.partiesRev,
      settings: this.settingsRev,
      lastTable: this.lastTable,
      updatedAt: this.lastUpdatedAt,
      tables: { ...this.tableRevisions }
    };
  }
}

const defaultTracker = new DataRevisionTracker();

function installDataRevisionHook(db, tracker = defaultTracker) {
  if (!db || db._dataRevisionInstalled) return tracker;

  const prevRun = db.run.bind(db);

  db.run = function hookedRevisionRun(sql, ...args) {
    const table = tracker.extractTargetTable(sql);
    const params = Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : [];
    const shouldBump = table && !tracker.isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params);

    if (!shouldBump) {
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    const lastIdx = args.length - 1;
    if (lastIdx >= 0 && typeof args[lastIdx] === 'function') {
      const origCb = args[lastIdx];
      args[lastIdx] = function wrappedCallback(err, ...cbArgs) {
        if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
        return origCb.call(this, err, ...cbArgs);
      };
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    return prevRun(sql, ...args, function autoCallback(err) {
      if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
    });
  };

  db._dataRevisionTracker = tracker;
  db._dataRevisionInstalled = true;
  return tracker;
}

module.exports = {
  DataRevisionTracker,
  tracker: defaultTracker,
  getDataRevision: () => defaultTracker.getSnapshot(),
  bumpRevision: (tbl) => defaultTracker.bump(tbl),
  installDataRevisionHook
};
```

 * القاموس الجزائري لباركود 613، نظام البيع بالتقسيط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير)
 */

'use strict';

const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { attachWriteQueue } = require('./db-write-queue');

const { installDataRevisionHook, tracker: dataRevisionTracker } = require('./data-revision');

function resolveDatabaseFilePath() {
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      const dir = app.getPath('userData');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      return path.join(dir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  if (!fs.existsSync(fallbackDir)) fs.mkdirSync(fallbackDir, { recursive: true });
  return path.join(fallbackDir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
}

function safeAddColumn(table, columnDef) {
  db._rawRun(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${columnDef}`, () => {});
}

function createSyncTriggersForTable(table) {
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert`);
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update`);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.uuid IS NULL OR NEW.uuid = '' OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at = ''
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.updated_at, ''), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
        origin_device = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.origin_device, ''), (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id')),
        dirty = COALESCE(${table}.dirty, 1)
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND NEW.server_rev IS OLD.server_rev
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        origin_device = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), ${table}.origin_device),
        dirty = 1
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);
}

function createStockLedgerTriggers() {
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert');
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update');

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id;

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        ib.uuid,
        p.uuid,
        pv.uuid,
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
      LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
      WHERE ib.id = NEW.id AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> '';
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update
    AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND ABS(COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0)) > 0.000001
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '');

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      WHERE COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0) <> 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm
          WHERE sm.batch_uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id))
        );

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'auto',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      );
    END;
  `);
}

function tombstoneOrphans() {
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const childTables = [
    'inventory_batches',
    'product_barcodes',
    'product_prices',
    'product_promotions',
    'product_option_groups',
    'product_variants',
    'bom_recipes'
  ];

  for (const tbl of childTables) {
    db._rawRun(
      `UPDATE ${tbl}
       SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?, dirty = 1
       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)`,
      [nowStr, nowStr]
    );
  }
}

function initializeDatabase() {
  db.serialize(() => {
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');

    db._rawRun('PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA cache_size = -32000');

    // 1. الإعدادات، معلومات المتجر، والمستخدمين
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )
    `);

    const setStmt = db._rawPrepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)');
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)) {
      setStmt.run(k, String(v));
    }
    setStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_info (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        address TEXT,
        phone TEXT,

    db._rawRun(`

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\db-write-queue.js`

```javascript
/**
 * db-write-queue.js
 * محرك طابور الكتابة الذري المتسلسل لقاعدة بيانات SQLite3
 * يمنع أخطاء SQLITE_BUSY ويدعم المعاملات المتداخلة عبر SAVEPOINT
 */

'use strict';

const WRITE_SQL_PATTERN = /^\s*(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|PRAGMA\s+(?!table_info|foreign_key_list|index_list)|BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK|SAVEPOINT|RELEASE)/i;

class DbWriteQueue {
  constructor(db, options = {}) {
    this.db = db;
    this.maxRetries = Number(options.maxRetries ?? 6);
    this.baseRetryDelayMs = Number(options.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 35);
    this._chain = Promise.resolve();
    this._txDepth = 0;
    this._stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      retries: 0,
      errors: 0,
      transactions: 0
    };
  }

  isWriteQuery(sql) {
    return typeof sql === 'string' && WRITE_SQL_PATTERN.test(sql);
  }

  _sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  async _runWithRetry(fn) {
    let attempt = 0;
    while (true) {
      try {
        return await fn();
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = String((err && err.message) || err || '');
        const isLocked =
          (err && (err.code === 'SQLITE_BUSY' || err.code === 'SQLITE_LOCKED')) ||
          /SQLITE_BUSY|SQLITE_LOCKED|database is locked/i.test(msg);

        if (isLocked && attempt < this.maxRetries) {
          attempt += 1;
          this._stats.retries += 1;
          const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
          const delay = Math.round(this.baseRetryDelayMs * Math.pow(1.6, attempt - 1)) + jitter;
          await this._sleep(delay);
          continue;
        }
        this._stats.errors += 1;
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }

  enqueue(taskFn) {
    this._stats.enqueued += 1;
    const nextPromise = this._chain.then(async () => {
      const res = await this._runWithRetry(taskFn);
      this._stats.completed += 1;
      return res;
    });
    this._chain = nextPromise.catch(() => {});
    return nextPromise;
  }

  runAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const runner = this.db._rawRun ? this.db._rawRun.bind(this.db) : this.db.run.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      runner(sql, params, function onRunComplete(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({
          lastID: this ? this.lastID : undefined,
          changes: this ? this.changes : 0
        });
      });
    });
  }

  getAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const getter = this.db._rawGet ? this.db._rawGet.bind(this.db) : this.db.get.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      getter(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  allAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const aller = this.db._rawAll ? this.db._rawAll.bind(this.db) : this.db.all.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      aller(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  }

  execAsync(sql) {
    const execer = this.db._rawExec ? this.db._rawExec.bind(this.db) : this.db.exec.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      execer(sql, (err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(true)));
    });
  }

  withTransaction(workFn) {
    const executeTx = async () => {
      this._stats.transactions += 1;
      const isNested = this._txDepth > 0;
      const spName = `sp_gherbi_${this._txDepth}_${Date.now()}`;
      this._txDepth += 1;

      try {
        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION');
        }

        const txContext = {
          db: this.db,
          run: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          get: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          all: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          exec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql),
          dbRun: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          dbGet: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          dbAll: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          dbExec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql)
        };

        const output = await workFn(txContext);

        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('COMMIT');
        }

        return output;
      } catch (err) {
        try {
          if (isNested) {
            await this.runAsync(`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
            await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
          } else {
            await this.runAsync('ROLLBACK');
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        throw err;
      } finally {
        this._txDepth = Math.max(0, this._txDepth - 1);
      }
    };

    if (this._txDepth > 0) {
      return executeTx();
    }
    return this.enqueue(executeTx);
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      ...this._stats,
      inTransaction: this._txDepth > 0,
      activeTxDepth: this._txDepth
    };
  }
}

function attachWriteQueue(db, options = {}) {
  if (!db) throw new Error('Valid sqlite3 instance required');
  if (db._writeQueue) return db._writeQueue;

  if (!db._rawRun) db._rawRun = db.run.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawGet) db._rawGet = db.get.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawAll) db._rawAll = db.all.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawExec) db._rawExec = db.exec.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawPrepare) db._rawPrepare = db.prepare.bind(db);

  const queue = new DbWriteQueue(db, options);
  db._writeQueue = queue;
  db.db = db;

  db.enqueueWrite = (fn) => queue.enqueue(fn);
  db.withTransaction = (fn) => queue.withTransaction(fn);
  db.runAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.runAsync(sql, params);
  db.getAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.getAsync(sql, params);
  db.allAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.allAsync(sql, params);
  db.execAsync = (sql) => queue.execAsync(sql);

  db.dbRun = db.runAsync;
  db.dbGet = db.getAsync;
  db.dbAll = db.allAsync;
  db.dbExec = db.execAsync;

  db.getSetting = async (key, fallback = '') => {
    const row = await queue.getAsync('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
    return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
  };

  db.allowExpired = async () => {
    const val = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_allow_expired', 'false');
    return String(val).toLowerCase() === 'true' || val === '1';
  };

  db.nextNumber = async (docType = 'invoice') => {
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const defaultFormats = {
      invoice: 'FAC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      proforma: 'PRO-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      order: 'BC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      delivery: 'BL-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      payment_receipt: 'REC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      avoir: 'AV-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      recap: 'FR-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      sales_summary: 'RM-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      supplier_return: 'RF-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      production: 'PRD-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      stocktake: 'INV-{YYYY}-{0000}'
    };
    const prefixFormat = defaultFormats[docType] || `${String(docType).toUpperCase()}-{YYYY}-{0000}`;

    await queue.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format)
       VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(doc_type, year) DO UPDATE SET last_number = last_number + 1`,
      [docType, year, prefixFormat]
    );

    const row = await queue.getAsync(
      'SELECT last_number, prefix_format FROM document_counters WHERE doc_type = ? AND year = ?',
      [docType, year]
    );
    const seq = Number((row && row.last_number) || 1);
    const fmt = (row && row.prefix_format) || prefixFormat;

    return fmt
      .replace(/\{YYYY\}/g, String(year))
      .replace(/\{YY\}/g, String(year).slice(-2))
      .replace(/\{(0+)\}/g, (_m, zeros) => String(seq).padStart(zeros.length, '0'));
  };

  db.nextDocNumber = db.nextNumber;

  return queue;
}

module.exports = {
  DbWriteQueue,
  attachWriteQueue,
  createWriteQueue: attachWriteQueue
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\device-auth.js`

```javascript
/**
 * device-auth.js
 * وحدة توثيق الأجهزة، التوقيع الرقمي للطلبات (HMAC-SHA256)، وإصدار رموز اقتران الهاتف
 */

'use strict';

const axios = require('axios');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const os = require('os');
const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');

async function getSetting(db, key, fallback = '') {
  if (typeof db.getSetting === 'function') return db.getSetting(key, fallback);
  const row = await db.dbGet('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
  return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
}

async function setSetting(db, key, value) {
  await db.dbRun('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [
    String(key),
    value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
  ]);
}

async function signedRequest(db, { method = 'GET', path: urlPath, data = null, params = null, timeout = 25000 }) {
  const cloudUrl = (await getSetting(db, 'cloud_url', 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai')).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const licenseCode = licenseManager.getLicenseCode();
  const timestamp = String(Date.now());

  const bodyHash = data
    ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex')
    : '';
  const payloadToSign = `${method.toUpperCase()}:${urlPath}:${instanceId}:${hwid}:${timestamp}:${bodyHash}`;
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', cloudToken || licenseCode || 'GHERBI_POS_SECRET')
    .update(payloadToSign)
    .digest('hex');

  const response = await axios.request({
    method,
    url: `${cloudUrl}${urlPath}`,
    data,
    params,
    timeout,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: cloudToken ? `Bearer ${cloudToken}` : undefined,
      'X-Instance-Id': instanceId,
      'X-Device-Hwid': hwid,
      'X-License-Code': licenseCode,
      'X-Timestamp': timestamp,
      'X-Signature': signature
    }
  });

  return response.data;
}

async function joinWithCode(db, joinCode) {
  const cleanCode = String(joinCode || '').trim();
  if (!cleanCode) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال كود الربط السحابي');

  let instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  if (!instanceId) {
    instanceId = crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    await setSetting(db, 'instance_id', instanceId);
  }

  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const label = os.hostname() || 'Gherbi POS Terminal';

  const res = await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/join-cloud',
    data: { join_code: cleanCode, instance_id: instanceId, hwid, label }
  });

  const token = (res && (res.token || res.cloud_token)) || '';
  const role = (res && res.role) || 'follower';

  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', token);
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_role', role);
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'cloud');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'cloud');

  await db.dbRun(
    `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO device_registry (instance_id, label, hwid, is_self, is_owner, last_seen_at)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)`,
    [instanceId, label, hwid, role === 'owner' ? 1 : 0, new Date().toISOString()]
  );

  return { ok: true, role, instanceId };
}

async function getJoinInfo(db) {
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const cloudRole = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_role', 'owner');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const networkScope = await getSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  const devices = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM device_registry ORDER BY is_owner DESC, last_seen_at DESC');

  return {
    connected: Boolean(cloudToken),
    instanceId,
    role: cloudRole,
    networkScope,
    devices
  };
}

async function leaveCloud(db) {
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'local');
  return { ok: true };
}

async function issueMobilePairCode(db) {
  try {
    const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
    if (cloudToken) {
      const res = await signedRequest(db, {
        method: 'POST',
        path: '/api/pos/pair/issue',
        data: {
          instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
          hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
        }
      });
      if (res && res.code) return res;
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const localCode = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));
  return {
    ok: true,
    code: localCode,
    expiresInSeconds: 300
  };
}

async function getRelayTicket(db) {
  return await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/relay-ticket',
    data: {
      instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
      hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
    }
  });
}

module.exports = {
  signedRequest,
  joinWithCode,
  getJoinInfo,
  leaveCloud,
  issueMobilePairCode,
  getRelayTicket,
  getLicenseCode: licenseManager.getLicenseCode
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\extract_code.py`

```python
import os

# ==============================
# الإعدادات
# ==============================

OUTPUT_FILE = "project_structuregherbiaiposCLEANnew2.md"
MAX_DEPTH = 3                 # أقصى عمق للشجرة
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 200 * 1024    # 200KB

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".github", 
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
    "fet-engine",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "release",
    "out",
    "target",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "coverage",
    ".next"
}

IGNORE_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    ".gitignore",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db"
}

IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif",
    ".svg", ".ico",
    ".pdf",
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav",
    ".exe", ".dll",
    ".pyc",
    ".log"
}

CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
}


def language(ext):
    ext = ext.lower()

    if ext == ".py":
        return "python"

    if ext in [".js", ".jsx"]:
        return "javascript"

    if ext in [".ts", ".tsx"]:
        return "typescript"

    if ext == ".css":
        return "css"

    if ext == ".html":
        return "html"

    if ext == ".json":
        return "json"

    if ext == ".sql":
        return "sql"

    if ext == ".md":
        return "markdown"

    return "text"


def generate(directory):

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        ##################################################
        # Project Tree
        ##################################################

        f.write("# Project Structure\n\n")
        f.write("```text\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = sorted([d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS])

            level = os.path.relpath(root, directory).count(os.sep)

            if level > MAX_DEPTH:
                dirs.clear()
                continue

            indent = "    " * level

            folder = os.path.basename(root)

            if root == directory:
                f.write(f"{os.path.basename(directory)}/\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"{indent}├── {folder}/\n")

            sub = "    " * (level + 1)

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext in IGNORE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                f.write(f"{sub}├── {file}\n")

        f.write("```\n\n")

        ##################################################
        # Source Code
        ##################################################

        f.write("\n---\n\n")
        f.write("# Source Code\n\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS]

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext not in CODE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                path = os.path.join(root, file)

                if os.path.getsize(path) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    continue

                relative = os.path.relpath(path, directory)

                f.write(f"## `{relative}`\n\n")

                f.write(f"```{language(ext)}\n")

                try:
                    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as code:
                        f.write(code.read())
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    f.write("// Unable to read file (encoding).")
                except Exception as e:
                    f.write(f"// {e}")

                f.write("\n```\n\n---\n\n")

    print("Done!")
    print("Output:", OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate(os.getcwd())
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\imageUtils.js`

```javascript
/**
 * imageUtils.js
 * وحدة معالجة وتحويل وحفظ صور المنتجات والمتغيرات وشعار المتجر
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const DATA_URL_PATTERN = /^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+);base64,([\s\S]+)$/;

function getImagesDir() {
  let baseDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      baseDir = app.getPath('userData');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const dir = path.join(baseDir, 'product_images');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
  return dir;
}

function subtypeToExt(sub = '') {
  const s = String(sub).toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'jpeg' || s === 'jpg') return 'jpg';
  if (s === 'webp') return 'webp';
  if (s === 'gif') return 'gif';
  if (s === 'svg+xml' || s === 'svg') return 'svg';
  return 'png';
}

function processImage(imageInput, options = {}) {
  if (!imageInput || typeof imageInput !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = imageInput.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const match = DATA_URL_PATTERN.exec(trimmed);
  if (!match) {
    if (
      !trimmed.startsWith('http://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('https://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('file://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('data:') &&
      fs.existsSync(trimmed)
    ) {
      try {
        const ext = path.extname(trimmed).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
        const buf = fs.readFileSync(trimmed);
        const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
        return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
      } catch (_) {
        return trimmed;
      }
    }
    return trimmed;
  }

  if (options.saveToDisk) {
    try {
      const ext = subtypeToExt(match[1]);
      const buf = Buffer.from(match[2].replace(/\s+/g, ''), 'base64');
      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(buf).digest('hex').slice(0, 20);
      const filePath = path.join(getImagesDir(), `${options.prefix || 'img'}_${hash}.${ext}`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, buf);
      }
      return filePath;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function imageToDataUrl(pathOrUrl) {
  if (!pathOrUrl || typeof pathOrUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = pathOrUrl.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('data:image/')) return trimmed || null;

  const cleanPath = trimmed.replace(/^file:\/\/\/?/, '');
  if (fs.existsSync(cleanPath)) {
    try {
      const ext = path.extname(cleanPath).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
      const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
      const buf = fs.readFileSync(cleanPath);
      return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function deleteLocalImage(imagePath) {
  if (!imagePath || typeof imagePath !== 'string') return false;
  if (imagePath.startsWith('data:') || imagePath.startsWith('http')) return false;
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(imagePath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(imagePath);
      return true;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return false;
}

module.exports = {
  getImagesDir,
  processImage,
  saveProductImage: processImage,
  imageToDataUrl,
  deleteLocalImage
};
```

<body class="select-none">
  
  <!-- شاشة الإقلاع الترحيبية السريعة (#splashScreen) -->
  <div id="splashScreen" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950 z-[200] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white transition-opacity duration-300">
    <div class="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl shadow-blue-600/40 mb-4">
      <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-xl">point_of_sale</span>
    </div>
    <h1 class="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">Gherbi.Ai POS</h1>
    <p class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold mt-1">النظام الجزائري المتكامل لنقاط البيع وإدارة المخازن والتصنيع</p>
    <div class="w-48 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-5">
      <div class="h-full bg-blue-500 w-full animate-pulse"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="app-container">
    <!-- ===================================================================
         القائمة الجانبية (Sidebar — 18 قسماً رئيسياً)
         =================================================================== -->
    <aside id="sidebar" class="shrink-0 select-none">
      <div class="p-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded">point_of_sale</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sidebar-label">
            <div class="font-black text-base tracking-tight text-white">Gherbi.Ai POS</div>
            <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-bold">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded" style="font-size:12px;">verified</span>
              <span>PRO مفعل مدى الحياة</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button onclick="App.toggleSidebar()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">menu_open</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <nav id="sidebar-nav" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2.5 space-y-1 text-xs font-bold">
        <div class="px-3 py-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase sidebar-label">المبيعات والكاشير</div>
        <button data-view="pos" onclick="App.switchView('pos')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">shopping_cart_checkout</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_pos">شاشة المبيعات</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="sales" onclick="App.switchView('sales')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">receipt_long</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_sales_history">سجل المبيعات والضمان</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="caisse" onclick="App.switchView('caisse')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">account_balance_wallet</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_caisse">إدارة الصندوق</span>
        </button>

        <div class="px-3 pt-3 pb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase sidebar-label">المخزون والإنتاج</div>
        <button data-view="inventory" onclick="App.switchView('inventory')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">inventory_2</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_inventory">إدارة المخزون</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="bundles" onclick="App.switchView('bundles')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">redeem</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_bundles">الحزم والعروض</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="manufacturing" onclick="App.switchView('manufacturing')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">precision_manufacturing</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_manufacturing">التصنيع والإنتاج</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="stocktake" onclick="App.switchView('stocktake')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">fact_check</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_stocktake">الجرد المخزني</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="print" onclick="App.switchView('print')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">qr_code_2</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_print_studio">مركز الطباعة والباركود</span>
        </button>

        <div class="px-3 pt-3 pb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase sidebar-label">الأطراف والمالية</div>
        <button data-view="suppliers" onclick="App.switchView('suppliers')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">local_shipping</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_suppliers">إدارة الموردين</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="purchases" onclick="App.switchView('purchases')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">shopping_bag</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_purchases">المشتريات والفواتير</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="customers" onclick="App.switchView('customers')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">groups</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_customers">الزبائن والديون والأقساط</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="proformas" onclick="App.switchView('proformas')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">description</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_proformas">الفواتير الشكلية</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="orders" onclick="App.switchView('orders')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">assignment</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_orders">طلبيات الزبائن</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="expenses" onclick="App.switchView('expenses')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">payments</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_expenses">المصاريف ورأس المال</span>
        </button>

        <div class="px-3 pt-3 pb-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase sidebar-label">الذكاء والإدارة</div>
        <button data-view="analytics" onclick="App.switchView('analytics')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">monitoring</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_analytics">الإحصائيات والزكاة</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="copilot" onclick="App.switchView('copilot')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-amber-400 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">auto_awesome</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_copilot">المساعد الذكي (AI)</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="users" onclick="App.switchView('users')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">manage_accounts</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_users">المستخدمون والرقابة</span>
        </button>
        <button data-view="settings" onclick="App.switchView('settings')" class="nav-btn w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">settings</span>
          <span class="sidebar-label" data-i18n="nav_settings">الإعدادات والشبكة</span>
        </button>
      </nav>

      <div class="p-3 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/50">
        <div onclick="App.openModal('accountModal')" class="flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer">
          <div id="userAvatarBadge" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white font-black flex items-center justify-center text-sm">م</div>
          <div class="sidebar-label text-xs">
            <div id="currentUserName" class="font-bold text-white">المدير العام</div>
            <div id="currentUserRole" class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Admin</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button onclick="App.openLockScreenModal()" title="قفل الشاشة السريع" class="text-amber-400 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">lock_person</span>
          </button>
          <button onclick="App.openLoginModal()" title="تبديل المستخدم" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">logout</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- ===================================================================
         المنطقة الرئيسية والشريط العلوي المتقدم (Main Content & Top Navbar)
         =================================================================== -->
    <main id="main-content">
      <header id="top-header">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-2xl">
          <div class="relative flex-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400">search</span>
            <input id="globalPosSearch" type="text"
              oninput="App.onPosSearchInput(this.value)"
              placeholder="ابحث بالاسم، الباركود، الفئة، العائلة، أو كود PLU..."
              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
          </div>
          <div class="relative w-52">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-blue-600">barcode_scanner</span>
            <input id="barcodeInput" type="text"
              onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') App.handleBarcodeScan(this.value)"
              placeholder="امسح الباركود (Enter)..."
              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold border-blue-500/40">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button onclick="App.openPosScaleModal()" id="liveScaleBox"
            class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs hover:border-emerald-500"
            title="فتح نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm text-emerald-500">scale</span>
            <span id="liveScaleWeight" class="font-mono font-black text-xs">0.000 kg</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('caisse')" id="headerShiftBadge"
            class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">point_of_sale</span>
            <span id="headerShiftText">المناوبة نشطة</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('settings')" id="lanClientsBadge"
            class="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20 text-xs font-bold"
            title="الأجهزة المتصلة على الشبكة المحلية">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">lan</span>
            <span id="lanClientsCountText">LAN</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openCustomerDisplayWindow()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
            title="فتح شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية (Customer Display)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tv</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('virtualKeyboardModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            title="لوحة المفاتيح اللمسية (Touch Keyboard)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard</span>
          </button>

          <div class="relative">
            <button id="notificationsBellBtn" onclick="App.toggleNotificationsPopover()"
              class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 relative"
              title="تنبيهات المخزون والصلاحية والأقساط">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">notifications</span>
              <span id="notifCountBadge" class="hidden absolute -top-0.5 -left-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-full text-[10px] font-black">0</span>
            </button>
            <div id="notificationsPopover" class="hidden absolute left-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-3 z-50 text-xs space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
          </div>

          <button onclick="App.openAuditLogsModal()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-amber-500"
            title="سجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير (Anti-Theft Audit)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">shield_person</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('shortcutsHelpModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            title="دليل اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح (F1..F12)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">help</span>
          </button>

          <select id="langSwitcher" onchange="App.setLanguage(this.value)"
            class="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer">
            <option value="ar">🇩🇿 العربية</option>
            <option value="fr">🇫🇷 Français</option>
            <option value="en">🇬🇧 English</option>
          </select>

          <button onclick="App.toggleDarkMode()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="الوضع الليلي / النهاري">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">dark_mode</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.toggleFullscreen()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="ملء الشاشة">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">fullscreen</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- =================================================================
           1. شاشة المبيعات والكاشير المطورة (POS View with Resizer & Edit Mode)
           ================================================================= -->
      <section id="view-pos" class="view-section active">
        <div id="posMainGridContainer" class="pos-layout" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 6px 420px; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <!-- يمين: الفئات، أزرار التحكم، وشبكة المنتجات مع الترقيم -->
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-2.5 min-h-0 pl-1">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div id="posCategoryPills" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5"></div>
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <button onclick="App.openModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tune</span>
                  <span>تخصيص</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openPosAdvancedFilterModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">filter_alt</span>
                  <span>فلتر</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openPosQuickProduceModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">precision_manufacturing</span>
                  <span>إنتاج فوري</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openFreeItemModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add_shopping_cart</span>
                  <span>منتج حر (F8)</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.toggleReturnMode()" id="btnReturnMode" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard_return</span>
                  <span>إرجاع</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openProductModal()" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add</span>
                  <span>إضافة منتج</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posProductsGrid" class="products-grid flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1"></div>

            <div id="posPaginationBar" class="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(-1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">السابق</button>
              <span id="posPageInfoText" class="text-slate-500">صفحة 1 من 1</span>
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">التالي</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- الفاصل القابل للسحب لتغيير عرض السلة (#posCartResizer) -->
          <div id="posCartResizer" title="اسحب لتكبير أو تصغير عرض السلة"
            class="w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-500 cursor-col-resize transition-colors"></div>

          <!-- يسار: سلة المشتريات والحسابات -->
          <div id="posCartContainer" class="cart-container">
            <!-- شريط تنبيه وضع تعديل فاتورة سابقة -->
            <div id="posEditSaleBanner" class="hidden px-3 py-2 bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-between">
              <span id="posEditSaleBannerText">وضع تعديل الفاتورة #</span>
              <button onclick="App.cancelEditSaleMode()" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/25 hover:bg-black/40 text-[11px]">إلغاء التعديل ✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="p-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div id="multiCartTabs" class="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto"></div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button onclick="App.openRecentSalesModal()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1" title="آخر مبيعات الكاشير">
                    <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">history</span>
                    <span>سجل</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onclick="App.newCartTab()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 text-xs font-bold">+ سلة</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="flex gap-1.5">
                <select id="posCustomerSelect" class="flex-1 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"></select>
                <button onclick="App.openCustomerModal()" class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600/15 text-emerald-600" title="إضافة زبون جديد">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">person_add</span>
                </button>
                <select id="posPriceTierSelect" onchange="App.setCartPriceTier(this.value)" class="w-28 px-2 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
                  <option value="retail">سعر التجزئة</option>
                  <option value="wholesale">سعر الجملة</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posCartItems" class="cart-items p-3 space-y-2"></div>

            <div class="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span class="text-slate-500 font-bold">المجموع الفرعي (<span id="cartItemsCountText">0</span> صنف):</span>
                <span id="cartSubtotalText" class="font-mono font-bold">0.00 د.ج</span>
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <button onclick="App.openCartModifierModal()" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">calculate</span>
                  <span>التخفيض (% أو مبلغ):</span>
                </button>
                <input id="cartDiscountInput" type="number" step="any" value="0"
                  oninput="App.recalcCart()"
                  class="w-28 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-center font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                <span class="font-black text-sm">الإجمالي المستحق:</span>
                <div class="text-left">
                  <span id="cartTotalText" class="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 block">0.00 د.ج</span>
                  <span id="cartTotalCentimeBadge" class="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block">🇩🇿 بالتداول الجزائري: 0 سنتيم</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                <button onclick="App.clearCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/20">إلغاء (F4)</button>
                <button onclick="App.holdCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/20">تعليق (F2)</button>
                <button onclick="App.openDraftsModal()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800">مسودات (<span id="draftsCountBadge">0</span>)</button>
                <button onclick="App.saveCartAsProforma()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500/20">كمبدئية</button>
                <button onclick="App.openOrderModalFromCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500/20">كطلبية</button>
              </div>

              <button onclick="App.openCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-black text-base flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25">
                <span class="material-symbols-rounded">payments</span>
                <span id="btnCheckoutMainText">تسديد الفاتورة (F1)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- =================================================================
           بقية الأقسام الـ 17 (تُبنى ديناميكياً عبر renderer.js)
           ================================================================= -->

      <section id="view-caisse" class="view-section"><div id="caisse-view-root"></div></section>

      <section id="view-bundles" class="view-section"><div id="bundles-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-manufacturing" class="view-section"><div id="manufacturing-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-stocktake" class="view-section"><div id="stocktake-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-print" class="view-section"><div id="print-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-suppliers" class="view-section"><div id="suppliers-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-purchases" class="view-section"><div id="purchases-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-customers" class="view-section"><div id="customers-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-proformas" class="view-section"><div id="proformas-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-orders" class="view-section"><div id="orders-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-expenses" class="view-section"><div id="expenses-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-analytics" class="view-section"><div id="analytics-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-copilot" class="view-section"><div id="copilot-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-users" class="view-section"><div id="users-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-settings" class="view-section"><div id="settings-view-root"></div></section>

  </div>

  <!-- =====================================================================
       منظومة النوافذ المنبثقة الشاملة (44 نافذة تفاعلية — Zero window.prompt)
       ===================================================================== -->

  <!-- 1. نافذة الدفع والتسديد الشاملة (Checkout Modal + Split Payment + Installments) -->
  <div id="checkoutModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-xl font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-blue-600">point_of_sale</span>
          <span>تسديد وإتمام الفاتورة (F1)</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('checkoutModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="creditLimitAlertBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/15 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 text-xs font-bold"></div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div class="space-y-3">
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-center">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الإجمالي المطلوب للدفع</div>
            <div id="chkTotalDue" class="text-3xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 mt-1">0.00 د.ج</div>
            <div id="chkCentimeHelperText" class="text-xs font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-1">🇩🇿 بالسنتيم: 0 سنتيم</div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyTva" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">تطبيق TVA (19%)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyStamp" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">حق الطابع (1%)</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">طريقة الدفع</label>
            <select id="chkPaymentMethod" onchange="App.onCheckoutMethodChange(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <option value="cash">نقداً (Espèces / Cash)</option>
              <option value="credit">آجل / دين (À Terme)</option>
              <option value="cib">بطاقة ذهبية / بنكية (CIB / Edahabia)</option>
              <option value="baridimob">بريدي موب (BaridiMob / CCP)</option>
              <option value="cheque">شيك (Chèque)</option>
              <option value="split">دفع مختلط متعدد (Split Payment)</option>
              <option value="installment">بيع بالتقسيط (Vente par Facilité)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          
          <!-- حقل رقم المرجع ورمز BaridiMob QR عند الدفع الإلكتروني أو الشيك -->
          <div id="chkPaymentRefBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div class="flex-1">
                <label class="block font-bold mb-1 text-indigo-600">رقم مرجع العملية / الصك (Transaction Reference N°)</label>
                <input id="chkPaymentRefInput" type="text" placeholder="أدخل رقم العملية أو الشيك..." class="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <img id="chkBaridimobQrImg" class="hidden w-20 h-20 rounded-lg border bg-white p-1" alt="RIP QR">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="chkSplitPaymentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-blue-600">تقسيم المبلغ على عدة طرق دفع:</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">نقداً (Cash)</label><input id="splitCashInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">CIB / BaridiMob</label><input id="splitCardInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الباقي آجل (دين)</label><input id="splitCreditInput" type="number" step="any" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-rose-500"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="chkInstallmentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-amber-600">جدولة الأقساط الشهرية (Vente par Facilité):</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الدفعة الأولى (تسبقة)</label><input id="instDownPayment" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">عدد الأشهر</label><input id="instMonthsCount" type="number" min="1" max="36" value="6" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">القسط الشهري</label><input id="instMonthlyVal" type="text" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">المبلغ المستلم</label>
              <input id="chkPaidAmount" type="number" step="any"
                oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-mono font-black text-base text-center">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">الباقي للزبون (Rendu)</label>
              <div id="chkChangeAmount" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 font-mono font-black text-base text-center">0.00</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-2">
          <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الفئات النقدية الجزائرية السريعة (د.ج)</div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(2000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-900 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">2000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(1000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">1000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(500)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">500 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(200)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">200 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(100)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-sky-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">100 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(50)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">50 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(20)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">20 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(10)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">10 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(5)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-500 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">5 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.setExactCash()" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-xs">المبلغ الكامل</button>
          </div>
          <div class="pt-2">
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">تاريخ استحقاق الدين (عند البيع الآجل)</label>
            <input id="chkDueDate" type="date" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('receipt')" class="py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">receipt</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة وصل حراري</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('a4')" class="py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة فاتورة A4</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('none')" class="py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">check_circle</span>
          <span>حفظ فقط بدون طباعة</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. نافذة المسودات والفواتير المعلقة (Drafts Modal - F3) -->
  <div id="draftsModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">الفواتير المعلقة والمسودات (F3)</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('draftsModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="draftsModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. نافذة سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع (Recent Sales Modal) -->
  <div id="recentSalesModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('recentSalesModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="recentSalesModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. نافذة تخصيص عرض شاشة المبيعات المتقدمة (POS Customize Modal) -->
  <div id="posCustomizeModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">تخصيص شبكة منتجات الكاشير وعرض السلة</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">حجم بطاقات المنتجات</label>
          <select id="posCardSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="small">صغير (كثافة عالية)</option>
            <option value="medium" selected>متوسط (قياسي)</option>
            <option value="large">كبير (واضح للشاشات اللمسية)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عدد المنتجات في كل صفحة</label>
          <select id="posPageSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
            <option value="18">18 منتج</option>
            <option value="24" selected>24 منتج</option>
            <option value="36">36 منتج</option>
            <option value="60">60 منتج</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عرض السلة الجانبية (بالبيكسل)</label>
          <input id="posCartWidthInput" type="number" min="320" max="620" value="420" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
        </div>
        <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowImagesCheckbox" type="checkbox" checked>
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار صور المنتجات داخل البطاقات</span>
        </label>
        <label id="posShowCostRow" class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowCostCheckbox" type="checkbox">
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار سعر الشراء (التكلفة) بخط صغير على بطاقة المنتج</span>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3">
        <button onclick="App.savePosCustomization()" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">حفظ وتطبيق</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 5. نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر (POS Scale Modal) -->
  <div id="posScaleModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-500">scale</span>
          <span>الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posScaleModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-emerald-400 text-center font-mono">
        <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">الوزن الصافي المستقر</div>
        <div id="scaleModalWeightDisplay" class="text-4xl font-black">0.000 kg</div>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-2 text-xs">
        <label class="block font-bold">اختر المنتج الموزون لإضافته للسلة:</label>
        <select id="scaleModalProductSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold"></select>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2">
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.zero()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">تصفير (Zero)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.tare()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">طارئة (Tare)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.readOnce()" class="py-2 bg-blue-600/15 text-blue-600 rounded-xl font-bold">قراءة الآن</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button onclick="App.addWeightedProductFromScaleModal()" class="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black">إضافة الوزن الحالي إلى السلة</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 6. نافذة اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي عند البيع (Variant/Batch/Serial Picker) -->
  <div id="posVariantBatchPickerModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="pickerModalProductName" class="text-lg font-black">اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posVariantBatchPickerModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="pickerModalBody" class="space-y-3 text-xs max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 7. نافذة إضافة/تعديل منتج الشاملة بـ 5 تبويبات + Markup % + أدوات المتغيرات الجماعية -->
  <div id="productModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="productModalTitle" class="text-lg font-black">إضافة / تعديل منتج</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('productModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <input id="prodIdInput" type="hidden">

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-2 text-xs font-bold">
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('basic')" id="prodTabBtn-basic" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white">1. البيانات الأساسية</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('pricing')" id="prodTabBtn-pricing" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">2. الأسعار وهامش الربح</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('barcodes')" id="prodTabBtn-barcodes" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">3. الباركودات المتعددة</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('variants')" id="prodTabBtn-variants" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">4. مصفوفة المتغيرات</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('bom')" id="prodTabBtn-bom" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">5. التصنيع والضمان</button>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 1: البيانات الأساسية -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-basic" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">اسم المنتج *</label>
          <input id="prodNameInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">الباركود (يدعم القاموس الجزائري 613)</label>
          <div class="flex gap-1">
            <input id="prodBarcodeInput" type="text" onchange="App.autoFillFromDzDictionary(this.value)" class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
            <button onclick="App.generateRandomBarcode()" class="px-2.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold" title="توليد باركود جزائري">⚡</button>
          </div>
        </div>

  <!-- 15. نافذة إنشاء مرتجع للمورد (Supplier Return Modal) -->
  <div id="supplierReturnModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black text-rose-600">إرجاع بضاعة للمورد من فواتير الشراء (Bon de Retour Fournisseur)</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('supplierReturnModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">اختر المورد *</label>
          <select id="supRetSupplierSelect" onchange="App.loadSupplierReturnableBatches(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold"></select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">طريقة تسوية المرتجع</label>
          <select id="supRetSettlementMode" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="credit">خصم من دين المورد (Avoir / Crédit)</option>
            <option value="cash">استرداد نقدي للصندوق (Remboursement Espèces)</option>
          </select>
