        <input id="chqPartyInp" type="text" placeholder="اسم الزبون / المورد *" class="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
        <input id="chqNumberInp" type="text" placeholder="رقم الشيك / الكمبيالة *" class="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
        <select id="chqBankInp" class="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
          <option value="CCP Algérie Poste">CCP بريد الجزائر</option>
          <option value="BNA">BNA البنك الوطني الجزائري</option>
          <option value="BEA">BEA بنك الجزائر الخارجي</option>
          <option value="CPA">CPA القرض الشعبي الجزائري</option>
          <option value="BADR">BADR بنك الفلاحة والتنمية</option>
          <option value="AGB">AGB الخليج الجزائر</option>
          <option value="Al Salam Bank">بنك السلام الجزائر</option>
          <option value="Société Générale">Société Générale</option>
        </select>
        <input id="chqAmountInp" type="number" step="any" placeholder="المبلغ (د.ج) *" class="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
        <div class="flex gap-1">
          <input id="chqDueInp" type="date" class="flex-1 px-2 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
          <button onclick="App.addNewChequeRecord()" class="px-3 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl font-black">+</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="chequesPortfolioTableBox" class="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto text-xs"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- نافذة التصريح الجبائي الجزائري (État 104 & G50 — #algerianFiscalModal) -->
  <div id="algerianFiscalModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-5xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white font-black text-xs">🇩🇿 الجباية الجزائرية</span>
          <h3 class="text-lg font-black">التصريح الجبائي السنوي للزبائن (État 104) وملخص الضرائب الشهري (G50)</h3>
        </div>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('algerianFiscalModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="algerianFiscalModalBody" class="space-y-4 text-xs"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- نافذة اقتران تطبيق الهاتف المحمول عبر QR (#cloudPairMobileModal) -->
  <div id="cloudPairMobileModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4 text-center">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">

        <div class="text-xs font-bold">امسح الرمز من هاتفك على نفس شبكة Wi-Fi أو أدخل كود الاقتران:</div>
        <div id="mobilePairCodeText" class="font-mono text-2xl font-black tracking-widest text-blue-600">------</div>
        <div id="mobilePairUrlText" class="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script src="./assets/js/translations.js"></script>

  <script src="./stocktake/stocktake-ui.js"></script>

</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      color: #1f2937;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .accent {
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-table">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 16px auto;
      padding: 22px 26px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .reg-strip {
      border-top: 2px double #1e3a8a;
      border-bottom: 2px double #1e3a8a;
    }

    .info-box {
      border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* جدول مضغوط — يتسع لعدد كبير من المنتجات في صفحة واحدة. */
    .invoice-table {
      border-collapse: collapse;
      width: 100%;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }

    .invoice-table th,
    .invoice-table td {
      border: 1px solid #475569;
      padding: 3px 5px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }

    .invoice-table th {
      font-weight: 800;
      background: #e8eefc;
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }

    .invoice-table td {
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* خلية البيان يضع لها الـ renderer صنف .text-left — نحاذيها يميناً في RTL */
    .invoice-table td.text-left {
      text-align: right;
    }

    .filler td {
      height: 70px;
      border-left: 1px solid #475569;
      border-right: 1px solid #475569;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #475569;
      border-top: none;
    }

    .totals-box {
      border: 1.5px solid #1e3a8a;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    @media print {
      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 14px 16px;
      }

      .invoice-table th {
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
        print-color-adjust: exact;
      }

      .no-print {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" id="invoice-paper">

    <!-- الترويسة -->
    <header class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-2">
      <div class="text-right flex-1" data-purpose="company-details">
        <h1 class="text-xl font-extrabold accent leading-tight">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        <p class="text-[10px] font-bold mt-0.5">العنوان : {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-[10px] mt-0.5">
          <span>الهاتف : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>
          <span>الثابت : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>
          <span>البريد : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-purpose="logo-container">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="{{COMPANY_NAME}}" class="h-20 w-20 object-contain rounded-lg" />
        {{/if}}
        {{#unless COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <div class="h-20 w-20 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300">
          <span class="text-slate-400 font-black text-[9px] text-center px-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/unless}}
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- المعلومات القانونية للشركة -->
    <section class="reg-strip py-1 mb-2 text-center text-[9.5px] font-semibold tracking-tight" data-purpose="registry-info">
      رقم جبائي : {{COMPANY_NIF}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; سجل تجاري : {{COMPANY_RC}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; مادة جبائية : {{COMPANY_AI}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; رقم الإحصاء : {{COMPANY_NIS}}
    </section>

    <!-- العنوان -->
    <h2 class="text-center text-lg font-extrabold accent mb-2">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}} رقم {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</h2>

    <!-- معلومات الزبون + الفاتورة -->
    <section class="flex justify-between gap-3 mb-2 text-[10.5px]" data-purpose="client-information">
      <div class="info-box p-2 w-[62%] leading-relaxed">
        <p><span class="font-bold">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}} :</span> {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p><span class="font-bold">العنوان :</span> {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4">
          <span><span class="font-bold">سجل تجاري :</span> {{PARTY_RC}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">رقم جبائي :</span> {{PARTY_NIF}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">مادة جبائية :</span> {{PARTY_AI}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">رقم الإحصاء :</span> {{PARTY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="info-box p-2 w-[36%] leading-relaxed">
        <p><span class="font-bold">التاريخ :</span> {{DATE}}</p>
        <p><span class="font-bold">{{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}}</span> {{PAYMENT_MODE}}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- جدول المنتجات (8 أعمدة — مطابق لمخرجات الـ renderer) -->
    <section class="mb-2">
      <table class="invoice-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width:5%">الرقم</th>
            <th style="width:13%">المرجع</th>
            <th style="width:29%">البيان</th>
            <th style="width:10%">الكمية</th>
            <th style="width:9%">الوحدة</th>
            <th style="width:11%">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
            <th style="width:8%">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
            <th style="width:15%">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
          <tr class="filler">
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <!-- المجاميع + المبلغ بالحروف -->
    <section class="flex flex-row justify-between gap-4 mt-2">
      <div class="w-1/2 pt-2">
        <p class="font-bold text-[11px] mb-1">حررت هذه الفاتورة بمبلغ :</p>
        <p class="text-[11px] italic font-bold">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-1/2 totals-box p-3 bg-white" data-purpose="totals-box">
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm border-t border-black pt-1 mt-1">
          <span class="font-black text-base accent">{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-base accent">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1 mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-dashed border-slate-400" data-purpose="old-balance-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="remaining-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm border-t border-black pt-1 mt-1" data-purpose="total-debt-row">
          <span class="font-black text-base">{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-base">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- التوقيع -->

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: 210mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 3px solid #047857;
      
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #047857;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #047857;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer-sign">
      <div>Gherbi.Ai POS — نظام نقاط البيع والمحاسبة المتكامل</div>
      <div class="sign-box">{{LBL_SIGNATURE}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>

```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
    }

    .font-serif-bold {
      font-family: serif;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-borders">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: 40px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .rounded-box {
      border: 1.5px solid #000;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .table-border,
    .table-border th,
    .table-border td {
      border: 1px solid #000;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    .table-border th {
      padding: 6px 4px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .table-border td {
      padding: 6px 4px;
    }

    @media print {
      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 20px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" data-purpose="invoice-document">

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="mb-8">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-bold mb-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-2 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>الهاتف : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
        <div>الثابت : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</div>
        <div>البريد : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-1 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>سجل تجاري : {{COMPANY_RC}}</div>
        <div>رقم جبائي : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</div>
        <div>مادة جبائية : {{COMPANY_AI}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="font-bold text-[10px] mt-1">رقم الإحصاء : {{COMPANY_NIS}}</div>
    </header>

    <!-- Client/Supplier and Invoice Info -->
    <section class="flex justify-between items-start mb-10" data-purpose="info-block">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box text-[10px] font-bold leading-relaxed">
        <p>{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}} : {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p>العنوان : {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <p>سجل تجاري : {{PARTY_RC}}</p>
        <p>رقم جبائي : {{PARTY_NIF}}</p>
        <p>مادة جبائية : {{PARTY_AI}}</p>
        <p>رقم الإحصاء : {{PARTY_NIS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-[48%] pl-8" style="text-align: left;">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}} رقم {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</h2>
        <p class="text-sm font-bold">التاريخ : {{DATE}}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Items Table -->
    <section class="mb-8" data-purpose="items-table">
      <table class="w-full table-border text-center text-[10px] font-bold">
        <thead>
          <tr class="bg-white">
            <th class="w-[6%]">الرقم</th>
            <th class="w-[14%]">المرجع</th>
            <th class="w-[30%]">البيان</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">الكمية</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">الوحدة</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <!-- Summary and Total -->
    <section class="flex flex-col mb-8" style="align-items: flex-start;" data-purpose="totals-section">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span>{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span>{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span>{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span>{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span>{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-dashed border-slate-400" data-purpose="old-balance-row">
          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span>{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1" data-purpose="remaining-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span>{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black" data-purpose="total-debt-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span>{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <section class="space-y-6" data-purpose="footer-details">
      <div>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">حررت هذه الفاتورة بمبلغ :</p>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px]">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-end gap-4 mt-6" data-purpose="footer-row">
        <div class="border border-black px-4 py-2 font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="payment-mode">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} {{PAYMENT_MODE}}
        </div>
        <div class="w-[45%] border border-black rounded-md px-3 pt-2 pb-12 text-center font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="signature-box">
          {{LBL_SIGNATURE}}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>
  <script>
    window.onload = function () {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print=true')) {
        setTimeout(() => { window.print(); }, 500);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;

      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px;

    .table-border,
    .table-border th,

      border: 1px solid #000;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    .table-border th {
      padding: 6px 4px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 20px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">

    <header class="mb-8">

      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>

        <div>Email : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</div>
      </div>

        <div>CR : {{COMPANY_RC}}</div>
        <div>TIN : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</div>
        <div>AI : {{COMPANY_AI}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="font-bold text-[10px] mt-1">NIS : {{COMPANY_NIS}}</div>
    </header>

    <!-- Client/Supplier and Invoice Info -->
    <section class="flex justify-between items-start mb-10" data-purpose="info-block">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box text-[10px] font-bold leading-relaxed">
        <p>{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}} : {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p>Address : {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <p>CR : {{PARTY_RC}}</p>
        <p>TIN : {{PARTY_NIF}}</p>
        <p>AI : {{PARTY_AI}}</p>
        <p>NIS : {{PARTY_NIS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-[48%] text-right pr-8">

          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span>{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1" data-purpose="remaining-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span>{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black" data-purpose="total-debt-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span>{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Footer -->

      <div>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">Invoice fixed at the sum of :</p>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px]">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-end gap-4 mt-6" data-purpose="footer-row">
        <div class="border border-black px-4 py-2 font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="payment-mode">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} {{PAYMENT_MODE}}
        </div>
        <div class="w-[45%] border border-black rounded-md px-3 pt-2 pb-12 text-center font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="signature-box">
          {{LBL_SIGNATURE}}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>
  <script>
    window.onload = function () {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print=true')) {
        setTimeout(() => { window.print(); }, 500);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

      background: #e8eefc;

      height: 70px;
      border-left: 1px solid #475569;
      border-right: 1px solid #475569;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #475569;
      border-top: none;
    }

    @media print {

      }

      <div class="w-1/2 totals-box p-3 bg-white" data-purpose="totals-box">

        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">

        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm border-t border-black pt-1 mt-1">

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\invoice_template_9.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr" dir="ltr">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #1f2937;
      background-color: #eef0f4;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-borders">
    /* Indigo/blue palette sampled from the printed model. */
    :root {
      --ink: #283593;       /* deep indigo — titles & strong text       */
      --line: #3f51b5;      /* indigo grid & frame lines                 */
      --head: #e9ecfb;      /* soft tinted header fill                   */
      --head2: #f4f6fd;     /* lighter fill for value cells / Total row  */
    }

    /* The whole sheet — A4 proportions, soft framed boxes like the model. */
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: 28px 32px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
    }

    /* Rounded outlined panels (header, client, title). */
    .panel,
    .panel-soft {
      border: 1.6px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 14px;
    }

    /* Rounded card that clips a table's square corners into the radius. */
    .table-card {
      border: 1.6px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .grid-table {
      border-collapse: collapse;
      width: 100%;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }

    .grid-table th,
    .grid-table td {
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    /* The card frame already draws the outer edges — drop the table's own
       outer borders so the rounded corners stay clean. */
    .grid-table tr>*:first-child {
      border-left: none;
    }

    .grid-table tr>*:last-child {
      border-right: none;
    }

    .grid-table thead tr:first-child>*,
    .grid-table tbody tr:first-child>* {
      border-top: none;
    }

    .grid-table tbody tr:last-child>* {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    /* Meta band — separated rounded label pills + a value row card. */
    .meta-labels {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .meta-pill {
      border: 1.4px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--head);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 10px;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 5px 4px;
    }

    .meta-values td {
      padding: 7px 4px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 11px;
      height: 26px;
      background: var(--head2);
    }

    .items-table th {
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 8px 4px;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--head);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .items-table td {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 6px 6px;
      text-align: center;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .items-table td.desig {
      text-align: start;
    }

    /* Tall filler so the products grid fills the page like the printed model. */
    .filler-row td {
      height: 340px;
      border-top: none;
    }

    .total-row td {
      background: var(--head);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .brand-title {
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    @media print {
      :root {
        --head: #e9ecfb;
        --head2: #f4f6fd;
      }

      .meta-pill,
      .meta-values td,
      .items-table th,
      .total-row td {
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
        print-color-adjust: exact;
      }

      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 14px 18px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" data-purpose="invoice-document">

    <!-- ===== Top: Company panel (left) + Client panel (right) ===== -->
    <section class="flex justify-between gap-4 mb-3" data-purpose="head-block">

      <!-- Company panel -->
      <div class="panel w-[60%] p-3">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
          <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="{{COMPANY_NAME}}" class="h-16 w-16 object-contain rounded-lg" />
          {{/if}}
          {{#unless COMPANY_LOGO}}
          <div class="h-16 w-16 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span class="text-slate-400 font-black text-[9px] text-center px-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</span>
          </div>
          {{/unless}}
          <div class="flex-1">
            <h1 class="brand-title text-lg leading-tight">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
            <p class="text-[10px] font-bold mt-0.5">{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-[10px] font-bold mt-0.5">
              <span>{{LBL_TEL}} : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>
              <span>{{LBL_FAX}} : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pt-2 mt-1 text-[10px] font-bold space-y-0.5" style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);">
          <p>RC : {{COMPANY_RC}}</p>
          <p>AI : {{COMPANY_AI}}</p>
          <p>NIF : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</p>
          <p>NIS : {{COMPANY_NIS}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Client panel -->
      <div class="panel-soft w-[38%] p-3">
        <div class="brand-title text-base text-center rounded-md py-1 mb-2" style="background:var(--head);">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="text-[10px] font-bold space-y-1">
          <p>{{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
          <p>RC : {{PARTY_RC}}</p>
          <p>AI : {{PARTY_AI}}</p>
          <p>NIF : {{PARTY_NIF}}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="text-[10px] font-bold mt-2 pt-2 space-y-0.5" style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);">
          <p class="flex justify-between"><span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span><span>{{CLIENT_OLD_DEBT}}</span></p>
          <p class="flex justify-between" style="color:var(--ink);"><span class="font-black">{{LBL_CURRENT_DEBT}}</span><span class="font-black">{{CLIENT_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===== Title (Facture + N° + Date) ===== -->
    <section class="panel px-4 py-2 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between" style="background:var(--head);">
      <h2 class="brand-title text-3xl">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</h2>
      <div class="text-right text-[12px] font-bold leading-snug" style="color:var(--ink);">
        <div>N° {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div>{{LBL_DATE}} : {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===== Meta band (N° / Date / Commande / Règlement / Livraison / Page) ===== -->
    <section class="mb-3" data-purpose="meta-band">
      <div class="meta-labels mb-1">
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:16%">{{LBL_INVOICE_NO}}</div>
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:14%">{{LBL_DATE}}</div>
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:20%">{{LBL_YOUR_ORDER}}</div>
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:18%">{{LBL_SETTLEMENT_MODE}}</div>
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:20%">{{LBL_DELIVERY}}</div>
        <div class="meta-pill" style="width:12%">{{LBL_PAGE}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="table-card">
        <table class="grid-table meta-values">
          <tr>
            <td style="width:16%">{{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</td>
            <td style="width:14%">{{DATE}}</td>
            <td style="width:20%">&nbsp;</td>
            <td style="width:18%">{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</td>
            <td style="width:20%">&nbsp;</td>
            <td style="width:12%">1/1</td>
          </tr>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===== Items table ===== -->
    <section class="mb-4" data-purpose="items-table">
      <div class="table-card">
        <table class="grid-table items-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style="width:15%">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
              <th style="width:37%">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
              <th style="width:12%">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
              <th style="width:12%">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
              <th style="width:12%">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
              <th style="width:12%">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
            <tr class="filler-row">
              <td></td>
              <td></td>
              <td></td>
              <td></td>
              <td></td>
              <td></td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===== Totals + debts summary (follows design 1) ===== -->
    <section class="flex justify-between gap-6 mt-2" data-purpose="totals-section">

      <!-- Left: amount in words -->
      <div class="w-1/2 pt-2" data-purpose="amount-in-words">
        <p class="font-extrabold text-[12px] mb-1">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</p>
        <p class="font-bold text-[12px] italic">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Right: totals / debts box -->
      <div class="w-[44%] panel p-3 text-[11px]" data-purpose="totals-box">
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="discount-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mt-1 pt-1" style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);">
          <span class="font-black text-base" style="color:var(--ink);">{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-base" style="color:var(--ink);">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ===== Signature ===== -->
    <section class="flex justify-end mt-8" data-purpose="signature-section">
      <div class="w-1/3 panel px-3 pt-2 pb-14 text-center font-bold text-[11px]" style="color:var(--ink);">
        {{LBL_SIGNATURE}}
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>
  <script>
    window.onload = function () {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print=true')) {
        setTimeout(function () { window.print(); }, 500);
      }
    };
  </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}

    </section>

    <!-- Totals (markup mirrors invoice_template_4 so the conditional row removals apply) -->
    <section class="flex flex-col mb-3" style="align-items: flex-start;" data-purpose="totals-section">

        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span>{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-0.5" data-purpose="stamp-row">

          <span>{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black">

        </div>

          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>

        <div class="flex justify-between py-0.5" data-purpose="remaining-row">

          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span>{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Footer -->

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="page-size">
    @page { size: A4; margin: 0; }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #1f2937;
      background-color: #e5e7eb;
    }
    .accent { color: #1d4ed8; }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-borders">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .doc-pad { padding: 16mm 14mm; }

    .brand-bar {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a 0%, #1d4ed8 100%);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 10mm 14mm;
    }
    .logo-box {
      width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden; flex: none;
    }
    .logo-box img { max-width: 90px; max-height: 90px; object-fit: contain; }

    .rounded-box { border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; }

    .table-border { border-collapse: collapse; }
    .table-border th { background: #1e293b; color: #fff; padding: 8px 6px; font-weight: bold; }
    .table-border td { padding: 7px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .table-border tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f8fafc; }

    @media print {
      body { background-color: #fff; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
      .invoice-container { box-shadow: none; margin: 0; width: 100%; min-height: auto; }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" data-purpose="invoice-document">

    <!-- Big-logo brand header -->
    <header class="brand-bar flex justify-between items-center">
      <div class="logo-box">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}<img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="logo" />{{/if}}
        {{#unless COMPANY_LOGO}}<span style="font-size:30px;font-weight:900;opacity:.85;">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</span>{{/unless}}
      </div>
      <div class="text-left" style="text-align:left;">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-black mb-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        <p class="text-[10px] opacity-90">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>
        <p class="text-[10px] opacity-90 mt-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <p class="text-[10px] opacity-90">{{LBL_TEL}} : {{COMPANY_PHONE}} — {{LBL_FAX}} : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</p>
        <p class="text-[10px] opacity-90">{{LBL_EMAIL}} : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</p>

</body>

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\licenseManager.js`

```javascript
/**
 * licenseManager.js
 * نظام إدارة التراخيص والبصمة المادية للجهاز (HWID) لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * مفعّل بالكامل مدى الحياة للمالك (PRO_LIFETIME) دون أي قيود تجريبية
 */

'use strict';

const crypto = require('crypto');
const os = require('os');

let machineIdSync = null;
try {
  machineIdSync = require('node-machine-id').machineIdSync;
} catch (_) {}

function getHWID() {
  try {
    if (typeof machineIdSync === 'function') {
      const rawId = machineIdSync(true);
      return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(`${rawId}:GHERBI_AI_POS_MASTER`)
        .digest('hex')
        .slice(0, 24)
        .toUpperCase();
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackSeed = `${os.hostname()}-${os.platform()}-${os.arch()}-${os.cpus()[0]?.model || 'cpu'}`;
  return crypto
    .createHash('sha256')
    .update(fallbackSeed)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 24)
    .toUpperCase();
}

function getPermanentProStatus() {
  const hwid = getHWID();
  return {
    valid: true,
    isActivated: true,
    activated: true,
    isTrial: false,
    hwid,
    code: 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME',
    licenseKey: 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME',
    plan: 'PRO_LIFETIME',
    activatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    trialLimit: 999999999,
    limit: 999999999,
    maxSales: 999999999,
    trialUsage: 0,
    usage: 0,
    salesCount: 0,
    trialRemaining: 999999999,
    remaining: 999999999,
    salesLeft: 999999999
  };
}

function verifyLicense() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

function verifyMobileLicense() {
  return true;
}

function getLicenseCode() {
  return 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME';
}

async function getLicenseStatus() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

async function getTrialStatus() {
  return getPermanentProStatus();
}

async function activateApp(_code) {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true,
    info: getPermanentProStatus()
  };
}

async function installOfflineLicense() {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true,
    info: getPermanentProStatus()
  };
}

async function deactivateApp() {
  return {
    success: true,
    isActivated: true
  };
}

async function checkTrialBeforeSale() {
  return { blocked: false, isActivated: true };
}

async function incrementTrialUsage() {
  return true;
}

async function getPromoStatus() {
  return {
    isPromoActive: false,
    enabled: false,
    installDate: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    promoEndDate: '2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z'
  };
}

module.exports = {
  getHWID,
  getHwid: getHWID,
  verifyLicense,
  verifyMobileLicense,
  getLicenseCode,
  getLicenseStatus,
  activateApp,
  installOfflineLicense,
  deactivateApp,
  getTrialStatus,
  checkTrialBeforeSale,
  incrementTrialUsage,
  getPromoStatus,
  isPromoActive: getPromoStatus
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\main.js`

```javascript
/**
 * main.js
 * العملية الرئيسية الشاملة (Electron Main Process) لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * تدير النوافذ، شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية، قاعدة البيانات، الطباعة الصامتة،
 * استيراد وتصدير Excel الكامل، النسخ الاحتياطي، القاموس الجزائري 613، الأقساط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية
 */

'use strict';

process.env.ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS = 'true';

const { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, dialog, shell, screen } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');
const QRCode = require('qrcode');
const bwipjs = require('bwip-js');

const db = require('./database');
const { processImage, getImagesDir } = require('./imageUtils');
const productWriterMod = require('./product-write');
const batchAlloc = require('./batch-alloc');
const stockLedger = require('./stock-ledger');
const tillLedger = require('./till-ledger');
const analyticsQueries = require('./analytics-queries');
const productionGuard = require('./manufacturing/production-guard');
const stocktakeGuard = require('./stocktake/stocktake-guard');
const { getDataRevision } = require('./data-revision');
const lanClient = require('./api-client');
const scaleBridge = require('./scale-bridge');
const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');
const deviceAuth = require('./device-auth');
const cloudDbSyncMod = require('./cloud-db-sync');
const cloudDiagnostics = require('./cloud-diagnostics');
const {
  startLocalServer,
  generateNextDocNumber,
  enrichProductsFull,
  getProductFullDetails,
  getPaymentDetailsFull,
  executeSaleTransaction,
  recordAuditLog,
  createInstallmentPlanRecord,
  buildProductsQueryOrder
} = require('./server');

const productWriter = productWriterMod.createProductWriter(db);

let mainWindow = null;
let customerDisplayWindow = null;
let localServerHandle = null;
let cloudDbSync = null;
let activeServerPort = 8080;

const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => db.dbGet(sql, params);
const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => db.dbAll(sql, params);
const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => db.dbRun(sql, params);

async function getSetting(key, fallback = '') {
  return await db.getSetting(key, fallback);
}

async function setSetting(key, value) {
  await dbRun('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [
    String(key),
    value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
  ]);
}

async function getAllSettingsObject() {
  const rows = await dbAll('SELECT key, value FROM settings');
  const obj = {};
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.value !== 'undefined' && r.value !== 'null') {
      obj[r.key] = r.value;
    }
  }
  const shopRow = await dbGet(
    'SELECT * FROM shop_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1'
  );
  if (shopRow) {
    if (shopRow.name && !obj.shop_name) obj.shop_name = shopRow.name;
    if (shopRow.description && !obj.shop_description) obj.shop_description = shopRow.description;
    if (shopRow.address && !obj.shop_address) obj.shop_address = shopRow.address;
    if (shopRow.phone && !obj.shop_phone) obj.shop_phone = shopRow.phone;
    if (shopRow.fax && !obj.shop_fax) obj.shop_fax = shopRow.fax;
    if (shopRow.email && !obj.shop_email) obj.shop_email = shopRow.email;
    if (shopRow.rc && !obj.shop_rc) obj.shop_rc = shopRow.rc;
    if (shopRow.nif && !obj.shop_nif) obj.shop_nif = shopRow.nif;
    if (shopRow.ai && !obj.shop_ai) obj.shop_ai = shopRow.ai;
    if (shopRow.nis && !obj.shop_nis) obj.shop_nis = shopRow.nis;
    if (shopRow.logo && !obj.shop_logo) obj.shop_logo = shopRow.logo;
  }
  return obj;
}

async function isLanClientMode() {
  const scope = (await getSetting('network_scope', 'local')).toLowerCase();
  const mode = (await getSetting('network_mode', 'server')).toLowerCase();
  if ((scope === 'local' || scope === 'lan' || scope === 'both') && mode === 'client') {
    const serverIp = await getSetting('server_ip', '192.168.1.15');
    const serverPort = Number(await getSetting('server_port', '8080')) || 8080;
    const instanceId = await getSetting('instance_id', 'lan-client');
    lanClient.setTarget(serverIp, serverPort, instanceId);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function getLocalIpv4List() {
  const nets = os.networkInterfaces();
  const list = [];
  for (const [name, addrs] of Object.entries(nets)) {
    for (const addr of addrs || []) {
      if (addr.family === 'IPv4' && !addr.internal) {
        list.push({ name, address: addr.address, netmask: addr.netmask });
      }
    }
  }
  return list;
}

function getPrimaryLocalIp() {
  const list = getLocalIpv4List();
  return list.length > 0 ? list[0].address : '127.0.0.1';
}

async function ensureSupplierByName(supplierName) {
  const clean = String(supplierName || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return null;
  const existing = await dbGet(
    'SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
    [clean]
  );
  if (existing) return existing.id;
  const ins = await dbRun(
    'INSERT INTO suppliers (name, initial_debt, initial_debt_paid) VALUES (?, 0, 0)',
    [clean]
  );
  return ins.lastID;
}

// ============================================================================
// إنشاء النافذة الرئيسية وشاشة عرض الزبون الثانية (Customer Facing Display)
// ============================================================================
function createMainWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1420,
    height: 890,
    minWidth: 1024,
    minHeight: 700,
    title: 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
    autoHideMenuBar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      sandbox: false
    }
  });

  mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'));

  if (process.argv.includes('--dev')) {
    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools({ mode: 'detach' });
  }

  mainWindow.on('closed', () => {
    mainWindow = null;
    if (customerDisplayWindow && !customerDisplayWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      customerDisplayWindow.close();
    }
  });
}

    customerDisplayWindow.focus();

    }

  <script>
    const { ipcRenderer } = require('electron');
    setInterval(() => { document.getElementById('clock').textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ar-DZ'); }, 1000);
    ipcRenderer.on('customer-display:update', (_e, state) => {
      const items = (state && state.items) || [];
      const list = document.getElementById('itemsList');
      if (items.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#64748b;margin-top:120px;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;">شكراً لزيارتكم — مرحباً بكم</div>';
      } else {
        list.innerHTML = items.map((it) => \`
          <div class="item-row">
            <span>\${it.name} × \${it.quantity}</span>
            <span style="font-family:monospace;color:#38bdf8;">\${Number(it.subtotal || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</span>
          </div>\`).join('');
      }
      document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = Number((state && state.total) || 0).toFixed(2) + ' د.ج';
      const disc = Number((state && state.discount) || 0);
      document.getElementById('discountLine').textContent = disc > 0 ? ('التخفيض: -' + disc.toFixed(2) + ' د.ج') : '';
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;

  customerDisplayWindow.loadURL(`data:text/html;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(html)}`);
  customerDisplayWindow.on('closed', () => {
    customerDisplayWindow = null;
  });

  return { success: true };
}

// بث قراءات الميزان الحية إلى الواجهة الأمامية
scaleBridge.on('reading', (reading) => {
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    mainWindow.webContents.send('scale:reading', reading);
  }
});

scaleBridge.on('status', (st) => {
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    mainWindow.webContents.send('scale:status', st);
  }
});

scaleBridge.on('raw', (rawItem) => {
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    mainWindow.webContents.send('scale:raw', rawItem);
  }
});

// ============================================================================
// تسجيل جميع قنوات الاتصال (IPC Handlers)
// ============================================================================
function registerIpcHandlers() {
  ipcMain.on('get-hwid-sync', (event) => {
    event.returnValue = licenseManager.getHWID();
  });

  // 1. المراجعات والإعدادات ومعلومات النظام
  ipcMain.handle('get-data-revision', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getDataRevision();
    return getDataRevision();
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-app-version', () => app.getVersion() || '3.0.0');
  ipcMain.handle('check-update', () => ({ updateAvailable: false, version: app.getVersion() }));
  ipcMain.handle('open-external-link', (_e, url) => {
    if (url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(url))) shell.openExternal(String(url));
    return { ok: true };
  });
  ipcMain.handle('open-youtube-video', (_e, url) => {
    if (url) shell.openExternal(String(url));
    return { ok: true };
  });
  ipcMain.handle('app-relaunch', () => {
    app.relaunch();
    app.exit(0);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-settings', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getSettings();
    return await getAllSettingsObject();
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-settings', async (_e, settingsObj = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateSettings(settingsObj);
    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(settingsObj || {})) {
        if (v === undefined || v === 'undefined') continue;
        const val = k === 'shop_logo' && v ? processImage(String(v)) : String(v ?? '');
        await setSetting(k, val);
      }
    });
    return { success: true };
  });

  // 2. المستخدمون والمصادقة
  ipcMain.handle('check-first-run', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.checkFirstRun();
    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );
    const row = await dbGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL');
    return Number((row && row.count) || 0) === 0;
  });

  ipcMain.handle('setup-first-admin', async (_e, arg1, arg2, arg3) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.setupFirstAdmin(arg1);
    const d =
      typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null
        ? arg1
        : { name: arg1, username: arg2, password: arg3 };

    const name = String(d.name || d.username || 'Admin').trim();
    const username = String(d.username || d.name || 'admin').trim();
    const rawPass = String(d.password || '1234');
    const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(rawPass, 10);

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );

    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );

    let userId;
    if (existing && existing.id) {
      userId = existing.id;
      await dbRun(
        "UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, password = ?, role = 'Admin', status = 'Active', deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = ?",
        [name, username, hashed, userId]
      );
    } else {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        "INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Admin', 'Active')",
        [name, username, hashed]
      );
      userId = ins.lastID;
    }

    const userObj = { id: userId, name, username, role: 'Admin', status: 'Active' };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...userObj, user: userObj };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('login-user', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const username = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.username : arg1) || ''
    ).trim();
    const password = String(
      (typeof arg1 === 'object' && arg1 !== null ? arg1.password : arg2) || ''
    );
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.loginUser(username, password);

    const user = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id, name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
      [username]
    );
    if (!user) return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    if (user.status && String(user.status).toLowerCase() !== 'active') {
      return { success: false, error: 'account_disabled' };
    }

    let valid = false;
    if (String(user.password || '').startsWith('$2')) {
      valid = bcrypt.compareSync(password, user.password);
    } else {
      const sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(password).digest('hex');
      valid = user.password === password || user.password === sha;
      if (valid) {
        await dbRun('UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?', [
          bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10),
          user.id
        ]);
      }
    }

    if (!valid) {
      await recordAuditLog({
        user_name: username,
        action_type: 'login_failed',
        severity: 'warning',
        details: { attempted_username: username }
      });
      return { success: false, error: 'invalid_creds' };
    }

    const safeUser = {
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      username: user.username,
      role: user.role || 'Admin',
      permissions_json: user.permissions_json || null,
      status: user.status || 'Active'
    };
    return { success: true, ok: true, ...safeUser, user: safeUser };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-users', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getUsers();
    return await dbAll(
      'SELECT id, name, username, role, permissions_json, status, created_at FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC'
    );
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-user', async (_e, u = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addUser(u);
    const name = String(u.name || u.username || '').trim();
    const username = String(u.username || '').trim();
    const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(u.password || '1234'), 10);
    const role = u.role || 'Cashier';
    const perms = u.permissions_json
      ? typeof u.permissions_json === 'string'
        ? u.permissions_json
        : JSON.stringify(u.permissions_json)
      : null;
    const status = u.status || 'Active';

    await dbRun(
      "UPDATE users SET username = username || '~del~' || id WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND username NOT LIKE '%~del~%'"
    );
    const existing = await dbGet(
      'SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND deleted_at IS NULL',
      [username]
    );
    if (existing) {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, password = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [name, hashed, role, perms, status, existing.id]
      );
      return { success: true, id: existing.id };
    }
    const ins = await dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO users (name, username, password, role, permissions_json, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
      [name, username, hashed, role, perms, status]
    );
    return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-user', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const id = Number(typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1.id : arg1);
    const u = typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1 : arg2 || {};
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateUser(id, u);

    const perms =
      u.permissions_json !== undefined
        ? typeof u.permissions_json === 'string'
          ? u.permissions_json
          : JSON.stringify(u.permissions_json)
        : null;

    if (u.password && String(u.password).trim() !== '') {
      const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(u.password), 10);
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, password = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = COALESCE(?, permissions_json), status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [u.name, u.username, hashed, u.role || 'Cashier', perms, u.status || 'Active', id]
      );
    } else {
      await dbRun(
        'UPDATE users SET name = ?, username = ?, role = ?, permissions_json = COALESCE(?, permissions_json), status = ? WHERE id = ?',
        [u.name, u.username, u.role || 'Cashier', perms, u.status || 'Active', id]
      );
    }
    return { success: true, id };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-user', async (_e, id) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteUser(id);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?', [Number(id)]);
    return { success: true };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-account', async (_e, userId, username, currentPassword, newPassword) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) {
      return lanClient.updateAccount(userId, username, currentPassword, newPassword);
    }
    const user = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [
      Number(userId)
    ]);
    if (!user) return { success: false, error: 'user_not_found' };

    if (newPassword) {
      const hashed = bcrypt.hashSync(String(newPassword), 10);
      await dbRun('UPDATE users SET username = ?, password = ? WHERE id = ?', [
        String(username || user.username).trim(),
        hashed,
        user.id
      ]);
    } else {
      await dbRun('UPDATE users SET username = ? WHERE id = ?', [
        String(username || user.username).trim(),
        user.id
      ]);
    }
    return { success: true };
  });

  // 3. المنتجات، الفئات، الدفعات، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
  ipcMain.handle('get-categories', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getCategories();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(category) <> '' ORDER BY category ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.category);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-families', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getFamilies();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT family FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND family IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(family) <> '' ORDER BY family ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.family);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-suppliers', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductSuppliers();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      "SELECT DISTINCT name FROM suppliers WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name) <> '' ORDER BY name ASC"
    );
    return rows.map((r) => r.name);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-products', async (_e, filters = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProducts(filters);
    const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
    const params = [];

    if (filters && filters.category) {
      conds.push('p.category = ?');
      params.push(filters.category);
    }
    if (filters && filters.family) {
      conds.push('p.family = ?');
      params.push(filters.family);
    }
    if (filters && filters.supplier) {
      conds.push('p.supplier = ?');
      params.push(filters.supplier);
    }
    if (filters && filters.search) {
      const q = `%${String(filters.search).trim()}%`;
      conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ? OR p.plu_code LIKE ?)');
      params.push(q, q, q, q);
    }

    const { stockJoinSql, orderBySql } = buildProductsQueryOrder(filters && filters.sort);
    const rows = await dbAll(
      `SELECT p.* FROM products p ${stockJoinSql} WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')} ${orderBySql}`,
      params
    );
    return await enrichProductsFull(rows);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-pos-stock', async () => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getPosStock();
    const rows = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(hide_from_pos, 0) = 0 ORDER BY is_featured DESC, id DESC'
    );
    return await enrichProductsFull(rows);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-full', async (_e, productId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductFull(productId);
    return await getProductFullDetails(productId);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-product-analytics', async (_e, productId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.getProductAnalytics(productId);
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const summary = await dbGet(
      `SELECT
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS total_sold_qty,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.subtotal), 0) AS total_revenue,
         COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity * COALESCE(si.cost_price, ib.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS total_cost
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = si.batch_id
       WHERE si.product_id = ? AND si.deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [pid]
    );
    const rev = Number((summary && summary.total_revenue) || 0);
    const cost = Number((summary && summary.total_cost) || 0);
    return {
      product_id: pid,
      total_sold_qty: Number((summary && summary.total_sold_qty) || 0),
      total_revenue: rev,
      total_cost: cost,
      total_profit: Number((rev - cost).toFixed(2))
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-product', async (_e, p = {}) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addProduct(p);
    const barcode = p.barcode ? String(p.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);
    if (p.supplier) await ensureSupplierByName(p.supplier);

    const img = p.image ? processImage(p.image) : null;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO products (
          barcode, name, category, family, supplier, description, min_stock,
          image, unit, color, weight_volume, wholesale_unit, wholesale_qty,
          plu_code, has_variants, is_featured, material_role, track_serial, warranty_months, hide_from_pos
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          barcode,
          String(p.name || 'منتج جديد').trim(),
          p.category || 'عام',
          p.family || null,
          p.supplier || null,
          p.description || null,
          Number(p.min_stock ?? 5),
          img,
          p.unit || 'قطعة',
          p.color || null,
          p.weight_volume || null,
          p.wholesale_unit || null,
          p.wholesale_qty ? Number(p.wholesale_qty) : null,
          p.plu_code || null,
          p.has_variants ? 1 : 0,
          p.is_featured ? 1 : 0,
          p.material_role || null,
          p.track_serial ? 1 : 0,
          Number(p.warranty_months ?? 0),
          p.hide_from_pos ? 1 : 0
        ]
      );
      const productId = ins.lastID;

      await productWriter.insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices(
        productId,
        p.extra_barcodes || p.barcodes || [],
        p.extra_prices || p.prices || []
      );

      if (p.has_variants && Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants.length > 0) {
        await productWriter.insertVariantData(
          productId,
          p.option_groups || [],
          p.variants,
          p.location || null
        );
      } else {
        await dbRun(
          `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
            product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
          [
            productId,
            Number(p.stock ?? 0),
            Number(p.cost_price ?? 0),
            Number(p.selling_price ?? 0),
            p.wholesale_price !== undefined && p.wholesale_price !== ''
              ? Number(p.wholesale_price)
              : null,
            p.expiry_date || null,
            p.location || null
          ]
        );
      }

      return { success: true, id: productId };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-product', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const productId = Number(typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1.id : arg1);
    const p = typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1 : arg2 || {};
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateProduct(productId, p);

    const barcode = p.barcode ? String(p.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await productWriter.freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);
    if (p.supplier) await ensureSupplierByName(p.supplier);

    const img = p.image !== undefined ? (p.image ? processImage(p.image) : null) : undefined;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      await dbRun(
        `UPDATE products
         SET barcode = ?, name = ?, category = ?, family = ?, supplier = ?,
             description = ?, min_stock = ?, image = COALESCE(?, image),
             unit = ?, color = ?, weight_volume = ?, wholesale_unit = ?,
             wholesale_qty = ?, plu_code = ?, is_featured = COALESCE(?, is_featured),
             material_role = COALESCE(?, material_role), track_serial = COALESCE(?, track_serial),
             warranty_months = COALESCE(?, warranty_months), hide_from_pos = COALESCE(?, hide_from_pos)
         WHERE id = ?`,
        [
          barcode,
          String(p.name || '').trim(),
          p.category || 'عام',
          p.family || null,
          p.supplier || null,
          p.description || null,
          Number(p.min_stock ?? 5),
          img === undefined ? null : img,
          p.unit || 'قطعة',
          p.color || null,
          p.weight_volume || null,
          p.wholesale_unit || null,
          p.wholesale_qty ? Number(p.wholesale_qty) : null,
          p.plu_code || null,
          p.is_featured !== undefined ? (p.is_featured ? 1 : 0) : null,
          p.material_role !== undefined ? p.material_role : null,
          p.track_serial !== undefined ? (p.track_serial ? 1 : 0) : null,
          p.warranty_months !== undefined ? Number(p.warranty_months) : null,
          p.hide_from_pos !== undefined ? (p.hide_from_pos ? 1 : 0) : null,
          productId
        ]
      );

      if (p.extra_barcodes !== undefined || p.extra_prices !== undefined) {
        await productWriter.insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices(
          productId,
          p.extra_barcodes || [],
          p.extra_prices || []
        );
      }

      return { success: true, id: productId };
    });
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-product', async (_e, productId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteProduct(productId);
    const pid = Number(productId);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    await dbRun('DELETE FROM products WHERE id = ?', [pid]);
    db.tombstoneOrphans();
    return { success: true };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-batch', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const productId = Number(typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1.product_id || arg1.productId : arg1);
    const b = typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1 : arg2 || {};
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addBatch(productId, b);

    const ins = await dbRun(
      `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
        product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location, supplier_id
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      [
        productId,
        b.variant_id || null,
        Number(b.stock ?? 0),
        Number(b.cost_price ?? 0),
        Number(b.selling_price ?? 0),
        b.wholesale_price !== undefined && b.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(b.wholesale_price) : null,
        b.expiry_date || null,
        b.location || null,
        b.supplier_id || null
      ]
    );
    await batchAlloc.reconcileStockDebt(db, productId, ins.lastID);
    return { success: true, id: ins.lastID };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-batch', async (_e, arg1, arg2) => {
    const batchId = Number(typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1.id || arg1.batchId : arg1);
    const b = typeof arg1 === 'object' ? arg1 : arg2 || {};
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.updateBatch(batchId, b);

    await dbRun(
      `UPDATE inventory_batches
       SET stock = ?, cost_price = ?, selling_price = ?, wholesale_price = ?, expiry_date = ?, location = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      [
        Number(b.stock ?? 0),
        Number(b.cost_price ?? 0),
        Number(b.selling_price ?? 0),
        b.wholesale_price !== undefined && b.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(b.wholesale_price) : null,
        b.expiry_date || null,
        b.location || null,
        batchId
      ]
    );
    return { success: true, id: batchId };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('delete-batch', async (_e, batchId) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.deleteBatch(batchId);
    await batchAlloc.voidBatches(db, [Number(batchId)]);
    return { success: true };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('save-product-variants', async (_e, productId, variantData) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.saveProductVariants(productId, variantData);
    return await productWriter.rewriteProductVariants(productId, variantData);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-variant-templates', () => [
    {
      id: 'clothing',
      name: 'ملابس وأزياء',
      groups: [
        { name: 'المقاس', values: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', 'XXL'] },
        { name: 'اللون', values: ['أسود', 'أبيض', 'أزرق', 'أحمر'] }
      ]
    },
    {
      id: 'shoes',
      name: 'أحذية',
      groups: [{ name: 'المقاس', values: ['38', '39', '40', '41', '42', '43', '44'] }]
    }
  ]);

  ipcMain.handle('add-product-barcode', async (_e, productId, barcode, priceLabel) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addProductBarcode(productId, barcode, priceLabel);
    return await productWriter.addProductBarcode(productId, barcode, priceLabel);
  });

  ipcMain.handle('add-variant-quick', async (_e, payload) => {
    if (await isLanClientMode()) return lanClient.addVariantQuick(payload);
    return await productWriter.addVariantQuick(payload);
