## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\manufacturing\production-guard.js`

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/production-guard.js
 * المحرك الشامل للتصنيع والإنتاج (BOM Recipes, Capacity Calculation, FIFO Component Deduction, Order Lifecycle)
 */

'use strict';

function resolveHelpers(ctx) {
  const db = ctx && ctx.db ? ctx.db : ctx;
  const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbGet === 'function') return ctx.dbGet(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  };
  const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbAll === 'function') return ctx.dbAll(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  };
  const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbRun === 'function') return ctx.dbRun(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbRun === 'function') return db.dbRun(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  };
  const withTx = (workFn) => {
    if (db && typeof db.withTransaction === 'function') {
      return db.withTransaction((tx) => workFn(tx));
    }
    return workFn({ db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun });
  };
  const nextNumber = async (docType = 'production') => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.nextNumber === 'function') return ctx.nextNumber(docType);
    if (db && typeof db.nextNumber === 'function') return db.nextNumber(docType);
    return `PRD-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;
  };
  const allowExpired = async () => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.allowExpired === 'function') return ctx.allowExpired();
    if (db && typeof db.allowExpired === 'function') return db.allowExpired();
    const r = await dbGet("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'manufacturing_allow_expired'");
    return r && (String(r.value).toLowerCase() === 'true' || r.value === '1');
  };

  return { db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun, withTx, nextNumber, allowExpired };
}

/**
 * 1. جلب قائمة وصفات التصنيع (BOM Recipes)
 */
async function listRecipes(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['r.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.productId || filters.product_id) {
    conds.push('r.product_id = ?');
    params.push(Number(filters.productId || filters.product_id));
  }
  if (filters.activeOnly || filters.is_active) {
    conds.push('r.is_active = 1');
  }
  if (filters.search) {
    conds.push('(r.name LIKE ? OR p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ?)');
    const q = `%${String(filters.search).trim()}%`;
    params.push(q, q, q);
  }

  const recipes = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      r.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      p.image AS product_image,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_components bc WHERE bc.recipe_id = r.id AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS components_count
    FROM bom_recipes r
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY r.is_default DESC, r.id DESC
    `,
    params
  );

  for (const rec of recipes) {
    rec.components = await dbAll(
      `
      SELECT
        bc.*,
        cp.name AS component_name,
        cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
        cp.unit AS component_unit,
        COALESCE((
          SELECT SUM(ib.stock) FROM inventory_batches ib
          WHERE ib.product_id = bc.component_product_id
            AND (bc.component_variant_id IS NULL OR ib.variant_id = bc.component_variant_id)
            AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
        ), 0) AS available_stock
      FROM bom_components bc
      LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = bc.component_product_id
      WHERE bc.recipe_id = ? AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY bc.position ASC, bc.id ASC
      `,
      [rec.id]
    );
  }

  return recipes;
}

/**
 * 2. جلب وصفة واحدة مع كامل مكوناتها
 */
async function loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipe = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT
      r.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      p.image AS product_image
    FROM bom_recipes r
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE r.id = ? AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [Number(recipeId)]
  );
  if (!recipe) return null;

  recipe.components = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      bc.*,
      cp.name AS component_name,
      cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
      cp.unit AS component_unit,
      cp.wholesale_unit AS component_wholesale_unit,
      cp.wholesale_qty AS component_wholesale_qty,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(ib.stock) FROM inventory_batches ib
        WHERE ib.product_id = bc.component_product_id
          AND (bc.component_variant_id IS NULL OR ib.variant_id = bc.component_variant_id)
          AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0) AS available_stock,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT AVG(ib2.cost_price) FROM inventory_batches ib2
        WHERE ib2.product_id = bc.component_product_id
          AND ib2.deleted_at IS NULL AND ib2.stock > 0
      ), 0) AS est_unit_cost
    FROM bom_components bc
    LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = bc.component_product_id
    WHERE bc.recipe_id = ? AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY bc.position ASC, bc.id ASC
    `,
    [recipe.id]
  );

  return recipe;
}

/**
 * 3. حفظ أو تحديث وصفة تصنيع (BOM Recipe) مع منع الحلقات الدائرية (Circular Dependency Check)
 */
async function saveRecipe(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbRun, withTx } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const productId = Number(payload.product_id || payload.productId);
  const variantId = payload.variant_id || payload.variantId ? Number(payload.variant_id || payload.variantId) : null;
  const name = String(payload.name || 'وصفة قياسية').trim();
  const outputQty = Math.max(0.0001, Number(payload.output_qty ?? payload.outputQty ?? 1));
  const extraCost = Math.max(0, Number(payload.extra_cost ?? payload.extraCost ?? 0));
  const extraCostType = payload.extra_cost_type || payload.extraCostType || 'per_batch';
  const isDefault = payload.is_default ?? payload.isDefault ? 1 : 0;
  const isActive = payload.is_active !== undefined ? (payload.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1;
  const autoOnSale = payload.auto_on_sale ?? payload.autoOnSale ? 1 : 0;
  const autoRound = payload.auto_round || payload.autoRound || 'exact';
  const autoTarget = payload.auto_target || payload.autoTarget || 'shortfall';
  const sellPrice =
    payload.sell_price !== undefined && payload.sell_price !== null && payload.sell_price !== ''
      ? Number(payload.sell_price)
      : null;

  const components = Array.isArray(payload.components) ? payload.components : [];
  if (!productId) throw new Error('يرجى اختيار المنتج النهائي للوصفة');
  if (components.length === 0) throw new Error('يجب أن تحتوي الوصفة على مكون أولي واحد على الأقل');

  for (const comp of components) {
    const compProdId = Number(comp.component_product_id || comp.product_id || comp.productId);
    if (compProdId === productId) {
      throw new Error('لا يمكن أن يكون المنتج النهائي مكوناً داخل وصفته نفسها');
    }
  }

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    let recipeId = payload.id ? Number(payload.id) : null;

    if (isDefault) {
      await tx.dbRun(
        'UPDATE bom_recipes SET is_default = 0 WHERE product_id = ? AND COALESCE(variant_id, -1) = COALESCE(?, -1)',
        [productId, variantId]
      );
    }

    if (recipeId) {
      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        UPDATE bom_recipes
        SET product_id = ?, variant_id = ?, name = ?, output_qty = ?,
            extra_cost = ?, extra_cost_type = ?, is_default = ?, is_active = ?,
            auto_on_sale = ?, auto_round = ?, auto_target = ?, sell_price = ?
        WHERE id = ?
        `,
        [
          productId,
          variantId,
          name,
          outputQty,
          extraCost,
          extraCostType,
          isDefault,
          isActive,
          autoOnSale,
          autoRound,
          autoTarget,
          sellPrice,
          recipeId
        ]
      );
      await tx.dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_components WHERE recipe_id = ?', [recipeId]);
    } else {
      const existingDefault = await dbGet(
        'SELECT id FROM bom_recipes WHERE product_id = ? AND is_default = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
        [productId]
      );
      const effectiveDefault = isDefault || !existingDefault ? 1 : 0;

      const ins = await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO bom_recipes (
          product_id, variant_id, name, output_qty, extra_cost, extra_cost_type,
          is_default, is_active, auto_on_sale, auto_round, auto_target, sell_price
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [
          productId,
          variantId,
          name,
          outputQty,
          extraCost,
          extraCostType,
          effectiveDefault,
          isActive,
          autoOnSale,
          autoRound,
          autoTarget,
          sellPrice
        ]
      );
      recipeId = ins.lastID;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < components.length; i++) {
      const c = components[i];
      const compProdId = Number(c.component_product_id || c.product_id || c.productId);
      const compVarId = c.component_variant_id || c.variant_id ? Number(c.component_variant_id || c.variant_id) : null;
      const qty = Math.max(0.000001, Number(c.quantity ?? 1));
      const waste = Math.max(0, Number(c.waste_percent ?? c.wastePercent ?? 0));
      const unitLabel = c.unit_label || c.unitLabel || null;
      const unitQty = c.unit_qty !== undefined && c.unit_qty !== null ? Number(c.unit_qty) : qty;

      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO bom_components (
          recipe_id, component_product_id, component_variant_id,
          quantity, unit_label, unit_qty, waste_percent, position
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [recipeId, compProdId, compVarId, qty, unitLabel, unitQty, waste, i]
      );
    }

    return await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  });
}

/**
 * 4. حذف وصفة تصنيع
 */
async function deleteRecipe(ctx, recipeId) {
  const { dbRun } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(recipeId && typeof recipeId === 'object' ? recipeId.id || recipeId.recipeId : recipeId);
  await dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_components WHERE recipe_id = ?', [id]);
  await dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_recipes WHERE id = ?', [id]);
  return { success: true, id };
}

/**
 * 5. حساب توفر المكونات وأقصى كمية قابلة للتصنيع والتكلفة التقديرية (FIFO Simulation)
 */
async function computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbAll, allowExpired } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipeId = Number(payload.recipeId || payload.recipe_id || payload.id);
  const requestedOutputQty = Math.max(
    0.0001,
    Number(payload.plannedQty ?? payload.planned_qty ?? payload.quantity ?? 0) || 0
  );

  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('وصفة التصنيع غير موجودة');

  const canUseExpired = await allowExpired();
  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const effectivePlannedQty = requestedOutputQty > 0 ? requestedOutputQty : Number(recipe.output_qty || 1);
  const scaleFactor = effectivePlannedQty / Math.max(0.0001, Number(recipe.output_qty || 1));

  let maxBatchesPossible = Infinity;
  let totalComponentsCost = 0;
  const componentBreakdown = [];
  const shortages = [];

  for (const comp of recipe.components || []) {
    const wasteMultiplier = 1 + Math.max(0, Number(comp.waste_percent || 0)) / 100.0;
    const reqPerRecipeBatch = Number(comp.quantity || 0) * wasteMultiplier;
    const requiredTotalQty = Number((reqPerRecipeBatch * scaleFactor).toFixed(6));

    const batchConds = ['product_id = ?', 'deleted_at IS NULL', 'COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0'];
    const batchParams = [Number(comp.component_product_id)];

    if (comp.component_variant_id) {
      batchConds.push('variant_id = ?');
      batchParams.push(Number(comp.component_variant_id));
    }
    if (!canUseExpired) {
      batchConds.push("(expiry_date IS NULL OR TRIM(expiry_date) = '' OR date(expiry_date) >= date(?))");
      batchParams.push(todayIso);
    }

    const batches = await dbAll(
      `
      SELECT id, stock, cost_price, expiry_date
      FROM inventory_batches
      WHERE ${batchConds.join(' AND ')}
      ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
      `,
      batchParams
    );

    const totalAvail = batches.reduce((acc, b) => acc + Number(b.stock || 0), 0);
    const possibleRecipeBatches = reqPerRecipeBatch > 0 ? totalAvail / reqPerRecipeBatch : Infinity;
    if (possibleRecipeBatches < maxBatchesPossible) {
      maxBatchesPossible = possibleRecipeBatches;
    }

    // محاكاة السحب بطريقة FIFO لحساب التكلفة الدقيقة
    let remToCost = requiredTotalQty;
    let compCost = 0;
    let lastKnownCost = batches.length > 0 ? Number(batches[0].cost_price || 0) : Number(comp.est_unit_cost || 0);

    for (const b of batches) {
      if (remToCost <= 0) break;
      const take = Math.min(Number(b.stock || 0), remToCost);
      compCost += take * Number(b.cost_price || 0);
      lastKnownCost = Number(b.cost_price || lastKnownCost);
      remToCost -= take;
    }
    if (remToCost > 0) {
      compCost += remToCost * lastKnownCost;
    }

    totalComponentsCost += compCost;
    const shortage = Math.max(0, Number((requiredTotalQty - totalAvail).toFixed(6)));
    if (shortage > 0.0001) {
      shortages.push({
        component_product_id: comp.component_product_id,
        component_name: comp.component_name,
        required: requiredTotalQty,
        available: totalAvail,
        shortage
      });
    }

    componentBreakdown.push({
      component_product_id: comp.component_product_id,
      component_variant_id: comp.component_variant_id,
      component_name: comp.component_name,
      component_unit: comp.component_unit,
      required_qty: requiredTotalQty,
      available_qty: totalAvail,
      shortage_qty: shortage,
      estimated_cost: Number(compCost.toFixed(2)),
      sufficient: shortage <= 0.0001
    });
  }

  const maxOutputQty = Number.isFinite(maxBatchesPossible)
    ? Number((Math.max(0, maxBatchesPossible) * Number(recipe.output_qty || 1)).toFixed(4))
    : 0;

  const extraCostTotal =
    recipe.extra_cost_type === 'per_unit'
      ? Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * effectivePlannedQty
      : Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * scaleFactor;

  const totalCost = Number((totalComponentsCost + extraCostTotal).toFixed(2));
  const unitCost = Number((totalCost / Math.max(0.0001, effectivePlannedQty)).toFixed(2));

  return {
    recipe_id: recipe.id,
    product_id: recipe.product_id,
    product_name: recipe.product_name,
    planned_qty: effectivePlannedQty,
    max_manufacturable_qty: maxOutputQty,
    can_produce: shortages.length === 0,
    components_cost: Number(totalComponentsCost.toFixed(2)),
    extra_cost: Number(extraCostTotal.toFixed(2)),
    total_cost: totalCost,
    unit_cost: unitCost,
    components: componentBreakdown,
    shortages
  };
}

/**
 * 6. حساب القدرة الإنتاجية الفورية لمجموعة منتجات (في شاشة الكاشير POS)
 */
async function autoCapacityForProducts(ctx, productIds = []) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const ids = Array.isArray(productIds)
    ? productIds.map(Number).filter(Boolean)
    : productIds && Array.isArray(productIds.productIds)
      ? productIds.productIds.map(Number).filter(Boolean)
      : [];

  let recipesQuery = 'SELECT id, product_id, variant_id, auto_on_sale FROM bom_recipes WHERE is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL';
  const params = [];
  if (ids.length > 0) {
    recipesQuery += ` AND product_id IN (${ids.map(() => '?').join(',')})`;
    params.push(...ids);
  }

  const recipes = await dbAll(recipesQuery, params);
  const result = {};

  for (const r of recipes) {
    try {
      const avail = await computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, { recipeId: r.id, plannedQty: 1 });
      result[r.product_id] = {
        recipeId: r.id,
        maxManufacturableQty: avail.max_manufacturable_qty,
        unitCost: avail.unit_cost,
        autoOnSale: Boolean(r.auto_on_sale)
      };
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * 7. إنشاء مسودة أمر إنتاج (createDraft)
 */
async function createDraft(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbRun, nextNumber } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipeId = Number(payload.recipe_id || payload.recipeId);
  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('وصفة التصنيع غير موجودة');

  const plannedQty = Math.max(0.0001, Number(payload.planned_qty ?? payload.plannedQty ?? recipe.output_qty ?? 1));
  const avail = await computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, { recipeId, plannedQty });
  const docNum = payload.number || (await nextNumber('production'));
  const orderDate = payload.order_date || payload.orderDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const ins = await dbRun(
    `
    INSERT INTO production_orders (
      number, recipe_id, product_id, variant_id, planned_qty, status,
      components_cost, extra_cost, unit_cost, output_expiry_date,
      output_selling_price, output_wholesale_price, trigger_source,
      sale_id, user_id, note, order_date
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `,
    [
      docNum,
      recipe.id,
      recipe.product_id,
      recipe.variant_id || null,
      plannedQty,
      avail.components_cost,
      avail.extra_cost,
      avail.unit_cost,
      payload.output_expiry_date || payload.outputExpiryDate || null,
      payload.output_selling_price ?? payload.outputSellingPrice ?? recipe.sell_price ?? null,
      payload.output_wholesale_price ?? payload.outputWholesalePrice ?? null,
      payload.trigger_source || payload.triggerSource || 'manual',
      payload.sale_id || payload.saleId || null,
      payload.user_id || payload.userId || null,
      payload.note || null,
      orderDate
    ]
  );

  return await getOrder(ctx, ins.lastID);
}

/**
 * 8. تأكيد أمر الإنتاج (خصم المكونات الأولية بـ FIFO وإنشاء دفعة المنتج النهائي)
 */
async function confirmOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll, withTx, allowExpired } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const orderId = Number(payload.orderId || payload.order_id || payload.id);
  const order = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM production_orders WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [orderId]);
  if (!order) throw new Error('أمر الإنتاج غير موجود');
  if (order.status === 'confirmed') return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);

  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, order.recipe_id);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('الوصفة المرتبطة بأمر الإنتاج غير موجودة');

  const producedQty = Math.max(
    0.0001,
    Number(payload.produced_qty ?? payload.producedQty ?? order.planned_qty ?? recipe.output_qty ?? 1)
  );
  const scaleFactor = producedQty / Math.max(0.0001, Number(recipe.output_qty || 1));
  const canUseExpired = await allowExpired();
  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    let actualComponentsCost = 0;

    for (const comp of recipe.components || []) {
      const wasteMultiplier = 1 + Math.max(0, Number(comp.waste_percent || 0)) / 100.0;
      let remainingNeed = Number((Number(comp.quantity || 0) * wasteMultiplier * scaleFactor).toFixed(6));

      const batchConds = ['product_id = ?', 'deleted_at IS NULL', 'COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0'];
      const batchParams = [Number(comp.component_product_id)];
      if (comp.component_variant_id) {
        batchConds.push('variant_id = ?');
        batchParams.push(Number(comp.component_variant_id));
      }
      if (!canUseExpired) {
        batchConds.push("(expiry_date IS NULL OR TRIM(expiry_date) = '' OR date(expiry_date) >= date(?))");
        batchParams.push(todayIso);
      }

      const batches = await dbAll(
        `
        SELECT id, stock, cost_price
        FROM inventory_batches
        WHERE ${batchConds.join(' AND ')}
        ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
        `,
        batchParams
      );

      for (const b of batches) {
        if (remainingNeed <= 0.000001) break;
        const avail = Math.max(0, Number(b.stock || 0));
        if (avail <= 0) continue;

        const take = Math.min(avail, remainingNeed);
        const unitCost = Number(b.cost_price || 0);
        const lineSub = Number((take * unitCost).toFixed(4));

        await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [take, b.id]);
        await tx.dbRun(
          `
          INSERT INTO production_order_items (
            order_id, component_product_id, component_variant_id,
            batch_id, quantity, unit_cost, subtotal
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
          `,
          [orderId, comp.component_product_id, comp.component_variant_id || null, b.id, take, unitCost, lineSub]
        );

        actualComponentsCost += lineSub;
        remainingNeed = Number((remainingNeed - take).toFixed(6));
      }

      if (remainingNeed > 0.0001) {
        throw new Error(`رصيد المكون "${comp.component_name}" غير كافٍ لإتمام الإنتاج (العجز: ${remainingNeed})`);
      }
    }

    const extraCostTotal =
      recipe.extra_cost_type === 'per_unit'
        ? Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * producedQty
        : Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * scaleFactor;

    const totalCost = Number((actualComponentsCost + extraCostTotal).toFixed(2));
    const unitCost = Number((totalCost / producedQty).toFixed(2));

    // تحديد سعر البيع للدفعة الناتجة
    let sellingPrice = order.output_selling_price ?? payload.output_selling_price ?? recipe.sell_price;
    if (sellingPrice === null || sellingPrice === undefined || sellingPrice === '') {
      const lastBatch = await dbGet(
        'SELECT selling_price FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',
        [order.product_id]
      );
      sellingPrice = lastBatch && Number(lastBatch.selling_price) > 0 ? Number(lastBatch.selling_price) : unitCost;
    }

    const batchIns = await tx.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
        product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price,
        wholesale_price, expiry_date, display_code
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [
        order.product_id,
        order.variant_id || null,
        producedQty,
        unitCost,
        Number(sellingPrice || 0),
        order.output_wholesale_price || null,
        order.output_expiry_date || payload.output_expiry_date || null,
        order.number
      ]
    );

    const outputBatchId = batchIns.lastID;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    await tx.dbRun(
      `
      UPDATE production_orders
      SET status = 'confirmed',
          produced_qty = ?,
          components_cost = ?,
          extra_cost = ?,
          unit_cost = ?,
          output_batch_id = ?,
          output_selling_price = ?,
          confirmed_at = ?
      WHERE id = ?
      `,
      [
        producedQty,
        Number(actualComponentsCost.toFixed(2)),
        Number(extraCostTotal.toFixed(2)),
        unitCost,
        outputBatchId,
        Number(sellingPrice || 0),
        nowIso,
        orderId
      ]
    );

    return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);
  });
}

/**
 * 9. عكس/إلغاء أمر إنتاج مؤكد (إرجاع المكونات الأولية للدفعات وسحب دفعة المنتج النهائي)
 */
async function reverseOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll, withTx } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const orderId = Number(payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload.orderId || payload.order_id || payload.id : payload);
  const order = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM production_orders WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [orderId]);
  if (!order) throw new Error('أمر الإنتاج غير موجود');
  if (order.status === 'reversed') return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);

  const items = await dbAll(
    'SELECT * FROM production_order_items WHERE order_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
    [orderId]
  );

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    for (const item of items) {
      await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = COALESCE(stock, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', [
        Number(item.quantity || 0),
        item.batch_id
      ]);
    }

    if (order.output_batch_id) {
      const deductQty = Number(order.produced_qty || order.planned_qty || 0);
      await tx.dbRun(
        'UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = MAX(0, COALESCE(stock, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
        [deductQty, order.output_batch_id]
      );
    }

    await tx.dbRun("UPDATE production_orders SET status = 'reversed' WHERE id = ?", [orderId]);
    return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);
  });
}

/**
 * 10. جلب قائمة أوامر الإنتاج أو تفاصيل أمر إنتاج واحد
 */
async function listOrders(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['po.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.status) {
    conds.push('po.status = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.status));
  }
  if (filters.productId || filters.product_id) {
    conds.push('po.product_id = ?');
    params.push(Number(filters.productId || filters.product_id));
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
    conds.push('date(po.order_date) >= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
  }
  if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
    conds.push('date(po.order_date) <= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
  }

  return await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      po.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      r.name AS recipe_name,
      u.name AS user_name
    FROM production_orders po
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = po.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_recipes r ON r.id = po.recipe_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = po.user_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY po.id DESC
    LIMIT 250
    `,
    params
  );
}

async function getOrder(ctx, orderId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(orderId && typeof orderId === 'object' ? orderId.id || orderId.orderId : orderId);
  const order = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT
      po.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      r.name AS recipe_name,
      u.name AS user_name
    FROM production_orders po
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = po.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_recipes r ON r.id = po.recipe_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = po.user_id
    WHERE po.id = ? AND po.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [id]
  );
  if (!order) return null;

  order.items = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      poi.*,
      cp.name AS component_name,
      cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
      cp.unit AS component_unit
    FROM production_order_items poi
    LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = poi.component_product_id
    WHERE poi.order_id = ? AND poi.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY poi.id ASC
    `,
    [id]
  );

  return order;
}

/**
 * 11. تعيين دور المادة للمنتج (raw_material / semi_finished / finished_good)
 */
async function setMaterialRole(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbRun } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const productId = Number(payload.productId || payload.product_id || payload.id);
  const role = payload.materialRole ?? payload.material_role ?? null;
  const hideFromPos =
    payload.hideFromPos !== undefined
      ? payload.hideFromPos
        ? 1
        : 0
      : role === 'raw_material'
        ? 1
        : 0;

  await dbRun('UPDATE products SET material_role = ?, hide_from_pos = ? WHERE id = ?', [
    role,
    hideFromPos,
    productId
  ]);
  return { success: true, product_id: productId, material_role: role, hide_from_pos: hideFromPos };
}

/**
 * إنشاء أمر إنتاج مع خيار التأكيد الفوري المباشر
 */
async function createProductionOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const draft = await createDraft(ctx, payload);
  if (payload && (payload.confirmImmediately || payload.confirm || payload.status === 'confirmed')) {
    return await confirmOrder(ctx, { orderId: draft.id, ...payload });
  }
  return draft;
}

module.exports = {
  listRecipes,
  getBomRecipes: listRecipes,
  loadRecipeWithComponents,
  getRecipe: loadRecipeWithComponents,
  getBomRecipe: loadRecipeWithComponents,
  saveRecipe,
  saveBomRecipe: saveRecipe,
  deleteRecipe,
  deleteBomRecipe: deleteRecipe,
  computeRecipeAvailability,
  getRecipeAvailability: computeRecipeAvailability,
  autoCapacityForProducts,
  getManufacturableCapacity: (ctx, payload = {}) =>
    autoCapacityForProducts(
      ctx,
      Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload.productIds || payload.product_ids || []
    ),
  createDraft,
  createProductionOrder,
  confirmOrder,
  confirmProductionOrder: confirmOrder,
  reverseOrder,
  reverseProductionOrder: reverseOrder,
  listOrders,
  getProductionOrders: listOrders,
  getOrder,
  getProductionOrder: getOrder,
  setMaterialRole
};

```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-guard.js
 * محرك الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake Sheet, Variance Calculation & Batch Stock Reconciliation)
 */

'use strict';

function resolveHelpers(ctx) {
  const db = ctx && ctx.db ? ctx.db : ctx;
  const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbGet === 'function') return ctx.dbGet(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  };
  const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbAll === 'function') return ctx.dbAll(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  };
  const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbRun === 'function') return ctx.dbRun(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbRun === 'function') return db.dbRun(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  };
  const withTx = (workFn) => {
    if (db && typeof db.withTransaction === 'function') {
      return db.withTransaction((tx) => workFn(tx));
    }
    return workFn({ db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun });
  };
  const nextNumber = async (docType = 'stocktake') => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.nextNumber === 'function') return ctx.nextNumber(docType);
    if (db && typeof db.nextNumber === 'function') return db.nextNumber(docType);
    return `INV-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;
  };

  return { db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun, withTx, nextNumber };
}

/**
 * 1. تحميل ورقة الجرد الحالية (Stocktake Sheet) مع التصفية حسب الفئة أو العائلة أو البحث
 */
async function loadSheet(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const scopeType = String(filters.scopeType || filters.scope_type || 'all').toLowerCase();
  const scopeValue = filters.scopeValue || filters.scope_value || filters.category || filters.family || '';
  const search = filters.search ? String(filters.search).trim() : '';

  const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (scopeType === 'category' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (scopeType === 'family' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (filters.category) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.category));
  } else if (filters.family) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.family));
  }

  if (search) {
    conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ?)');
    const q = `%${search}%`;
    params.push(q, q, q);
  }

  const rows = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      p.id AS product_id,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.family,
      p.unit,
      ib.id AS batch_id,
      ib.variant_id,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) AS book_qty
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, ib.id ASC
    `,
    params
  );

  return rows;
}

/**
 * 2. عرض سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة
 */
async function listStocktakes(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['st.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.status) {
    conds.push('st.status = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.status));
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) >= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
  }
  if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) <= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
  }

  return await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      st.*,
      u.name AS user_name,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti WHERE sti.stocktake_id = st.id AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL) AS items_count,
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti2
        WHERE sti2.stocktake_id = st.id
          AND sti2.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND sti2.counted_qty IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(COALESCE(sti2.counted_qty, 0) - COALESCE(sti2.book_qty, 0)) > 0.0001
      ) AS discrepancies_count
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY st.id DESC
    LIMIT 200
    `,
    params
  );
}

/**
 * 3. جلب تفاصيل عملية جرد محددة مع كافة أسطرها وفروقاتها المالية
 */
async function getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(
    stocktakeId && typeof stocktakeId === 'object'
      ? stocktakeId.id || stocktakeId.stocktakeId
      : stocktakeId
  );

  const stocktake = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT st.*, u.name AS user_name
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE st.id = ? AND st.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [id]
  );
  if (!stocktake) return null;

  const items = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      sti.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.unit,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      (COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) AS diff_qty,
      ((COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) * COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0)) AS diff_cost_value
    FROM stocktake_items sti
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = sti.product_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = sti.batch_id
    WHERE sti.stocktake_id = ? AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, sti.id ASC
    `,
    [id]
  );

  stocktake.items = items;
  return stocktake;
}

/**
 * 4. اعتماد وحفظ جلسة جرد مخزني وتعديل أرصدة الدفعات آلياً بالكميات الفعلية المعدودة
 */
async function createStocktake(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, withTx, nextNumber } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const items = Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  if (items.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('لا توجد عناصر في قائمة الجرد لحفظها');
  }

  const docNumber = payload.number || (await nextNumber('stocktake'));
  const scopeType = payload.scope_type || payload.scopeType || 'all';
  const scopeValue = payload.scope_value || payload.scopeValue || null;
  const userId = payload.user_id || payload.userId || null;
  const note = payload.note || null;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const applyAdjustments = payload.applyAdjustments !== false;

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    const ins = await tx.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO stocktakes (
        number, status, scope_type, scope_value, user_id, note, started_at, closed_at
      ) VALUES (?, 'closed', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [docNumber, scopeType, scopeValue, userId, note, payload.started_at || nowIso, nowIso]
    );
    const stocktakeId = ins.lastID;

    for (const item of items) {
      const productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
      if (!productId) continue;

      let batchId = item.batch_id || item.batchId ? Number(item.batch_id || item.batchId) : null;
      const variantId = item.variant_id || item.variantId ? Number(item.variant_id || item.variantId) : null;

      let bookQty = Number(item.book_qty ?? item.bookQty ?? 0);
      const hasCounted =
        item.counted_qty !== undefined && item.counted_qty !== null && String(item.counted_qty).trim() !== '';
      const countedQty = hasCounted ? Number(item.counted_qty) : bookQty;

      // إذا لم يكن للمنتج دفعة مسجلة بعد وتم عده بكمية موجبة، ننشئ له دفعة ابتدائية
      if (!batchId) {
        const existingBatch = await dbGet(
          'SELECT id, stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',
          [productId]
        );
        if (existingBatch) {
          batchId = existingBatch.id;
          bookQty = Number(existingBatch.stock || 0);
        } else if (applyAdjustments && countedQty > 0) {
          const newB = await tx.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, 0)',
            [productId, variantId]
          );
          batchId = newB.lastID;
          bookQty = 0;
        }
      }

      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO stocktake_items (
          stocktake_id, product_id, variant_id, batch_id, book_qty, counted_qty
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [stocktakeId, productId, variantId, batchId, bookQty, countedQty]
      );

      // تطبيق التسوية المخزنية على الدفعة إذا تغيرت الكمية المعدودة عن الكمية الدفترية
      if (applyAdjustments && batchId && hasCounted && Math.abs(countedQty - bookQty) > 0.0001) {
        await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = ? WHERE id = ?', [countedQty, batchId]);
      }
    }

    return await getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId);
  });
}

module.exports = {
  loadSheet,
  getStocktakeSheet: loadSheet,
  listStocktakes,
  getStocktakes: listStocktakes,
  getStocktake,
  createStocktake
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-ui.js
 * محرك واجهة الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake & Variance Reconciliation UI)
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  let currentSheetRows = [];
  let historyList = [];

  async function renderStocktakeView(filters = {}) {
    const container = document.getElementById('stocktake-view-root');
    if (!container || !window.api) return;

    const [sheet, stocktakes] = await Promise.all([
      window.api.getStocktakeSheet(filters).catch(() => []),
      window.api.getStocktakes({}).catch(() => [])
    ]);

    currentSheetRows = (Array.isArray(sheet) ? sheet : []).map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      counted_qty: row.book_qty
    }));
    historyList = Array.isArray(stocktakes) ? stocktakes : [];

    drawStocktakeInterface(container);
  }

  function drawStocktakeInterface(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-black">الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake)</h2>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">مقارنة الرصيد الدفتري بالرصيد الفعلي المعدود وتسوية الفروقات آلياً</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.printBlankSheet()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
              <span>طباعة ورقة الجرد</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.commitStocktake()"
              class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">Fact_Check</span>
              <span>اعتماد الجرد وتسوية الأرصدة</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- جدول إدخال الجرد الحي -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base">ورقة العد المباشر (${currentSheetRows.length} دفعة/منتج)</h3>
            <input id="stocktakeNoteInput" type="text" placeholder="ملاحظة على جلسة الجرد (اختياري)..."
              class="w-72 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">
          </div>

          <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[460px]">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead class="sticky top-0 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900">
                <tr class="text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">المنتج</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الباركود</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفئة</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الكمية المعدودة فعلياً</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفارق</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${
                  currentSheetRows.length === 0
                    ? '<tr><td colspan="6" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد منتجات للجرد</td></tr>'
                    : currentSheetRows
                        .map((r, idx) => {
                          const diff = Number((Number(r.counted_qty ?? r.book_qty) - Number(r.book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3));
                          const diffClass =
                            diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400';
                          return `
                            <tr>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-bold">${r.product_name}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono text-slate-500">${r.barcode || '-'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">${r.category || 'عام'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono font-bold">${r.book_qty} ${r.unit || ''}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">
                                <input type="number" step="any" value="${r.counted_qty}"
                                  oninput="window.StocktakeUI.updateCountedQty(${idx}, this.value)"
                                  class="w-28 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono text-center font-bold">
                              </td>
                              <td id="stk-diff-${idx}" class="py-2 px-3 font-mono ${diffClass}">
                                ${diff > 0 ? '+' + diff : diff}
                              </td>
                            </tr>`;
                        })
                        .join('')
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
          <h3 class="font-black text-sm">سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة (${historyList.length})</h3>
          <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">رقم الجرد</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">التاريخ</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">عدد العناصر</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">الفروقات المسجلة</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">ملاحظة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${historyList
                  .map(
                    (st) => `
                  <tr>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${st.number || '#' + st.id}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono">${String(st.closed_at || st.created_at || '').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2">${st.items_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-amber-500">${st.discrepancies_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 text-slate-500">${st.note || '-'}</td>
                  </tr>`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateCountedQty(index, rawValue) {
    if (!currentSheetRows[index]) return;
    const val = parseFloat(rawValue);
    currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty = Number.isFinite(val) ? val : currentSheetRows[index].book_qty;
    const diff = Number(
      (Number(currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty) - Number(currentSheetRows[index].book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3)
    );
    const cell = document.getElementById(`stk-diff-${index}`);
    if (cell) {
      cell.textContent = diff > 0 ? `+${diff}` : String(diff);
      cell.className = `py-2 px-3 font-mono ${
        diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400'
      }`;
    }
  }

  async function commitStocktake() {
    if (currentSheetRows.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm('سيتم اعتماد الكميات المعدودة وتحديث أرصدة المخزون فعلياً. هل أنت متأكد؟')) return;

    const noteEl = document.getElementById('stocktakeNoteInput');
    const note = noteEl ? noteEl.value.trim() : '';

    try {
      await window.api.createStocktake({
        scope_type: 'all',
        note,
        applyAdjustments: true,
        items: currentSheetRows
      });
      await renderStocktakeView();
      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم اعتماد الجرد وتحديث الأرصدة بنجاح', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ الجرد');
    }
  }

  function printBlankSheet() {
    const rowsHtml = currentSheetRows
      .map(
        (r, i) => `
        <tr>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;">${r.product_name}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.barcode || ''}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.book_qty}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;"></td>
        </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    const html = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
      <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ورقة جرد المخزون</title></head>
      <body style="font-family:Cairo,Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;">
        <h2 style="text-align:center;">ورقة الجرد المخزني — Gherbi.Ai POS</h2>
        <p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;">التاريخ: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}</p>
        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="background:#f1f5f9;">
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">#</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">المنتج</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الباركود</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;width:120px;">الكمية المعدودة</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </body>
      </html>`;

    if (window.PrintEngine) {
      window.PrintEngine.printHtmlDocument(html, { silent: false });
    }
  }

  window.StocktakeUI = {
    renderStocktakeView,
    updateCountedQty,
    commitStocktake,
    printBlankSheet
  };
})();

/**

 * واجهة بناء وتخصيص القوالب المرئية ومعاينتها الحية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات

'use strict';

(function () {
  let currentLayout = window.TemplatePresets
    ? window.TemplatePresets.getPreset('modern_a4')
    : { name: 'قالب مخصص', paper: 'a4', accentColor: '#1d4ed8', columns: {} };
  let savedTemplates = [];

  const sampleDocData = {
    doc_number: 'FAC-2026-0105',
    sale_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    customer_name: 'مؤسسة الأمل للتجارة',
    customer_phone: '0550123456',
    payment_method: 'نقداً',
    subtotal: 14500,
    discount: 500,
    total: 14000,
    paid_amount: 14000,
    old_balance: 2000,
    items: [
      { barcode: '6130001', product_name: 'زيت مائدة 5 لتر', quantity: 4, unit: 'قارورة', price: 650, subtotal: 2600 },
      { barcode: '6130002', product_name: 'قهوة مطحونة ممتازة 250غ', quantity: 20, unit: 'علبة', price: 320, subtotal: 6400 },
      { barcode: '6130003', product_name: 'حليب مجفف 500غ', quantity: 11, unit: 'علبة', price: 500, subtotal: 5500 }
    ]
  };

  async function initTemplateBuilder(containerId = 'template-designer-root') {
    const root = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!root) return;

    if (window.api && window.api.getCustomTemplates) {
      savedTemplates = (await window.api.getCustomTemplates().catch(() => [])) || [];

    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">

        <div class="lg:col-span-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base">خصائص القالب المخصص</h3>

              class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">save</span>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">

            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block font-bold mb-1">مقاس الورق</label>
              <select id="td-paper" onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('paper', this.value)"
                class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl">
                <option value="a4" ${currentLayout.paper === 'a4' ? 'selected' : ''}>A4 قياسي</option>
                <option value="a5" ${currentLayout.paper === 'a5' ? 'selected' : ''}>A5 نصفي</option>
                <option value="thermal80" ${currentLayout.paper === 'thermal80' ? 'selected' : ''}>حراري 80mm</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block font-bold mb-1">اللون الرئيسي</label>
              <input id="td-color" type="color" value="${currentLayout.accentColor || '#1d4ed8'}"
                oninput="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('accentColor', this.value)"
                class="w-full h-9 rounded-xl cursor-pointer">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block font-bold mb-1">حجم الخط (px)</label>
              <input id="td-fontsize" type="number" min="9" max="18" value="${currentLayout.fontSize || 12}"
                oninput="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('fontSize', Number(this.value))"
                class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="space-y-2 text-xs pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" ${currentLayout.showFiscal ? 'checked' : ''}
                onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('showFiscal', this.checked)">
              <span>إظهار البيانات الجبائية للمتجر (RC / NIF / AI / NIS)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" ${currentLayout.showOldDebt ? 'checked' : ''}
                onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('showOldDebt', this.checked)">
              <span>إظهار الرصيد السابق للزبون</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" ${currentLayout.showAmountInWords ? 'checked' : ''}
                onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('showAmountInWords', this.checked)">
              <span>إظهار المبلغ بالحروف (التفقيط)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" ${currentLayout.showSignature ? 'checked' : ''}
                onchange="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('showSignature', this.checked)">
              <span>إظهار خانة الختم والإمضاء</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">ملاحظة أسفل الفاتورة</label>
            <input type="text" value="${currentLayout.footerNote || ''}"
              oninput="window.TemplateBuilder.updateProp('footerNote', this.value)"
              class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">
          </div>

          <div class="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold mb-2">القوالب المحفوظة (${savedTemplates.length})</div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              ${savedTemplates
                .map(
                  (t) => `
                <button onclick="window.TemplateBuilder.loadSaved(${t.id})"
                  class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-50">
                  ${t.name}
                </button>`
                )
                .join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- المعاينة الحية -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-7 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">معاينة حية ومباشرة للقالب</div>
          <iframe id="td-preview-frame" class="w-full h-[520px] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    refreshPreview();
  }

  function updateProp(key, val) {
    currentLayout[key] = val;
    refreshPreview();
  }

  function refreshPreview() {
    const frame = document.getElementById('td-preview-frame');
    if (!frame || !window.TemplateRenderer) return;
    const settings = (window.AppState && window.AppState.settings) || {};
    const html = window.TemplateRenderer.renderCustomTemplateHtml(currentLayout, sampleDocData, settings);
    const doc = frame.contentWindow.document;
    doc.open();
    doc.write(html);
    doc.close();
  }

  async function saveCurrent() {
    if (!window.api || !window.api.saveCustomTemplate) return;
    await window.api.saveCustomTemplate({
      id: currentLayout.id || undefined,
      name: currentLayout.name || 'قالب مخصص',
      doc_type: currentLayout.doc_type || 'invoice',
      paper: currentLayout.paper || 'a4',
      lang: currentLayout.lang || 'ar',
      layout_json: JSON.stringify(currentLayout),
      is_default: 1
    });
    if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم حفظ القالب المخصص بنجاح', 'success');
    await initTemplateBuilder();
  }

  async function loadSaved(id) {
    const found = savedTemplates.find((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id));
    if (!found) return;
    try {
      currentLayout = { ...JSON.parse(found.layout_json || '{}'), id: found.id, name: found.name };
      await initTemplateBuilder();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  window.TemplateBuilder = {
    initTemplateBuilder,
    updateProp,
    refreshPreview,
    saveCurrent,
    loadSaved
  };
})();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\template-designer\template-renderer.js`

```javascript
/**
 * template-designer/template-renderer.js
 * محرك تحويل مخطط القالب المخصص (JSON Layout) إلى مستند HTML جاهز للطباعة
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  function renderCustomTemplateHtml(layout = {}, docData = {}, settings = {}) {
    const lang = layout.lang || 'ar';
    const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    const accent = layout.accentColor || '#1d4ed8';
    const cols = layout.columns || {};
    const items = Array.isArray(docData.items) ? docData.items : [];

    const subtotal = Number(docData.subtotal ?? docData.total ?? 0);
    const discount = Number(docData.discount || 0);
    const total = Number(docData.total ?? (subtotal - discount));
    const paid = Number(docData.paid_amount ?? total);
    const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
    const oldDebt = Number(docData.old_balance || 0);

    const words =
      window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function'
        ? window.NumberToWords.toWords(total, lang)
        : `${total.toFixed(2)} DZD`;

    const headersHtml = `
      ${cols.index !== false ? '<th>#</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.barcode ? '<th>المرجع</th>' : ''}
      <th>البيان / المنتج</th>
      ${cols.qty !== false ? '<th>الكمية</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unit ? '<th>الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? '<th>سعر الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.tva ? '<th>TVA</th>' : ''}
      <th>المجموع</th>
    `;

    const rowsHtml = items
      .map(
        (it, i) => `
      <tr>
        ${cols.index !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.barcode ? `<td>${it.barcode || it.product_barcode || '-'}</td>` : ''}
        <td style="font-weight:700;">${it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج'}</td>
        ${cols.qty !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.quantity || 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unit ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.unit || 'قطعة'}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(it.price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.tva ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(docData.tax_percentage || 0)}%</td>` : ''}
        <td style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;">${Number(it.subtotal || (it.quantity || 1) * (it.price || 0)).toFixed(2)}</td>
      </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <style>
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', sans-serif; font-size: ${layout.fontSize || 12}px; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }
    .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; border-bottom: 3px solid ${accent}; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .shop-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: ${accent}; }
    .meta-box { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    th { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid ${accent}; }
    td { padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
    .totals { width: 280px; margin-right: auto; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
    .totals-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .totals-row.grand { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 14px; }
    .words-box { margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #f1f5f9; border-right: 4px solid ${accent}; font-weight: 700; }
    .footer { margin-top: 28px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="shop-title">${settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS'}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_description || ''}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_address || ''} ${settings.shop_phone ? ' | ' + settings.shop_phone : ''}</div>
      ${
        layout.showFiscal
          ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;">RC: ${settings.shop_rc || '-'} | NIF: ${settings.shop_nif || '-'} | AI: ${settings.shop_ai || '-'} | NIS: ${settings.shop_nis || '-'}</div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:left;">
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:${accent};">فاتورة رقم: ${docData.doc_number || 'FAC-2026-0001'}</div>
      <div>التاريخ: ${String(docData.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-box">
    <div>
      <strong>الزبون:</strong> ${docData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر'}
      ${docData.customer_phone ? ` | <strong>الهاتف:</strong> ${docData.customer_phone}` : ''}
    </div>
    <div><strong>طريقة الدفع:</strong> ${docData.payment_method || 'نقداً'}</div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead><tr>${headersHtml}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المجموع الفرعي:</span><span>${subtotal.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${discount > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>التخفيض:</span><span>${discount.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    <div class="totals-row grand"><span>الصافي للدفع:</span><span>${total.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المدفوع:</span><span>${paid.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${rest > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الباقي من الفاتورة:</span><span>${rest.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    ${layout.showOldDebt && oldDebt > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الدين السابق:</span><span>${oldDebt.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
  </div>

  ${layout.showAmountInWords ? `<div class="words-box">أوقفت هذه الفاتورة على مبلغ: ${words}</div>` : ''}

  <div class="footer">
    <div>${layout.footerNote || ''}</div>
    ${layout.showSignature ? '<div style="font-weight:700;">الختم والإمضاء</div>' : ''}
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  window.TemplateRenderer = {
    renderCustomTemplateHtml
  };
})();
```

## `scripts_archive_backup\commercial-launch-100.js`

```javascript
/**
 * commercial-launch-100.js
 * السكربت الهندسي الختامي للإطلاق التجاري الكامل (100.0% Commercial Launch & Full Lumina Contract Parity)
 * لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS (Clean-Room Edition)
 *
 * ينفذ المهام الـ 6 الختامية بدقة جراحية:
 * 1. توليد صور نقطية حقيقية (Valid Binary PNG/JPEG) للفئات النقدية الجزائرية الـ 9 في assets/img/ + عرضها كأزرار دفع سريع في #checkoutModal
 * 2. مطابقة جميع عقود المتغيرات (Template Data Contracts) في delivery_note_thermal.html و payment_receipt_ar/fr.html و print-engine.js مع Lumina POS 100%
 * 3. تفعيل المنطق التفاعلي الكامل لـ #posUnitChoiceModal (بيع بالتجزئة / بالجملة بالكرتون) و #posBarcodeSuggestModal (اقتراح الباركود الذكي)
 * 4. تفعيل معاينة صفحة الملصقات (#plSheetPreviewModal) وتصدير الملصقات PDF في مركز الطباعة
 * 5. إضافة شاشة الإقلاع الترحيبية السريعة (#splashScreen) ونافذة الدعم الفني وفحص التحديثات
 * 6. تنظيف جذر المشروع بنقل سكربتات الترقيع المؤقتة القديمة إلى scripts_archive/ وفحص سلامة جميع ملفات .js
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const ROOT = __dirname;

// ============================================================================
// 1. توليد صور نقطية حقيقية (Binary PNG) + SVG للفئات النقدية الجزائرية الـ 9
//    وربطها كأزرار دفع نقدي سريع داخل #checkoutModal
// ============================================================================
function createSolidColorPngBuffer(width, height, r, g, b) {
  const signature = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]);

  function crc32(buf) {
    let c = 0xffffffff;
    for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
      c ^= buf[i];
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
      }
    }
    return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
  }

  function makeChunk(type, data) {
    const len = Buffer.alloc(4);
    len.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);
    const typeBuf = Buffer.from(type, 'ascii');
    const crcBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
    crcBuf.writeUInt32BE(crc32(Buffer.concat([typeBuf, data])), 0);
    return Buffer.concat([len, typeBuf, data, crcBuf]);
  }

  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(width, 0);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(height, 4);
  ihdr[8] = 8; // bit depth
  ihdr[9] = 2; // color type RGB
  ihdr[10] = 0;
  ihdr[11] = 0;
  ihdr[12] = 0;

  const rowSize = width * 3 + 1;
  const rawData = Buffer.alloc(rowSize * height);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    const rowStart = y * rowSize;
    rawData[rowStart] = 0; // filter type 0
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const px = rowStart + 1 + x * 3;
      const isBorder = x < 3 || x >= width - 3 || y < 3 || y >= height - 3;
      rawData[px] = isBorder ? 255 : r;
      rawData[px + 1] = isBorder ? 255 : g;
      rawData[px + 2] = isBorder ? 255 : b;
    }
  }

  const idat = makeChunk('IDAT', zlib.deflateSync(rawData));
  const iend = makeChunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0));
  return Buffer.concat([signature, makeChunk('IHDR', ihdr), idat, iend]);
}

const imgDir = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'img');
if (!fs.existsSync(imgDir)) fs.mkdirSync(imgDir, { recursive: true });

const dzNotes = [
  { file: '2000.jpg', val: 2000, rgb: [30, 58, 138], label: '2000 د.ج' },
  { file: '1000.jpg', val: 1000, rgb: [154, 52, 18], label: '1000 د.ج' },
  { file: '500.jpg', val: 500, rgb: [6, 95, 70], label: '500 د.ج' },
  { file: '200.jpg', val: 200, rgb: [146, 64, 14], label: '200 د.ج' },
  { file: '100.jpg', val: 100, rgb: [3, 105, 161], label: '100 د.ج' },
  { file: '50.jpg', val: 50, rgb: [51, 65, 85], label: '50 د.ج' },
  { file: '20.jpg', val: 20, rgb: [161, 98, 7], label: '20 د.ج' },
  { file: '10.jpg', val: 10, rgb: [71, 85, 105], label: '10 د.ج' },
  { file: '5.png', val: 5, rgb: [100, 116, 139], label: '5 د.ج' }
];

for (const n of dzNotes) {
  const pngBuf = createSolidColorPngBuffer(120, 60, n.rgb[0], n.rgb[1], n.rgb[2]);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(imgDir, n.file), pngBuf);
}
console.log('✅ 1/6: تم توليد صور الفئات النقدية النقطية الـ 9 داخل assets/img/.');

// ============================================================================
// 2. تحديث delivery_note_thermal.html و payment_receipt_ar/fr.html و print-engine.js
//    لتطابق عقود المتغيرات (Template Data Contracts) في Lumina POS بنسبة 100%
// ============================================================================
const luminaDeliveryThermalHtml = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_DELIVERY_TITLE}} - {{DELIVERY_NUMBER}}</title>
  <style data-purpose="page-size">
    @page { margin: 0; }
  </style>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm);
      color: #000;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    .center { text-align: center; }
    .b { font-weight: 800; }
    .sep { border-top: 1px dashed #000; margin: 5px 0; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; }
    h1 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; margin: 0 0 2px; }
    .muted { font-size: 9px; }
    .logo { max-width: 120px; max-height: 60px; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto 4px; display: block; }
    .t-item { margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .t-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; }

    .t-line .muted2 { color: #333; }

    @media print { body { padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm); } }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <div class="center">
    {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}<img class="logo" src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="logo" />{{/if}}

  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_CARRIER}} :</span><span>{{CARRIER_NAME}}</span></div>
  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_VEHICLE}} :</span><span>{{VEHICLE_PLATE}}</span></div>
  <div class="sep"></div>

  <div class="sep"></div>
