      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white font-black text-xs">🇩🇿 الجباية الجزائرية</span>
          <h3 class="text-lg font-black">التصريح الجبائي السنوي للزبائن (État 104) وملخص الضرائب الشهري (G50)</h3>
        </div>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('algerianFiscalModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="algerianFiscalModalBody" class="space-y-4 text-xs"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
`;
    html = html.replace('<script src="./assets/js/translations.js"></script>', newModalsHtml + '\n  <script src="./assets/js/translations.js"></script>');
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(indexPath, html, 'utf8');
}
console.log('✅ 3/4: تم حقن النوافذ الـ 4 المتقدمة في index.html بنجاح.');

// ============================================================================
// 4. حقن المنطق البرمجي الكامل للـ 12 ميزة في renderer-rc-100.js
// ============================================================================
const ultimateRendererCode = `
// ============================================================================
// [ULTIMATE ALGERIAN MARKET-LEADER & 100% LUMINA PARITY ENGINE]
// ============================================================================
(function applyUltimateAlgeria100() {
  if (!window.App || !window.AppState) return;

  AppState.posShowCost = false;
  AppState.lastScannedUnknownBarcode = '';
  AppState.lastDzSuggestItem = null;

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 9: المحول الجزائري الفوري من الدينار إلى السنتيم ("المليون والألف سنتيم")
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  App.formatAlgerianCentimes = function (amountDzd) {
    const dzd = Number(amountDzd || 0);
    if (!Number.isFinite(dzd) || Math.abs(dzd) < 0.01) return '0 سنتيم';
    const sign = dzd < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const totalCentimes = Math.round(Math.abs(dzd) * 100);
    // 1 مليون سنتيم = 10,000 د.ج = 1,000,000 سنتيم
    // 1 ألف سنتيم ("ألف فرانك") = 10 د.ج = 1,000 سنتيم
    const millions = Math.floor(totalCentimes / 1000000);
    const remAfterMillions = totalCentimes % 1000000;
    const thousands = Math.floor(remAfterMillions / 1000);

    const parts = [];
    if (millions === 1) parts.push('مليون');
    else if (millions === 2) parts.push('جوج ملاين');
    else if (millions > 2) parts.push(\`\${millions} ملاين\`);

    if (thousands > 0) {
      parts.push(\`\${thousands} ألف\`);
    }
    if (parts.length === 0) {
      return \`\${sign}\${totalCentimes} سنتيم\`;
    }
    return \`\${sign}\${parts.join(' و ')} سنتيم\`;
  };

  // حقن عرض السنتيم تحت إجمالي السلة وفي نافذة الدفع تلقائياً
  const _origRecalcCart = App.recalcAndRenderCart.bind(App);
  App.recalcAndRenderCart = function () {
    const totals = _origRecalcCart();
    const totalEl = document.getElementById('cartTotalText');
    if (totalEl) {
      let centimeBadge = document.getElementById('cartTotalCentimeBadge');
      if (!centimeBadge) {
        centimeBadge = document.createElement('div');
        centimeBadge.id = 'cartTotalCentimeBadge';
        centimeBadge.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-0.5';
        totalEl.parentNode.appendChild(centimeBadge);
      }
      centimeBadge.textContent = \`🇩🇿 بالتداول الجزائري: \${this.formatAlgerianCentimes(totals.total)}\`;
    }
    return totals;
  };

  const _origRecalcCheckout = App.recalcCheckoutModal.bind(App);
  App.recalcCheckoutModal = function () {
    const res = _origRecalcCheckout();
    const totalEl = document.getElementById('chkTotalText');
    if (totalEl) {
      let badge = document.getElementById('chkCentimeHelperText');
      if (!badge) {
        badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.id = 'chkCentimeHelperText';
        badge.className = 'text-xs font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-1';
        totalEl.parentNode.appendChild(badge);
      }
      badge.innerHTML = \`🇩🇿 الإجمالي بالسنتيم: <span>\${this.formatAlgerianCentimes(res.total)}</span>\${
        res.change > 0 ? \` | الباقي للزبون (الصرْف): <span class="text-emerald-600">\${this.formatAlgerianCentimes(res.change)}</span>\` : ''
      }\`;
    }
    return res;
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 4: أزرار الأوراق والعملات النقدية الجزائرية التفاعلية في نافذة التسديد (#checkoutModal)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const _origOpenCheckoutModal = App.openCheckoutModal.bind(App);
  App.openCheckoutModal = function () {
    _origOpenCheckoutModal();
    const paidInput = document.getElementById('chkPaidInput');
    if (paidInput && !document.getElementById('chkDzBanknotesBar')) {
      const bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.id = 'chkDzBanknotesBar';
      bar.className = 'space-y-1.5 pt-2';
      const notes = [2000, 1000, 500, 200, 100, 50];
      bar.innerHTML = \`
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">
          <span>🇩🇿 نقر سريع لإضافة الأوراق النقدية الجزائرية للمبلغ المدفوع:</span>
          <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('chkPaidInput').value='0'; App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="text-rose-500 hover:underline">تصفير</button>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1.5">
          \${notes
            .map(
              (n) => \`
            <button type="button" onclick="App.addBanknoteToCheckout(\${n})" class="p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 flex flex-col items-center transition transform active:scale-95">
              <img src="./assets/img/\${n}.svg" alt="\${n} DA" class="h-8 w-full object-contain rounded">
              <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-black mt-0.5">+\${n}</span>
            </button>\`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>
      \`;
      paidInput.parentNode.appendChild(bar);
    }

    // استكمال عملات 20، 10، 5 د.ج في حاسبة جرد الصندوق
    const denomGrid = document.querySelector('#closeShiftModal .grid.grid-cols-3.gap-2.font-mono');
    if (denomGrid && !denomGrid.querySelector('[data-denom="20"]')) {
      denomGrid.insertAdjacentHTML(
        'beforeend',
        \`
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-amber-600">20×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="20" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-slate-500">10×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="10" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-slate-400">5×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="5" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
        \`
      );
    }
  };

  App.addBanknoteToCheckout = function (noteVal) {
    const inp = document.getElementById('chkPaidInput');
    if (!inp) return;
    const cur = parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
    const total = this.recalcAndRenderCart().total;
    // إذا كان الحقل مساوياً للإجمالي الافتراضي عند أول نقرة، نبدأ من الصفر ثم نجمع الأوراق
    if (!AppState._banknoteClickedOnce && Math.abs(cur - total) < 0.01) {
      inp.value = String(noteVal);
      AppState._banknoteClickedOnce = true;
    } else {
      inp.value = String(Number((cur + Number(noteVal)).toFixed(2)));
    }
    this.recalcCheckoutModal();
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 1: نافذة الاقتراح الذكي عند مسح باركود غير موجود (#posBarcodeSuggestModal)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const _origHandleBarcodeScan = App.handleBarcodeScan.bind(App);
  App.handleBarcodeScan = async function (rawCode) {
    const code = String(rawCode || '').trim();
    if (!code) return;

    // فحص ما إذا كان الباركود موجوداً في المنتجات أو الحزم أو باركود الميزان
    const scalePrefix = String(AppState.settings.scale_barcode_prefix || '20');
    const isScaleBc = String(AppState.settings.scale_barcode_enabled) !== 'false' && code.length >= 12 && code.startsWith(scalePrefix);
    const prodMatch = AppState.products.find(
      (p) =>
        String(p.barcode || '') === code ||
        String(p.plu_code || '') === code ||
        (Array.isArray(p.barcodes) && p.barcodes.some((b) => String(b.barcode || b) === code)) ||
        (Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants.some((v) => String(v.barcode || '') === code))
    );
    const bundleMatch = AppState.bundles.find((b) => String(b.barcode || '') === code && b.is_active !== 0);

    if (prodMatch || bundleMatch || isScaleBc) {
      return await _origHandleBarcodeScan(code);
    }

    // الباركود غير مسجل -> فتح نافذة الاقتراح الذكي (#posBarcodeSuggestModal)
    const bcInput = document.getElementById('barcodeInput');
    if (bcInput) bcInput.value = '';
    this.playScanSound(false);
    await this.openBarcodeSuggestModal(code);
  };

  App.openBarcodeSuggestModal = async function (barcode) {
    AppState.lastScannedUnknownBarcode = barcode;
    document.getElementById('suggestScannedBarcode').textContent = barcode;
    const dzBox = document.getElementById('suggestDzDictBox');
    dzBox.classList.add('hidden');
    AppState.lastDzSuggestItem = null;

    if (window.api && window.api.lookupDzBarcode) {
      const dzItem = await window.api.lookupDzBarcode(barcode).catch(() => null);
      if (dzItem && dzItem.name) {
        AppState.lastDzSuggestItem = dzItem;
        dzBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('suggestDzDictDetails').textContent = \`\${dzItem.name} — العلامة: \${dzItem.brand || 'جزائرية'} (\${dzItem.category || 'عام'})\`;
        const sugPrice = Number(dzItem.suggested_price || 100);
        document.getElementById('suggestDzPriceInput').value = String(sugPrice);
        document.getElementById('suggestDzCostInput').value = String(Math.round(sugPrice * 0.82));
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('suggestLinkSearchInput').value = '';
    this.renderBarcodeSuggestProducts('');
    this.openModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal');
  };

  App.renderBarcodeSuggestProducts = function (query = '') {
    const q = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = (AppState.products || [])
      .filter((p) => !q || String(p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(p.barcode || '').includes(q))
      .slice(0, 15);
    const box = document.getElementById('posBarcodeSuggestList');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML =
      list
        .map(
          (p) => \`
        <div class="py-1.5 px-2 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg">
          <div>
            <div class="font-bold">\${p.name}</div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">\${p.barcode || ''} — \${Number(p.selling_price || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
          </div>
          <button onclick="App.linkScannedBarcodeToExistingProduct(\${p.id})" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600/15 text-indigo-600 font-bold text-[11px]">
            ربط الباركود وبيع
          </button>
        </div>\`
        )
        .join('') || '<div class="py-3 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد منتجات مطابقة</div>';
  };

  App.linkScannedBarcodeToExistingProduct = async function (productId) {
    const bc = AppState.lastScannedUnknownBarcode;
    if (!bc || !productId) return;
    await window.api.addProductBarcode(productId, bc, null);
    this.closeModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal');
    await this.refreshProducts();
    this.addProductToCart(productId, 1);
    showToast(\`تم ربط الباركود (\${bc}) بالمنتج وإضافته للسلة!\`, 'success');
  };

  App.QuickCreateFromDzSuggest = async function () {
    const dz = AppState.lastDzSuggestItem;
    const bc = AppState.lastScannedUnknownBarcode;
    if (!dz || !bc) return;
    const cost = parseFloat(document.getElementById('suggestDzCostInput')?.value) || 0;
    const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('suggestDzPriceInput')?.value) || 0;
    const stock = parseFloat(document.getElementById('suggestDzStockInput')?.value) || 10;

    const res = await window.api.addProduct({
      barcode: bc,
      name: dz.name,
      category: dz.category || 'عام',
      supplier: dz.brand || '',
      unit: dz.unit || 'قطعة',
      min_stock: 5,
      stock,
      cost_price: cost,
      selling_price: price
    });
    this.closeModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal');
    await this.refreshProducts();
    if (res && res.id) {
      this.addProductToCart(res.id, 1);
    }
    showToast(\`تمت إضافة "\${dz.name}" للمخزون والسلة بنجاح!\`, 'success');
  };

  App.createSimilarProductFromSuggest = function () {
    const bc = AppState.lastScannedUnknownBarcode;
    this.closeModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal');
    this.openProductModal(null);
    const bcInp = document.getElementById('prodBarcodeInput');
    if (bcInp && bc) {
      bcInp.value = bc;
      this.checkDzDictionaryForBarcode(bc);
    }
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 2: تبديل وحدة البيع في السلة (قطعة Détail / كرتونة جملة Gros)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  App.toggleCartItemWholesaleUnit = function (idx) {
    const item = this.currentCart.items[idx];
    if (!item || !item.product_id) return;
    const prod = AppState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(item.product_id));
    if (!prod) return;

    const wQty = Math.max(1, Number(prod.wholesale_qty || 1));
    const wUnit = prod.wholesale_unit || 'كرتونة';
    const wPrice = Number(prod.wholesale_price || prod.selling_price || item.price);

    if (!item._isWholesaleMode) {
      item._isWholesaleMode = true;
      item._origUnit = item.unit;
      item._origPrice = item.price;
      item.unit = \`\${wUnit} (\${wQty}×)\`;
      item.quantity = wQty;
      item.price = wPrice;
      showToast(\`تم التبديل إلى البيع بالجملة (\${wUnit} = \${wQty} بسعر \${wPrice} د.ج)\`, 'info');
    } else {
      item._isWholesaleMode = false;
      item.unit = item._origUnit || prod.unit || 'قطعة';
      item.quantity = 1;
      item.price = item._origPrice || Number(prod.selling_price || item.price);
      showToast('تمت العودة إلى البيع بالتجزئة (القطعة)', 'info');
    }
    item.subtotal = Number((item.quantity * item.price).toFixed(2));
    this.recalcAndRenderCart();
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 3: حاسبة نسبة الربح (#batchMarkup) وأدوات التعبئة الجماعية للمتغيرات
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function injectProductModalEnhancements() {
    const priceInput = document.getElementById('prodPriceInput');
    const costInput = document.getElementById('prodCostInput');
    if (priceInput && costInput && !document.getElementById('prodMarkupPercentInput')) {
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]';
      wrap.innerHTML = \`
        <span class="text-slate-400 font-bold">هامش الربح %:</span>
        <input id="prodMarkupPercentInput" type="number" step="any" placeholder="مثلاً 25%"
          oninput="App.onProdMarkupChange(this.value)"
          class="w-24 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600">
      \`;
      priceInput.parentNode.appendChild(wrap);
      costInput.addEventListener('input', () => App.syncProdMarkupFromPrices());
      priceInput.addEventListener('input', () => App.syncProdMarkupFromPrices());
    }

    // شريط التعبئة الجماعية للمتغيرات (Bulk Variant Fill)
    const varRowsBox = document.getElementById('prodVariantsMatrixRows');
    if (varRowsBox && !document.getElementById('bulkVariantsToolbar')) {
      const bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.id = 'bulkVariantsToolbar';
      bar.className = 'grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5 pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-indigo-500/20 text-[11px]';
      bar.innerHTML = \`
        <input id="bulkVarStockInp" type="number" placeholder="الكمية للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono">
        <input id="bulkVarCostInp" type="number" placeholder="التكلفة للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono">
        <input id="bulkVarPriceInp" type="number" placeholder="سعر البيع للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono">
        <button type="button" onclick="App.applyBulkVariantValues()" class="px-2 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">تطبيق على الكل</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="App.bulkGenerateVariantBarcodes()" class="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">توليد باركودات</button>
      \`;
      varRowsBox.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, varRowsBox);
    }
  }

  App.onProdMarkupChange = function (pctVal) {
    const cost = parseFloat(document.getElementById('prodCostInput')?.value) || 0;
    const pct = parseFloat(pctVal);
    if (cost > 0 && Number.isFinite(pct)) {
      document.getElementById('prodPriceInput').value = (cost * (1 + pct / 100)).toFixed(2);
    }
  };

  App.syncProdMarkupFromPrices = function () {
    const cost = parseFloat(document.getElementById('prodCostInput')?.value) || 0;
    const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('prodPriceInput')?.value) || 0;
    const mkInp = document.getElementById('prodMarkupPercentInput');
    if (mkInp && cost > 0 && price >= cost) {
      mkInp.value = (((price - cost) / cost) * 100).toFixed(1);
    }
  };

  App.applyBulkVariantValues = function () {
    const st = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bulkVarStockInp')?.value);
    const co = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bulkVarCostInp')?.value);
    const pr = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bulkVarPriceInp')?.value);
    (AppState.tempVariantsMatrix || []).forEach((v) => {
      if (Number.isFinite(st)) v.stock = st;
      if (Number.isFinite(co)) v.cost_price = co;
      if (Number.isFinite(pr)) v.selling_price = pr;
    });
    this.renderVariantsMatrixInModal();
    showToast('تم تعميم القيم على جميع المتغيرات بنجاح', 'success');
  };

  App.bulkGenerateVariantBarcodes = function () {
    const baseBc = document.getElementById('prodBarcodeInput')?.value?.trim() || '6130099';
    (AppState.tempVariantsMatrix || []).forEach((v, i) => {
      v.barcode = \`\${baseBc}-\${i + 1}\`;
    });
    this.renderVariantsMatrixInModal();
    showToast('تم توليد باركودات متسلسلة لجميع المتغيرات', 'success');
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 5 و 6: مقبض تغيير عرض السلة (#posCartResizer)، كشف التكلفة، وآخر المبيعات
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function injectPosTopToolbarExtras() {
    const topRightBar = document.querySelector('#top-header > div:last-child');
    if (topRightBar && !document.getElementById('btnPosRecentSalesQuick')) {
      topRightBar.insertAdjacentHTML(
        'afterbegin',
        \`
        <button id="btnPosRecentSalesQuick" onclick="App.openPosRecentSalesModal()" title="آخر المبيعات في الكاشير" class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white transition">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">history</span>
        </button>
        <button id="btnPosBossCostPeek" onclick="App.togglePosCostPeek()" title="إظهار/إخفاء سعر التكلفة (للمدير)" class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-white transition">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">visibility</span>
        </button>
        \`
      );
    }
  }

  App.togglePosCostPeek = function () {
    AppState.posShowCost = !AppState.posShowCost;
    this.renderPosView();
    showToast(AppState.posShowCost ? '👁️ تم إظهار سعر التكلفة على بطاقات الكاشير' : 'تم إخفاء سعر التكلفة', 'info');
  };

  App.openPosRecentSalesModal = async function () {
    const res = await window.api.getSales({ page: 1, limit: 15 });
    const rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : res.items || [];
    const box = document.getElementById('posRecentSalesTableBox');
    if (box) {
      box.innerHTML = \`
        <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
              <th class="py-2">#</th>
              <th class="py-2">التاريخ</th>
              <th class="py-2">الزبون</th>
              <th class="py-2">الإجمالي</th>
              <th class="py-2">المدفوع</th>
              <th class="py-2 text-center">إجراءات سريعة</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
            \${rows
              .map(
                (s) => \`
              <tr>
                <td class="py-2 font-mono font-bold">#\${s.id}</td>
                <td class="py-2 font-mono text-slate-400">\${String(s.sale_date || '').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                <td class="py-2 font-bold">\${s.customer_name || 'زبون عابر'}</td>
                <td class="py-2 font-mono font-black">\${Number(s.total || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</td>
                <td class="py-2 font-mono text-emerald-600">\${Number(s.paid_amount || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</td>
                <td class="py-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                  <button onclick="App.reprintSale(\${s.id}, 'receipt')" class="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg font-bold">وصل 80mm</button>
                  <button onclick="App.openPrintCenterModal(\${s.id}, 'invoice_a4')" class="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">🖨️ طباعة</button>
                  <button onclick="App.closeModal('posRecentSalesModal'); App.loadSaleIntoPosForEdit(\${s.id})" class="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 rounded-lg font-bold">تعديل</button>
                </td>
              </tr>\`
              )
              .join('')}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      \`;

              <div class="text-sm font-black font-mono text-emerald-600 mt-0.5">\${Number(g.tva_deductible || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
            </div>
            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">حقوق الطابع الجبائي (Timbre)</div>
              <div class="text-sm font-black font-mono text-amber-600 mt-0.5">\${Number(g.droit_timbre || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
            </div>
            <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white">
              <div class="text-[10px] opacity-80">صافي G50 المستحق للدفع</div>
              <div class="text-sm font-black font-mono mt-0.5">\${Number(g.total_a_payer || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- جدول État 104 للزبائن -->
        <div class="space-y-2">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="font-black text-sm text-emerald-600">2. كشف الزبائن السنوي (État 104 — الرقم الجبائي NIF والسجل التجاري RC):</div>
            <button onclick="window.api.exportEtat104Excel(AppState._lastFiscalReport?.etat104 || [])" class="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold">
              📥 تصدير كشف État 104 إلى Excel
            </button>

              <thead>
                <tr class="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500">
                  <th class="p-2">الزبون</th>
                  <th class="p-2">NIF</th>
                  <th class="p-2">RC</th>
                  <th class="p-2">AI</th>
                  <th class="p-2">CA HT</th>
                  <th class="p-2">TVA</th>
                  <th class="p-2">Timbre</th>
                  <th class="p-2">Total TTC</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                \${rows
                  .map(
                    (r) => \`
                  <tr>
                    <td class="p-2 font-bold">\${r.name}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono">\${r.nif || '—'}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono">\${r.rc || '—'}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono">\${r.ai || '—'}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono font-bold">\${Number(r.total_ht || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono text-blue-600">\${Number(r.total_tva || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono">\${Number(r.total_stamp || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td class="p-2 font-mono font-black text-emerald-600">\${Number(r.total_ttc || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</td>
                  </tr>\`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      \`;
    }
    this.openModal('algerianFiscalModal');
  };

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // الميزة 11: تذكير الديون والأقساط عبر WhatsApp الجزائري (+213) بضغطة زر
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  App.sendAlgerianWhatsAppReminder = function (phone, customerName, amountDzd, typeLabel = 'دين مستحق') {
    let clean = String(phone || '').replace(/\\D+/g, '');
    if (!clean) {
      showToast('يرجى تسجيل رقم هاتف الزبون أولاً لإرسال رسالة واتساب', 'warning');
      return;
    }
    if (clean.startsWith('0')) clean = '213' + clean.slice(1);
    else if (!clean.startsWith('213')) clean = '213' + clean;

    const shopName = AppState.settings.shop_name || 'متجرنا';
    const rip = AppState.settings.shop_baridimob_rip || '';
    const centimesStr = this.formatAlgerianCentimes(amountDzd);
    const msg = \`السلام عليكم السيد(ة) \${customerName}، نذكركم من "\${shopName}" بوجود \${typeLabel} بقيمة \${Number(amountDzd).toFixed(2)} د.ج (\${centimesStr}).\${
      rip ? \` يمكنكم التسديد عبر BaridiMob RIP: \${rip}\` : ''
    } شكراً لثقتكم.\`;

    const url = \`https://wa.me/\${clean}?text=\${encodeURIComponent(msg)}\`;
    if (window.api && window.api.openExternalLink) {
      window.api.openExternalLink(url);
    } else {
      window.open(url, '_blank');
    }
  };

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      injectProductModalEnhancements();
      injectPosTopToolbarExtras();
    }, 350);
  });
})();
`;

const rc100Path = path.join(ROOT, 'renderer-rc-100.js');
if (fs.existsSync(rc100Path)) {
  let rc = fs.readFileSync(rc100Path, 'utf8');
  if (!rc.includes('applyUltimateAlgeria100')) {
    fs.writeFileSync(rc100Path, rc + '\n' + ultimateRendererCode, 'utf8');
  }
}

// إضافة زر التصريح الجبائي (État 104 & G50) وزر واتساب في renderer.js
const rendererPath = path.join(ROOT, 'renderer.js');
if (fs.existsSync(rendererPath)) {
  let ren = fs.readFileSync(rendererPath, 'utf8');

  if (!ren.includes('App.openAlgerianFiscalModal()')) {
    ren = ren.replace(
      'onclick="App.printAnalyticsSalesSummary()"',
      `onclick="App.openAlgerianFiscalModal()" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold">🇩🇿 تصريح État 104 & G50</button>
            <button onclick="App.printAnalyticsSalesSummary()"`
    );
  }

  if (!ren.includes('App.sendAlgerianWhatsAppReminder(')) {
    ren = ren.replace(
      `onclick="App.openCustomerPaymentModal(\${c.id})"`,
      `onclick="App.sendAlgerianWhatsAppReminder('\${c.phone || ''}', '\${(c.name || '').replace(/'/g, '')}', \${Number(c.total_debt || 0)})" class="px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg font-bold" title="تذكير واتساب بالدارجة/العربية">💬 واتساب</button>
                    <button onclick="App.openCustomerPaymentModal(\${c.id})"`
    );
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(rendererPath, ren, 'utf8');
}

console.log('✅ 4/4: تم ربط جميع الميزات الـ 12 في renderer.js و renderer-rc-100.js بنجاح.');
console.log('\n🇩🇿🏆 اكتملت ترقية الصدارة الجزائرية 100.0%! شغّل النظام الآن عبر: npm run dev');
```

## `scripts_archive_backup\upgrade-final-backend.js`

```javascript
/**
 * upgrade-final-backend.js
 * يحقن معالجات الـ 18% الختامية في main.js:
 * 1. lookup-warranty-serial (فحص الضمان برقم IMEI / Serial)
 * 2. import-dz-dictionary-csv & get-dz-dictionary-stats (استيراد قاعدة المنتجات الجزائرية الضخمة 613)
 * 3. get-supplier-ledger (كشف حساب المورد الشامل: مشتريات + دفعات + مرتجعات)
 * 4. get-doc-counters & update-doc-counter (تخصيص بادئات ترقيم الفواتير والمستندات)
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const mainPath = path.join(__dirname, 'main.js');
if (!fs.existsSync(mainPath)) {
  console.error('❌ لم يتم العثور على main.js في المسار الحالي');
  process.exit(1);
}

let code = fs.readFileSync(mainPath, 'utf8');

const finalHandlersBlock = `
  // ============================================================================
  // [FINAL 100% UPGRADE HANDLERS]: Warranty IMEI, DZ 613 CSV, Supplier Ledger, Doc Counters
  // ============================================================================
  ipcMain.handle('lookup-warranty-serial', async (_e, rawSerial) => {
    const serial = String(rawSerial || '').trim();
    if (!serial) return null;

    const item = await dbGet(
      \`SELECT
         si.*,
         COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
         p.barcode AS product_barcode,
         p.warranty_months AS default_warranty_months,
         s.doc_number,
         s.sale_date,
         s.total AS sale_total,
         c.name AS customer_name,
         c.phone AS customer_phone
       FROM sale_items si
       INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
       LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
       LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
       WHERE si.serial_number = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND si.deleted_at IS NULL
       ORDER BY si.id DESC LIMIT 1\`,
      [serial]
    );

    if (!item) return { found: false, serial };

    const months = Number(item.warranty_months || item.default_warranty_months || 12);
    const startDate = new Date(item.sale_date || Date.now());
    const endDate = new Date(startDate);
    endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + months);
    const daysLeft = Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86400000);

    return {
      found: true,
      serial,
      sale_id: item.sale_id,
      doc_number: item.doc_number || ('#' + item.sale_id),
      sale_date: String(item.sale_date || '').slice(0, 10),
      product_name: item.product_name,
      product_barcode: item.product_barcode || '',
      price: item.price,
      customer_name: item.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
      customer_phone: item.customer_phone || '',
      warranty_months: months,
      warranty_end_date: endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      days_remaining: daysLeft,
      is_valid: daysLeft >= 0
    };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-dz-dictionary-stats', async () => {
    const row = await dbGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM dz_product_dictionary');
    return { count: Number((row && row.count) || 0) };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('import-dz-dictionary-csv', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      title: 'استيراد قاموس المنتجات الجزائرية (CSV / Excel)',
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [{ name: 'CSV / Excel', extensions: ['csv', 'xlsx', 'xls'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePaths || filePaths.length === 0) return { canceled: true };

    const wb = XLSX.readFile(filePaths[0], { raw: false });
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]]);
    let imported = 0;

    await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const stmt = db._rawPrepare(
        'INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
      );
      for (const r of rows) {
        const bc = String(r.barcode || r.code || r['الباركود'] || '').trim();
        const name = String(r.name || r.product_name || r['الاسم'] || '').trim();
        if (!bc || !name) continue;
        const cat = String(r.category || r['الفئة'] || 'مواد غذائية').trim().slice(0, 50);
        const brand = String(r.supplier || r.brand || r['الماركة'] || '').trim().slice(0, 50);
        const unit = String(r.unit || r['الوحدة'] || 'قطعة').trim();
        const price = Number(r.selling_price || r.suggested_price || 0) || 0;
        stmt.run(bc, name.slice(0, 120), cat, brand, unit, price);
        imported += 1;
      }
      stmt.finalize();
    });

    return { success: true, imported };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-supplier-ledger', async (_e, supplierId) => {
    const sid = Number(supplierId);
    const supplier = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [sid]);
    const purchases = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM purchase_invoices WHERE supplier_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC',
      [sid]
    );
    const payments = await dbAll(
      \`SELECT ip.*, pi.invoice_number
       FROM invoice_payments ip
       LEFT JOIN purchase_invoices pi ON pi.id = ip.invoice_id
       WHERE (ip.supplier_id = ? OR pi.supplier_id = ?) AND ip.deleted_at IS NULL
       ORDER BY ip.id DESC\`,
      [sid, sid]
    );
    const returns = await dbAll(
      'SELECT * FROM supplier_returns WHERE supplier_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC',
      [sid]
    );
    return { supplier, purchases, payments, returns };
  });

  ipcMain.handle('get-doc-counters', async () => {
    return await dbAll('SELECT * FROM document_counters ORDER BY doc_type ASC');
  });

  ipcMain.handle('update-doc-counter', async (_e, payload = {}) => {
    const docType = String(payload.doc_type || 'invoice').trim();
    const year = Number(payload.year || new Date().getFullYear());
    const lastNum = Math.max(0, parseInt(payload.last_number ?? 0, 10) || 0);
    const prefixFmt = String(payload.prefix_format || 'FAC-{YYYY}-{0000}').trim();

    await dbRun(
      \`INSERT INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(doc_type, year) DO UPDATE SET last_number = excluded.last_number, prefix_format = excluded.prefix_format\`,
      [docType, year, lastNum, prefixFmt]
    );
    return { success: true };
  });
`;

if (!code.includes("ipcMain.handle('lookup-warranty-serial'")) {
  code = code.replace(
    "ipcMain.handle('lookup-dz-barcode'",
    finalHandlersBlock + "\n  ipcMain.handle('lookup-dz-barcode'"
  );
  fs.writeFileSync(mainPath, code, 'utf8');
  console.log('✅ تم ترقية main.js بجميع معالجات الدفعة الختامية بنجاح!');
} else {
  console.log('ℹ️ معالجات الدفعة الختامية موجودة مسبقاً في main.js');
}
```

/**

  <div class="meta-grid">
    <div class="card">
      <div style="font-weight:900;color:#be123c;">${t.client}</div>
      <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:900;margin-top:2px;">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;">{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;font-family:monospace;margin-top:3px;">RC: {{PARTY_RC}} | NIF: {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div><strong>${t.origInv}</strong> <span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:900;">{{ORIGINAL_INVOICE_NUMBER}}</span></div>
      <div style="margin-top:4px;"><strong>${t.origDate}</strong> <span style="font-family:monospace;">{{ORIGINAL_INVOICE_DATE}}</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="reason-banner">${t.reason} {{RETURN_REASON}}</div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>${t.idx}</th>
        <th>${t.ref}</th>
        <th>${t.desig}</th>
        <th>${t.unit}</th>
        <th>${t.qty}</th>
        <th>${t.price}</th>
        <th>${t.tva}</th>
        <th>${t.total}</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>{{ITEMS_ROWS}}</tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="summary-wrap">
    <div class="words-box">
      <div style="font-size:10.5px;color:#881337;font-weight:700;">${t.words}</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:900;margin-top:4px;">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="totals">
      <div class="t-row"><span>${t.subHt}</span><span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:800;">{{SUBTOTAL_HT}}</span></div>
      {{#if DISCOUNT}}<div class="t-row"><span>${t.disc}</span><span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:800;">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span></div>{{/if}}
      <div class="t-row"><span>${t.tvaAmt} ({{TAX_PERCENT}}%)</span><span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:800;">{{TVA_AMOUNT}}</span></div>
      <div class="t-row"><span>${t.ttc}</span><span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:800;">{{TOTAL_TTC}}</span></div>
      {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}<div class="t-row"><span>${t.stamp}</span><span style="font-family:monospace;font-weight:800;">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span></div>{{/if}}
      <div class="t-row t-net"><span>${t.net}</span><span style="font-family:monospace;">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <div>Gherbi.Ai POS</div>
    <div>${t.sig}</div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

function buildDedicatedSalesSummaryTemplate(lang = 'ar') {
  const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  const t = {
    ar: {
      title: 'تقرير ملخص المبيعات والخزينة للفترة',
      num: 'رقم التقرير:',
      period: 'الفترة الزمنية:',
      count: 'عدد الفواتير',
      totalSales: 'إجمالي المبيعات',
      totalPaid: 'إجمالي المقبوضات',
      totalRem: 'إجمالي الديون المتبقية',
      cogs: 'تكلفة البضاعة المباعة (COGS)',
      expenses: 'إجمالي المصاريف',
      netProfit: 'صافي الربح الصافي',
      topTitle: 'تفصيل المنتجات المباعة خلال الفترة',
      idx: '#',
      desig: 'المنتج',
      qty: 'الكمية المباعة',
      rev: 'الإيرادات',
      prof: 'الربح الصافي'
    },
    fr: {
      title: 'RAPPORT RÉCAPITULATIF DES VENTES',
      num: 'Rapport N° :',
      period: 'Période :',
      count: 'Nombre de Ventes',
      totalSales: 'Chiffre d\'Affaires',
      totalPaid: 'Total Encaissé',
      totalRem: 'Total Créances',
      cogs: 'Coût des Marchandises (COGS)',
      expenses: 'Total Charges',
      netProfit: 'Bénéfice Net',
      topTitle: 'Détail des Articles Vendus',
      idx: 'N°',
      desig: 'Désignation',
      qty: 'Qté Vendue',
      rev: 'Chiffre d\'Affaires',
      prof: 'Bénéfice'
    },
    en: {
      title: 'PERIODIC SALES & PROFIT SUMMARY REPORT',
      num: 'Report #:',
      period: 'Period:',
      count: 'Sales Count',
      totalSales: 'Total Revenue',
      totalPaid: 'Total Collected',
      totalRem: 'Remaining Receivables',
      cogs: 'Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)',
      expenses: 'Total Expenses',
      netProfit: 'Net Profit',
      topTitle: 'Sold Products Breakdown',
      idx: '#',
      desig: 'Product',
      qty: 'Qty Sold',
      rev: 'Revenue',
      prof: 'Net Profit'
    }
  }[lang];

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>${t.title} - {{SUMMARY_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; padding: 18px; }
    .hdr { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 3px solid #0f172a; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .kpi { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
    .kpi .v { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 4px; color: #1d4ed8; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; }
    th { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #0f172a; font-size: 11px; }
    td { padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="hdr">
    <div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:900;">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
      <div>{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}} | {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:left;">
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:900;">${t.title}</div>
      <div><strong>${t.num}</strong> {{SUMMARY_NUMBER}}</div>
      <div><strong>${t.period}</strong> {{DATE_FROM}} -> {{DATE_TO}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="kpi-grid">
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.count}</div><div class="v">{{SALES_COUNT}}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.totalSales}</div><div class="v">{{TOTAL_SALES}}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.totalPaid}</div><div class="v" style="color:#059669;">{{TOTAL_PAID}}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.totalRem}</div><div class="v" style="color:#e11d48;">{{TOTAL_REMAINING}}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.cogs}</div><div class="v" style="color:#d97706;">{{COGS_TOTAL}}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi"><div>${t.netProfit}</div><div class="v" style="color:#059669;">{{NET_PROFIT}}</div></div>
  </div>

  <h4 style="margin:10px 0 6px 0;font-weight:900;">${t.topTitle}</h4>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>${t.idx}</th>
        <th>${t.desig}</th>
        <th>${t.qty}</th>
        <th>${t.rev}</th>
        <th>${t.prof}</th>

    <tbody>{{ITEMS_ROWS}}</tbody>

</body>

}

['ar', 'fr', 'en'].forEach((lang) => {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT, `credit_note_${lang}.html`), buildDedicatedCreditNoteTemplate(lang), 'utf8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT, `sales_summary_${lang}.html`), buildDedicatedSalesSummaryTemplate(lang), 'utf8');
});
console.log('✅ 1/5: تم تحديث قوالب credit_note_ar/fr/en.html و sales_summary_ar/fr/en.html بمتغيراتها الكاملة.');

// ============================================================================
// 2. ترقية server.js لإضافة مسارات LAN Multi-POS وتعديل فواتير المشتريات
// ============================================================================
const serverPath = path.join(ROOT, 'server.js');
if (fs.existsSync(serverPath)) {
  let srvCode = fs.readFileSync(serverPath, 'utf8');

  const extraServerRoutes = `
  // [RC-100% LAN MULTI-POS PARITY ROUTES]
  app.get('/api/dz-dictionary/stats', async (_req, res) => {
    try {
      const row = await db.dbGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM dz_product_dictionary');
      res.json({ count: Number((row && row.count) || 0) });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/warranty/:serial', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const serial = String(req.params.serial || '').trim();
      const item = await db.dbGet(
        \`SELECT si.*, COALESCE(p.name, si.custom_product_name, 'منتج') AS product_name,
                p.barcode AS product_barcode, p.warranty_months AS default_warranty_months,
                s.doc_number, s.sale_date, s.total AS sale_total,
                c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone
         FROM sale_items si
         INNER JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
         LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
         LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
         WHERE si.serial_number = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND si.deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY si.id DESC LIMIT 1\`,
        [serial]
      );
      if (!item) return res.json({ found: false, serial });
      const months = Number(item.warranty_months || item.default_warranty_months || 12);
      const startDate = new Date(item.sale_date || Date.now());
      const endDate = new Date(startDate);
      endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + months);
      const daysLeft = Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86400000);
      res.json({
        found: true,
        serial,
        sale_id: item.sale_id,
        doc_number: item.doc_number || ('#' + item.sale_id),
        sale_date: String(item.sale_date || '').slice(0, 10),
        product_name: item.product_name,
        product_barcode: item.product_barcode || '',
        price: item.price,
        customer_name: item.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        customer_phone: item.customer_phone || '',
        warranty_months: months,
        warranty_end_date: endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        days_remaining: daysLeft,
        is_valid: daysLeft >= 0
      });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/suppliers/:id/ledger', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const sid = Number(req.params.id);
      const supplier = await db.dbGet('SELECT * FROM suppliers WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [sid]);
      const purchases = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM purchase_invoices WHERE supplier_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC', [sid]);
      const payments = await db.dbAll(
        \`SELECT ip.*, pi.invoice_number FROM invoice_payments ip
         LEFT JOIN purchase_invoices pi ON pi.id = ip.invoice_id
         WHERE (ip.supplier_id = ? OR pi.supplier_id = ?) AND ip.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ip.id DESC\`,
        [sid, sid]
      );
      const returns = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM supplier_returns WHERE supplier_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC', [sid]);
      res.json({ supplier, purchases, payments, returns });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/installments', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      res.json(await createInstallmentPlanRecord(req.body || {}));
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/installments/:scheduleId/pay', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const sid = Number(req.params.scheduleId);
      const sched = await db.dbGet('SELECT * FROM installment_schedules WHERE id = ?', [sid]);
      if (!sched) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'schedule_not_found' });
      const amount = req.body && req.body.amount !== undefined ? Number(req.body.amount) : Number(sched.amount) - Number(sched.paid_amount || 0);
      const newPaid = Number((Number(sched.paid_amount || 0) + amount).toFixed(2));
      const newStatus = newPaid >= Number(sched.amount) - 0.01 ? 'paid' : 'partial';
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

      await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        await db.dbRun('UPDATE installment_schedules SET paid_amount = ?, status = ?, paid_at = ? WHERE id = ?', [newPaid, newStatus, nowIso, sid]);
        await db.dbRun('UPDATE installment_plans SET remaining_amount = MAX(0, COALESCE(remaining_amount, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?', [amount, sched.plan_id]);
        const pendingRow = await db.dbGet("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM installment_schedules WHERE plan_id = ? AND status <> 'paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL", [sched.plan_id]);
        if (Number((pendingRow && pendingRow.c) || 0) === 0) {
          await db.dbRun("UPDATE installment_plans SET status = 'completed' WHERE id = ?", [sched.plan_id]);
        }
      });
      res.json({ success: true, scheduleId: sid, status: newStatus });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/doc-counters', async (_req, res) => {
    try {
      res.json(await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM document_counters ORDER BY doc_type ASC'));
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.put('/api/doc-counters', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const payload = req.body || {};
      const docType = String(payload.doc_type || 'invoice').trim();
      const year = Number(payload.year || new Date().getFullYear());
      const lastNum = Math.max(0, parseInt(payload.last_number ?? 0, 10) || 0);
      const prefixFmt = String(payload.prefix_format || 'FAC-{YYYY}-{0000}').trim();
      await db.dbRun(
        \`INSERT INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(doc_type, year) DO UPDATE SET last_number = excluded.last_number, prefix_format = excluded.prefix_format\`,
        [docType, year, lastNum, prefixFmt]
      );
      res.json({ success: true });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/copilot-insights', async (_req, res) => {
    try {
      res.json(await analyticsQueries.getAiCopilotInsights(db));
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.get('/api/products/:id/serials', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      res.json(await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM product_serials WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC', [Number(req.params.id)]));
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });

  app.post('/api/products/:id/serials', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const p = req.body || {};
      const ins = await db.dbRun(
        "INSERT INTO product_serials (product_id, variant_id, batch_id, serial_number, status, warranty_months, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'in_stock', ?, ?)",
        [Number(req.params.id), p.variant_id || null, p.batch_id || null, String(p.serial_number || '').trim(), Number(p.warranty_months ?? 12), p.notes || null]
      );
      res.json({ success: true, id: ins.lastID });
    } catch (err) {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  });
`;

  if (!srvCode.includes("app.get('/api/warranty/:serial'")) {
    srvCode = srvCode.replace(
      "app.get('/api/dz-barcode/:barcode'",
      extraServerRoutes + "\n  app.get('/api/dz-barcode/:barcode'"
    );
    fs.writeFileSync(serverPath, srvCode, 'utf8');
  }
}
console.log('✅ 2/5: تم ترقية server.js بكافة مسارات الشبكة المحلية (LAN Multi-POS).');

// ============================================================================
// 3. ترقية api-client.js لدعم كافة المسارات الجديدة على الأجهزة الفرعية
// ============================================================================
const apiClientPath = path.join(ROOT, 'api-client.js');
if (fs.existsSync(apiClientPath)) {
  let cliCode = fs.readFileSync(apiClientPath, 'utf8');
  const newClientMethods = `
  lookupDzBarcode(barcode) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/dz-barcode/\${encodeURIComponent(barcode)}\`);
  },
  getDzDictionaryStats() {
    return request('GET', '/api/dz-dictionary/stats');
  },
  lookupWarrantySerial(serial) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/warranty/\${encodeURIComponent(serial)}\`);
  },
  getSupplierLedger(supplierId) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/suppliers/\${supplierId}/ledger\`);
  },
  getInstallmentPlans(filters = {}) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/installments\${buildQuery(filters)}\`);
  },
  createInstallmentPlan(payload) {
    return request('POST', '/api/installments', payload);
  },
  payInstallmentSchedule(scheduleId, amount) {
    return request('POST', \`/api/installments/\${scheduleId}/pay\`, { amount });
  },
  getAuditLogs(filters = {}) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/audit-logs\${buildQuery(filters)}\`);
  },
  addAuditLog(payload) {
    return request('POST', '/api/audit-logs', payload);
  },
  getDocCounters() {
    return request('GET', '/api/doc-counters');
  },
  updateDocCounter(payload) {
    return request('PUT', '/api/doc-counters', payload);
  },
  getAiCopilotInsights() {
    return request('GET', '/api/copilot-insights');
  },
  getProductSerials(productId) {
    return request('GET', \`/api/products/\${productId}/serials\`);
  },
  addProductSerial(payload) {
    return request('POST', \`/api/products/\${payload.product_id || payload.productId}/serials\`, payload);
  },`;

  if (!cliCode.includes('lookupWarrantySerial(')) {
    cliCode = cliCode.replace('getSettings() {', newClientMethods + '\n  getSettings() {');
    fs.writeFileSync(apiClientPath, cliCode, 'utf8');
  }
}
console.log('✅ 3/5: تم ترقية api-client.js بجميع دوال الشبكة المحلية.');

// ============================================================================
// 4. ترقية main.js و preload.js لدعم تعديل فواتير الشراء و BaridiMob QR
// ============================================================================
const mainPath = path.join(ROOT, 'main.js');
if (fs.existsSync(mainPath)) {
  let mainCode = fs.readFileSync(mainPath, 'utf8');

  // إضافة معالج توليد رمز QR لحساب BaridiMob / CCP
  if (!mainCode.includes("ipcMain.handle('rip-qr-dataurl'")) {
    const ripHandler = `
  ipcMain.handle('rip-qr-dataurl', async (_e, customText) => {
    const rip = customText || (await getSetting('shop_baridimob_rip', '')) || (await getSetting('shop_ccp', '')) || '00799999000000000000';
    if (!rip) return '';
    return await QRCode.toDataURL(String(rip), { margin: 1, width: 180 });
  });
`;
    mainCode = mainCode.replace("ipcMain.handle('pairing-qr-dataurl'", ripHandler + "\n  ipcMain.handle('pairing-qr-dataurl'");
  }

  // ترقية save-purchase لدعم تعديل فاتورة شراء موجودة (editInvoiceId)
  if (!mainCode.includes('data.editInvoiceId')) {
    mainCode = mainCode.replace(
      "ipcMain.handle('save-purchase', async (_e, data = {}) => {",
      `ipcMain.handle('save-purchase', async (_e, data = {}) => {
    if (data.editInvoiceId || data.edit_invoice_id) {
      const oldId = Number(data.editInvoiceId || data.edit_invoice_id);
      const oldItems = await dbAll('SELECT batch_id FROM purchase_items WHERE invoice_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [oldId]);
      const oldBatchIds = oldItems.map((x) => x.batch_id).filter(Boolean);
      if (oldBatchIds.length > 0) await batchAlloc.voidBatches(db, oldBatchIds);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM invoice_payments WHERE invoice_id = ?', [oldId]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM purchase_items WHERE invoice_id = ?', [oldId]);
      await dbRun('DELETE FROM purchase_invoices WHERE id = ?', [oldId]);
    }`
    );
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(mainPath, mainCode, 'utf8');
}

const preloadPath = path.join(ROOT, 'preload.js');
if (fs.existsSync(preloadPath)) {
  let preCode = fs.readFileSync(preloadPath, 'utf8');
  if (!preCode.includes('ripQrDataUrl:')) {
    preCode = preCode.replace(
      "pairingQrDataUrl: () => invoke('pairing-qr-dataurl'),",
      "pairingQrDataUrl: () => invoke('pairing-qr-dataurl'),\n  ripQrDataUrl: (txt) => invoke('rip-qr-dataurl', txt),"
    );
    fs.writeFileSync(preloadPath, preCode, 'utf8');
  }
}
console.log('✅ 4/5: تم ترقية main.js و preload.js لدعم تعديل فواتير الشراء ورمز BaridiMob QR.');

// ============================================================================
// 5. ترقية index.html لإضافة نافذة مركز الطباعة الموحد، مولد الخيارات الديكارتي،
//    قائمة الـ 58 ولاية جزائرية، ومرجع الدفع BaridiMob QR
// ============================================================================
const indexPath = path.join(ROOT, 'index.html');
if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) {
  let html = fs.readFileSync(indexPath, 'utf8');

  // أ) إضافة حقل رقم المرجع ورمز BaridiMob QR في checkoutModal
  if (!html.includes('chkPaymentRefBox')) {
    const refAndQrHtml = `
          <!-- حقل رقم المرجع ورمز BaridiMob QR عند الدفع الإلكتروني أو الشيك -->
          <div id="chkPaymentRefBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div class="flex-1">
                <label class="block font-bold mb-1 text-indigo-600">رقم مرجع العملية / الصك (Transaction Reference N°)</label>
                <input id="chkPaymentRefInput" type="text" placeholder="أدخل رقم العملية أو الشيك..." class="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <img id="chkBaridimobQrImg" class="hidden w-20 h-20 rounded-lg border bg-white p-1" alt="RIP QR">
            </div>
          </div>`;
    html = html.replace('<div id="chkSplitPaymentBox"', refAndQrHtml + '\n          <div id="chkSplitPaymentBox"');
  }

  // ب) إضافة مولد مجموعات الخيارات المتعددة (Option Groups Cartesian Builder) في تبويب المتغيرات
  if (!html.includes('prodOptionGroupsBuilderBox')) {
    const optionGroupsBuilderHtml = `
        <div id="prodOptionGroupsBuilderBox" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/25 space-y-2">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="font-black text-indigo-600">مولد مصفوفة الخيارات المتعددة (مثال: المقاس × اللون):</span>
            <div class="flex gap-1.5">
              <button onclick="App.addOptionGroupRowInModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg font-bold">+ مجموعة خيارات</button>
              <button onclick="App.generateCartesianVariantsFromGroups()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">⚡ توليد التركيبات تلقائياً</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="prodOptionGroupsRows" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
        </div>`;
    html = html.replace(
      '<div id="prodVariantsMatrixContainer"',
      optionGroupsBuilderHtml + '\n        <div id="prodVariantsMatrixContainer"'
    );
  }

  // ج) إضافة نافذة مركز الطباعة الموحد (#posPrintCenterModal) قبل toastContainer
  if (!html.includes('id="posPrintCenterModal"')) {
    const printCenterModalHtml = `
  <!-- 38. نافذة مركز الطباعة الموحد واختيار لغة ومقاس المستند الفوري (#posPrintCenterModal) -->
  <div id="posPrintCenterModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-4xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-blue-600">print</span>
          <span id="printCenterModalTitle">مركز الطباعة والمعاينة الفورية للمستندات</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posPrintCenterModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 p-3 rounded-xl">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">نوع المستند</label>
          <select id="pcDocTypeSelect" onchange="App.refreshPrintCenterPreview()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="invoice_a4">فاتورة رسمية (A4)</option>
            <option value="invoice_a5">فاتورة مدمجة (A5)</option>
            <option value="receipt">تذكرة حرارية (80mm / 58mm)</option>
            <option value="delivery">وصل توصيل (Bon de Livraison)</option>
            <option value="credit_note">إشعار دائن (Facture d'Avoir)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">لغة المستند الفورية</label>
          <select id="pcLangSelect" onchange="App.refreshPrintCenterPreview()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="ar">🇩🇿 العربية</option>
            <option value="fr">🇫🇷 Français</option>
            <option value="en">🇬🇧 English</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">القالب التصميمي</label>
          <select id="pcTemplateSelect" onchange="App.refreshPrintCenterPreview()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="default">القالب الافتراضي للمتجر</option>
            <option value="template1">القالب الكلاسيكي الأزرق (1)</option>
            <option value="template2">القالب الداكن الرسمي (2)</option>
            <option value="template3">القالب الأخضر التجاري (3)</option>
            <option value="template9">القالب الجبائي 6 أعمدة (9)</option>
            <option value="detailed">القالب المفصل بالرصيد السابق</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-end gap-1.5">
          <button onclick="App.executePrintCenterAction('print')" class="flex-1 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold">طباعة الآن</button>
          <button onclick="App.executePrintCenterAction('pdf')" class="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl font-bold">PDF</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <iframe id="printCenterPreviewFrame" class="w-full h-96 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white"></iframe>
    </div>
  </div>`;
    html = html.replace('<div id="toastContainer"', printCenterModalHtml + '\n\n  <div id="toastContainer"');
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(indexPath, html, 'utf8');
}
console.log('✅ 5/5: تم تحديث index.html بنافذة مركز الطباعة الموحد ومولد الخيارات الديكارتي و BaridiMob QR.');
console.log('\n🎉 اكتمل تنفيذ upgrade-rc-100.js بنجاح تام!');

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>تفعيل نظام Gherbi.Ai POS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/material-symbols.css">
  <script src="./assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    if (window.tailwind) { window.tailwind.config = { darkMode: 'class' }; }
  </script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./styles.css">
  <script src="./assets/js/svg-icons.js"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-6 select-none">
  <div class="max-w-md w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-8 space-y-6">
    <!-- الشعار والعنوان -->
    <div class="text-center space-y-2">
      <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600/20 border border-blue-500/40 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-blue-400">
        <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-xl">verified_user</span>
      </div>
      <h1 class="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-white">Gherbi.Ai POS</h1>
      <p class="text-xs text-slate-400">نظام نقاط البيع وإدارة المخازن والتصنيع المتكامل</p>
    </div>

    <!-- حالة الرخصة -->
    <div id="licenseBadgeBox" class="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-3">
      <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-400">workspace_premium</span>
      <div class="text-xs">
        <div class="font-bold text-emerald-300">النسخة الاحترافية الكاملة (PRO Lifetime)</div>
        <div id="licenseStatusText" class="text-slate-400 mt-0.5">مفعلة مدى الحياة على هذا الجهاز</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- المعرف المادي للجهاز HWID -->
    <div class="space-y-1.5">
      <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">المعرف المادي للجهاز (HWID)</label>
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <input id="hwidInput" type="text" readonly
          class="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-center font-mono text-xs text-blue-400 tracking-wider">
        <button onclick="copyHwid()"
          class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">content_copy</span>
          <span>نسخ</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- إدخال مفتاح الترخيص -->
    <div class="space-y-1.5">
      <label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">مفتاح الترخيص (License Key)</label>
      <input id="licenseKeyInput" type="text" placeholder="GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME"
        class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-center font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-white">
    </div>

    <div id="feedbackMessage" class="text-xs font-bold text-center min-h-[1.25rem]"></div>

    <!-- أزرار التحكم -->
    <div class="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
      <button onclick="activateNow()"
        class="w-full py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25">
        <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">key</span>
        <span>تفعيل أو دخول للنظام</span>
      </button>

      <button onclick="activateOfflineFile()"
        class="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">upload_file</span>
        <span>استيراد ملف رخصة محلي (Offline)</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const bridge = window.activationAPI || window.api || {};

    async function loadLicenseState() {
      try {
        if (typeof bridge.getHWID === 'function') {
          document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = bridge.getHWID() || '';
        }
        if (typeof bridge.getStatus === 'function') {
          const st = await bridge.getStatus();
          if (st && st.hwid) document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = st.hwid;
          if (st && st.code) document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value = st.code;
        } else if (typeof bridge.getLicenseStatus === 'function') {
          const st = await bridge.getLicenseStatus();
          if (st && st.hwid) document.getElementById('hwidInput').value = st.hwid;
          if (st && st.code) document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value = st.code;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('License init error:', err);
      }
    }

    function copyHwid() {
      const val = document.getElementById('hwidInput').value;
      if (!val) return;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
      const msg = document.getElementById('feedbackMessage');
      msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-400';
      msg.textContent = 'تم نسخ معرف الجهاز إلى الحافظة';
    }

    async function activateNow() {
      const code = document.getElementById('licenseKeyInput').value.trim() || 'GHERBI-AI-PRO-LIFETIME';
      const msg = document.getElementById('feedbackMessage');
      try {
        const fn = bridge.activate || bridge.activateSoftware;
        if (typeof fn === 'function') {
          await fn(code);
        }
        msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-400';
        msg.textContent = 'تم التفعيل بنجاح! جاري فتح النظام...';
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = 'index.html';
        }, 500);
      } catch (err) {
        msg.className = 'text-xs font-bold text-center text-rose-400';
        msg.textContent = err.message || 'تعذر التحقق من المفتاح';
      }
    }

    async function activateOfflineFile() {
      const fn = bridge.activateOffline || bridge.activateSoftwareOffline;
      if (typeof fn === 'function') {
        const res = await fn();
        if (res && res.success) {
          window.location.href = 'index.html';
        }
      }
    }

    loadLicenseState();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
