## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-db-sync.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-db-sync.js
 * محرك المزامنة السحابية الثنائية الكامل لقاعدة البيانات (100% Bi-Directional LWW Cloud DB Sync)
 * يدعم: sale_replay، recomputeBatchSet، resolvePendingFkFixups، sync_row_errors، pull_row_errors، و Fresh Bootstrap
 */

'use strict';

const { signedRequest } = require('./device-auth');
const stockLedger = require('./stock-ledger');

const SYNC_TABLES_ORDER = [
  'shop_info',
  'users',
  'custom_templates',
  'suppliers',
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'inventory_batches',
  'product_serials',
  'stock_movements',
  'stock_debt',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items',
  'expenses',
  'capital_injections',
  'caisse_transactions',
  'installment_plans',
  'installment_schedules',
  'cheques_portfolio',
  'audit_logs'
];

const IMAGE_TABLES = ['products', 'product_variants', 'product_bundles'];

function createCloudDbSync({ db, getSetting, setSetting, getMainWindow }) {
  let pushTimer = null;
  let pullTimer = null;
  let isSyncing = false;
  let lastStatus = {
    enabled: false,
    syncing: false,
    lastPushAt: null,
    lastPullAt: null,
    lastError: null,
    dirtyCount: 0
  };

  function rawGet(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawGet ? db._rawGet.bind(db) : db.get.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  function rawAll(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawAll ? db._rawAll.bind(db) : db.all.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  }

  function rawRun(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawRun ? db._rawRun.bind(db) : db.run.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  }

  function emitStatus() {
    const win = typeof getMainWindow === 'function' ? getMainWindow() : null;
    if (win && !win.isDestroyed() && win.webContents) {
      win.webContents.send('cloud-sync:status', lastStatus);
    }
  }

  function emitDataChanged(changedTables = []) {
    const win = typeof getMainWindow === 'function' ? getMainWindow() : null;
    if (win && !win.isDestroyed() && win.webContents) {
      win.webContents.send('cloud-sync:data-changed', { tables: changedTables });
    }
  }

  async function countTotalDirty() {
    let total = 0;
    for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
      try {
        const r = await rawGet(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ${tbl} WHERE dirty = 1`);
        total += Number((r && r.n) || 0);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    lastStatus.dirtyCount = total;
    return total;
  }

  async function gatherTableBatch(tableName, limit = 150) {
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    return await rawAll(
      `
      SELECT t.*
      FROM ${tableName} t
      LEFT JOIN sync_row_errors qe ON qe.table_name = ? AND qe.uuid = t.uuid
      WHERE t.dirty = 1
        AND t.uuid IS NOT NULL AND t.uuid <> ''
        AND (qe.next_retry_ms IS NULL OR qe.next_retry_ms <= ?)
      ORDER BY t.id ASC
      LIMIT ?
      `,
      [tableName, nowMs, limit]
    );
  }

  async function ensureStockMovementForSaleItem(saleItemRow) {
    if (!saleItemRow || !saleItemRow.uuid) return null;
    if (Number(saleItemRow.sold_without_stock || 0) === 1) return null;

    const existing = await rawGet(
      "SELECT id FROM stock_movements WHERE ref_type = 'sale_item' AND ref_uuid = ? LIMIT 1",
      [saleItemRow.uuid]
    );
    if (existing) return null;

    if (!saleItemRow.batch_id) return null;
    const batchRow = await rawGet(
      'SELECT uuid, product_id, variant_id FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = ?',
      [saleItemRow.batch_id]
    );
    if (!batchRow || !batchRow.uuid) return null;

    const prodRow = batchRow.product_id
      ? await rawGet('SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = ?', [batchRow.product_id])
      : null;
    const varRow = batchRow.variant_id
      ? await rawGet('SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = ?', [batchRow.variant_id])
      : null;

    const delta = -Math.abs(Number(saleItemRow.quantity || 0));
    if (Math.abs(delta) < 0.000001) return null;

    const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
    await rawRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        ref_type, ref_uuid, origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      ) VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?, ?, ?, 'sale_replay',
        'sale_item', ?, ?, ?, ?, 0
      )
      `,
      [
        batchRow.uuid,
        prodRow ? prodRow.uuid : null,
        varRow ? varRow.uuid : null,
        delta,
        saleItemRow.uuid,
        saleItemRow.origin_device || 'cloud-replay',
        saleItemRow.updated_at || nowStr,
        nowStr
      ]
    );

    return batchRow.uuid;
  }

  async function recomputeBatchSet(batchUuids = []) {
    const unique = Array.from(new Set((batchUuids || []).filter(Boolean)));
    if (unique.length === 0) return;

    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      for (const bUuid of unique) {
        await rawRun(
          `
          UPDATE inventory_batches
          SET stock = COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(delta) FROM stock_movements
            WHERE batch_uuid = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
          ), 0)
          WHERE uuid = ?
          `,
          [bUuid, bUuid]
        );
      }
    });
  }

  async function resolvePendingFkFixups() {
    const fixups = await rawAll('SELECT * FROM pending_fk_fixups ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 500');
    for (const fx of fixups) {
      try {
        const parentRow = await rawGet(`SELECT id FROM ${fx.parent_table} WHERE uuid = ?`, [
          fx.parent_uuid
        ]);
        if (parentRow && parentRow.id) {
          await rawRun(`UPDATE ${fx.tbl} SET ${fx.fk_col} = ? WHERE uuid = ?`, [
            parentRow.id,
            fx.row_uuid
          ]);
          await rawRun('DELETE FROM pending_fk_fixups WHERE id = ?', [fx.id]);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  async function applyPulledRow(tableName, rowData) {
    if (!rowData || !rowData.uuid) return false;
    const colInfo = await rawAll(`PRAGMA table_info(${tableName})`);
    const validCols = new Set(colInfo.map((c) => c.name));

    const cols = [];
    const vals = [];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rowData)) {
      if (k === 'id') continue;
      if (validCols.has(k)) {
        cols.push(k);
        vals.push(v);
      }
    }

    if (validCols.has('dirty')) {
      const idx = cols.indexOf('dirty');
      if (idx === -1) {
        cols.push('dirty');
        vals.push(0);
      } else {
        vals[idx] = 0;
      }
    }

    const placeholders = cols.map(() => '?').join(', ');
    const updates = cols
      .filter((c) => c !== 'uuid')
      .map((c) => `${c} = excluded.${c}`)
      .join(', ');

    await rawRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO ${tableName} (${cols.join(', ')})
      VALUES (${placeholders})
      ON CONFLICT(uuid) DO UPDATE SET
        ${updates}
      WHERE ${tableName}.updated_at IS NULL
         OR excluded.updated_at IS NULL
         OR datetime(excluded.updated_at) >= datetime(${tableName}.updated_at)
      `,
      vals
    );
    return true;
  }

  async function pushDirtyRows() {
    const payloadTables = {};
    let totalGathered = 0;

    for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
      const rows = await gatherTableBatch(tbl, 150);
      if (rows.length > 0) {
        payloadTables[tbl] = rows;
        totalGathered += rows.length;
      }
      if (totalGathered >= 400) break;
    }

    if (totalGathered === 0) return { pushed: 0 };

    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/api/cloud/sync/push',
      data: { tables: payloadTables }
    });

    const accepted = (res && res.accepted) || {};
    const rejected = (res && res.rejected) || {};

    for (const [tbl, uuids] of Object.entries(accepted)) {
      if (Array.isArray(uuids) && uuids.length > 0) {
        const ph = uuids.map(() => '?').join(',');
        await rawRun(`UPDATE ${tbl} SET dirty = 0 WHERE uuid IN (${ph})`, uuids);
        await rawRun(`DELETE FROM sync_row_errors WHERE table_name = ? AND uuid IN (${ph})`, [
          tbl,
          ...uuids
        ]);
      }
    }

    for (const [tbl, errItems] of Object.entries(rejected)) {
      for (const item of Array.isArray(errItems) ? errItems : []) {
        const nextRetry = Date.now() + 60000;
        await rawRun(
          `
          INSERT INTO sync_row_errors (table_name, uuid, attempts, last_error, next_retry_ms)
          VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
          ON CONFLICT(table_name, uuid) DO UPDATE SET
            attempts = sync_row_errors.attempts + 1,
            last_error = excluded.last_error,
            next_retry_ms = excluded.next_retry_ms
          `,
          [tbl, item.uuid || 'unknown', String(item.error || 'rejected'), nextRetry]
        );
      }
    }

    lastStatus.lastPushAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return { pushed: totalGathered };
  }

  async function pullRemoteChanges() {
    const cursorRows = await rawAll('SELECT table_name, last_rev FROM sync_cursors');
    const cursors = {};
    for (const r of cursorRows) cursors[r.table_name] = Number(r.last_rev || 0);

    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(cursors));
    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/api/cloud/sync/pull?cursors=${encoded}&include_self=1`
    });
    if (!res) return { pulled: 0 };

    const localEpoch = await getSetting('cloud_sync_epoch', '');
    if (res.epoch && localEpoch && String(res.epoch) !== String(localEpoch)) {
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM pending_fk_fixups');
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM pull_row_errors');
    }
    if (res.epoch && typeof setSetting === 'function') {
      await setSetting('cloud_sync_epoch', String(res.epoch));
    }

    const serverTables = (res && res.tables) || {};
    const touchedBatchUuids = [];
    const changedTables = [];
    let totalPulled = 0;

    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
        const tData = serverTables[tbl];
        if (!tData || !Array.isArray(tData.rows) || tData.rows.length === 0) continue;

        changedTables.push(tbl);
        let maxRev = cursors[tbl] || 0;

        for (const row of tData.rows) {
          try {
            await applyPulledRow(tbl, row);
            totalPulled += 1;

            if (tbl === 'stock_movements' && row.batch_uuid) {
              touchedBatchUuids.push(row.batch_uuid);
            } else if (tbl === 'sale_items') {
              const replayBatchUuid = await ensureStockMovementForSaleItem(row);
              if (replayBatchUuid) touchedBatchUuids.push(replayBatchUuid);
            }

            if (row.server_rev && Number(row.server_rev) > maxRev) {
              maxRev = Number(row.server_rev);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            await rawRun(
              `
              INSERT INTO pull_row_errors (table_name, uuid, payload, attempts, last_error, next_retry_ms)
              VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
              ON CONFLICT(table_name, uuid) DO UPDATE SET
                payload = excluded.payload,
                attempts = pull_row_errors.attempts + 1,
                last_error = excluded.last_error,
                next_retry_ms = excluded.next_retry_ms
              `,
              [tbl, row.uuid || 'unknown', JSON.stringify(row), err.message, Date.now() + 30000]
            );
          }
        }

        await rawRun(
          `INSERT INTO sync_cursors (table_name, last_rev, last_pulled_at)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?)
           ON CONFLICT(table_name) DO UPDATE SET last_rev = excluded.last_rev, last_pulled_at = excluded.last_pulled_at`,
          [tbl, maxRev, new Date().toISOString()]
        );
      }
    });

    await resolvePendingFkFixups();

    if (touchedBatchUuids.length > 0) {
      await recomputeBatchSet(touchedBatchUuids);
    }

    if (changedTables.length > 0) {
      emitDataChanged(changedTables);
    }
    lastStatus.lastPullAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return { pulled: totalPulled, changedTables };
  }

  async function triggerNow() {
    const token = await getSetting('cloud_token', '');
    if (!token) {
      lastStatus.enabled = false;
      emitStatus();
      return { ok: false, reason: 'no_cloud_token' };
    }
    if (isSyncing) return { ok: true, busy: true };

    isSyncing = true;
    lastStatus.enabled = true;
    lastStatus.syncing = true;
    emitStatus();

    try {
      const pushRes = await pushDirtyRows();
      const pullRes = await pullRemoteChanges();
      await countTotalDirty();
      lastStatus.lastError = null;
      return { ok: true, ...pushRes, ...pullRes };
    } catch (err) {
      lastStatus.lastError = err.message;
      return { ok: false, error: err.message };
    } finally {
      isSyncing = false;
      lastStatus.syncing = false;
      emitStatus();
    }
  }

  async function runFreshBootstrap() {
    await rawRun('DELETE FROM fresh_bootstrap_images');
    for (const tbl of IMAGE_TABLES) {
      await rawRun(
        `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fresh_bootstrap_images (tbl, uuid, image)
         SELECT ?, uuid, image FROM ${tbl}
         WHERE image IS NOT NULL AND image != '' AND uuid IS NOT NULL AND uuid != ''`,
        [tbl]
      );
    }

    const tablesToWipe = [...SYNC_TABLES_ORDER].reverse().filter((t) => t !== 'users');
    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      for (const tbl of tablesToWipe) {
        await rawRun(`DELETE FROM ${tbl}`);
      }
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM sync_row_errors');
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM pull_row_errors');
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM pending_fk_fixups');
      await rawRun("DELETE FROM settings WHERE key = 'cloud_sync_epoch'");
    });

    let pages = 0;
    while (pages < 50) {
      const pullRes = await pullRemoteChanges();
      pages += 1;
      if (!pullRes || pullRes.pulled === 0) break;
    }

    for (const tbl of IMAGE_TABLES) {
      await rawRun(
        `UPDATE fresh_bootstrap_images
         SET
           post_updated_at = (SELECT r.updated_at FROM ${tbl} r WHERE r.uuid = fresh_bootstrap_images.uuid),
           post_dirty = (SELECT r.dirty FROM ${tbl} r WHERE r.uuid = fresh_bootstrap_images.uuid),
           post_origin = (SELECT r.origin_device FROM ${tbl} r WHERE r.uuid = fresh_bootstrap_images.uuid)
         WHERE tbl = ?`,
        [tbl]
      );

      await rawRun(
        `UPDATE ${tbl}
         SET image = (SELECT b.image FROM fresh_bootstrap_images b WHERE b.tbl = ? AND b.uuid = ${tbl}.uuid)
         WHERE (image IS NULL OR image = '') AND uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM fresh_bootstrap_images WHERE tbl = ?)`,
        [tbl, tbl]
      );

      await rawRun(
        `UPDATE ${tbl}
         SET
           updated_at = COALESCE((SELECT b.post_updated_at FROM fresh_bootstrap_images b WHERE b.tbl = ? AND b.uuid = ${tbl}.uuid), updated_at),
           dirty = COALESCE((SELECT b.post_dirty FROM fresh_bootstrap_images b WHERE b.tbl = ? AND b.uuid = ${tbl}.uuid), 0)
         WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM fresh_bootstrap_images WHERE tbl = ?)`,
        [tbl, tbl, tbl]
      );
    }

    await rawRun('DELETE FROM fresh_bootstrap_images');
    await stockLedger.recomputeAllBatches(db);
    return { ok: true, pagesPulled: pages };
  }

  function start() {
    stop();
    lastStatus.enabled = true;
    pushTimer = setInterval(() => triggerNow(), 8000);
    pullTimer = setInterval(() => triggerNow(), 15000);
    setTimeout(() => triggerNow(), 1500);
  }

  function stop() {
    if (pushTimer) clearInterval(pushTimer);
    if (pullTimer) clearInterval(pullTimer);
    pushTimer = null;
    pullTimer = null;
    lastStatus.enabled = false;
    emitStatus();
  }

  return {
    start,
    stop,
    triggerNow,
    getStatus: async () => {
      await countTotalDirty();
      return lastStatus;
    },
    setMode: async (mode) => {
      if (mode === 'cloud' || mode === 'both') start();
      else stop();
      return lastStatus;
    },
    pushSnapshot: async () => {
      for (const tbl of SYNC_TABLES_ORDER) {
        await rawRun(`UPDATE ${tbl} SET dirty = 1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`);
      }
      return await triggerNow();
    },
    wipeCloudData: async () => {
      const res = await signedRequest(db, { method: 'POST', path: '/api/cloud/sync/wipe', data: {} });
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      return res || { ok: true };
    },
    runFreshBootstrap,
    backfillFromOwner: async () => {
      await stockLedger.repairMissingMovements(db);
      return await triggerNow();
    },
    resetAndResync: async () => {
      await rawRun('DELETE FROM sync_cursors');
      return await triggerNow();
    }
  };
}

module.exports = {
  SYNC_TABLES_ORDER,
  createCloudDbSync
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-diagnostics.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-diagnostics.js
 * أداة الفحص الهندسي العميق لسلامة الجداول، المشغلات (Triggers Probe)، ودفتر حركات المخزون
 */

'use strict';

const { signedRequest } = require('./device-auth');

function rawGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawGet ? db._rawGet.bind(db) : db.get.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
  });
}

function rawAll(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawAll ? db._rawAll.bind(db) : db.all.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

function rawRun(db, sql, params = []) {
  const fn = db._rawRun ? db._rawRun.bind(db) : db.run.bind(db);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    fn(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
    });
  });
}

async function deepDiagnose(db) {
  const triggers = await rawAll(
    db,
    "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'trigger' ORDER BY name ASC"
  );

  const counts = await rawGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_products,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '') AS products_missing_uuid,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_batches,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE COALESCE(stock, 0) <> 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS batches_with_stock,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '') AS batches_missing_uuid,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_batches WHERE dirty = 1) AS dirty_batches,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_movements,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_movements WHERE dirty = 1) AS dirty_movements,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_sales
    `
  );

  let nullInsertOk = false;
  let nullInsertError = null;
  let triggerFired = false;

  try {
    await rawRun(db, 'SAVEPOINT probe_insert');
    await rawRun(
      db,
      `
      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      ) VALUES (
        'probe_' || lower(hex(randomblob(8))), NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 'probe',
        'diagnostic', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'), 0
      )
      `
    );
    nullInsertOk = true;
  } catch (err) {
    nullInsertError = err.message;
  } finally {
    try {
      await rawRun(db, 'ROLLBACK TO probe_insert');
      await rawRun(db, 'RELEASE probe_insert');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  try {
    const sampleBatch = await rawGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id, uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE uuid IS NOT NULL AND uuid <> '' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
    );
    if (sampleBatch && sampleBatch.id) {
      await rawRun(db, 'SAVEPOINT probe_update');
      const beforeRow = await rawGet(
        db,
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_movements WHERE batch_uuid = ?',
        [sampleBatch.uuid]
      );
      await rawRun(
        db,
        'UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = COALESCE(stock, 0) + 1 WHERE id = ?',
        [sampleBatch.id]
      );
      const afterRow = await rawGet(
        db,
        'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_movements WHERE batch_uuid = ?',
        [sampleBatch.uuid]
      );
      triggerFired = Number((afterRow && afterRow.n) || 0) > Number((beforeRow && beforeRow.n) || 0);
      await rawRun(db, 'ROLLBACK TO probe_update');
      await rawRun(db, 'RELEASE probe_update');
    }
  } catch (_) {
    try {
      await rawRun(db, 'ROLLBACK TO probe_update');
      await rawRun(db, 'RELEASE probe_update');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const recentMovements = await rawAll(
    db,
    `SELECT id, uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, delta, reason, origin_device, dirty, server_rev, occurred_at
     FROM stock_movements
     ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25`
  );

  const syncErrors = await rawAll(db, 'SELECT * FROM sync_row_errors LIMIT 50');
  const pullErrors = await rawAll(db, 'SELECT * FROM pull_row_errors LIMIT 50');

  return {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    counts,
    probes: {
      nullInsertOk,
      nullInsertError,
      triggerFired
    },
    triggersCount: triggers.length,
    triggers: triggers.map((t) => ({ name: t.name, table: t.tbl_name })),
    recentMovements,
    syncErrors,
    pullErrors
  };
}

async function sendDiagnostics(db, extraPayload = {}) {
  const report = await deepDiagnose(db);
  try {
    const res = await signedRequest(db, {
      method: 'POST',
      path: '/api/cloud/diagnostics',
      data: { ...extraPayload, report }
    });
    return { ok: true, serverResponse: res, report };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err.message, report };
  }
}

module.exports = {
  deepDiagnose,
  sendDiagnostics
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\cloud-sync.js`

```javascript
/**
 * cloud-sync.js
 * محرك مزامنة طابور الأحداث الصادرة (sync_outbox) ومزامنة المستخدمين مع الخادم السحابي
 */

'use strict';

const axios = require('axios');

async function postSyncEvent(cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId, eventType, payload) {
  const cleanUrl = String(cloudUrl || 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const res = await axios.post(
    `${cleanUrl}/api/pos/sync/event`,
    {
      instance_id: instanceId,
      event_type: eventType,
      payload
    },
    {
      timeout: 15000,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${cloudToken}`
      }
    }
  );
  return res.data;
}

async function syncUsersToCloud(db, cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId) {
  const users = await db.dbAll(
    "SELECT username, password, name, role, status FROM users WHERE status = 'Active' AND deleted_at IS NULL"
  );
  if (users.length === 0) return;
  await postSyncEvent(cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId, 'users_sync', { users });
}

async function runCloudSync(db, options = {}) {
  const maxBatch = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBatch || 50));
  const cloudUrl = await db.getSetting('cloud_url', 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai');
  const cloudToken = await db.getSetting('cloud_token', '');
  const instanceId = await db.getSetting('instance_id', '');

  if (!cloudToken) {
    return { synced: 0, skipped: true, reason: 'missing_cloud_token' };
  }

  const pending = await db.dbAll(
    'SELECT id, event_type, payload_json FROM sync_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?',
    [maxBatch]
  );

  let synced = 0;
  for (const row of pending) {
    try {
      let payload = {};
      try {
        payload = JSON.parse(row.payload_json || '{}');
      } catch (_) {}

      await postSyncEvent(cloudUrl, cloudToken, instanceId, row.event_type, payload);
      await db.dbRun('UPDATE sync_outbox SET sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?', [row.id]);
      synced += 1;
    } catch (err) {
      return { synced, error: 'send_failed', message: err.message };
    }
  }

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.dbRun("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('last_cloud_sync_at', ?)", [
    nowIso
  ]);

  return { synced, lastSyncAt: nowIso };
}

module.exports = {
  postSyncEvent,
  syncUsersToCloud,
  runCloudSync
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\data-revision.js`

```javascript
/**
 * data-revision.js
 * متتبع مراجعات البيانات اللحظي لتحديث واجهة الكاشير وعملاء الشبكة المحلية فور حدوث أي تغيير
 */

'use strict';

const EventEmitter = require('events');

const IGNORED_TABLES = new Set([
  'sync_cursors',
  'sync_outbox',
  'sync_row_errors',
  'pull_row_errors',
  'pending_fk_fixups',
  'device_registry',
  'fresh_bootstrap_images',
  'document_print_log',
  'sqlite_sequence'
]);

const IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS = new Set([
  'last_cloud_sync_at',
  '_skip_stock_ledger',
  'cloud_sync_epoch',
  'cloud_snapshot_done'
]);

const PRODUCT_TABLES = new Set([
  'products',
  'product_barcodes',
  'product_prices',
  'product_option_groups',
  'product_option_values',
  'product_variants',
  'variant_option_values',
  'product_bundles',
  'bundle_items',
  'product_promotions',
  'bom_recipes',
  'bom_components'
]);

const STOCK_TABLES = new Set([
  'inventory_batches',
  'stock_movements',
  'stock_debt',
  'product_serials',
  'inventory_reservations',
  'production_orders',
  'production_order_items',
  'stocktakes',
  'stocktake_items'
]);

const SALES_TABLES = new Set([
  'sales',
  'sale_items',
  'sale_payments',
  'proforma_invoices',
  'proforma_items',
  'customer_orders',
  'customer_order_items',
  'caisse_sessions',
  'caisse_transactions'
]);

const PARTY_TABLES = new Set([
  'customers',
  'loyalty_transactions',
  'suppliers',
  'purchase_invoices',
  'purchase_items',
  'invoice_payments',
  'supplier_returns',
  'supplier_return_items'
]);

class DataRevisionTracker extends EventEmitter {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.revision = 1;
    this.productsRev = 1;
    this.stockRev = 1;
    this.salesRev = 1;
    this.partiesRev = 1;
    this.settingsRev = 1;
    this.lastTable = 'init';
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions = Object.create(null);
  }

  extractTargetTable(sql) {
    if (typeof sql !== 'string') return null;
    const s = sql.trim();

    let m = /^(?:INSERT(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+INTO|REPLACE\s+INTO)\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^UPDATE(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    m = /^DELETE\s+FROM\s+["`[]?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)["`\]]?/i.exec(s);
    if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();

    return null;
  }

  isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params = []) {
    if (!table || IGNORED_TABLES.has(table)) return true;

    if (table === 'settings') {
      const str = String(sql || '');
      for (const k of IGNORED_SETTING_KEYS) {
        if (str.includes(`'${k}'`) || (Array.isArray(params) && params[0] === k)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    if (/^UPDATE\b/i.test(String(sql || '').trim())) {
      const setMatch = /\bSET\s+([\s\S]+?)(?:\bWHERE\b|$)/i.exec(sql);
      if (setMatch) {
        const cols = setMatch[1]
          .split(',')
          .map((c) => c.split('=')[0].trim().toLowerCase())
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (cols.length > 0 && cols.every((c) => c === 'dirty' || c === 'server_rev')) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  bump(table = 'general') {
    const tbl = String(table || 'general').toLowerCase();
    if (IGNORED_TABLES.has(tbl)) return this.getSnapshot();

    this.revision += 1;
    this.lastTable = tbl;
    this.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.tableRevisions[tbl] = (this.tableRevisions[tbl] || 0) + 1;

    if (PRODUCT_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.productsRev += 1;
    if (STOCK_TABLES.has(tbl)) {
      this.stockRev += 1;
      this.productsRev += 1;
    }
    if (SALES_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.salesRev += 1;
    if (PARTY_TABLES.has(tbl)) this.partiesRev += 1;
    if (tbl === 'settings' || tbl === 'shop_info' || tbl === 'custom_templates') {
      this.settingsRev += 1;
    }

    const snapshot = this.getSnapshot();
    this.emit('changed', snapshot);
    return snapshot;
  }

  getSnapshot() {
    return {
      revision: this.revision,
      products: this.productsRev,
      stock: this.stockRev,
      sales: this.salesRev,
      parties: this.partiesRev,
      settings: this.settingsRev,
      lastTable: this.lastTable,
      updatedAt: this.lastUpdatedAt,
      tables: { ...this.tableRevisions }
    };
  }
}

const defaultTracker = new DataRevisionTracker();

function installDataRevisionHook(db, tracker = defaultTracker) {
  if (!db || db._dataRevisionInstalled) return tracker;

  const prevRun = db.run.bind(db);

  db.run = function hookedRevisionRun(sql, ...args) {
    const table = tracker.extractTargetTable(sql);
    const params = Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : [];
    const shouldBump = table && !tracker.isInternalBookkeeping(sql, table, params);

    if (!shouldBump) {
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    const lastIdx = args.length - 1;
    if (lastIdx >= 0 && typeof args[lastIdx] === 'function') {
      const origCb = args[lastIdx];
      args[lastIdx] = function wrappedCallback(err, ...cbArgs) {
        if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
        return origCb.call(this, err, ...cbArgs);
      };
      return prevRun(sql, ...args);
    }

    return prevRun(sql, ...args, function autoCallback(err) {
      if (!err) tracker.bump(table);
    });
  };

  db._dataRevisionTracker = tracker;
  db._dataRevisionInstalled = true;
  return tracker;
}

module.exports = {
  DataRevisionTracker,
  tracker: defaultTracker,
  getDataRevision: () => defaultTracker.getSnapshot(),
  bumpRevision: (tbl) => defaultTracker.bump(tbl),
  installDataRevisionHook
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\database.js`

```javascript
/**
 * database.js
 * المخطط الشامل لقاعدة بيانات Gherbi.Ai POS (46 جدولاً، فهارس الأداء، مشغلات المزامنة والمخزون،
 * القاموس الجزائري لباركود 613، نظام البيع بالتقسيط، وسجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير)
 */

'use strict';

const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { attachWriteQueue } = require('./db-write-queue');
const { installSoftDeleteShim } = require('./soft-delete');
const { installDataRevisionHook, tracker: dataRevisionTracker } = require('./data-revision');

function resolveDatabaseFilePath() {
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      const dir = app.getPath('userData');
      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      return path.join(dir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const fallbackDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  if (!fs.existsSync(fallbackDir)) fs.mkdirSync(fallbackDir, { recursive: true });
  return path.join(fallbackDir, 'gherbi_ai_pos.db');
}

installSoftDeleteShim(db);

function safeAddColumn(table, columnDef) {
  db._rawRun(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${columnDef}`, () => {});
}

function createSyncTriggersForTable(table) {
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert`);
  db._rawRun(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update`);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.uuid IS NULL OR NEW.uuid = '' OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at = ''
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
        updated_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.updated_at, ''), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
        origin_device = COALESCE(NULLIF(${table}.origin_device, ''), (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id')),
        dirty = COALESCE(${table}.dirty, 1)
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_${table}_sync_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON ${table}
    WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND NEW.server_rev IS OLD.server_rev
    BEGIN
      UPDATE ${table}
      SET
        updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        origin_device = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='instance_id'), ${table}.origin_device),
        dirty = 1
      WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
    END;
  `);
}

function createStockLedgerTriggers() {
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert');
  db._rawRun('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update');

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_insert
    AFTER INSERT ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) <> 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id;

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        ib.uuid,
        p.uuid,
        pv.uuid,
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      FROM inventory_batches ib
      LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ib.product_id
      LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ib.variant_id
      WHERE ib.id = NEW.id AND ib.uuid IS NOT NULL AND ib.uuid <> '';
    END;
  `);

  db._rawRun(`
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_inventory_batches_ledger_update
    AFTER UPDATE OF stock ON inventory_batches
    WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = '_skip_stock_ledger'), '0') <> '1'
      AND ABS(COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0)) > 0.000001
    BEGIN
      UPDATE inventory_batches
      SET uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(uuid, ''), lower(hex(randomblob(16))))
      WHERE id = NEW.id AND (uuid IS NULL OR uuid = '');

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'init',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      WHERE COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0) <> 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements sm
          WHERE sm.batch_uuid = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id))
        );

      INSERT INTO stock_movements (
        uuid, batch_uuid, product_uuid, variant_uuid, delta, reason,
        origin_device, occurred_at, updated_at, dirty
      )
      VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.uuid, ''), (SELECT uuid FROM inventory_batches WHERE id = NEW.id)),
        (SELECT uuid FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id),
        (SELECT uuid FROM product_variants WHERE id = NEW.variant_id),
        COALESCE(NEW.stock, 0) - COALESCE(OLD.stock, 0),
        'auto',
        COALESCE((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'instance_id'), 'local'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
        1
      );
    END;
  `);
}

function tombstoneOrphans() {
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const childTables = [
    'inventory_batches',
    'product_barcodes',
    'product_prices',
    'product_promotions',
    'product_option_groups',
    'product_variants',
    'bom_recipes'
  ];

  for (const tbl of childTables) {
    db._rawRun(
      `UPDATE ${tbl}
       SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ?, dirty = 1
       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL)`,
      [nowStr, nowStr]
    );
  }
}

function initializeDatabase() {
  db.serialize(() => {
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY');
    db._rawRun('PRAGMA cache_size = -32000');

    // 1. الإعدادات، معلومات المتجر، والمستخدمين
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT DEFAULT ''
      )
    `);

    const setStmt = db._rawPrepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)');
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS)) {
      setStmt.run(k, String(v));
    }
    setStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_info (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        address TEXT,
        phone TEXT,
        fax TEXT,
        email TEXT,
        rc TEXT,
        nif TEXT,
        ai TEXT,
        nis TEXT,
        logo TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT DEFAULT 'Cashier',
        permissions_json TEXT,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'Active',
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);

    // 2. المنتجات، الباركودات، مستويات الأسعار، المتغيرات، والأرقام التسلسلية
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT,
        family TEXT,
        supplier TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        min_stock INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
        image TEXT,
        unit TEXT DEFAULT 'قطعة',
        color TEXT,
        weight_volume TEXT,
        wholesale_unit TEXT,
        wholesale_qty INTEGER,
        plu_code TEXT,
        has_variants INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        is_featured INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        material_role TEXT,
        track_serial INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        hide_from_pos INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1
      )
    `);
    safeAddColumn('products', 'warranty_months INTEGER DEFAULT 0');

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_barcodes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        price_label TEXT,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_prices (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        label TEXT NOT NULL,
        price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_option_groups (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_option_values (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        option_group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        value TEXT NOT NULL,
        position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (option_group_id) REFERENCES product_option_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_variants (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
        sku TEXT,
        image TEXT,
        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        uuid TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,
        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

    db._rawRun(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dz_product_dictionary (

        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT DEFAULT 'عام',

        unit TEXT DEFAULT 'قطعة',

      )
    `);

    const dzStmt = db._rawPrepare(

    );
    for (const item of DEFAULT_DZ_DICTIONARY) {
      dzStmt.run(item.barcode, item.name, item.category, item.brand, item.unit, item.suggested_price);
    }
    dzStmt.finalize();

    // 9. القوالب المخصصة، عدادات المستندات، سجلات الطباعة، والمزامنة
    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS custom_templates (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        uuid TEXT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        doc_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invoice',
        paper TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a4',

        layout_json TEXT NOT NULL,

        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,

        updated_at TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        origin_device TEXT,
        server_rev INTEGER,

      )
    `);

    db._rawRun(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_counters (

        updated_at TEXT,

        dirty INTEGER DEFAULT 1,

      )
    `);

    const curYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    const ctrStmt = db._rawPrepare(
      'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?)'
    );
    for (const c of DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_COUNTERS) {
      ctrStmt.run(c.doc_type, curYear, c.prefix_format);
    }
    ctrStmt.finalize();

    db._rawRun(`

    `);

    db._rawRun(`

    db._rawRun(`

        image TEXT,

        post_dirty INTEGER,
        post_origin TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (tbl, uuid)
      )
    `);

    // 10. إنشاء الفهارس الشاملة
    const indexes = [
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_name ON products(name)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_category ON products(category)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_family ON products(family)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_supplier ON products(supplier)',

      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_product_barcodes_product ON product_barcodes(product_id)',

      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_opt_values_group ON product_option_values(option_group_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_product_variants_product ON product_variants(product_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_variant_opt_values_variant ON variant_option_values(variant_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batches_product ON inventory_batches(product_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batches_variant ON inventory_batches(variant_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batches_expiry ON inventory_batches(expiry_date)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batches_stock ON inventory_batches(product_id, stock)',
      'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_uuid ON stock_movements(uuid)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_batch ON stock_movements(batch_uuid)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_product ON stock_movements(product_uuid)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_movements_dirty ON stock_movements(dirty) WHERE dirty = 1',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stock_debt_product ON stock_debt(product_id, resolved)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_date ON sales(sale_date)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sales_customer ON sales(customer_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sale_items_sale ON sale_items(sale_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sale_items_product ON sale_items(product_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sale_payments_date ON sale_payments(date)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_caisse_sessions_status ON caisse_sessions(status)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_caisse_transactions_session ON caisse_transactions(session_id)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_installment_plans_cust ON installment_plans(customer_id, status)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_installment_sched_due ON installment_schedules(due_date, status)',
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_logs_created ON audit_logs(created_at)'
    ];

    for (const sql of indexes) {
      db._rawRun(sql);
    }

    for (const tbl of SYNCED_TABLES) {
      db._rawRun(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_${tbl}_uuid ON ${tbl}(uuid)`);
      db._rawRun(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_${tbl}_dirty ON ${tbl}(dirty) WHERE dirty = 1`);
      db._rawRun(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_${tbl}_updated ON ${tbl}(updated_at)`);
      createSyncTriggersForTable(tbl);
    }

    createStockLedgerTriggers();
    tombstoneOrphans();
  });
}

initializeDatabase();

db.dbPath = dbPath;
db.SYNCED_TABLES = SYNCED_TABLES;
db.DEFAULT_SETTINGS = DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
db.DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_COUNTERS = DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_COUNTERS;
db.DEFAULT_DZ_DICTIONARY = DEFAULT_DZ_DICTIONARY;
db.tombstoneOrphans = tombstoneOrphans;
db.safeAddColumn = safeAddColumn;
db.dataRevisionTracker = dataRevisionTracker;


/**
 * شحن تلقائي كامل لملف Lumina_DZ_Products.csv (31,533 منتجاً) في جدول dz_product_dictionary
 */
function autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary() {
  db._rawGet('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dz_product_dictionary', [], (err, row) => {
    if (err || (row && Number(row.cnt) >= 1000)) return;
    const candidates = [
      path.join(__dirname, 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', 'Lumina_DZ_Products.csv')
    ];
    const csvPath = candidates.find((p) => fs.existsSync(p));
    if (!csvPath) return;

    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(csvPath, 'utf8');
      const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
      if (lines.length <= 1) return;

      db.serialize(() => {
        db._rawRun('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION');
        const stmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
          const line = lines[i];
          if (!line || !line.trim()) continue;
          const parts = line.split(',');
          const barcode = String(parts[0] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const name = String(parts[1] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          if (!barcode || !name || barcode.length < 6) continue;
          const category = String(parts[2] || 'عام').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim() || 'عام';
          const brand = String(parts[3] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const price = parseFloat(parts[4]) || 0;
          stmt.run(barcode, name.slice(0, 120), category.slice(0, 60), brand.slice(0, 60), 'قطعة', price);
        }
        stmt.finalize();
        db._rawRun('COMMIT');
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[DZ Dictionary Auto-Seed] Warning:', e.message);
    }
  });
}
autoSeedFullAlgerianCsvDictionary();

module.exports = db;

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\db-write-queue.js`

```javascript
/**
 * db-write-queue.js
 * محرك طابور الكتابة الذري المتسلسل لقاعدة بيانات SQLite3
 * يمنع أخطاء SQLITE_BUSY ويدعم المعاملات المتداخلة عبر SAVEPOINT
 */

'use strict';

const WRITE_SQL_PATTERN = /^\s*(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|PRAGMA\s+(?!table_info|foreign_key_list|index_list)|BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK|SAVEPOINT|RELEASE)/i;

class DbWriteQueue {
  constructor(db, options = {}) {
    this.db = db;
    this.maxRetries = Number(options.maxRetries ?? 6);
    this.baseRetryDelayMs = Number(options.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 35);
    this._chain = Promise.resolve();
    this._txDepth = 0;
    this._stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      retries: 0,
      errors: 0,
      transactions: 0
    };
  }

  isWriteQuery(sql) {
    return typeof sql === 'string' && WRITE_SQL_PATTERN.test(sql);
  }

  _sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  async _runWithRetry(fn) {
    let attempt = 0;
    while (true) {
      try {
        return await fn();
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = String((err && err.message) || err || '');
        const isLocked =
          (err && (err.code === 'SQLITE_BUSY' || err.code === 'SQLITE_LOCKED')) ||
          /SQLITE_BUSY|SQLITE_LOCKED|database is locked/i.test(msg);

        if (isLocked && attempt < this.maxRetries) {
          attempt += 1;
          this._stats.retries += 1;
          const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
          const delay = Math.round(this.baseRetryDelayMs * Math.pow(1.6, attempt - 1)) + jitter;
          await this._sleep(delay);
          continue;
        }
        this._stats.errors += 1;
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }

  enqueue(taskFn) {
    this._stats.enqueued += 1;
    const nextPromise = this._chain.then(async () => {
      const res = await this._runWithRetry(taskFn);
      this._stats.completed += 1;
      return res;
    });
    this._chain = nextPromise.catch(() => {});
    return nextPromise;
  }

  runAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const runner = this.db._rawRun ? this.db._rawRun.bind(this.db) : this.db.run.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      runner(sql, params, function onRunComplete(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({
          lastID: this ? this.lastID : undefined,
          changes: this ? this.changes : 0
        });
      });
    });
  }

  getAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const getter = this.db._rawGet ? this.db._rawGet.bind(this.db) : this.db.get.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      getter(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  allAsync(sql, params = []) {
    const aller = this.db._rawAll ? this.db._rawAll.bind(this.db) : this.db.all.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      aller(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  }

  execAsync(sql) {
    const execer = this.db._rawExec ? this.db._rawExec.bind(this.db) : this.db.exec.bind(this.db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      execer(sql, (err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(true)));
    });
  }

  withTransaction(workFn) {
    const executeTx = async () => {
      this._stats.transactions += 1;
      const isNested = this._txDepth > 0;
      const spName = `sp_gherbi_${this._txDepth}_${Date.now()}`;
      this._txDepth += 1;

      try {
        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION');
        }

        const txContext = {
          db: this.db,
          run: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          get: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          all: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          exec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql),
          dbRun: (sql, params = []) => this.runAsync(sql, params),
          dbGet: (sql, params = []) => this.getAsync(sql, params),
          dbAll: (sql, params = []) => this.allAsync(sql, params),
          dbExec: (sql) => this.execAsync(sql)
        };

        const output = await workFn(txContext);

        if (isNested) {
          await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
        } else {
          await this.runAsync('COMMIT');
        }

        return output;
      } catch (err) {
        try {
          if (isNested) {
            await this.runAsync(`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
            await this.runAsync(`RELEASE SAVEPOINT ${spName}`);
          } else {
            await this.runAsync('ROLLBACK');
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        throw err;
      } finally {
        this._txDepth = Math.max(0, this._txDepth - 1);
      }
    };

    if (this._txDepth > 0) {
      return executeTx();
    }
    return this.enqueue(executeTx);
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      ...this._stats,
      inTransaction: this._txDepth > 0,
      activeTxDepth: this._txDepth
    };
  }
}

function attachWriteQueue(db, options = {}) {
  if (!db) throw new Error('Valid sqlite3 instance required');
  if (db._writeQueue) return db._writeQueue;

  if (!db._rawRun) db._rawRun = db.run.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawGet) db._rawGet = db.get.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawAll) db._rawAll = db.all.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawExec) db._rawExec = db.exec.bind(db);
  if (!db._rawPrepare) db._rawPrepare = db.prepare.bind(db);

  const queue = new DbWriteQueue(db, options);
  db._writeQueue = queue;
  db.db = db;

  db.enqueueWrite = (fn) => queue.enqueue(fn);
  db.withTransaction = (fn) => queue.withTransaction(fn);
  db.runAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.runAsync(sql, params);
  db.getAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.getAsync(sql, params);
  db.allAsync = (sql, params = []) => queue.allAsync(sql, params);
  db.execAsync = (sql) => queue.execAsync(sql);

  db.dbRun = db.runAsync;
  db.dbGet = db.getAsync;
  db.dbAll = db.allAsync;
  db.dbExec = db.execAsync;

  db.getSetting = async (key, fallback = '') => {
    const row = await queue.getAsync('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
    return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
  };

  db.allowExpired = async () => {
    const val = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_allow_expired', 'false');
    return String(val).toLowerCase() === 'true' || val === '1';
  };

  db.nextNumber = async (docType = 'invoice') => {
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const defaultFormats = {
      invoice: 'FAC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      proforma: 'PRO-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      order: 'BC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      delivery: 'BL-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      payment_receipt: 'REC-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      avoir: 'AV-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      recap: 'FR-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      sales_summary: 'RM-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      supplier_return: 'RF-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      production: 'PRD-{YYYY}-{0000}',
      stocktake: 'INV-{YYYY}-{0000}'
    };
    const prefixFormat = defaultFormats[docType] || `${String(docType).toUpperCase()}-{YYYY}-{0000}`;

    await queue.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO document_counters (doc_type, year, last_number, prefix_format)
       VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?)
       ON CONFLICT(doc_type, year) DO UPDATE SET last_number = last_number + 1`,
      [docType, year, prefixFormat]
    );

    const row = await queue.getAsync(
      'SELECT last_number, prefix_format FROM document_counters WHERE doc_type = ? AND year = ?',
      [docType, year]
    );
    const seq = Number((row && row.last_number) || 1);
    const fmt = (row && row.prefix_format) || prefixFormat;

    return fmt
      .replace(/\{YYYY\}/g, String(year))
      .replace(/\{YY\}/g, String(year).slice(-2))
      .replace(/\{(0+)\}/g, (_m, zeros) => String(seq).padStart(zeros.length, '0'));
  };

  db.nextDocNumber = db.nextNumber;

  return queue;
}

module.exports = {
  DbWriteQueue,
  attachWriteQueue,
  createWriteQueue: attachWriteQueue
};
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_DELIVERY_TITLE}} - {{DELIVERY_NUMBER}}</title>
  <style data-purpose="page-size">
    /* 80mm thermal roll, continuous height. */
    /* مقاس الصفحة يُحسب وقت الطباعة (ورق مستمر): pageSize بطول المحتوى.
       ملاحظة: `size: 80mm auto` تصريح غير صالح — خلط <length> مع auto — كان
       Chromium يُسقطه ويعود لنموذج ورق التعريف الافتراضي فيقسّم المستند. */
    @page { margin: 0; }
  </style>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      /* كان 76مم مثبّتاً: على بكرة 58مم يخرج الوصل بعرض بكرة 80مم
         فيقتطعه التعريف أو يصغّره. العرض الآن من receipt_paper_width_mm
         عبر --rcpt-paper-w، والحشو من الهامش الجانبي نفسه كوقت الطباعة. */
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm);
      color: #000;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    .center { text-align: center; }
    .b { font-weight: 800; }
    .sep { border-top: 1px dashed #000; margin: 5px 0; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; }
    h1 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; margin: 0 0 2px; }
    .muted { font-size: 9px; }
    .logo { max-width: 120px; max-height: 60px; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto 4px; display: block; }

    /* Item blocks (generated by printDeliveryNote for this thermal template) */
    .t-item { margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .t-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; }
    .t-line { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 10px; }
    .t-line .muted2 { color: #333; }

    /* Signature area — two stacked lines for the thermal roll */
    .sig { margin-top: 10px; }
    .sig-line { border-top: 1px solid #000; margin-top: 18px; padding-top: 2px; font-size: 9px; }

    @media print { body { padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm); } }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body>
  <div class="center">
    {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}<img class="logo" src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="logo" />{{/if}}
    <h1>{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
    <div class="muted">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>
    <div class="muted">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>
    <div class="muted">{{LBL_TEL}} : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
    <div class="muted">RC : {{COMPANY_RC}} — NIF : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</div>
  </div>

  <div class="sep"></div>

  <div class="b center" style="font-size:13px;">{{LBL_DELIVERY_TITLE}} {{DELIVERY_NUMBER}}</div>
  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</span><span>{{LBL_ORDER_NUMBER}} {{ORDER_NUMBER}}</span></div>

  <div class="sep"></div>

  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_CLIENT}} :</span><span class="b">{{PARTY_NAME}}</span></div>
  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_ADDRESS}}</span><span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span></div>
  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_CARRIER}} :</span><span>{{CARRIER_NAME}}</span></div>
  <div class="row muted"><span>{{LBL_VEHICLE}} :</span><span>{{VEHICLE_PLATE}}</span></div>

  <div class="sep"></div>

  <!-- Items (vertical thermal layout — no prices) -->

    {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
  </div>

  <div class="sep"></div>

  <div class="sig">
    <div class="sig-line">{{LBL_SIGNATURE_SENDER}}</div>
    <div class="sig-line">{{LBL_SIGNATURE_CLIENT}}</div>
  </div>

  <div class="center b" style="margin-top:8px;">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
</body>

</html>

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\device-auth.js`

```javascript
/**
 * device-auth.js
 * وحدة توثيق الأجهزة، التوقيع الرقمي للطلبات (HMAC-SHA256)، وإصدار رموز اقتران الهاتف
 */

'use strict';

const axios = require('axios');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const os = require('os');
const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');

async function getSetting(db, key, fallback = '') {
  if (typeof db.getSetting === 'function') return db.getSetting(key, fallback);
  const row = await db.dbGet('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?', [String(key)]);
  return row && row.value !== undefined && row.value !== null ? row.value : fallback;
}

async function setSetting(db, key, value) {
  await db.dbRun('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)', [
    String(key),
    value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value)
  ]);
}

async function signedRequest(db, { method = 'GET', path: urlPath, data = null, params = null, timeout = 25000 }) {
  const cloudUrl = (await getSetting(db, 'cloud_url', 'https://cloud.gherbi.ai')).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const licenseCode = licenseManager.getLicenseCode();
  const timestamp = String(Date.now());

  const bodyHash = data
    ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex')
    : '';
  const payloadToSign = `${method.toUpperCase()}:${urlPath}:${instanceId}:${hwid}:${timestamp}:${bodyHash}`;
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', cloudToken || licenseCode || 'GHERBI_POS_SECRET')
    .update(payloadToSign)
    .digest('hex');

  const response = await axios.request({
    method,
    url: `${cloudUrl}${urlPath}`,
    data,
    params,
    timeout,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: cloudToken ? `Bearer ${cloudToken}` : undefined,
      'X-Instance-Id': instanceId,
      'X-Device-Hwid': hwid,
      'X-License-Code': licenseCode,
      'X-Timestamp': timestamp,
      'X-Signature': signature
    }
  });

  return response.data;
}

async function joinWithCode(db, joinCode) {
  const cleanCode = String(joinCode || '').trim();
  if (!cleanCode) throw new Error('يرجى إدخال كود الربط السحابي');

  let instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  if (!instanceId) {
    instanceId = crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    await setSetting(db, 'instance_id', instanceId);
  }

  const hwid = licenseManager.getHWID();
  const label = os.hostname() || 'Gherbi POS Terminal';

  const res = await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/join-cloud',
    data: { join_code: cleanCode, instance_id: instanceId, hwid, label }
  });

  const token = (res && (res.token || res.cloud_token)) || '';
  const role = (res && res.role) || 'follower';

  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', token);
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_role', role);
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'cloud');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'cloud');

  await db.dbRun(
    `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO device_registry (instance_id, label, hwid, is_self, is_owner, last_seen_at)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)`,
    [instanceId, label, hwid, role === 'owner' ? 1 : 0, new Date().toISOString()]
  );

  return { ok: true, role, instanceId };
}

async function getJoinInfo(db) {
  const instanceId = await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', '');
  const cloudRole = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_role', 'owner');
  const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  const networkScope = await getSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  const devices = await db.dbAll('SELECT * FROM device_registry ORDER BY is_owner DESC, last_seen_at DESC');

  return {
    connected: Boolean(cloudToken),
    instanceId,
    role: cloudRole,
    networkScope,
    devices
  };
}

async function leaveCloud(db) {
  await setSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
  await setSetting(db, 'network_scope', 'local');
  await setSetting(db, 'sync_mode', 'local');
  return { ok: true };
}

async function issueMobilePairCode(db) {
  try {
    const cloudToken = await getSetting(db, 'cloud_token', '');
    if (cloudToken) {
      const res = await signedRequest(db, {
        method: 'POST',
        path: '/api/pos/pair/issue',
        data: {
          instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
          hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
        }
      });
      if (res && res.code) return res;
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const localCode = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));
  return {
    ok: true,
    code: localCode,
    expiresInSeconds: 300
  };
}

async function getRelayTicket(db) {
  return await signedRequest(db, {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/devices/relay-ticket',
    data: {
      instance_id: await getSetting(db, 'instance_id', ''),
      hwid: licenseManager.getHWID()
    }
  });
}

module.exports = {
  signedRequest,
  joinWithCode,
  getJoinInfo,
  leaveCloud,
  issueMobilePairCode,
  getRelayTicket,
  getLicenseCode: licenseManager.getLicenseCode
};

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\extract_code.py`

```python
import os

# ==============================
# الإعدادات
# ==============================

OUTPUT_FILE = "project_structuregherbiaiposCLEANnew3.md"
MAX_DEPTH = 3                 # أقصى عمق للشجرة
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5000 * 1024    # 200KB

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".github", 
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
    "fet-engine",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "release",
    "out",
    "target",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "coverage",
    ".next"
}

IGNORE_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    ".gitignore",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db"
}

IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif",
    ".svg", ".ico",
    ".pdf",
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav",
    ".exe", ".dll",
    ".pyc",
    ".log"
}

CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
}


def language(ext):
    ext = ext.lower()

    if ext == ".py":
        return "python"

    if ext in [".js", ".jsx"]:
        return "javascript"

    if ext in [".ts", ".tsx"]:
        return "typescript"

    if ext == ".css":
        return "css"

    if ext == ".html":
        return "html"

    if ext == ".json":
        return "json"

    if ext == ".sql":
        return "sql"

    if ext == ".md":
        return "markdown"

    return "text"


def generate(directory):

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        ##################################################
        # Project Tree
        ##################################################

        f.write("# Project Structure\n\n")
        f.write("```text\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = sorted([d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS])

            level = os.path.relpath(root, directory).count(os.sep)

            if level > MAX_DEPTH:
                dirs.clear()
                continue

            indent = "    " * level

            folder = os.path.basename(root)

            if root == directory:
                f.write(f"{os.path.basename(directory)}/\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"{indent}├── {folder}/\n")

            sub = "    " * (level + 1)

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext in IGNORE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                f.write(f"{sub}├── {file}\n")

        f.write("```\n\n")

        ##################################################
        # Source Code
        ##################################################

        f.write("\n---\n\n")
        f.write("# Source Code\n\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS]

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext not in CODE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                path = os.path.join(root, file)

                if os.path.getsize(path) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    continue

                relative = os.path.relpath(path, directory)

                f.write(f"## `{relative}`\n\n")

                f.write(f"```{language(ext)}\n")

                try:
                    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as code:
                        f.write(code.read())
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    f.write("// Unable to read file (encoding).")
                except Exception as e:
                    f.write(f"// {e}")

                f.write("\n```\n\n---\n\n")

    print("Done!")
    print("Output:", OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate(os.getcwd())
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\imageUtils.js`

```javascript
/**
 * imageUtils.js
 * وحدة معالجة وتحويل وحفظ صور المنتجات والمتغيرات وشعار المتجر
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const DATA_URL_PATTERN = /^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9+.-]+);base64,([\s\S]+)$/;

function getImagesDir() {
  let baseDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data');
  try {
    const electron = require('electron');
    const app = electron.app || (electron.remote && electron.remote.app);
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      baseDir = app.getPath('userData');
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  const dir = path.join(baseDir, 'product_images');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
  return dir;
}

function subtypeToExt(sub = '') {
  const s = String(sub).toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'jpeg' || s === 'jpg') return 'jpg';
  if (s === 'webp') return 'webp';
  if (s === 'gif') return 'gif';
  if (s === 'svg+xml' || s === 'svg') return 'svg';
  return 'png';
}

function processImage(imageInput, options = {}) {
  if (!imageInput || typeof imageInput !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = imageInput.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const match = DATA_URL_PATTERN.exec(trimmed);
  if (!match) {
    if (
      !trimmed.startsWith('http://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('https://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('file://') &&
      !trimmed.startsWith('data:') &&
      fs.existsSync(trimmed)
    ) {
      try {
        const ext = path.extname(trimmed).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
        const buf = fs.readFileSync(trimmed);
        const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
        return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
      } catch (_) {
        return trimmed;
      }
    }
    return trimmed;
  }

  if (options.saveToDisk) {
    try {
      const ext = subtypeToExt(match[1]);
      const buf = Buffer.from(match[2].replace(/\s+/g, ''), 'base64');
      const hash = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(buf).digest('hex').slice(0, 20);
      const filePath = path.join(getImagesDir(), `${options.prefix || 'img'}_${hash}.${ext}`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, buf);
      }
      return filePath;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }

  return trimmed;
}

function imageToDataUrl(pathOrUrl) {
  if (!pathOrUrl || typeof pathOrUrl !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = pathOrUrl.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('data:image/')) return trimmed || null;

  const cleanPath = trimmed.replace(/^file:\/\/\/?/, '');
  if (fs.existsSync(cleanPath)) {
    try {
      const ext = path.extname(cleanPath).replace('.', '').toLowerCase() || 'png';
      const mime = ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext;
      const buf = fs.readFileSync(cleanPath);
      return `data:image/${mime};base64,${buf.toString('base64')}`;
    } catch (_) {
      return trimmed;
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function deleteLocalImage(imagePath) {
  if (!imagePath || typeof imagePath !== 'string') return false;
  if (imagePath.startsWith('data:') || imagePath.startsWith('http')) return false;
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(imagePath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(imagePath);
      return true;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return false;
}

module.exports = {
  getImagesDir,
  processImage,
  saveProductImage: processImage,
  imageToDataUrl,
  deleteLocalImage
};
```
