```html
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">logout</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- ===================================================================
         المنطقة الرئيسية والشريط العلوي المتقدم (Main Content & Top Navbar)
         =================================================================== -->
    <main id="main-content">
      <header id="top-header">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 max-w-2xl">
          <div class="relative flex-1">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400">search</span>
            <input id="globalPosSearch" type="text"
              oninput="App.onPosSearchInput(this.value)"
              placeholder="[F4] ابحث بالاسم، الباركود، الفئة، أو اضغط Enter للإضافة..."
              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
          </div>
          <div class="relative w-52">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-blue-600">barcode_scanner</span>
            <input id="barcodeInput" type="text"
              onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') App.handleBarcodeScan(this.value)"
              placeholder="[F5] امسح الباركود هنا دائماً..."
              class="w-full pr-9 pl-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold border-blue-500/40">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button onclick="App.openPosScaleModal()" id="liveScaleBox"
            class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs hover:border-emerald-500"
            title="فتح نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm text-emerald-500">scale</span>
            <span id="liveScaleWeight" class="font-mono font-black text-xs">0.000 kg</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('caisse')" id="headerShiftBadge"
            class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">point_of_sale</span>
            <span id="headerShiftText">المناوبة نشطة</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.switchView('settings')" id="lanClientsBadge"
            class="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20 text-xs font-bold"
            title="الأجهزة المتصلة على الشبكة المحلية">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">lan</span>
            <span id="lanClientsCountText">LAN</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openCustomerDisplayWindow()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
            title="فتح شاشة عرض الزبون الثانية (Customer Display)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tv</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('virtualKeyboardModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            title="لوحة المفاتيح اللمسية (Touch Keyboard)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard</span>
          </button>

          <div class="relative">
            <button id="notificationsBellBtn" onclick="App.toggleNotificationsPopover()"
              class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 relative"
              title="تنبيهات المخزون والصلاحية والأقساط">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">notifications</span>
              <span id="notifCountBadge" class="hidden absolute -top-0.5 -left-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-full text-[10px] font-black">0</span>
            </button>
            <div id="notificationsPopover" class="hidden absolute left-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-3 z-50 text-xs space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
          </div>

          <button onclick="App.openAuditLogsModal()"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-amber-500"
            title="سجل الرقابة الأمنية للكاشير (Anti-Theft Audit)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">shield_person</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.openModal('shortcutsHelpModal')"
            class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
            title="دليل اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح (F1..F12)">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">help</span>
          </button>

          <select id="langSwitcher" onchange="App.setLanguage(this.value)"
            class="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer">
            <option value="ar">🇩🇿 العربية</option>
            <option value="fr">🇫🇷 Français</option>
            <option value="en">🇬🇧 English</option>
          </select>

          <button onclick="App.toggleDarkMode()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="الوضع الليلي / النهاري">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">dark_mode</span>
          </button>

          <button onclick="App.toggleFullscreen()" class="p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" title="ملء الشاشة">
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">fullscreen</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- =================================================================
           1. شاشة المبيعات والكاشير المطورة (POS View with Resizer & Edit Mode)
           ================================================================= -->
      <section id="view-pos" class="view-section active">
        <div id="posMainGridContainer" class="pos-layout" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 6px 420px; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <!-- يمين: الفئات، أزرار التحكم، وشبكة المنتجات مع الترقيم -->
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-2.5 min-h-0 pl-1">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div id="posCategoryPills" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5"></div>
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <button onclick="App.openModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">tune</span>
                  <span>تخصيص</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openPosAdvancedFilterModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">filter_alt</span>
                  <span>فلتر</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openPosQuickProduceModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">precision_manufacturing</span>
                  <span>إنتاج فوري</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openFreeItemModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add_shopping_cart</span>
                  <span>منتج حر (F8)</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.toggleReturnMode()" id="btnReturnMode" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">keyboard_return</span>
                  <span>إرجاع</span>
                </button>
                <button id="btnPosHeaderQaBot" onclick="App.runAutoTest_PosPage()" title="تشغيل الفحص الآلي الشامل للصفحة (Ctrl+Shift+T)" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md">
                  <span>🤖 فحص آلي (QA)</span>
                </button>
                <button onclick="App.openProductModal()" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add</span>
                  <span>إضافة منتج</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posProductsGrid" class="products-grid flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1"></div>

            <div id="posPaginationBar" class="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(-1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">السابق</button>
              <span id="posPageInfoText" class="text-slate-500">صفحة 1 من 1</span>
              <button onclick="App.changePosPage(1)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white">التالي</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- الفاصل القابل للسحب لتغيير عرض السلة (#posCartResizer) -->
          <div id="posCartResizer" title="اسحب لتكبير أو تصغير عرض السلة"
            class="w-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-500 cursor-col-resize transition-colors"></div>

          <!-- يسار: سلة المشتريات والحسابات -->
          <div id="posCartContainer" class="cart-container">
            <!-- شريط تنبيه وضع تعديل فاتورة سابقة -->
            <div id="posEditSaleBanner" class="hidden px-3 py-2 bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-between">
              <span id="posEditSaleBannerText">وضع تعديل الفاتورة #</span>
              <button onclick="App.cancelEditSaleMode()" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/25 hover:bg-black/40 text-[11px]">إلغاء التعديل ✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="p-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div id="multiCartTabs" class="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto"></div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button onclick="App.openRecentSalesModal()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1" title="آخر مبيعات الكاشير">
                    <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">history</span>
                    <span>سجل</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onclick="App.newCartTab()" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 text-xs font-bold">+ سلة</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="flex gap-1.5">
                <select id="posCustomerSelect" class="flex-1 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"></select>
                <button onclick="App.openCustomerModal()" class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600/15 text-emerald-600" title="إضافة زبون جديد">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">person_add</span>
                </button>
                <select id="posPriceTierSelect" onchange="App.setCartPriceTier(this.value)" class="w-28 px-2 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
                  <option value="retail">سعر التجزئة</option>
                  <option value="wholesale">سعر الجملة</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="posCartItems" class="cart-items p-3 space-y-2"></div>

            <div class="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/70 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span class="text-slate-500 font-bold">المجموع الفرعي (<span id="cartItemsCountText">0</span> صنف):</span>
                <span id="cartSubtotalText" class="font-mono font-bold">0.00 د.ج</span>
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <button onclick="App.openCartModifierModal()" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">calculate</span>
                  <span>التخفيض (% أو مبلغ):</span>
                </button>
                <input id="cartDiscountInput" type="number" step="any" value="0"
                  oninput="App.recalcCart()"
                  class="w-28 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-center font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                <span class="font-black text-sm">الإجمالي المستحق:</span>
                <div class="text-left">
                  <span id="cartTotalText" class="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 block">0.00 د.ج</span>
                  <span id="cartTotalCentimeBadge" class="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block">🇩🇿 بالتداول الجزائري: 0 سنتيم</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                <button onclick="App.clearCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/20">إلغاء (Shift+F4)</button>
                <button onclick="App.holdCurrentCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/20">تعليق (F2)</button>
                <button onclick="App.openDraftsModal()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800">مسودات (<span id="draftsCountBadge">0</span>)</button>
                <button onclick="App.saveCartAsProforma()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500/20">كمبدئية</button>
                <button onclick="App.openOrderModalFromCart()" class="py-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500/20">كطلبية</button>
              </div>

              <button onclick="App.openCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-black text-base flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25">
                <span class="material-symbols-rounded">payments</span>
                <span id="btnCheckoutMainText">تسديد الفاتورة (F1)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- =================================================================
           بقية الأقسام الـ 17 (تُبنى ديناميكياً عبر renderer.js)
           ================================================================= -->
      <section id="view-sales" class="view-section"><div id="sales-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-caisse" class="view-section"><div id="caisse-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-inventory" class="view-section"><div id="inventory-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-bundles" class="view-section"><div id="bundles-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-manufacturing" class="view-section"><div id="manufacturing-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-stocktake" class="view-section"><div id="stocktake-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-print" class="view-section"><div id="print-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-suppliers" class="view-section"><div id="suppliers-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-purchases" class="view-section"><div id="purchases-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-customers" class="view-section"><div id="customers-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-proformas" class="view-section"><div id="proformas-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-orders" class="view-section"><div id="orders-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-expenses" class="view-section"><div id="expenses-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-analytics" class="view-section"><div id="analytics-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-copilot" class="view-section"><div id="copilot-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-users" class="view-section"><div id="users-view-root"></div></section>
      <section id="view-settings" class="view-section"><div id="settings-view-root"></div></section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- =====================================================================
       منظومة النوافذ المنبثقة الشاملة (44 نافذة تفاعلية — Zero window.prompt)
       ===================================================================== -->

  <!-- 1. نافذة الدفع والتسديد الشاملة (Checkout Modal + Split Payment + Installments) -->
  <div id="checkoutModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-xl font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-blue-600">point_of_sale</span>
          <span>تسديد وإتمام الفاتورة (F1)</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('checkoutModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="creditLimitAlertBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/15 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 text-xs font-bold"></div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div class="space-y-3">
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-center">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الإجمالي المطلوب للدفع</div>
            <div id="chkTotalDue" class="text-3xl font-black font-mono text-blue-600 mt-1">0.00 د.ج</div>
            <div id="chkCentimeHelperText" class="text-xs font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-1">🇩🇿 بالسنتيم: 0 سنتيم</div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyTva" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">تطبيق TVA (19%)</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="chkApplyStamp" type="checkbox" onchange="App.recalcCheckoutModal()">
              <span class="font-bold">حق الطابع (1%)</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">طريقة الدفع</label>
            <select id="chkPaymentMethod" onchange="App.onCheckoutMethodChange(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">
              <option value="cash">نقداً (Espèces / Cash)</option>
              <option value="credit">آجل / دين (À Terme)</option>
              <option value="cib">بطاقة ذهبية / بنكية (CIB / Edahabia)</option>
              <option value="baridimob">بريدي موب (BaridiMob / CCP)</option>
              <option value="cheque">شيك (Chèque)</option>
              <option value="split">دفع مختلط متعدد (Split Payment)</option>
              <option value="installment">بيع بالتقسيط (Vente par Facilité)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          
          <!-- حقل رقم المرجع ورمز BaridiMob QR عند الدفع الإلكتروني أو الشيك -->
          <div id="chkPaymentRefBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div class="flex-1">
                <label class="block font-bold mb-1 text-indigo-600">رقم مرجع العملية / الصك (Transaction Reference N°)</label>
                <input id="chkPaymentRefInput" type="text" placeholder="أدخل رقم العملية أو الشيك..." class="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold">
              </div>
              <img id="chkBaridimobQrImg" class="hidden w-20 h-20 rounded-lg border bg-white p-1" alt="RIP QR">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="chkSplitPaymentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-blue-600">تقسيم المبلغ على عدة طرق دفع:</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">نقداً (Cash)</label><input id="splitCashInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">CIB / BaridiMob</label><input id="splitCardInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcSplitTotals()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الباقي آجل (دين)</label><input id="splitCreditInput" type="number" step="any" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-rose-500"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="chkInstallmentBox" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 space-y-2 text-xs">
            <div class="font-bold text-amber-600">جدولة الأقساط الشهرية (Vente par Facilité):</div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">الدفعة الأولى (تسبقة)</label><input id="instDownPayment" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">عدد الأشهر</label><input id="instMonthsCount" type="number" min="1" max="36" value="6" oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()" class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold"></div>
              <div><label class="block text-[10px]">القسط الشهري</label><input id="instMonthlyVal" type="text" readonly class="w-full px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">المبلغ المستلم</label>
              <input id="chkPaidAmount" type="number" step="any"
                oninput="App.recalcCheckoutModal()"
                class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-mono font-black text-base text-center">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">الباقي للزبون (Rendu)</label>
              <div id="chkChangeAmount" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 font-mono font-black text-base text-center">0.00</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-2">
          <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">الفئات النقدية الجزائرية السريعة (د.ج)</div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(2000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-900 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">2000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(1000)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">1000 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(500)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-800 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">500 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(200)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">200 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(100)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-sky-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">100 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(50)" class="py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-700 text-white font-mono font-black text-sm hover:opacity-90">50 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(20)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">20 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(10)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-600 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">10 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.addCashDenom(5)" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-500 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs">5 د.ج</button>
            <button onclick="App.setExactCash()" class="py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-xs">المبلغ الكامل</button>
          </div>
          <div class="pt-2">
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">تاريخ استحقاق الدين (عند البيع الآجل)</label>
            <input id="chkDueDate" type="date" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('receipt')" class="py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">receipt</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة وصل حراري</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('a4')" class="py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
          <span>حفظ وطباعة فاتورة A4</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.submitSale('none')" class="py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">check_circle</span>
          <span>حفظ فقط بدون طباعة</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. نافذة المسودات والفواتير المعلقة (Drafts Modal - F3) -->
  <div id="draftsModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">الفواتير المعلقة والمسودات (F3)</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('draftsModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="draftsModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. نافذة سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع (Recent Sales Modal) -->
  <div id="recentSalesModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">سجل آخر مبيعات الكاشير السريع</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('recentSalesModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="recentSalesModalBody" class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. نافذة تخصيص عرض شاشة المبيعات المتقدمة (POS Customize Modal) -->
  <div id="posCustomizeModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black">تخصيص شبكة منتجات الكاشير وعرض السلة</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posCustomizeModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">حجم بطاقات المنتجات</label>
          <select id="posCardSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
            <option value="small">صغير (كثافة عالية)</option>
            <option value="medium" selected>متوسط (قياسي)</option>
            <option value="large">كبير (واضح للشاشات اللمسية)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عدد المنتجات في كل صفحة</label>
          <select id="posPageSizeSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
            <option value="18">18 منتج</option>
            <option value="24" selected>24 منتج</option>
            <option value="36">36 منتج</option>
            <option value="60">60 منتج</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">عرض السلة الجانبية (بالبيكسل)</label>
          <input id="posCartWidthInput" type="number" min="320" max="620" value="420" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold">
        </div>
        <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowImagesCheckbox" type="checkbox" checked>
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار صور المنتجات داخل البطاقات</span>
        </label>
        <label id="posShowCostRow" class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-1">
          <input id="posShowCostCheckbox" type="checkbox">
          <span class="font-bold">إظهار سعر الشراء (التكلفة) بخط صغير على بطاقة المنتج</span>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3">
        <button onclick="App.savePosCustomization()" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">حفظ وتطبيق</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 5. نافذة الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر (POS Scale Modal) -->
  <div id="posScaleModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-black flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-500">scale</span>
          <span>الميزان الإلكتروني المباشر</span>
        </h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posScaleModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 text-emerald-400 text-center font-mono">
        <div class="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">الوزن الصافي المستقر</div>
        <div id="scaleModalWeightDisplay" class="text-4xl font-black">0.000 kg</div>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-2 text-xs">
        <label class="block font-bold">اختر المنتج الموزون لإضافته للسلة:</label>
        <select id="scaleModalProductSelect" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold"></select>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2">
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.zero()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">تصفير (Zero)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.tare()" class="py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold">طارئة (Tare)</button>
          <button onclick="window.api.scale.readOnce()" class="py-2 bg-blue-600/15 text-blue-600 rounded-xl font-bold">قراءة الآن</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button onclick="App.addWeightedProductFromScaleModal()" class="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black">إضافة الوزن الحالي إلى السلة</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 6. نافذة اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي عند البيع (Variant/Batch/Serial Picker) -->
  <div id="posVariantBatchPickerModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="pickerModalProductName" class="text-lg font-black">اختيار المتغير / الدفعة / الرقم التسلسلي</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('posVariantBatchPickerModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <div id="pickerModalBody" class="space-y-3 text-xs max-h-96 overflow-y-auto"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 7. نافذة إضافة/تعديل منتج الشاملة بـ 5 تبويبات + Markup % + أدوات المتغيرات الجماعية -->
  <div id="productModal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-content w-full max-w-3xl p-6 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
        <h3 id="productModalTitle" class="text-lg font-black">إضافة / تعديل منتج</h3>
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('productModal')" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500"><span class="material-symbols-rounded">close</span></button>
      </div>
      <input id="prodIdInput" type="hidden">

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-2 text-xs font-bold">
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('basic')" id="prodTabBtn-basic" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white">1. البيانات الأساسية</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('pricing')" id="prodTabBtn-pricing" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">2. الأسعار وهامش الربح</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('barcodes')" id="prodTabBtn-barcodes" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">3. الباركودات المتعددة</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('variants')" id="prodTabBtn-variants" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">4. مصفوفة المتغيرات</button>
        <button onclick="App.switchProductModalTab('bom')" id="prodTabBtn-bom" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">5. التصنيع والضمان</button>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 1: البيانات الأساسية -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-basic" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">اسم المنتج *</label>
          <input id="prodNameInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">الباركود (يدعم القاموس الجزائري 613)</label>
          <div class="flex gap-1">
            <input id="prodBarcodeInput" type="text" onchange="App.autoFillFromDzDictionary(this.value)" class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
            <button onclick="App.generateRandomBarcode()" class="px-2.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold" title="توليد باركود جزائري">⚡</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الفئة (Catégorie)</label><input id="prodCategoryInput" type="text" placeholder="عام" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">العائلة (Famille)</label><input id="prodFamilyInput" type="text" placeholder="اختياري" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">المورد</label><input id="prodSupplierInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">وحدة البيع</label><input id="prodUnitInput" type="text" value="قطعة" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الكمية الابتدائية</label><input id="prodStockInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">الحد الأدنى للتنبيه</label><input id="prodMinStockInput" type="number" value="5" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية</label><input id="prodExpiryInput" type="date" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">مكان التخزين (Rayon)</label><input id="prodLocationInput" type="text" placeholder="ممر A - رف 2" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">كود الميزان (PLU 5 digits)</label><input id="prodPluInput" type="text" placeholder="00105" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        <div class="md:col-span-3 flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
          <input id="prodImageFileInput" type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="App.handleProductImageUpload(this)" class="text-xs">
          <input id="prodImageDataInput" type="hidden">
          <label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input id="prodFeaturedCheckbox" type="checkbox">
            <span class="font-bold">تمييز كمفضلة (Featured)</span>
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 2: الأسعار وحاسبة هامش الربح % والجملة -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-pricing" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر التكلفة (الشراء)</label><input id="prodCostInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" oninput="App.onProdCostOrMarkupInput()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1 text-emerald-600">هامش الربح (% Markup)</label><input id="prodMarkupInput" type="number" step="any" placeholder="20%" oninput="App.onProdMarkupChange(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر البيع (التجزئة)</label><input id="prodPriceInput" type="number" step="any" value="0" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-blue-600"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">سعر الجملة</label><input id="prodWholesaleInput" type="number" step="any" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">اسم وحدة الجملة (كرتونة/صندوق)</label><input id="prodWholesaleUnitInput" type="text" placeholder="كرتونة" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
          <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">عدد القطع في الكرتونة</label><input id="prodWholesaleQtyInput" type="number" placeholder="12" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="font-bold">مستويات أسعار إضافية (نصف جملة، خاص، VIP):</span>
            <button onclick="App.addExtraPriceRow()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 rounded-lg font-bold">+ إضافة سعر</button>
          </div>
          <div id="prodExtraPricesContainer" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 3: الباركودات المتعددة -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-barcodes" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>ربط باركودات إضافية بنفس المنتج أو بتسعيرة محددة:</span>
          <button onclick="App.addExtraBarcodeRow()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600/10 text-blue-600 rounded-lg font-bold">+ إضافة باركود فرعي</button>
        </div>
        <div id="prodExtraBarcodesContainer" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 4: مصفوفة المتغيرات + أدوات التطبيق الجماعي (Bulk Variant Tools) -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-variants" class="hidden space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
            <input id="prodHasVariantsCheckbox" type="checkbox">
            <span class="font-bold">تفعيل المتغيرات لهذا المنتج (مقاس، لون...)</span>
          </label>
          <div class="flex gap-1.5">
            <button onclick="App.applyVariantTemplate('clothing')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg font-bold">قالب ملابس</button>
            <button onclick="App.applyVariantTemplate('shoes')" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg font-bold">قالب أحذية</button>
            <button onclick="App.bulkFillVariantBarcodes()" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-600/15 text-indigo-600 rounded-lg font-bold">⚡ باركودات للكل</button>
            <button onclick="App.addVariantRowInModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">+ متغير</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- شريط التطبيق الجماعي على جميع المتغيرات -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
          <input id="bulkVariantCost" type="number" step="any" placeholder="شراء للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono">
          <input id="bulkVariantPrice" type="number" step="any" placeholder="بيع للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono">
          <input id="bulkVariantStock" type="number" step="any" placeholder="رصيد للكل" class="px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono">
          <button onclick="App.bulkApplyVariantFields()" class="bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded font-bold">تطبيق على الكل</button>
        </div>
        
        <div id="prodOptionGroupsBuilderBox" class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/25 space-y-2">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="font-black text-indigo-600">مولد مصفوفة الخيارات المتعددة (مثال: المقاس × اللون):</span>
            <div class="flex gap-1.5">
              <button onclick="App.addOptionGroupRowInModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg font-bold">+ مجموعة خيارات</button>
              <button onclick="App.generateCartesianVariantsFromGroups()" class="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">⚡ توليد التركيبات تلقائياً</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="prodOptionGroupsRows" class="space-y-1.5"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="prodVariantsMatrixContainer" class="space-y-1.5 max-h-52 overflow-y-auto"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- تبويب 5: التصنيع والضمان -->
      <div id="prodTabContent-bom" class="hidden grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">دور المادة في التصنيع (BOM Role)</label>
          <select id="prodMaterialRoleInput" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl">
            <option value="">منتج تجاري عادي</option>
            <option value="finished_good">منتج مصنع نهائي (Finished Good)</option>
            <option value="semi_finished">نصف مصنع (Semi-Finished)</option>
            <option value="raw_material">مادة أولية للتصنيع (Raw Material)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label class="block font-bold mb-1">مدة الضمان الافتراضية (بالأشهر)</label>
          <input id="prodWarrantyMonthsInput" type="number" value="0" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono">
        </div>
        <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
          <input id="prodTrackSerialCheckbox" type="checkbox">
          <span class="font-bold">تتبع الأرقام التسلسلية (IMEI / Serial Number) عند البيع</span>
        </label>
        <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
          <input id="prodHideFromPosCheckbox" type="checkbox">
          <span class="font-bold">إخفاء هذه المادة من شاشة الكاشير (للمواد الأولية)</span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
        <button onclick="App.closeModal('productModal')" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-bold">إلغاء</button>
        <button onclick="App.saveProductFromModal()" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold">حفظ بيانات المنتج</button>
      </div>

          <strong id="closeShiftExpectedText" class="font-mono text-base text-blue-600">0.00 د.ج</strong>
        </div>

        <!-- حاسبة عدّ الأوراق والعملات النقدية الجزائرية -->
        <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-2">

            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-indigo-600">2000×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="2000" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-amber-700">1000×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="1000" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-emerald-700">500×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="500" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-amber-600">200×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="200" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-sky-600">100×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="100" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-slate-500">50×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="50" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-amber-600">20×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="20" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-slate-500">10×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="10" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-16 font-bold text-slate-400">5×</span><input type="number" min="0" placeholder="0" oninput="App.recalcCloseShiftDenoms()" data-denom="5" class="denom-inp w-full px-2 py-1 rounded text-center font-bold"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label class="block font-bold mb-1">المبلغ الفعلي المعدود في الدرج (د.ج) *</label>

          </div>
        </div>
        <div><label class="block font-bold mb-1">ملاحظة الإغلاق</label><input id="closeShiftNoteInput" type="text" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl"></div>
      </div>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>Facture - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
    }

    .font-serif-bold {
      font-family: serif;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-borders">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: 40px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .rounded-box {
      border: 1.5px solid #000;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .table-border,
    .table-border th,
    .table-border td {
      border: 1px solid #000;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    .table-border th {
      padding: 6px 4px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .table-border td {
      padding: 6px 4px;
    }

    @media print {
      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 20px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" data-purpose="invoice-document">

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="mb-8">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-bold mb-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-2 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>الهاتف : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
        <div>الثابت : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</div>
        <div>البريد : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-1 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>سجل تجاري : {{COMPANY_RC}}</div>
        <div>رقم جبائي : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</div>
        <div>مادة جبائية : {{COMPANY_AI}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="font-bold text-[10px] mt-1">رقم الإحصاء : {{COMPANY_NIS}}</div>
    </header>

    <!-- Client/Supplier and Invoice Info -->
    <section class="flex justify-between items-start mb-10" data-purpose="info-block">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box text-[10px] font-bold leading-relaxed">
        <p>{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}} : {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p>العنوان : {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <p>سجل تجاري : {{PARTY_RC}}</p>
        <p>رقم جبائي : {{PARTY_NIF}}</p>
        <p>مادة جبائية : {{PARTY_AI}}</p>
        <p>رقم الإحصاء : {{PARTY_NIS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-[48%] pl-8" style="text-align: left;">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}} رقم {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</h2>
        <p class="text-sm font-bold">التاريخ : {{DATE}}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Items Table -->
    <section class="mb-8" data-purpose="items-table">
      <table class="w-full table-border text-center text-[10px] font-bold">
        <thead>
          <tr class="bg-white">
            <th class="w-[6%]">الرقم</th>
            <th class="w-[14%]">المرجع</th>
            <th class="w-[30%]">البيان</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">الكمية</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">الوحدة</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <!-- Summary and Total -->
    <section class="flex flex-col mb-8" style="align-items: flex-start;" data-purpose="totals-section">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span>{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span>{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span>{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span>{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span>{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-dashed border-slate-400" data-purpose="old-balance-row">
          <span>{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span>{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1" data-purpose="remaining-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span>{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-black mt-1 pt-1 font-black" data-purpose="total-debt-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span>{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <section class="space-y-6" data-purpose="footer-details">
      <div>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">حررت هذه الفاتورة بمبلغ :</p>
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px]">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between items-end gap-4 mt-6" data-purpose="footer-row">
        <div class="border border-black px-4 py-2 font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="payment-mode">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} {{PAYMENT_MODE}}
        </div>
        <div class="w-[45%] border border-black rounded-md px-3 pt-2 pb-12 text-center font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="signature-box">
          {{LBL_SIGNATURE}}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>
  <script>
    window.onload = function () {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print=true')) {
        setTimeout(() => { window.print(); }, 500);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      color: #1f2937;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .accent {
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-table">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 16px auto;
      padding: 22px 26px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .reg-strip {
      border-top: 2px double #1e3a8a;
      border-bottom: 2px double #1e3a8a;
    }

    .info-box {
      border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* جدول مضغوط — يتسع لعدد كبير من المنتجات في صفحة واحدة. */
    .invoice-table {
      border-collapse: collapse;
      width: 100%;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }

    .invoice-table th,
    .invoice-table td {
      border: 1px solid #475569;
      padding: 3px 5px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }

    .invoice-table th {
      font-weight: 800;
      background: #e8eefc;
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }

    .invoice-table td {
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* خلية البيان يضع لها الـ renderer صنف .text-left — نحاذيها يميناً في RTL */
    .invoice-table td.text-left {
      text-align: right;
    }

    .filler td {
      height: 70px;
      border-left: 1px solid #475569;
      border-right: 1px solid #475569;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #475569;
      border-top: none;
    }

    .totals-box {
      border: 1.5px solid #1e3a8a;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    @media print {
      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .invoice-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 14px 16px;
      }

      .invoice-table th {
        -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
        print-color-adjust: exact;
      }

      .no-print {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="invoice-container mx-auto bg-white" id="invoice-paper">

    <!-- الترويسة -->
    <header class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-2">
      <div class="text-right flex-1" data-purpose="company-details">
        <h1 class="text-xl font-extrabold accent leading-tight">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        <p class="text-[10px] font-bold mt-0.5">العنوان : {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-[10px] mt-0.5">
          <span>الهاتف : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>
          <span>الثابت : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>
          <span>البريد : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-purpose="logo-container">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="{{COMPANY_NAME}}" class="h-20 w-20 object-contain rounded-lg" />
        {{/if}}
        {{#unless COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <div class="h-20 w-20 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300">
          <span class="text-slate-400 font-black text-[9px] text-center px-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/unless}}
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- المعلومات القانونية للشركة -->
    <section class="reg-strip py-1 mb-2 text-center text-[9.5px] font-semibold tracking-tight" data-purpose="registry-info">
      رقم جبائي : {{COMPANY_NIF}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; سجل تجاري : {{COMPANY_RC}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; مادة جبائية : {{COMPANY_AI}} &nbsp;•&nbsp; رقم الإحصاء : {{COMPANY_NIS}}
    </section>

    <!-- العنوان -->
    <h2 class="text-center text-lg font-extrabold accent mb-2">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}} رقم {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</h2>

    <!-- معلومات الزبون + الفاتورة -->
    <section class="flex justify-between gap-3 mb-2 text-[10.5px]" data-purpose="client-information">
      <div class="info-box p-2 w-[62%] leading-relaxed">
        <p><span class="font-bold">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}} :</span> {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p><span class="font-bold">العنوان :</span> {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4">
          <span><span class="font-bold">سجل تجاري :</span> {{PARTY_RC}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">رقم جبائي :</span> {{PARTY_NIF}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">مادة جبائية :</span> {{PARTY_AI}}</span>
          <span><span class="font-bold">رقم الإحصاء :</span> {{PARTY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="info-box p-2 w-[36%] leading-relaxed">
        <p><span class="font-bold">التاريخ :</span> {{DATE}}</p>
        <p><span class="font-bold">{{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}}</span> {{PAYMENT_MODE}}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- جدول المنتجات (8 أعمدة — مطابق لمخرجات الـ renderer) -->
    <section class="mb-2">
      <table class="invoice-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width:5%">الرقم</th>
            <th style="width:13%">المرجع</th>
            <th style="width:29%">البيان</th>
            <th style="width:10%">الكمية</th>
            <th style="width:9%">الوحدة</th>
            <th style="width:11%">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
            <th style="width:8%">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
            <th style="width:15%">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
          <tr class="filler">
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
            <td></td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <!-- المجاميع + المبلغ بالحروف -->
    <section class="flex flex-row justify-between gap-4 mt-2">
      <div class="w-1/2 pt-2">
        <p class="font-bold text-[11px] mb-1">حررت هذه الفاتورة بمبلغ :</p>
        <p class="text-[11px] italic font-bold">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-1/2 totals-box p-3 bg-white" data-purpose="totals-box">
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="stamp-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm border-t border-black pt-1 mt-1">
          <span class="font-black text-base accent">{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-base accent">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1 mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-dashed border-slate-400" data-purpose="old-balance-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{OLD_BALANCE}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1" data-purpose="remaining-row">
          <span class="font-bold">{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="font-bold">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex justify-between text-sm border-t border-black pt-1 mt-1" data-purpose="total-debt-row">
          <span class="font-black text-base">{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
          <span class="font-black text-base">{{TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- التوقيع -->
    <section class="flex justify-end mt-6" data-purpose="signature-section">
      <div class="w-1/3 info-box px-3 pt-2 pb-12 text-center font-bold text-[10px]" data-purpose="signature-box">
        {{LBL_SIGNATURE}}
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>
</body>

</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>
    @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 10mm; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }
    .doc-container {
      max-width: 210mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 3px solid #047857;
      
    }
    .company-block { flex: 1; }
    .company-name {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    }
    .company-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .company-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5; }
    .fiscal-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #1e293b;
    }
    .fiscal-pills span {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .doc-badge {
      text-align: left;
      min-width: 190px;
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-top: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }
    .doc-type {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #047857;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .doc-num {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #0f172a;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .doc-date {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .party-card {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .party-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #047857;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .party-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; }
    .party-details { font-size: 10.5px; color: #334155; margin-top: 3px; }
    .party-fiscal {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      color: #334155;
      text-align: left;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    table.items-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    table.items-table th {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 7px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #047857;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td {
      padding: 6px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    table.items-table td.text-left,
    table.items-table td.desig {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    table.items-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f8fafc;
    }
    .summary-section {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .words-and-payment { flex: 1; }
    .words-box {
      background: #ecfdf5;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-right: 4px solid #047857;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .words-prefix { font-size: 10.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 700; }
    .words-text { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px; }
    .payment-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #334155;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .totals-box {
      width: 270px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .totals-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .totals-row .val {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
    }
    .totals-row.net-row {
      background: #047857;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }
    .footer-sign {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #475569;
    }
    .sign-box {
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #0f172a;
      padding-bottom: 36px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="doc-container">
    <div class="header-bar">
      <div class="company-block">
        {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}
        <img src="{{COMPANY_LOGO}}" alt="Logo" style="max-height:52px;margin-bottom:6px;object-fit:contain;">
        {{/if}}
        <h1 class="company-name">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<div class="company-desc">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</div>{{/if}}
        <div class="company-meta">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<div>{{LBL_ADDRESS}} {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>{{/if}}
          <div>
            {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span>{{LBL_TEL}}: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span> | {{LBL_FAX}}: {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
            {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span> | {{LBL_EMAIL}}: {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fiscal-pills">
          <span>RC: {{COMPANY_RC}}</span>
          <span>NIF: {{COMPANY_NIF}}</span>
          <span>AI: {{COMPANY_AI}}</span>
          <span>NIS: {{COMPANY_NIS}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="doc-badge">
        <div class="doc-type">{{INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="doc-num">N°: {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</div>
        <div class="doc-date">{{LBL_DATE}} {{DATE}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="party-card">
      <div>
        <div class="party-title">{{CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL}}</div>
        <div class="party-name">{{PARTY_NAME}}</div>
        <div class="party-details">
          {{#if PARTY_ADDRESS}}<span>{{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if PARTY_PHONE}}<span> | {{LBL_TEL}}: {{PARTY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="party-fiscal">
        <div><strong>RC:</strong> {{PARTY_RC}} | <strong>NIF:</strong> {{PARTY_NIF}}</div>
        <div><strong>AI:</strong> {{PARTY_AI}} | <strong>NIS:</strong> {{PARTY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="items-table">
      <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:6%;">{{LBL_N_INDEX}}</th>
        <th style="width:13%;">{{LBL_REF}}</th>
        <th style="width:35%;">{{LBL_DESIGNATION}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_QTY}}</th>
        <th style="width:9%;">{{LBL_UNIT}}</th>
        <th style="width:11%;">{{LBL_UNIT_PRICE}}</th>
        <th style="width:7%;">{{LBL_TVA}}</th>
        <th style="width:10%;">{{LBL_TOTAL_HT}}</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="summary-section">
      <div class="words-and-payment">
        <div class="words-box">
          <div class="words-prefix">{{LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX}}</div>
          <div class="words-text">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-meta">
          {{LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT}} <span>{{PAYMENT_MODE}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="totals-box">
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_SUBTOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{SUBTOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{#if DISCOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_DISCOUNT}}</span>
          <span class="val">-{{DISCOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TAX_TOTAL}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{TAX_TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if STAMP_AMOUNT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_STAMP}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        <div class="totals-row net-row">
          <span>{{LBL_NET_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{NET_TO_PAY}}</span>
        </div>
        
        {{#if REMAINING_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_REMAINING_PAY}}</span>
          <span class="val">{{REMAINING_DEBT}}</span>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{#if TOTAL_DEBT}}
        <div class="totals-row">
          <span>{{LBL_TOTAL_DEBT}}</span>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
```
```html
<html lang="fr" dir="ltr">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_INVOICE_TITLE}} - {{INVOICE_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
```
```html
      color: #1f2937;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .accent {
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="layout-and-table">
    .invoice-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 16px auto;
      padding: 22px 26px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .reg-strip {
      border-top: 2px double #1e3a8a;
      border-bottom: 2px double #1e3a8a;
    }

    .info-box {
      border: 1px solid #94a3b8;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* Compact products grid — many rows fit on a single page. */
    .invoice-table {
      border-collapse: collapse;
      width: 100%;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }

    .invoice-table th,
    .invoice-table td {
      border: 1px solid #475569;
      padding: 3px 5px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }

    .invoice-table th {
      font-weight: 800;
      background: #e8eefc;
      color: #1e3a8a;
    }
```
