## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\price_list.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- قائمة أسعار المنتجات — قالب واحد يخدم اللغات الثلاث.
     محايد اللغة: renderer.js يعيد كتابة <html lang/dir> ويستبدل
     مفاتيح LBL_* حسب لغة الفاتورة المضبوطة، تماماً كقوالب A5/الحرارية.

     ⚠ قاعدة التصميم هنا: **لا يعتمد شيء على طباعة الخلفيات للقراءة.**
     مسار الطباعة غير الصامتة يمرّ بـwindow.print()، و«رسوم الخلفية» مُطفأة
     افتراضياً في Chromium — فرأس جدول أسود بنصّ أبيض كان يخرج أبيضَ على أبيض.
     لذلك كل نصّ داكن على خلفية فاتحة، والفصل البصري بالخطوط لا بالكتل، مع
     print-color-adjust:exact كطبقة ثانية حين تُطبع الخلفيات فعلاً. -->
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_TITLE}} - {{COMPANY_NAME}}</title>
  <style data-purpose="page-size">
    @page { size: A4; margin: 12mm 10mm; }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="typography">
    :root {
      --ink: #0f172a;
      --ink-soft: #334155;
      --muted: #64748b;
      --hair: #e2e8f0;
      --hair-soft: #eef1f5;
      --tint: #f1f5f9;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: var(--ink);
      background-color: #e5e7eb;
      padding: 16px;
      -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
      print-color-adjust: exact;
    }
    .doc {
      width: 190mm;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: #fff;
      padding: 10mm;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="header">
    /* الترويسة: الهوية على البداية، والمعرّفات القانونية في بطاقة على النهاية.
       الحقول الفارغة تختفي كلياً بشرط «if» بدل طبع شرطات بلا معنى. */
    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
    }
    .logo-box {
      width: 64px; height: 64px; flex: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden; background: #fff;
    }
    .logo-box img { max-width: 58px; max-height: 58px; object-fit: contain; }

    .brand-main { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
    .brand-main h1 {
      margin: 0 0 1px;
      font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.2px;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }
    .tagline { margin: 0 0 3px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft); }
    .contact {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1px 14px;
      font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft);
    }
    .contact span { white-space: nowrap; }
    .contact b { font-weight: 800; color: var(--muted); }
    .contact .addr { white-space: normal; }

    /* بطاقة المعرّفات — شبكة عمودين تبقى مصطفّة مهما طال الرقم */
    .legal {
      flex: none; max-width: 62mm;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 2px 9px;
      border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 6px 9px; background: var(--tint);
      font-size: 9px;
    }
    .legal .k { font-weight: 800; color: var(--muted); }
    .legal .v {
      font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: end;
      word-break: break-all;
    }

    /* شريط العنوان: علامة رأسية + العنوان، مقابل ختم التاريخ والعدد */
    .sheet-title {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px; margin: 9px 0 7px;
    }
    .sheet-title h2 {
      margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.2px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    }
    .sheet-title h2::before {
      content: ''; display: block; width: 4px; height: 16px;
      background: var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; flex: none;
    }
    .stamp { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-align: end; line-height: 1.5; }
    .stamp b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    .scope {
      background: var(--tint); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 5px 9px; margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft);
    }
    .scope b { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 800; }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="table">
    /* جدول القائمة: خطوط أفقية فقط. الشبكة الكاملة تُثقل قائمةً طويلة بصرياً،
       والخطّ الرأسي يبقى حيث يفيد وحده: الفصل بين مجموعات الأعمدة. */
    table.items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 10px; }

    table.items th {
      padding: 6px;
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .2px;
      color: var(--ink); background: var(--tint);
      border-top: 1.2px solid var(--ink);
      border-bottom: 1.2px solid var(--ink);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    /* الرؤوس تُحاذى كأعمدتها: الاسم من البداية والسعر من النهاية */
    th.h-name { text-align: start; }
    th.h-code { text-align: start; }
    th.h-price { text-align: end; }

    table.items td {
      padding: 4.5px 6px;
      border-bottom: .6px solid var(--hair-soft);
      vertical-align: middle;
    }
    table.items tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #fafbfd; }

    .c-name { font-weight: 700; }
    .c-code {
      font-family: ui-monospace, 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--muted);
      white-space: nowrap; width: 1%;
    }
    /* الأرقام الجدولية تُصفّ الفواصل العشرية عمودياً فيُقرأ العمود دفعة واحدة */
    .c-price {
      font-weight: 900; text-align: end; white-space: nowrap;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 1%;
    }
    /* خانات الحشو في آخر صفّ: تختفي بلا خطّ ولا ظلّ */
    .c-empty { background: transparent !important; border-bottom-color: transparent !important; }

    /* الفاصل بين مجموعات الأعمدة حين تُطبع القائمة على عمودين أو ثلاثة */
    .grp-start {
      border-inline-start: 1.2px solid #cbd5e1 !important;
      padding-inline-start: 10px !important;
    }

    /* عنوان التصنيف — فاتح بنصّ داكن كي يبقى مقروءاً بلا خلفيات مطبوعة */
    tr.cat td {
      background: #e8edf3 !important;
      color: var(--ink); font-weight: 900; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .2px;
      padding: 6px 9px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    }
    /* لا يُترك عنوان تصنيف يتيماً في ذيل الصفحة وبنوده في التالية */
    tr.cat { break-after: avoid; page-break-after: avoid; }
    tr { break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }

    .foot {
      margin-top: 9px; padding-top: 6px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--hair);
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-align: center;
    }
  </style>
  <style data-purpose="print">
    @media print {
      body { background: #fff; padding: 0; }
      .doc { width: 100%; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; margin: 0; }
      /* رأس الجدول يتكرّر في كل صفحة من صفحات القائمة */
      thead { display: table-header-group; }
      tfoot { display: table-footer-group; }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body>
  <main class="doc">

    <header class="brand">
      {{#if COMPANY_LOGO}}<div class="logo-box"><img src="{{{COMPANY_LOGO}}}" alt="logo"></div>{{/if}}

      <div class="brand-main">
        <h1>{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
        {{#if COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}<p class="tagline">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>{{/if}}
        <div class="contact">
          {{#if COMPANY_ADDRESS}}<span class="addr"><b>{{LBL_ADDRESS}}</b> {{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if COMPANY_PHONE}}<span><b>{{LBL_TEL}}:</b> {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if COMPANY_FAX}}<span><b>{{LBL_FAX}}:</b> {{COMPANY_FAX}}</span>{{/if}}
          {{#if COMPANY_EMAIL}}<span><b>{{LBL_EMAIL}}:</b> {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</span>{{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- بطاقة المعرّفات القانونية يبنيها renderer صفوفاً جاهزة: محرّك القوالب
           لا يدعم شرط «if» متداخلاً، فلو غُلّفت أربعة شروط بشرط خامس لالتقط
           التعبير النمطي أوّل وسم إغلاق وأفسد الترويسة. بلا أي معرّف تختفي
           البطاقة كلها بدل إطار فارغ معلّق. -->
      {{#if LEGAL_ROWS}}<div class="legal">{{{LEGAL_ROWS}}}</div>{{/if}}
    </header>

    <section class="sheet-title">
      <h2>{{LBL_TITLE}}</h2>
      <div class="stamp">
        <div>{{LBL_DATE}} : <b>{{DATE}}</b></div>
        <div>{{LBL_ITEMS_COUNT}} : <b>{{ITEMS_COUNT}}</b></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="scope"><b>{{LBL_SCOPE}}</b> : {{SCOPE_LABEL}}</section>

    <table class="items">
      <thead>{{{TABLE_HEAD}}}</thead>
      <tbody>{{{ITEMS_ROWS}}}</tbody>
    </table>

    <p class="foot">{{LBL_FOOTER}}</p>

  </main>
</body>

</html>

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\print-engine.js`

```javascript
/**
 * print-engine.js
 * محرك الطباعة وتوليد المستندات الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS (13 نوع مستند + 53 قالب HTML)
 * يشمل:
 * - الفواتير الرسمية (مع تفصيل الدفع المختلط Split Payment Breakdown)
 * - الوصولات الحرارية (مع باركود الفاتورة وتفصيل الدفع المختلط)
 * - إشعار الدائن (Facture d'Avoir)
 * - وصل التوصيل (Bon de Livraison A4/A5/Thermal)
 * - وصل الاستلام المخزني (Bon de Réception)
 * - الفاتورة الشكلية (Facture Proforma)
 * - سند الطلبية (Bon de Commande)
 * - وصل تسديد الديون (Reçu de Paiement)
 * - الفاتورة المجمعة (Facture Récapitulative)
 * - قائمة الأسعار (Catalogue des Prix)
 * - ملصق الباركود المفرد + طابور طباعة الملصقات بالجملة (renderBatchBarcodeLabelsHtml)
 * - شهادة الضمان (Certificat de Garantie IMEI/Serial)
 * - عقد البيع بالتقسيط الرسمي (Contrat de Vente par Facilité A4)
 */

'use strict';

if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
  module.exports = {};
} else {
  const PrintEngine = (function () {
    const templateCache = new Map();

    const TEMPLATE_FILES = {
      template1: 'invoice_template_1.html',
      template2: 'invoice_template_2.html',
      template3: 'invoice_template_3.html',
      template4: 'invoice_template_4.html',
      template5: 'invoice_template_5.html',
      template6: 'invoice_template_6.html',
      template7: 'invoice_template_7.html',
      template8: 'invoice_template_8.html',
      template9: 'invoice_template_9.html',
      a5: 'invoice_template_a5.html',
      detailed: 'invoice_template_detailed.html',
      thermal80: 'invoice_thermal_80.html',
      receipt1_ar: 'receipt_template_1.html',
      receipt1_fr: 'receipt_template_1_fr.html',
      receipt1_en: 'receipt_template_1_en.html',
      receipt2_ar: 'receipt_template_2.html',
      receipt2_fr: 'receipt_template_2_fr.html',
      receipt2_en: 'receipt_template_2_en.html',
      receipt3_ar: 'receipt_template_3.html',
      receipt3_fr: 'receipt_template_3_fr.html',
      receipt3_en: 'receipt_template_3_en.html',
      receipt4_ar: 'receipt_template_4.html',
      receipt4_fr: 'receipt_template_4_fr.html',
      receipt4_en: 'receipt_template_4_en.html',
      receipt5_ar: 'receipt_template_5.html',
      receipt5_fr: 'receipt_template_5_fr.html',
      receipt5_en: 'receipt_template_5_en.html',
      credit_note_ar: 'credit_note_ar.html',
      credit_note_fr: 'credit_note_fr.html',
      credit_note_en: 'credit_note_en.html',
      delivery_ar: 'delivery_note_ar.html',
      delivery_fr: 'delivery_note_fr.html',
      delivery_en: 'delivery_note_en.html',
      delivery_a5: 'delivery_note_a5.html',
      delivery_thermal: 'delivery_note_thermal.html',
      order_ar: 'order_receipt_ar.html',
      order_fr: 'order_receipt_fr.html',
      proforma_ar: 'proforma_invoice_ar.html',
      proforma_fr: 'proforma_invoice_fr.html',
      payment_ar: 'payment_receipt_ar.html',
      payment_fr: 'payment_receipt_fr.html',
      recap_ar: 'recap_invoice_ar.html',
      recap_fr: 'recap_invoice_fr.html',
      recap_en: 'recap_invoice_en.html',
      reception_ar: 'reception_note_ar.html',
      reception_fr: 'reception_note_fr.html',
      reception_en: 'reception_note_en.html',
      sales_summary_ar: 'sales_summary_ar.html',
      sales_summary_fr: 'sales_summary_fr.html',
      sales_summary_en: 'sales_summary_en.html',
      price_list: 'price_list.html',
      barcode_label: 'barcode_label_template_1.html'
    };

    function formatMoney(value, decimals = 2) {
      const num = Number(value || 0);
      if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '0.00';
      return num.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
        maximumFractionDigits: decimals
      });
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      return String(str ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    function toWords(amount, lang = 'ar') {
      if (window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function') {
        return window.NumberToWords.toWords(Number(amount || 0), lang);
      }
      return `${formatMoney(amount)} DZD`;
    }

    function formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleOrInvoice = {}) {
      const rawMethod = String(saleOrInvoice.payment_method || 'cash').toLowerCase();
      const map = {
        cash: 'نقداً (Espèces)',
        credit: 'آجل / دين (À Terme)',
        cib: 'بطاقة بنكية / الذهبية (CIB)',
        baridimob: 'بريدي موب (BaridiMob)',
        cheque: 'شيك (Chèque)',
        installment: 'بيع بالتقسيط (Facilités)',
        split: 'دفع مختلط (Multi-Paiement)'
      };
      if (saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json) {
        try {
          const splits =
            typeof saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json === 'string'
              ? JSON.parse(saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json)
              : saleOrInvoice.split_payments_json;
          if (Array.isArray(splits) && splits.length > 0) {
            const parts = splits.map(
              (s) => `${s.method === 'cib' ? 'CIB/BaridiMob' : 'نقداً'}: ${formatMoney(s.amount)} د.ج`
            );
            const total = Number(saleOrInvoice.total || 0);
            const paid = Number(saleOrInvoice.paid_amount || 0);
            if (total - paid > 0.01) {
              parts.push(`آجل: ${formatMoney(total - paid)} د.ج`);
            }
            return parts.join(' | ');
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      return saleOrInvoice.payment_method_label || map[rawMethod] || saleOrInvoice.payment_method || 'نقداً';
    }

    async function loadTemplateHtml(fileNameOrKey) {
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[fileNameOrKey] || fileNameOrKey;
      if (templateCache.has(fileName)) {
        return templateCache.get(fileName);
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`./${fileName}`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const text = await res.text();
        templateCache.set(fileName, text);
        return text;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[PrintEngine] Could not load template ${fileName}:`, err.message);
        return '';
      }
    }

    function compileTemplate(rawHtml, data = {}) {
      if (!rawHtml) return '';
      let out = String(rawHtml);

      out = out.replace(/\{\{#if\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/if\}\}/g, (_match, key, inner) => {
        const val = data[key];
        const isTruthy =
          val !== undefined &&
          val !== null &&
          val !== false &&
          val !== '' &&
          val !== '0' &&
          val !== '0.00';
        return isTruthy ? inner : '';
      });

      out = out.replace(
        /\{\{#unless\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}([\s\S]*?)\{\{\/unless\}\}/g,
        (_match, key, inner) => {
          const val = data[key];
          const isTruthy =
            val !== undefined &&
            val !== null &&
            val !== false &&
            val !== '' &&
            val !== '0' &&
            val !== '0.00';
          return !isTruthy ? inner : '';
        }
      );

      out = out.replace(/\{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/g, (_match, key) => {
        const val = data[key];
        return val !== undefined && val !== null ? String(val) : '';
      });

      return out;
    }

    function buildCompanyVars(settings = {}) {
      return {
        COMPANY_NAME: settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS',
        COMPANY_DESCRIPTION: settings.shop_description || '',
        COMPANY_ADDRESS: settings.shop_address || '',
        COMPANY_PHONE: settings.shop_phone || '',
        COMPANY_FAX: settings.shop_fax || '',
        COMPANY_EMAIL: settings.shop_email || '',
        COMPANY_RC: settings.shop_rc || '-',
        COMPANY_NIF: settings.shop_nif || '-',
        COMPANY_AI: settings.shop_ai || '-',
        COMPANY_NIS: settings.shop_nis || '-',
        COMPANY_LOGO: settings.shop_logo || ''
      };
    }

    function getInvoiceLabels(lang = 'ar', isPurchase = false, taxPercent = 0) {
      const dicts = {
        ar: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'فاتورة',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'فاتورة شراء' : 'فاتورة بيع',
          CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'المورد' : 'الزبون',
          LBL_N_INDEX: 'الرقم',

          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'التخفيض :',

          LBL_TOTAL_DEBT: 'إجمالي الدين الحالي :',
          LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT: 'طريقة الدفع :',
          LBL_SETTLEMENT_MODE: 'طريقة التسديد',
          LBL_INVOICE_NO: 'رقم الفاتورة',

        },
        fr: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'FACTURE',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: isPurchase ? "FACTURE D'ACHAT" : 'FACTURE',

          LBL_QTY: 'Qté',

          LBL_UNIT_PRICE: 'P.U. HT',

          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'Total HT :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'Remise :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `TVA (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'Timbre :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'Net à Payer TTC :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'Ancien Solde :',
          LBL_CURRENT_DEBT: 'Solde Actuel :',

          LBL_SETTLEMENT_MODE: 'Mode Règlement',
          LBL_INVOICE_NO: 'N° Facture',
          LBL_YOUR_ORDER: 'Votre Commande',
          LBL_DELIVERY: 'Livraison',
          LBL_PAGE: 'Page',
          LBL_SIGNATURE: 'Cachet et Signature',
          LBL_DATE: 'Date :',
          LBL_TEL: 'Tél',
          LBL_FAX: 'Fax',
          LBL_EMAIL: 'Email',
          LBL_ADDRESS: 'Adresse :',
          LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX: 'Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de :'
        },
        en: {
          LBL_INVOICE_TITLE: 'INVOICE',
          INVOICE_TYPE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'PURCHASE INVOICE' : 'SALES INVOICE',
          CLIENT_ROLE_LABEL: isPurchase ? 'Supplier' : 'Customer',
          LBL_N_INDEX: '#',
          LBL_REF: 'Ref',
          LBL_DESIGNATION: 'Description',
          LBL_QTY: 'Qty',
          LBL_UNIT: 'Unit',
          LBL_UNIT_PRICE: 'Unit Price',
          LBL_TVA: 'VAT',
          LBL_TOTAL_HT: 'Total',
          LBL_SUBTOTAL: 'Subtotal :',
          LBL_DISCOUNT: 'Discount :',
          LBL_TAX_TOTAL: `VAT (${taxPercent}%) :`,
          LBL_STAMP: 'Stamp Duty :',
          LBL_NET_PAY: 'Net to Pay :',
          LBL_OLD_BALANCE: 'Previous Balance :',
          LBL_CURRENT_DEBT: 'Current Debt :',
          LBL_REMAINING_PAY: 'Remaining Due :',
          LBL_TOTAL_DEBT: 'Total Balance Due :',
          LBL_MODE_PAIEMENT: 'Payment Method :',
          LBL_SETTLEMENT_MODE: 'Payment Mode',
          LBL_INVOICE_NO: 'Invoice No.',
          LBL_YOUR_ORDER: 'Your Order',
          LBL_DELIVERY: 'Delivery',
          LBL_PAGE: 'Page',
          LBL_SIGNATURE: 'Stamp & Signature',
          LBL_DATE: 'Date :',
          LBL_TEL: 'Phone',
          LBL_FAX: 'Fax',
          LBL_EMAIL: 'Email',
          LBL_ADDRESS: 'Address :',
          LBL_TOTAL_IN_WORDS_PREFIX: 'Invoice total in words :'
        }
      };
      return dicts[lang] || dicts.ar;
    }

    async function renderInvoiceHtml(invoiceData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || settings.app_lang || 'ar';
      const templateKey = options.template || settings.invoice_template || 'template1';
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[templateKey] || 'invoice_template_1.html';
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(invoiceData.items) ? invoiceData.items : [];
      const taxPercent = Number(invoiceData.tax_percentage || 0);
      const subtotal = Number(invoiceData.subtotal ?? invoiceData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(invoiceData.discount || 0);
      const stampAmount = Number(invoiceData.stamp_amount || 0);
      const taxTotal = Number(((subtotal - discount) * (taxPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
      const netToPay = Number(invoiceData.total ?? (subtotal - discount + taxTotal + stampAmount));
      const paidAmount = Number(invoiceData.paid_amount ?? netToPay);
      const remainingDebt = Math.max(0, Number((netToPay - paidAmount).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(invoiceData.old_balance || 0);
      const totalDebt = Number((oldBalance + remainingDebt).toFixed(2));

      const isThermal = fileName.includes('thermal');
      const isTemplate9 = fileName.includes('template_9');
      const isTemplate3 = fileName.includes('template_3') && !rawTpl.includes('LBL_REF');

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it, idx) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const serialBadge = it.serial_number
          ? ` <small style="font-family:monospace;">[S/N: ${escapeHtml(it.serial_number)}]</small>`
          : '';
        const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || it.id || idx + 1);
        const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.cost_price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineTotal = Number(it.subtotal ?? it.total_cost ?? qty * price);

        if (isThermal) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <div class="t-item">
              <div class="t-name">${idx + 1}. ${name}${serialBadge}</div>
              <div class="t-line">
                <span class="muted2">${qty} × ${formatMoney(price)}</span>
                <span class="b">${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        } else if (isTemplate9) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${ref}</td>
              <td class="desig">${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '-'}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        } else if (isTemplate3) {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${idx + 1}</td>
              <td>${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        } else {
          itemsRowsHtml += `
            <tr>
              <td>${idx + 1}</td>
              <td>${ref}</td>
              <td class="text-left">${name}${serialBadge}</td>
              <td>${qty}</td>
              <td>${unit}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
              <td>${taxPercent > 0 ? taxPercent + '%' : '0%'}</td>
              <td>${formatMoney(lineTotal)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        }
      });

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(lang, Boolean(invoiceData.is_purchase), taxPercent);
      const dateStr = String(invoiceData.sale_date || invoiceData.date || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10);

      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        INVOICE_NUMBER: invoiceData.doc_number || invoiceData.invoice_number || invoiceData.id || '0001',
        DOC_NUMBER: invoiceData.doc_number || invoiceData.invoice_number || invoiceData.id || '0001',
        DATE: dateStr,
        PARTY_NAME: invoiceData.customer_name || invoiceData.supplier_name || invoiceData.party_name || 'زبون عابر',
        PARTY_PHONE: invoiceData.customer_phone || invoiceData.supplier_phone || '',
        PARTY_ADDRESS: invoiceData.customer_address || invoiceData.supplier_address || '',
        PARTY_RC: invoiceData.customer_rc || invoiceData.supplier_rc || '-',
        PARTY_NIF: invoiceData.customer_nif || invoiceData.supplier_nif || '-',
        PARTY_AI: invoiceData.customer_ai || invoiceData.supplier_ai || '-',
        PARTY_NIS: invoiceData.customer_nis || invoiceData.supplier_nis || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: itemsRowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotal),
        DISCOUNT: discount > 0 ? formatMoney(discount) : '',
        TAX_TOTAL: taxTotal > 0 ? formatMoney(taxTotal) : '',
        STAMP_AMOUNT: stampAmount > 0 ? formatMoney(stampAmount) : '',
        NET_TO_PAY: formatMoney(netToPay),
        PAID_AMOUNT: formatMoney(paidAmount),
        OLD_BALANCE: oldBalance > 0 ? formatMoney(oldBalance) : '',
        CLIENT_OLD_DEBT: formatMoney(oldBalance),
        REMAINING_DEBT: remainingDebt > 0 ? formatMoney(remainingDebt) : '',
        TOTAL_DEBT: totalDebt > 0 ? formatMoney(totalDebt) : '',
        CLIENT_TOTAL_DEBT: formatMoney(totalDebt),
        PAYMENT_MODE: formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(invoiceData),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(netToPay, lang)
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    async function renderReceiptHtml(saleData = {}, settings = {}, options = {}) {
      const lang = options.lang || settings.receipt_lang || 'ar';
      const baseNum = String(options.template || settings.receipt_template || 'receipt1').replace(/\D/g, '') || '1';
      const suffix = lang === 'fr' ? '_fr' : lang === 'en' ? '_en' : '';
      const fileName = `receipt_template_${baseNum}${suffix}.html`;
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);

      const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
      const subtotal = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? saleData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(saleData.discount || 0);
      const total = Number(saleData.total ?? subtotal - discount);
      const paid = Number(saleData.paid_amount ?? total);
      const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
      const change = Math.max(0, Number((paid - total).toFixed(2)));
      const oldBalance = Number(saleData.old_balance || 0);

      let itemsRowsHtml = '';
      items.forEach((it) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
        const qty = Number(it.quantity || 1);
        const price = Number(it.price ?? it.selling_price ?? 0);
        const lineSub = Number(it.subtotal ?? qty * price);
        itemsRowsHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${name}</td>
            <td>${qty}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(price)}</td>
            <td>${formatMoney(lineSub)}</td>
          </tr>`;
      });

      const now = new Date(saleData.sale_date || Date.now());
      const dateStr = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const timeStr = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
      const receiptNum = String(saleData.doc_number || saleData.id || '0001');
      const paperWidthMm = Number(settings.receipt_paper_width_mm || 80);

      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        RECEIPT_NUMBER: receiptNum,
        DATE: dateStr,
        TIME: timeStr,
        CLIENT_NAME: saleData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        CLIENT_CODE: saleData.customer_id || '-',
        SELLER_NAME: saleData.seller_name || 'البائع',
        ITEMS_COUNT: items.length,
        ITEMS_ROWS: itemsRowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotal),
        DISCOUNT: discount > 0 ? formatMoney(discount) : '',
        TOTAL: formatMoney(total),
        PAID: formatMoney(paid),
        RECEIPT_REST: rest > 0 ? formatMoney(rest) : '',
        REST: formatMoney(oldBalance + rest),
        OLD_BALANCE: formatMoney(oldBalance),
        CHANGE: change > 0 ? formatMoney(change) : '',
        PAYMENT_MODE: formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleData),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(total, lang)
      };

      let compiled = compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);

      if (paperWidthMm === 58) {
        compiled = compiled.replace('width: 74mm;', 'width: 54mm;');
      }

      if (saleData.split_payments_json) {
        const splitLine = `<div style="font-size:9.5px;border-top:1px dotted #000;margin-top:4px;padding-top:3px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(
          formatPaymentMethodWithSplits(saleData)
        )}</div>`;
        compiled = compiled.replace('</body>', `${splitLine}</body>`);
      }

      if (String(settings.show_receipt_barcode) !== 'false' && window.api && window.api.generateBarcodeImage) {
        try {
          const bcDataUrl = await window.api.generateBarcodeImage(receiptNum, {
            bcid: 'code128',
            height: 8,
            scale: 2
          });
          if (bcDataUrl) {
            compiled = compiled.replace(
              '</body>',
              `<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:8px;"><img src="${bcDataUrl}" style="max-width:56mm;height:11mm;object-fit:contain;"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:9px;">${receiptNum}</div></div></body>`
            );
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      return compiled;
    }

    async function renderCreditNoteHtml(saleData = {}, settings = {}, lang = 'ar') {
      const fileKey = `credit_note_${lang}`;
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(TEMPLATE_FILES[fileKey] || 'credit_note_ar.html');
      const items = Array.isArray(saleData.items) ? saleData.items : [];
      const taxPercent = Number(saleData.tax_percentage || 0);
      const subtotalHt = Number(saleData.subtotal ?? saleData.total ?? 0);
      const discount = Number(saleData.discount || 0);
      const tvaAmount = Number(((subtotalHt - discount) * (taxPercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
      const totalTtc = Number((subtotalHt - discount + tvaAmount).toFixed(2));
      const stampAmount = Number(saleData.stamp_amount || 0);
      const netToPay = Number((totalTtc + stampAmount).toFixed(2));

      const rowsHtml = items
        .map((it, idx) => {
          const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج');
          const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || it.barcode || idx + 1);
          const unit = escapeHtml(it.product_unit || it.unit || 'قطعة');
          const qty = Math.abs(Number(it.quantity || 1));
          const price = Number(it.price || 0);
          const sub = Number((qty * price).toFixed(2));
          return `<tr><td>${idx + 1}</td><td>${ref}</td><td>${name}</td><td>${unit}</td><td>${qty}</td><td>${formatMoney(
            price
          )}</td><td>${taxPercent}%</td><td>${formatMoney(sub)}</td></tr>`;
        })
        .join('');

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(lang, false, taxPercent);
      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        CREDIT_NOTE_NUMBER:
          saleData.credit_note_number || `AV-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${saleData.id || '001'}`,
        INVOICE_NUMBER: saleData.credit_note_number || saleData.doc_number || saleData.id || '001',
        ORIGINAL_INVOICE_NUMBER: saleData.original_invoice_number || saleData.doc_number || `#${saleData.id}`,
        ORIGINAL_INVOICE_DATE: String(
          saleData.original_invoice_date || saleData.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()
        ).slice(0, 10),
        RETURN_REASON: saleData.credit_note_reason || saleData.reason || 'إرجاع بضاعة / تصحيح فاتورة',
        DATE: String(saleData.credit_note_issued_at || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10),
        PARTY_NAME: saleData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر',
        PARTY_ADDRESS: saleData.customer_address || '',
        PARTY_RC: saleData.customer_rc || '-',
        PARTY_NIF: saleData.customer_nif || '-',
        PARTY_AI: saleData.customer_ai || '-',
        PARTY_NIS: saleData.customer_nis || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: rowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL_HT: formatMoney(subtotalHt),
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(subtotalHt),
        DISCOUNT: formatMoney(discount),
        TAX_PERCENT: taxPercent,
        TVA_AMOUNT: formatMoney(tvaAmount),
        TAX_TOTAL: formatMoney(tvaAmount),
        TOTAL_TTC: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        STAMP_AMOUNT: formatMoney(stampAmount),
        NET_TO_PAY: formatMoney(netToPay),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(netToPay, lang)
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    async function renderRecapInvoiceHtml(recapData = {}, settings = {}, lang = 'ar') {
      const fileName = TEMPLATE_FILES[`recap_${lang}`] || 'recap_invoice_ar.html';
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml(fileName);
      const items = Array.isArray(recapData.items) ? recapData.items : [];
      const sales = Array.isArray(recapData.sales) ? recapData.sales : [];

      const totalTtc = sales.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.total || 0), 0);
      const paidAmount = sales.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.paid_amount || 0), 0);
      const remDebt = Math.max(0, Number((totalTtc - paidAmount).toFixed(2)));

      const rowsHtml = items
        .map((it, idx) => {
          const name = escapeHtml(it.product_name || 'منتج');
          const ref = escapeHtml(it.product_barcode || idx + 1);
          const unit = escapeHtml(it.unit || 'قطعة');
          const qty = Number(it.total_qty || 1);
          const avgPrice = Number(it.avg_price || 0);
          const sub = Number(it.total_subtotal || qty * avgPrice);
          return `<tr><td>${idx + 1}</td><td>${ref}</td><td>${name}</td><td>${qty}</td><td>${unit}</td><td>${formatMoney(
            avgPrice
          )}</td><td>0%</td><td>${formatMoney(sub)}</td></tr>`;
        })
        .join('');

      const lbl = getInvoiceLabels(lang, false, 0);
      const vars = {
        ...buildCompanyVars(settings),
        ...lbl,
        RECAP_NUMBER:
          recapData.recap_number || `FR-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`,
        INVOICE_NUMBER:
          recapData.recap_number || `FR-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`,
        DATE: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        DATE_FROM: recapData.dateFrom || '-',
        DATE_TO: recapData.dateTo || '-',
        SALES_COUNT: sales.length,
        PARTY_NAME: recapData.customer?.name || 'زبون',
        PARTY_PHONE: recapData.customer?.phone || '',
        PARTY_ADDRESS: recapData.customer?.address || '',
        PARTY_RC: recapData.customer?.rc || '-',
        PARTY_NIF: recapData.customer?.nif || '-',
        PARTY_AI: recapData.customer?.ai || '-',
        PARTY_NIS: recapData.customer?.nis || '-',
        ITEMS_ROWS: rowsHtml,
        SUBTOTAL_HT: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        SUBTOTAL: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        DISCOUNT: '0.00',
        TAX_PERCENT: 0,
        TVA_AMOUNT: '0.00',
        TOTAL_TTC: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        STAMP_AMOUNT: '0.00',
        NET_TO_PAY: formatMoney(totalTtc),
        PAID_AMOUNT: formatMoney(paidAmount),
        REMAINING_DEBT: formatMoney(remDebt),
        TOTAL_IN_WORDS: toWords(totalTtc, lang)
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    async function renderBarcodeLabelHtml(labelData = {}, settings = {}) {
      const rawTpl = await loadTemplateHtml('barcode_label_template_1.html');
      const labelW = Number(labelData.widthMm || settings.label_width_mm || 40);
      const labelH = Number(labelData.heightMm || settings.label_height_mm || 25);
      const barcodeH = Number(labelData.barcodeHeightMm || settings.label_barcode_height_mm || 11);
      const isPriceMode = Boolean(labelData.priceOnlyMode);

      let barcodeImg = labelData.barcodeImage || '';
      if (!barcodeImg && !isPriceMode && labelData.barcode && window.api && window.api.generateBarcodeImage) {
        barcodeImg = await window.api.generateBarcodeImage(labelData.barcode, {
          bcid: 'code128',
          height: barcodeH,
          scale: 3
        });
      }

      const priceStr =
        labelData.price !== undefined && labelData.price !== '' ? `${formatMoney(labelData.price)} د.ج` : '';
      const computedPriceSize = Math.max(
        4.5,
        Math.min(11, (labelW / Math.max(6, priceStr.length)) * 1.45)
      ).toFixed(1);

      const vars = {
        LABEL_W: labelW,
        LABEL_H: labelH,
        BARCODE_H: barcodeH,
        PRICE_SIZE: computedPriceSize,
        MODE_CLASS: isPriceMode ? 'mode-price' : '',
        SHOP_NAME: escapeHtml(settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS'),
        PRODUCT_NAME: escapeHtml(labelData.name || ''),
        BARCODE_IMAGE: barcodeImg || '',
        BARCODE_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.barcode || ''),
        PRICE_TEXT: priceStr,
        PRICE_TYPE: escapeHtml(labelData.priceType || ''),
        DISCOUNT_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.discountText || ''),
        VARIANTS_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.variantsText || ''),
        PLU_TEXT: escapeHtml(labelData.plu || ''),
        CUST_PHONE: escapeHtml(labelData.custPhone || ''),
        CUST_DEBT: escapeHtml(labelData.custDebt || ''),
        CUST_DATE: escapeHtml(labelData.custDate || ''),
        HIDE_SHOP: labelData.showShop ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_NAME: labelData.showName === false ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_BARCODE: isPriceMode || !barcodeImg ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_BCTEXT: isPriceMode || labelData.showBarcodeText === false ? 'hidden' : '',
        HIDE_PRICE: labelData.showPrice ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_PRICETYPE: labelData.showPriceType && labelData.priceType ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_DISCOUNT: labelData.showDiscount && labelData.discountText ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_VARIANTS: labelData.showVariants && labelData.variantsText ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_PLU: labelData.showPlu && labelData.plu ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTPHONE: labelData.custPhone ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTDEBT: labelData.custDebt ? '' : 'hidden',
        HIDE_CUSTDATE: labelData.custDate ? '' : 'hidden'
      };

      return compileTemplate(rawTpl, vars);
    }

    /**
     * توليد صفحة أو رول ملصقات باركود متعددة من طابور الطباعة بالجملة (Batch Label Queue Renderer)
     */
    async function renderBatchBarcodeLabelsHtml(queueItems = [], settings = {}, cfg = {}) {
      const labelW = Number(cfg.widthMm || settings.label_width_mm || 40);
      const labelH = Number(cfg.heightMm || settings.label_height_mm || 25);
      const barcodeH = Number(cfg.barcodeHeightMm || settings.label_barcode_height_mm || 11);
      const isPriceMode = Boolean(cfg.priceOnlyMode);
      const cols = Math.max(1, parseInt(cfg.columns || 1, 10) || 1);

      const cardsHtml = [];
      for (const item of queueItems) {
        const copies = Math.max(1, parseInt(item.copies || 1, 10) || 1);
        let bcImg = '';
        if (!isPriceMode && item.barcode && window.api && window.api.generateBarcodeImage) {
          bcImg = await window.api.generateBarcodeImage(item.barcode, {
            bcid: 'code128',
            height: barcodeH,
            scale: 3
          });
        }
        const priceStr =
          item.price !== undefined && item.price !== '' ? `${formatMoney(item.price)} د.ج` : '';

        const singleBox = `
          <div class="lbl-item">
            ${cfg.showShop ? `<div class="shop">${escapeHtml(settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS')}</div>` : ''}
            ${cfg.showName !== false ? `<div class="name">${escapeHtml(item.name || '')}</div>` : ''}
            ${!isPriceMode && bcImg ? `<img src="${bcImg}" class="bc-img">` : ''}
            ${!isPriceMode && cfg.showBarcodeText !== false ? `<div class="bc-txt">${escapeHtml(item.barcode || '')}</div>` : ''}
            ${cfg.showPrice && priceStr ? `<div class="price">${priceStr}</div>` : ''}
            ${cfg.showPlu && item.plu ? `<div class="plu">PLU: ${escapeHtml(item.plu)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>`;

        for (let c = 0; c < copies; c++) {
          cardsHtml.push(singleBox);
        }
      }

      return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>طابور طباعة الملصقات — Gherbi.Ai POS</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/css/fonts.css">
  <style>

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #000; }
    .sheet-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(${cols}, ${labelW}mm);
      gap: 2mm;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 2mm;
    }
    .lbl-item {
      width: ${labelW}mm;
      height: ${labelH}mm;
      border: 0.25mm dashed #cbd5e1;
      padding: 1mm 1.5mm;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .shop { font-size: 2.2mm; font-weight: 800; }
    .name { font-size: 2.6mm; font-weight: 900; max-width: 100%; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .bc-img { width: 92%; height: ${barcodeH}mm; object-fit: contain; margin: 0.4mm 0; }
    .bc-txt { font-family: monospace; font-size: 2.3mm; font-weight: 800; }
    .price { font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: ${isPriceMode ? '5.5mm' : '3.4mm'}; font-weight: 900; margin-top: 0.3mm; }
    .plu { font-size: 2mm; font-weight: 700; }
    @media print { .lbl-item { border: none; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="sheet-grid">${cardsHtml.join('')}</div>

    }

    function renderWarrantyCertificateHtml(saleItem = {}, sale = {}, settings = {}) {

    /**

    function renderInstallmentContractHtml(plan = {}, settings = {}) {

      return `<!DOCTYPE html>

    </div>
  </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;">

      <div><strong>الباقي للتقسيط:</strong> <span style="font-family:monospace;color:#e11d48;">${formatMoney(plan.remaining_amount)} د.ج</span></div>
      <div><strong>عدد الأقساط:</strong> ${plan.months_count} أشهر</div>

  <h4 style="margin:6px 0;font-weight:900;">جدول الأقساط الشهرية المتفق عليها (Échéancier de Paiement):</h4>

  </div>

  <div class="signs">

    <div>ختم وإمضاء المتجر البائع</div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
    }

    async function printHtmlDocument(htmlContent, options = {}) {
      if (!htmlContent) return { success: false, error: 'empty_html' };
      const silent = Boolean(options.silent);

      if (silent && window.api && typeof window.api.printSilent === 'function') {
        const res = await window.api.printSilent({
          html: htmlContent,
          silent: true,
          printerName: options.printerName || undefined
        });
        if (res && res.success) return res;
      }

      // استخدام إطار طباعة دائم ومستقر في الصفحة حتى لا يُحذف أثناء فتح نافذة طباعة ويندوز
      let iframe = document.getElementById('gherbiPersistentPrintFrame');
      if (!iframe) {
        iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
        iframe.id = 'gherbiPersistentPrintFrame';
        iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
        iframe.style.right = '0';
        iframe.style.bottom = '0';
        iframe.style.width = '1px';
        iframe.style.height = '1px';
        iframe.style.opacity = '0.01';
        iframe.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        iframe.style.border = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(iframe);
      }

      const doc = iframe.contentWindow.document;
      doc.open();
      doc.write(htmlContent);
      doc.close();

      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 450));
      try {
        iframe.contentWindow.focus();
        iframe.contentWindow.print();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PrintEngine] iframe print fallback:', err);
      }

      return { success: true };
    }

    return {
      TEMPLATE_FILES,
      formatMoney,
      loadTemplateHtml,
      compileTemplate,
      renderInvoiceHtml,
      renderReceiptHtml,
      renderCreditNoteHtml,
      renderDeliveryNoteHtml,
      renderReceptionNoteHtml,
      renderProformaHtml,
      renderOrderReceiptHtml,
      renderPaymentReceiptHtml,
      renderRecapInvoiceHtml,
      renderPriceListHtml,
      renderBarcodeLabelHtml,
      renderBatchBarcodeLabelsHtml,
      renderWarrantyCertificateHtml,
      renderInstallmentContractHtml,
      printHtmlDocument
    };
  })();

  window.PrintEngine = PrintEngine;
}

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\product-write.js`

```javascript
/**
 * product-write.js
 * محرك كتابة وتحديث المنتجات، الباركودات الإضافية، مستويات الأسعار، ومصفوفة المتغيرات (Variants)
 */

'use strict';

const { processImage } = require('./imageUtils');

function createProductWriter(db) {
  function rawGet(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawGet ? db._rawGet.bind(db) : db.get.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  }

  function rawRun(sql, params = []) {
    const fn = db._rawRun ? db._rawRun.bind(db) : db.run.bind(db);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      fn(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  }

  async function freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode) {
    const clean = String(barcode || '').trim();
    if (!clean) return;

    const prod = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM products WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (prod && prod.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE products SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [prod.id]
      );
    }

    const pb = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM product_barcodes WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (pb && pb.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE product_barcodes SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [pb.id]
      );
    }

    const pv = await rawGet('SELECT id, deleted_at FROM product_variants WHERE barcode = ?', [clean]);
    if (pv && pv.deleted_at) {
      await rawRun(
        "UPDATE product_variants SET barcode = barcode || '~del~' || id, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
        [pv.id]
      );
    }
  }

  async function insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices(productId, extraBarcodes = [], extraPrices = []) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_barcodes WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
    await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_prices WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);

    for (const item of Array.isArray(extraBarcodes) ? extraBarcodes : []) {
      const bc = String((typeof item === 'object' ? item.barcode : item) || '').trim();
      const priceLabel = typeof item === 'object' && item.price_label ? String(item.price_label).trim() : null;
      if (!bc) continue;

      await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(bc);
      const existing = await rawGet('SELECT id FROM product_barcodes WHERE barcode = ?', [bc]);
      if (existing) {
        await rawRun(
          "UPDATE product_barcodes SET product_id = ?, price_label = ?, deleted_at = NULL, dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE id = ?",
          [pid, priceLabel, existing.id]
        );
      } else {
        await db.dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO product_barcodes (product_id, barcode, price_label) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
          [pid, bc, priceLabel]
        );
      }
    }

    for (const pr of Array.isArray(extraPrices) ? extraPrices : []) {
      if (!pr || typeof pr !== 'object') continue;
      const label = String(pr.label || '').trim();
      const price = Number(pr.price);
      if (!label || !Number.isFinite(price)) continue;

      await db.dbRun('INSERT INTO product_prices (product_id, label, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [
        pid,
        label,
        price
      ]);
    }
  }

  async function insertVariantData(productId, optionGroups = [], variants = [], defaultLocation = null) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const groupValueMap = new Map();

    for (let gIdx = 0; gIdx < optionGroups.length; gIdx++) {
      const g = optionGroups[gIdx];
      const gName = String(g.name || '').trim();
      if (!gName) continue;

      const gIns = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_option_groups (product_id, name, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
        [pid, gName, gIdx]
      );
      const groupId = gIns.lastID;
      const valMap = new Map();

      const values = Array.isArray(g.values) ? g.values : [];
      for (let vIdx = 0; vIdx < values.length; vIdx++) {
        const rawVal = typeof values[vIdx] === 'object' ? values[vIdx].value : values[vIdx];
        const vLabel = String(rawVal || '').trim();
        if (!vLabel) continue;

        const vIns = await db.dbRun(
          'INSERT INTO product_option_values (option_group_id, value, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
          [groupId, vLabel, vIdx]
        );
        valMap.set(vLabel.toLowerCase(), vIns.lastID);
      }
      groupValueMap.set(gName.toLowerCase(), valMap);
    }

    for (const v of Array.isArray(variants) ? variants : []) {
      const vBarcode = v.barcode ? String(v.barcode).trim() : null;
      if (vBarcode) await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(vBarcode);

      const vImg = v.image ? processImage(v.image) : null;
      const isActive = v.is_active !== undefined ? (v.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1;

      const vIns = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_variants (product_id, barcode, sku, image, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        [pid, vBarcode, v.sku || null, vImg, isActive]
      );
      const variantId = vIns.lastID;

      const optVals = v.option_values || v.options || {};
      if (Array.isArray(optVals)) {
        for (const item of optVals) {
          const gKey = String(item.group_name || item.group || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const vKey = String(item.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const vMap = groupValueMap.get(gKey);
          const optValId = vMap ? vMap.get(vKey) : null;
          if (optValId) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO variant_option_values (variant_id, option_value_id) VALUES (?, ?)',
              [variantId, optValId]
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (typeof optVals === 'object' && optVals !== null) {
        for (const [gName, valLabel] of Object.entries(optVals)) {
          const vMap = groupValueMap.get(String(gName).trim().toLowerCase());
          const optValId = vMap ? vMap.get(String(valLabel).trim().toLowerCase()) : null;
          if (optValId) {
            await db.dbRun(
              'INSERT INTO variant_option_values (variant_id, option_value_id) VALUES (?, ?)',
              [variantId, optValId]
            );
          }
        }
      }

      await db.dbRun(
        `INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
          product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date, location
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          pid,
          variantId,
          Number(v.stock ?? 0),
          Number(v.cost_price ?? 0),
          Number(v.selling_price ?? 0),
          v.wholesale_price !== undefined && v.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(v.wholesale_price) : null,
          v.expiry_date || null,
          v.location || defaultLocation || null
        ]
      );
    }
  }

  async function rewriteProductVariants(productId, variantData = {}) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const optionGroups = variantData.option_groups || variantData.optionGroups || [];
    const variants = variantData.variants || [];
    const hasVariants = variants.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM variant_option_values WHERE variant_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = ?)',
        [pid]
      );
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM product_option_values WHERE option_group_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_option_groups WHERE product_id = ?)',
        [pid]
      );
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_variants WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
      await db.dbRun('DELETE FROM product_option_groups WHERE product_id = ?', [pid]);
      await db.dbRun(
        'DELETE FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT batch_id FROM sale_items WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL)',
        [pid]
      );

      await db.dbRun('UPDATE products SET has_variants = ? WHERE id = ?', [hasVariants, pid]);

      if (hasVariants) {
        await insertVariantData(pid, optionGroups, variants, variantData.batch_location || null);
      }

      return { success: true, product_id: pid, has_variants: hasVariants };
    });
  }

  async function addProductBarcode(productId, barcode, priceLabel = null) {
    const pid = Number(productId);
    const clean = String(barcode || '').trim();
    if (!clean) throw new Error('barcode_required');

    await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(clean);
    await db.dbRun(
      'INSERT INTO product_barcodes (product_id, barcode, price_label) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      [pid, clean, priceLabel || null]
    );
    return { success: true, barcode: clean };
  }

  async function addVariantQuick(payload = {}) {
    const pid = Number(payload.productId || payload.product_id);
    const barcode = payload.barcode ? String(payload.barcode).trim() : null;
    if (barcode) await freeTombstonedProductBarcode(barcode);

    return await db.withTransaction(async () => {
      const ins = await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO product_variants (product_id, barcode, sku, is_active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)',
        [pid, barcode, payload.sku || null]
      );
      const variantId = ins.lastID;

      await db.dbRun(
        'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
        [
          pid,
          variantId,
          Number(payload.stock ?? 0),
          Number(payload.cost_price ?? 0),
          Number(payload.selling_price ?? 0)
        ]
      );

      await db.dbRun('UPDATE products SET has_variants = 1 WHERE id = ?', [pid]);
      return { success: true, variant_id: variantId };
    });
  }

  return {
    freeTombstonedProductBarcode,
    insertExtraBarcodesAndPrices,
    insertVariantData,
    rewriteProductVariants,
    addProductBarcode,
    addVariantQuick
  };
}

module.exports = {
  createProductWriter
};
```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>Recapitulative Invoice - {{RECAP_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #000;
      background-color: #f3f4f6;
    }

    .doc-container {
      width: 210mm;
      min-height: 297mm;
      margin: 20px auto;
      padding: 40px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .rounded-box {
      border: 1.5px solid #000;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .table-border,
    .table-border th,
    .table-border td {
      border: 1px solid #000;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    .table-border th {
      padding: 6px 4px;
      font-weight: bold;
      background: #f3f4f6;
    }

    .table-border td {
      padding: 6px 4px;
    }

    .recap-banner {
      background: #dbeafe;
      border: 2px solid #1d4ed8;
      color: #1e3a8a;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: inline-block;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .period-strip {
      background: #ede9fe;
      border: 1.5px dashed #6d28d9;
      color: #4c1d95;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .totals-table td {
      padding: 5px 10px;
    }

    @media print {
      body {
        background-color: #fff;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .doc-container {
        box-shadow: none;
        margin: 0;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 20px;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body class="p-4">
  <main class="doc-container mx-auto bg-white">

    <header class="mb-6">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-bold mb-1">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</h1>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_DESCRIPTION}}</p>
      <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-2 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>Phone : {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
        <div>Fax : {{COMPANY_FAX}}</div>
        <div>Email : {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-1 mt-1 font-bold text-[10px]">
        <div>CR : {{COMPANY_RC}}</div>
        <div>TIN : {{COMPANY_NIF}}</div>
        <div>AI : {{COMPANY_AI}}</div>
        <div>NIS : {{COMPANY_NIS}}</div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <section class="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
      <div class="w-[48%] rounded-box text-[10px] font-bold leading-relaxed">
        <p>Client : {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <p>Address : {{PARTY_ADDRESS}}</p>
        <p>Phone : {{PARTY_PHONE}}</p>
        <p>CR : {{PARTY_RC}}</p>
        <p>TIN : {{PARTY_NIF}}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="w-[48%] text-right pr-8">
        <span class="recap-banner">RECAPITULATIVE INVOICE</span>
        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold mt-3 mb-1">No. : {{RECAP_NUMBER}}</h2>
        <p class="text-sm font-bold">Issue date : {{DATE}}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="mb-5">
      <div class="period-strip">
        Period : from <span class="font-black">{{DATE_FROM}}</span>
        to <span class="font-black">{{DATE_TO}}</span>
        <span class="mx-2">•</span>
        Sales consolidated : <span class="font-black">{{SALES_COUNT}}</span>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="mb-6">
      <table class="w-full table-border text-center text-[10px] font-bold">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th class="w-[5%]">#</th>
            <th class="w-[12%]">Ref</th>
            <th class="w-[33%]">Description</th>
            <th class="w-[8%]">Unit</th>
            <th class="w-[10%]">Total Qty</th>
            <th class="w-[12%]">Unit price excl. tax</th>
            <th class="w-[8%]">VAT %</th>
            <th class="w-[12%]">Total excl. tax</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section class="flex justify-end mb-8">
      <table class="totals-table text-[11px] font-bold border border-black">
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td class="border-b border-black">Subtotal (excl. tax)</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right">{{SUBTOTAL_HT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="border-b border-black">Discount</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right">{{DISCOUNT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="border-b border-black">VAT ({{TAX_PERCENT}}%)</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right">{{TVA_AMOUNT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="border-b border-black">Total (incl. tax)</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right">{{TOTAL_TTC}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr data-purpose="stamp-row">
            <td class="border-b border-black">Stamp duty (1%)</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right">{{STAMP_AMOUNT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="font-black bg-slate-100">Net to pay</td>
            <td class="font-black bg-slate-100 text-right text-blue-700">{{NET_TO_PAY}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="border-b border-black">Paid</td>
            <td class="border-b border-black text-right text-emerald-700">{{PAID_AMOUNT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td class="font-black bg-slate-100">Remaining (debt)</td>
            <td class="font-black bg-slate-100 text-right text-red-700">{{REMAINING_DEBT}} DA</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <p class="text-[10px] font-bold mb-6">Amount in words : <span class="text-blue-700">{{TOTAL_IN_WORDS}}</span></p>

    <section class="flex justify-between items-start mt-10">
      <div class="w-[45%]">
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-8">Sender : {{COMPANY_NAME}}</p>
        <div class="border-t border-black w-3/4 pt-1">
          <p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-500">Signature and stamp</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="w-[45%] text-right">
        <p class="font-bold text-[10px] mb-8">Receiver : {{PARTY_NAME}}</p>
        <div class="border-t border-black w-3/4 pt-1 ml-auto">
          <p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-500">Signature and stamp</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <p class="text-[9px] text-slate-500 mt-6 text-center font-bold">
      Recapitulative invoice consolidating all sales for the client over the indicated period. Replaces individual invoices for accounting and VAT.
    </p>

  </main>
  <script>
    window.onload = function () {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print=true')) {
        setTimeout(() => { window.print(); }, 500);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\receipt_template_1.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Reçu - {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    body {
      background: #f3f4f6;
      color: #000;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .paper {
      width: 100%;
      /* عرض البكرة يأتي من إعداد receipt_paper_width_mm عبر PrintEngine.
         الافتراضي 80مم حين لا يُحقن المتغيّر (معاينة/تصدير مباشر). */
      max-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
      background: #fff;
      margin: 0 auto;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
      border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Cairo', sans-serif;
    }

    @page {
      margin: 0;
    }

    @media print {
      html, body {
        /* صندوق الصفحة هو مَن يحدّد العرض (pageSize بعرض البكرة) — لا رقم
           مثبّت هنا، وإلا خرج الوصل بعرض 80مم على بكرة 58مم. */
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        background: #fff;
      }

      .paper {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm) !important;
        box-shadow: none;
        border: none;
        max-width: none;
      }
    }

    /* ── وضوح الطباعة الحرارية ──────────────────────────────────────────────
       الطابعات الحرارية أحادية اللون تُظهر النص/الحدود الرمادية باهتة وغير
       واضحة. نفرض أسود صريحاً على كل النص والحدود داخل الوصل، ونجعل الخط عريضاً
       (700) كحد أدنى مع الإبقاء على العناوين الأثقل (font-black كما هي). */
    .paper { font-weight: 900; }
    .paper * { color: #000 !important; border-color: #000 !important; }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body>
  <main class="paper">
    <!-- Header -->
    <header class="text-center border-b-2 border-black pb-3 mb-4">
      <div class="text-xl font-black">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-1">الهاتف: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
    </header>

    <!-- Meta -->
    <section class="text-sm font-bold mb-4 space-y-1">
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <div class="font-black underline">وصل رقم</div>
        <div class="font-black">{{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs">
        <div>تاريخ: {{DATE}}</div>
        <div class="italic">وقت: {{TIME}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold pt-2">الزبون: {{CLIENT_NAME}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold">البائع: {{SELLER_NAME}}</div>
    </section>

    <!-- Items -->
    <section class="mb-4">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-12 gap-1 bg-slate-100 border border-black rounded-xl p-2 text-xs font-black">
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">كمية</div>
        <div class="col-span-6 text-center">المنتج</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">سعر</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">مجموع</div>
      </div>

      <div class="mt-2 border border-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <table class="w-full text-xs">
          <tbody>
            {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Totals -->
    <section class="border-t-2 border-black pt-3 text-sm font-black space-y-2">
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <div>المجموع:</div>
        <div>{{TOTAL}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold">
        <div>المدفوع =</div>
        <div>{{PAID}}</div>
      </div>
      <div
        class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 pt-1 border-t border-dashed mt-2 border-slate-300">
        <div>الرصيد السابق :</div>
        <div>{{OLD_BALANCE}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700">
        <div>المتبقي للدفع :</div>
        <div>{{RECEIPT_REST}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-black pt-1">
        <div>إجمالي الديون :</div>
        <div class="underline">{{REST}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-6">
      شكراً لزيارتكم.
    </footer>
  </main>
</body>

</html>
```

    .paper {
      width: 100%;
      /* عرض البكرة يأتي من إعداد receipt_paper_width_mm عبر PrintEngine.
         الافتراضي 80مم حين لا يُحقن المتغيّر (معاينة/تصدير مباشر). */
      max-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
      background: #fff;
      margin: 0 auto;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
      border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Cairo', sans-serif;
    }

    @page {
      margin: 0;
    }

    @media print {
      html, body {
        /* صندوق الصفحة هو مَن يحدّد العرض (pageSize بعرض البكرة) — لا رقم
           مثبّت هنا، وإلا خرج الوصل بعرض 80مم على بكرة 58مم. */
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        background: #fff;
      }

      .paper {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm) !important;
        box-shadow: none;
        border: none;
        max-width: none;
      }
    }

    /* ── Thermal print legibility ───────────────────────────────────────────
       Monochrome thermal printers render gray text/borders faint and unclear.
       Force pure black on all receipt text and borders, and a minimum bold
       weight (700) while keeping heavier headings (font-black) intact. */
    .paper { font-weight: 700; }
    .paper * { color: #000 !important; border-color: #000 !important; }
  </style>
  <link href="assets/css/fonts.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>

<body>
  <main class="paper">
    <!-- Header -->
    <header class="text-center border-b-2 border-black pb-3 mb-4">
      <div class="text-xl font-black">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-1">Tel: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</div>
    </header>

    <!-- Meta -->
    <section class="text-sm font-bold mb-4 space-y-1">
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <div class="font-black underline">Receipt #</div>
        <div class="font-black">{{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs">
        <div>Date: {{DATE}}</div>
        <div class="italic">Time: {{TIME}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold pt-2">Client: {{CLIENT_NAME}}</div>
      <div class="text-xs font-bold">Seller: {{SELLER_NAME}}</div>
    </section>

    <!-- Items -->
    <section class="mb-4">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-12 gap-1 bg-slate-100 border border-black rounded-xl p-2 text-xs font-black">
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">Qty</div>
        <div class="col-span-6 text-center">Items</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">Price</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-center">Total</div>
      </div>

      <div class="mt-2 border border-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <table class="w-full text-xs">
          <tbody>
            {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Totals -->
    <section class="border-t-2 border-black pt-3 text-sm font-black space-y-2">
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <div>Total:</div>
        <div>{{TOTAL}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold">
        <div>Paid =</div>
        <div>{{PAID}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 pt-1 border-t border-dashed mt-2 border-slate-300">
        <div>PREVIOUS BALANCE :</div>
        <div>{{OLD_BALANCE}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700">
        <div>REMAINING TO PAY :</div>
        <div>{{RECEIPT_REST}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-black pt-1">
        <div>TOTAL DEBT :</div>
        <div class="underline">{{REST}}</div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-6">
      Thank you for your visit.
    </footer>
  </main>
</body>

</html>

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport" />
  <title>Reçu - {{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</title>
  <script src="assets/js/tailwind.min.js"></script>
  <!-- بلا خطوط بعيدة: طلبُ شبكةٍ داخل نافذة الطباعة يؤخّر حدث load (حتى مهلة
       الحارس على شبكة بطيئة)، والأسوأ أنه يجعل ارتفاع الوصل غير حتمي — نقيس
       بخطٍّ احتياطي ثم يصل خطّ الويب فيقصُر المطبوع عن الصفحة المطلوبة ⇒ فراغ
       في ذيل الورق «أحياناً». المكدّس أدناه محلّي بالكامل. -->
  <style>
    :root {
      /* عرض البكرة من إعداد receipt_paper_width_mm عبر PrintEngine؛ 80مم
         افتراضاً حين لا يُحقن المتغيّر (معاينة/تصدير مباشر). */
      --paper-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
    }

    body {
      background: #e4e4e7;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      color: #000;
    }

    .thermal-width {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--paper-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .dashed-separator {
      border-top: 1px dashed #000;
    }

    @page {
      margin: 0;
    }

    @media print {
      html, body {
        /* صندوق الصفحة هو مَن يحدّد العرض — لا رقم مثبّت هنا. */
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        background: #fff;
      }

      .thermal-width {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        border: none !important;
        max-width: none !important;
      }

      .no-print {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .shadow-xl {
        box-shadow: none !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<!-- py-8 و min-h-screen زينةُ معاينةٍ على الشاشة (تُوسّط الورقة على خلفية
     رمادية). وقت الطباعة تصير 8.5مم ورقاً أبيض قبل الوصل وصفحةً تُملأ قسراً،
     فتُطفأ بمتغيّر print: — قاعدة @media print العامة كانت تخسر أمام أصناف
     Tailwind في الترجيح. -->
<body class="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center py-8 print:py-0 print:min-h-0">
  <main class="thermal-width bg-white p-2 shadow-xl border-t-8 border-black">
    <!-- Brand Header -->
    <section class="text-center mb-3">
      <h1 class="font-black text-2xl tracking-tighter leading-none mb-1"
        style="font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;">
        {{COMPANY_NAME}}
      </h1>
      <p class="text-[8px] font-bold text-zinc-600 mt-1">{{COMPANY_ADDRESS}}</p>
      <p class="text-[8px] font-bold text-zinc-600">الهاتف: {{COMPANY_PHONE}}</p>
    </section>

    <div class="dashed-separator my-2"></div>

    <!-- Meta -->
    <section class="text-[8px] font-bold text-zinc-700 space-y-1 mb-2">
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span>وصل رقم</span>
        <span class="font-black">{{RECEIPT_NUMBER}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span>{{DATE}}</span>
        <span>{{TIME}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span>الزبون</span>
        <span class="font-black">{{CLIENT_NAME}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span>البائع</span>
        <span class="font-black">{{SELLER_NAME}}</span>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="dashed-separator my-2"></div>

    <!-- Table Headers -->
    <section class="mb-2">
      <div class="grid grid-cols-12 gap-x-0.5 text-[6px] font-black border-b border-black pb-1 mb-1">
        <div class="col-span-3">المرجع</div>
        <div class="col-span-4">البيان</div>
        <div class="col-span-1 text-center">الكمية</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-left">السعر</div>
        <div class="col-span-2 text-left">المجموع</div>
      </div>

      <!-- Rows -->
      <div class="space-y-2">
        {{ITEMS_ROWS}}
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="dashed-separator my-2"></div>

    <!-- Financial Summary -->
    <section class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4">
      <!-- Left Column -->
      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">عدد العناصر</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{ITEMS_COUNT}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">التخفيض</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{DISCOUNT}} DZD</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">الرصيد السابق</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{OLD_BALANCE}} DZD</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">المتبقي للدفع</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{RECEIPT_REST}} DZD</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Right Column -->
      <div class="space-y-1 text-left">
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">المجموع</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{TOTAL}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col p-1 border border-black">
          <span class="text-[7px] font-black uppercase">الصافي للدفع</span>
          <span class="text-xs font-black">{{TOTAL}} DZD</span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col">
          <span class="text-[6px] font-black uppercase text-zinc-500">المدفوع</span>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold">{{PAID}} DZD</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <div class="dashed-separator my-2"></div>
    <div class="text-center font-black text-xs">إجمالي الديون: {{REST}} DZD</div>

    <div class="mt-4 text-center text-[8px] font-bold text-zinc-600">
      شكراً لزيارتكم.
    </div>
  </main>
</body>

</html>
```
