## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\till-ledger.js`

```javascript
/**
 * till-ledger.js
 * محرك إدارة جلسات الخزينة (Caisse Sessions) وحساب الأرصدة ومزامنة المبيعات النقدية
 */

'use strict';

function dbGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
  });
}

function dbAll(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
  });
}

function dbRun(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * إيجاد الجلسة المفتوحة حالياً للمستخدم أو للجهاز الحالي
 */
async function resolveOpenSession(db, preferredSessionId = null, userId = null, deviceId = null) {
  if (preferredSessionId) {
    const row = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL",
      [Number(preferredSessionId)]
    );
    if (row && row.id) return row.id;
  }

  if (userId) {
    const userRow = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1",
      [Number(userId)]
    );
    if (userRow && userRow.id) return userRow.id;
  }

  if (deviceId) {
    const devRow = await dbGet(
      db,
      "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE device_id = ? AND status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1",
      [String(deviceId)]
    );
    if (devRow && devRow.id) return devRow.id;
  }

  const anyOpen = await dbGet(
    db,
    "SELECT id FROM caisse_sessions WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1"
  );
  return anyOpen ? anyOpen.id : null;
}

/**
 * حساب ملخص جلسة خزينة محددة والرصيد المتوقع في الدرج
 */
async function computeSessionSummary(db, sessionId) {
  const session = await dbGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT cs.*, u.name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role
    FROM caisse_sessions cs
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = cs.user_id
    WHERE cs.id = ? AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [Number(sessionId)]
  );
  if (!session) return null;

  const txs = await dbAll(
    db,
    `
    SELECT *, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) AS created_at
    FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE session_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY id DESC
    `,
    [Number(sessionId)]
  );

  let totalSalesCash = 0;
  let totalDebtPayments = 0;
  let totalOrderDeposits = 0;
  let totalCashIn = 0;
  let totalCashOut = 0;
  let totalExpenses = 0;
  let totalRefunds = 0;

  for (const tx of txs) {
    const amt = Math.abs(Number(tx.amount || 0));
    switch (tx.type) {
      case 'sale_cash':
      case 'sale':
        totalSalesCash += amt;
        break;
      case 'debt_payment':
        totalDebtPayments += amt;
        break;
      case 'order_deposit':
        totalOrderDeposits += amt;
        break;
      case 'cash_in':
        totalCashIn += amt;
        break;
      case 'cash_out':
        totalCashOut += amt;
        break;
      case 'expense':
        totalExpenses += amt;
        break;
      case 'sale_refund':
        totalRefunds += amt;
        break;
      default:
        if (Number(tx.amount) >= 0) totalCashIn += amt;
        else totalCashOut += amt;
        break;
    }
  }

  const openingBalance = Number(session.opening_balance || 0);
  const currentBalance = Number(
    (
      openingBalance +
      totalSalesCash +
      totalDebtPayments +
      totalOrderDeposits +
      totalCashIn -
      totalCashOut -
      totalExpenses -
      totalRefunds
    ).toFixed(2)
  );

  return {
    session,
    transactions: txs,
    summary: {
      openingBalance,
      totalSalesCash: Number((totalSalesCash + totalDebtPayments + totalOrderDeposits).toFixed(2)),
      totalDebtPayments: Number(totalDebtPayments.toFixed(2)),
      totalOrderDeposits: Number(totalOrderDeposits.toFixed(2)),
      totalCashIn: Number(totalCashIn.toFixed(2)),
      totalCashOut: Number(totalCashOut.toFixed(2)),
      totalExpenses: Number(totalExpenses.toFixed(2)),
      totalRefunds: Number(totalRefunds.toFixed(2)),
      currentBalance,
      expectedBalance: currentBalance
    }
  };
}

/**
 * قيد أو تحديث الأثر النقدي لفاتورة بيع في جلسة الخزينة المفتوحة
 */
async function applySaleTillDelta(db, {
  saleId,
  sessionId = null,
  userId = null,
  paidAmount = 0,
  totalAmount = 0,
  paymentMethod = 'cash'
}) {
  if (!saleId) return null;

  // لا نقيد في درج النقدية إلا المدفوعات النقدية
  if (paymentMethod && String(paymentMethod).toLowerCase() !== 'cash') {
    await reverseSaleTill(db, saleId);
    return null;
  }

  const activeSessionId = await resolveOpenSession(db, sessionId, userId);
  if (!activeSessionId) return null;

  const isReturnSale = Number(totalAmount || 0) < 0 || Number(paidAmount || 0) < 0;
  const absPaid = Math.abs(Number(paidAmount || 0));

  const existingTx = await dbGet(
    db,
    `
    SELECT id FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE reference_id = ? AND type IN ('sale_cash', 'sale_refund') AND deleted_at IS NULL
    LIMIT 1
    `,
    [Number(saleId)]
  );

  if (absPaid < 0.009) {
    if (existingTx) {
      await dbRun(db, 'DELETE FROM caisse_transactions WHERE id = ?', [existingTx.id]);
    }
    return activeSessionId;
  }

  const txType = isReturnSale ? 'sale_refund' : 'sale_cash';
  const desc = isReturnSale ? `مرتجع فاتورة بيع #${saleId}` : `مبيعات فاتورة #${saleId}`;

  if (existingTx) {
    await dbRun(
      db,
      'UPDATE caisse_transactions SET session_id = ?, type = ?, amount = ?, description = ? WHERE id = ?',
      [activeSessionId, txType, absPaid, desc, existingTx.id]
    );
  } else {
    await dbRun(
      db,
      `
      INSERT INTO caisse_transactions (
        session_id, type, amount, category, description, reference_id, reference_uuid
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'sales', ?, ?, (SELECT uuid FROM sales WHERE id = ?))
      `,
      [activeSessionId, txType, absPaid, desc, Number(saleId), Number(saleId)]
    );
  }

  return activeSessionId;
}

/**
 * إلغاء الأثر النقدي لفاتورة بيع عند حذفها
 */
async function reverseSaleTill(db, saleId) {
  if (!saleId) return;
  await dbRun(
    db,
    `
    DELETE FROM caisse_transactions
    WHERE (reference_id = ? OR reference_uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM sales WHERE id = ?))
      AND type IN ('sale_cash', 'sale_refund')
    `,
    [Number(saleId), Number(saleId)]
  );
}

module.exports = {
  resolveOpenSession,
  computeSessionSummary,
  applySaleTillDelta,
  reverseSaleTill
};
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\verify-system.js`

```javascript
/**
 * verify-system.js
 * منظومة الفحص الهندسي والاختبار الآلي الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 * تتحقق من سلامة الملفات، القواعد النحوية (Syntax)، وقواعد البيانات والمحركات الحسابية
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = __dirname;

const REQUIRED_CORE_FILES = [
  'package.json',
  'main.js',
  'preload.js',
  'preload-activation.js',
  'renderer.js',
  'server.js',
  'database.js',
  'db-write-queue.js',
  'soft-delete.js',
  'data-revision.js',
  'stock-ledger.js',
  'till-ledger.js',
  'batch-alloc.js',
  'product-write.js',
  'imageUtils.js',
  'analytics-queries.js',
  'api-client.js',
  'cloud-db-sync.js',
  'cloud-diagnostics.js',
  'cloud-sync.js',
  'device-auth.js',
  'licenseManager.js',
  'scale-bridge.js',
  'scale-protocols.js',
  'print-engine.js',
  'index.html',
  'activation.html',
  'styles.css',
  'manufacturing/production-guard.js',
  'manufacturing/pos-produce.js',
  'manufacturing/manufacturing.js',
  'manufacturing/manufacturing-ui.js',
  'stocktake/stocktake-guard.js',
  'stocktake/stocktake-ui.js',
  'template-designer/template-i18n.js',
  'template-designer/template-presets.js',
  'template-designer/template-renderer.js',
  'template-designer/template-builder.js',
  'assets/js/numberToWords.js',
  'assets/js/translations.js',
  'assets/css/fonts.css',
  'assets/css/material-symbols.css'
];

async function runFullVerification() {
  console.log('==============================================================');
  console.log('🔍 بدء الفحص الهندسي الشامل لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS');
  console.log('==============================================================\n');

  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  function recordResult(label, ok, detail = '') {
    if (ok) {
      passed += 1;
      console.log(`✅ [PASS] ${label}`);
    } else {
      failed += 1;
      console.error(`❌ [FAIL] ${label} ${detail ? '--> ' + detail : ''}`);
    }
  }

  // 1. فحص وجود الملفات الأساسية وعدم كونها فارغة
  console.log('--- 1. فحص الملفات الأساسية والوحدات البرمجية ---');
  for (const relPath of REQUIRED_CORE_FILES) {
    const fullPath = path.join(ROOT, relPath);
    const exists = fs.existsSync(fullPath);
    const size = exists ? fs.statSync(fullPath).size : 0;
    recordResult(`الملف ${relPath}`, exists && size > 10, !exists ? 'غير موجود' : size <= 10 ? 'ملف فارغ' : '');
  }

  // 2. فحص القواعد النحوية (JavaScript Syntax Validation) لجميع ملفات .js
  console.log('\n--- 2. فحص سلامة الكود البرمجي (JS Syntax Check) ---');
  const jsFiles = REQUIRED_CORE_FILES.filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js'));
  for (const jsFile of jsFiles) {
    const fullPath = path.join(ROOT, jsFile);
    if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) continue;
    try {
      const code = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      new vm.Script(code, { filename: jsFile });
      recordResult(`سلامة القواعد النحوية في ${jsFile}`, true);
    } catch (err) {
      recordResult(`سلامة القواعد النحوية في ${jsFile}`, false, err.message);
    }
  }

  // 3. فحص قوالب الطباعة
  console.log('\n--- 3. فحص منظومة قوالب الطباعة HTML ---');
  const allRootFiles = fs.readdirSync(ROOT);
  const htmlTemplates = allRootFiles.filter(
    (f) => f.endsWith('.html') && f !== 'index.html' && f !== 'activation.html'
  );
  recordResult(
    `عدد قوالب الطباعة المولدة (${htmlTemplates.length} قالب)`,
    htmlTemplates.length >= 40,
    htmlTemplates.length < 40 ? 'يرجى تشغيل node generate-print-templates.js أولاً' : ''
  );

  // 4. اختبار المحركات البرمجية والمنطقية (Integration Tests)
  console.log('\n--- 4. اختبار المحركات الحسابية وقاعدة البيانات ---');
  try {
    // أ) اختبار محرك التفقيط باللغات الثلاث
    const tafqeet = require('./assets/js/numberToWords');
    const arWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'ar');
    const frWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'fr');
    const enWords = tafqeet.toWords(15420.5, 'en');
    recordResult('محرك التفقيط المالي (العربية / الفرنسية / الإنجليزية)', Boolean(arWords && frWords && enWords));

    // ب) اختبار محرك الترجمة الثلاثي
    const { getTranslation } = require('./assets/js/translations');
    recordResult(
      'محرك الترجمة المركزي (RTL / LTR)',
      getTranslation('ar', 'nav_pos') === 'شاشة المبيعات' &&
        getTranslation('fr', 'nav_pos') === 'Point de Vente (POS)'
    );

    // ج) اختبار محرك التراخيص المفتوح للمالك
    const licenseManager = require('./licenseManager');
    const licStatus = await licenseManager.getLicenseStatus();
    recordResult(
      'محرك الترخيص الدائم (PRO Lifetime)',
      Boolean(licStatus && licStatus.isActivated === true && licStatus.isTrial === false && licStatus.hwid)
    );

    // د) اختبار محرك تفكيك باركود الميزان
    const { parseScaleBarcode } = require('./scale-protocols');
    const scaleParsed = parseScaleBarcode('2000105012504', { scale_barcode_enabled: 'true' });
    recordResult(
      'محرك تفكيك باركود الميزان الإلكتروني (PLU & Weight)',
      Boolean(scaleParsed && scaleParsed.pluCode === '00105' && scaleParsed.weight === 1.25)
    );

    // هـ) اختبار قاعدة البيانات والمحركات الذرية (في حال تثبيت sqlite3)
    const db = require('./database');
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));

    const tables = await db.dbAll("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'");
    recordResult(`مخطط قاعدة البيانات SQLite WAL (${tables.length} جدولاً)`, tables.length >= 40);

    // اختبار الإحصائيات وحاسبة الزكاة والمساعد الذكي
    const analyticsQueries = require('./analytics-queries');
    const stats = await analyticsQueries.getAnalytics(db, {});
    const copilot = await analyticsQueries.getAiCopilotInsights(db);
    recordResult(
      'محرك الإحصائيات وحاسبة الزكاة و Gherbi.Ai Copilot',
      Boolean(stats && Array.isArray(stats.debtAging) && stats.zakat && copilot)
    );
  } catch (err) {
    recordResult('اختبار المحركات الخلفية', false, err.message);
  }

  console.log('\n==============================================================');
  console.log(`📊 النتيجة النهائية: نجح (${passed}) اختبار | فشل (${failed}) اختبار`);
  console.log('==============================================================');

  if (failed === 0) {
    console.log('🚀 النظام جاهز تماماً للتشغيل عبر: npm run dev');
  } else {
    console.log('⚠️ يرجى مراجعة الملاحظات أعلاه قبل التشغيل.');
  }
}

runFullVerification();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\assets\css\fonts.css`

```css
/**
 * assets/css/fonts.css
 * محرك الخطوط المحلية لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS (Offline Fonts Engine)
 * يعتمد على خطوط Cairo و Tajawal المحملة محلياً لضمان عمل النظام بدون إنترنت
 */

/* ==========================================================================
   1. خط Cairo (للواجهة الأساسية والعناوين)
   ========================================================================== */
@font-face {
    font-family: 'Cairo';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Cairo'), url('../fonts/Cairo-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Cairo';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Cairo SemiBold'), url('../fonts/Cairo-SemiBold.woff2') format('woff2');
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Cairo';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Cairo Bold'), url('../fonts/Cairo-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Cairo';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Cairo Black'), url('../fonts/Cairo-Black.woff2') format('woff2');
}

/* ==========================================================================
   2. خط Tajawal (للفواتير الرسمية والطباعة الكلاسيكية)
   ========================================================================== */
@font-face {
    font-family: 'Tajawal';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Tajawal'), url('../fonts/Tajawal-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Tajawal';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-display: swap;
    src: local('Tajawal Bold'), url('../fonts/Tajawal-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
}
```

```css
/**
 * assets/css/material-symbols.css
 * تنسيق موحد لحاويات الأيقونات المتجهة (.material-symbols-rounded & .material-symbols-outlined)
 */

.material-symbols-rounded,
.material-symbols-outlined {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 1.35em;
  height: 1.35em;
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1;
  vertical-align: middle;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  user-select: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.material-symbols-rounded svg,
.material-symbols-outlined svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  fill: currentColor;
  display: block;
}

.icon-sm { font-size: 18px; width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.icon-md { font-size: 24px; width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.icon-lg { font-size: 32px; width: 32px; height: 32px; }
.icon-xl { font-size: 48px; width: 48px; height: 48px; }
```

```javascript
 * assets/js/numberToWords.js
 * محرك التفقيط المالي (Financial Number to Words Engine) لـ Gherbi.Ai POS
 * يدعم: العربية (بقواعد النحو للإفراد والتثنية والجمع)، الفرنسية، والإنجليزية.
 * مخصص خصيصاً للعملة الجزائرية (الدينار والسنتيم).
 */

'use strict';

const NumberToWords = (function () {
    // ============================================================================
    // 1. القاموس العربي (Arabic Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const arUnits = ["", "واحد", "اثنان", "ثلاثة", "أربعة", "خمسة", "ستة", "سبعة", "ثمانية", "تسعة"];
    const arTeens = ["عشرة", "أحد عشر", "اثنا عشر", "ثلاثة عشر", "أربعة عشر", "خمسة عشر", "ستة عشر", "سبعة عشر", "ثمانية عشر", "تسعة عشر"];
    const arTens = ["", "عشرة", "عشرون", "ثلاثون", "أربعون", "خمسون", "ستون", "سبعون", "ثمانون", "تسعون"];
    const arHundreds = ["", "مائة", "مائتان", "ثلاثمائة", "أربعمائة", "خمسمائة", "ستمائة", "سبعمائة", "ثمانمائة", "تسعمائة"];

    function convertArabicGroup(num) {
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let t = Math.floor((num % 100) / 10);
        let u = num % 10;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += arHundreds[h];
        }

        let tensUnits = "";
        if (t === 0) {
            if (u > 0) tensUnits = arUnits[u];
        } else if (t === 1) {
            tensUnits = arTeens[u];
        } else {
            if (u > 0) {
                tensUnits = arUnits[u] + " و" + arTens[t];
            } else {
                tensUnits = arTens[t];
            }
        }

        if (tensUnits !== "") {
            if (str !== "") str += " و";
            str += tensUnits;
        }
        return str;
    }

    function tafqeetArabic(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "صفر دينار جزائري";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);

        let dinarStr = "";
        if (dinars === 1) dinarStr = "دينار جزائري واحد";
        else if (dinars === 2) dinarStr = "ديناران جزائريان";
        else if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) {
                if (billions === 1) parts.push("مليار");
                else if (billions === 2) parts.push("ملياران");
                else if (billions >= 3 && billions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليارات");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(billions) + " مليار");
            }

            if (millions > 0) {
                if (millions === 1) parts.push("مليون");
                else if (millions === 2) parts.push("مليونان");
                else if (millions >= 3 && millions <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " ملايين");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(millions) + " مليون");
            }

            if (thousands > 0) {
                if (thousands === 1) parts.push("ألف");
                else if (thousands === 2) parts.push("ألفان");
                else if (thousands >= 3 && thousands <= 10) parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " آلاف");
                else parts.push(convertArabicGroup(thousands) + " ألف");
            }

            if (remainder > 0) {
                parts.push(convertArabicGroup(remainder));
            }

            dinarStr = parts.join(" و") + " دينار جزائري";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            if (centimes === 1) centimeStr = "سنتيم واحد";
            else if (centimes === 2) centimeStr = "سنتيمان";
            else if (centimes >= 3 && centimes <= 10) centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتميات";
            else centimeStr = convertArabicGroup(centimes) + " سنتيماً";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " و " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 2. القاموس الفرنسي (French Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const frUnits = ["", "un", "deux", "trois", "quatre", "cinq", "six", "sept", "huit", "neuf"];
    const frTeens = ["dix", "onze", "douze", "treize", "quatorze", "quinze", "seize", "dix-sept", "dix-huit", "dix-neuf"];
    const frTens = ["", "dix", "vingt", "trente", "quarante", "cinquante", "soixante", "soixante-dix", "quatre-vingts", "quatre-vingt-dix"];

    function convertFrenchGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            if (h === 1) str += "cent ";
            else str += frUnits[h] + " cent " + (rem === 0 ? "s " : "");
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (rem < 10) str += frUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += frTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                if (t === 7) {
                    str += (u === 1 ? "soixante et onze" : "soixante-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : ""));
                } else if (t === 9) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt-dix" + (u > 0 ? "-" + frUnits[u] : "");
                } else if (t === 8) {
                    str += "quatre-vingt" + (u === 0 ? "s" : "-" + frUnits[u]);
                } else {
                    str += frTens[t];
                    if (u === 1) str += " et un";
                    else if (u > 1) str += "-" + frUnits[u];
                }
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetFrench(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zéro Dinar Algérien";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(billions) + (billions > 1 ? " milliards" : " milliard"));
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(millions) + (millions > 1 ? " millions" : " million"));
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push((thousands === 1 ? "mille" : convertFrenchGroup(thousands) + " mille"));
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertFrenchGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Dinars Algériens";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertFrenchGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        let result = "";
        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) result = dinarStr + " et " + centimeStr;
        else if (centimeStr) result = centimeStr;
        else result = dinarStr;

        // رسملة الحرف الأول
        return result.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + result.slice(1);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 3. القاموس الإنجليزي (English Dictionary - DZD)
    // ============================================================================
    const enUnits = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"];
    const enTeens = ["Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"];
    const enTens = ["", "Ten", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];

    function convertEnglishGroup(num) {
        if (num === 0) return "";
        let str = "";
        let h = Math.floor(num / 100);
        let rem = num % 100;

        if (h > 0) {
            str += enUnits[h] + " Hundred ";
        }

        if (rem > 0) {
            if (h > 0) str += "and ";
            if (rem < 10) str += enUnits[rem];
            else if (rem < 20) str += enTeens[rem - 10];
            else {
                let t = Math.floor(rem / 10);
                let u = rem % 10;
                str += enTens[t];
                if (u > 0) str += "-" + enUnits[u];
            }
        }
        return str.trim();
    }

    function tafqeetEnglish(number) {
        if (number === 0) return "Zero Algerian Dinars";

        const dinars = Math.floor(number);
        const centimes = Math.round((number - dinars) * 100);
        let dinarStr = "";

        if (dinars > 0) {
            let parts = [];
            let billions = Math.floor(dinars / 1000000000);
            let millions = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000000) / 1000000);
            let thousands = Math.floor((dinars % 1000000) / 1000);
            let remainder = dinars % 1000;

            if (billions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(billions) + " Billion");
            if (millions > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(millions) + " Million");
            if (thousands > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(thousands) + " Thousand");
            if (remainder > 0) parts.push(convertEnglishGroup(remainder));

            dinarStr = parts.join(" ") + " Algerian Dinars";
        }

        let centimeStr = "";
        if (centimes > 0) {
            centimeStr = convertEnglishGroup(centimes) + " Centimes";
        }

        if (dinarStr && centimeStr) return dinarStr + " and " + centimeStr;
        if (centimeStr) return centimeStr;
        return dinarStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // التصدير للاستخدام العام (Public API)
    // ============================================================================
    return {
        /**
         * تحويل رقم مالي إلى حروف حسب اللغة المطلوبة
         * @param {number} num - المبلغ المالي
         * @param {string} lang - رمز اللغة ('ar', 'fr', 'en')
         * @returns {string} المبلغ مفقطاً بالحروف
         */
        toWords: function (num, lang = 'ar') {
            const cleanNum = Number(num);
            if (isNaN(cleanNum)) return "";

            const l = String(lang).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (l === 'fr') return tafqeetFrench(cleanNum);
            if (l === 'en') return tafqeetEnglish(cleanNum);
            
            // الافتراضي هو العربية
            return "فقط " + tafqeetArabic(cleanNum) + " لا غير.";
        }
    };
})();

// توافقية التصدير ليعمل في Node.js (للخلفية) والمتصفح (للواجهة الأمامية)
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = NumberToWords;
} else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.NumberToWords = NumberToWords;
}
```

```javascript
  const DEFAULT_PATH = 'M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm1 15h-2v-6h2v6zm0-8h-2V7h2v2z';
  const ICON_SELECTOR = '.material-symbols-rounded, .material-symbols-outlined';

  function convertSpanToSvg(el) {
    if (!el || el.dataset.svgRendered === '1') return;
    if (el.querySelector('svg')) {
      el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
      return;
    }
    const rawName = String(el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!rawName) return;

    const d = PATHS[rawName] || DEFAULT_PATH;
    el.dataset.iconName = rawName;
    el.dataset.svgRendered = '1';
    el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${d}"/></svg>`;
  }

  function scanAndRenderIcons(root = document) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    const nodes = root.querySelectorAll(ICON_SELECTOR);
    nodes.forEach(convertSpanToSvg);
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      scanAndRenderIcons(document);
      const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const m of mutations) {
          for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              if (
                node.classList &&
                (node.classList.contains('material-symbols-rounded') ||
                  node.classList.contains('material-symbols-outlined'))
              ) {
                convertSpanToSvg(node);
              }
              scanAndRenderIcons(node);
            }
          }
        }
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
  }

  window.SvgIconEngine = { scanAndRenderIcons, convertSpanToSvg };
})();
```

```javascript
};

// وظيفة جلب النص بناءً على اللغة المفعلة حالياً
function getTranslation(lang, key) {
    const defaultLang = 'ar';
    const langDict = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang];
    return langDict[key] || TRANSLATIONS[defaultLang][key] || key;
}

// التصدير للاستخدام في الخلفية أو الواجهة الأمامية
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = { TRANSLATIONS, getTranslation };
} else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.TRANSLATIONS = TRANSLATIONS;
    window.getTranslation = getTranslation;
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/manufacturing-ui.js
 * محرك عرض وتفاعل واجهة التصنيع والإنتاج (BOM Recipes & Production Orders UI)
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  let tempRecipeComponents = [];

  async function renderManufacturingView() {
    const container = document.getElementById('manufacturing-view-root');
    if (!container || !window.ManufacturingManager) return;

    await window.ManufacturingManager.fetchAllData();
    const { recipes, orders, productsList } = window.ManufacturingManager;

    const confirmedCount = orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'confirmed').length;
    const autoRecipesCount = recipes.filter((r) => Number(r.auto_on_sale) === 1).length;

    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <!-- الشريط العلوي والإحصائيات -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-black">التصنيع والإنتاج (BOM)</h2>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">إدارة وصفات التصنيع، خصم المواد الأولية بـ FIFO، وأوامر الإنتاج الآلية</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.openRecipeModal()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">add_circle</span>
              <span>وصفة تصنيع جديدة</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.openQuickProduceModal()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">precision_manufacturing</span>
              <span>أمر إنتاج فوري</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- بطاقات الملخص -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold">إجمالي وصفات التصنيع</div>
              <div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1">${recipes.length}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-lg text-blue-500">menu_book</span>
          </div>
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold">أوامر الإنتاج المنفذة</div>
              <div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1 text-emerald-600">${confirmedCount}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-lg text-emerald-500">task_alt</span>
          </div>
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold">وصفات التصنيع التلقائي عند البيع</div>
              <div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1 text-amber-500">${autoRecipesCount}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-lg text-amber-500">bolt</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- جدول الوصفات وجدول أوامر الإنتاج -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <!-- قائمة وصفات التصنيع -->
          <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-blue-500">receipt_long</span>
              <span>وصفات التصنيع المعتمدة (BOM Recipes)</span>
            </h3>
            <div class="overflow-x-auto">
              <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
                <thead>
                  <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">الوصفة / المنتج النهائي</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">كمية الخرج</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">المكونات</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">تلقائي؟</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">إجراءات</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                  ${
                    recipes.length === 0
                      ? '<tr><td colspan="5" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد وصفات تصنيع مسجلة بعد</td></tr>'
                      : recipes
                          .map(
                            (r) => `
                        <tr>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            <div class="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">${r.name}</div>
                            <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">${r.product_name || ''}</div>
                          </td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${r.output_qty} ${r.product_unit || ''}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">${(r.components || []).length} مكونات</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            ${
                              Number(r.auto_on_sale) === 1
                                ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 font-bold">نعم</span>'
                                : '<span class="text-slate-400">يدوي</span>'
                            }
                          </td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.produceFromRecipe(${r.id})"
                              class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">إنتاج</button>
                            <button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.deleteRecipe(${r.id})"
                              class="p-1 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg">
                              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">delete</span>
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>`
                          )
                          .join('')
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- سجل أوامر الإنتاج -->
          <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded text-emerald-500">factory</span>
              <span>سجل أوامر الإنتاج (Production Orders)</span>
            </h3>
            <div class="overflow-x-auto">
              <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
                <thead>
                  <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">الرقم</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">المنتج</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">الكمية</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">تكلفة الوحدة</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">الحالة</th>
                    <th class="py-2.5 px-2">إجراء</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                  ${
                    orders.length === 0
                      ? '<tr><td colspan="6" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد أوامر إنتاج مسجلة</td></tr>'
                      : orders
                          .map(
                            (o) => `
                        <tr>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${o.number || '#' + o.id}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-bold">${o.product_name || ''}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono">${o.produced_qty || o.planned_qty}</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2 font-mono">${Number(o.unit_cost || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            ${
                              o.status === 'confirmed'
                                ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 font-bold">مؤكد</span>'
                                : o.status === 'reversed'
                                  ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500 font-bold">ملغى</span>'
                                  : '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 font-bold">مسودة</span>'
                            }
                          </td>
                          <td class="py-2.5 px-2">
                            ${
                              o.status === 'confirmed'
                                ? `<button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.reverseOrder(${o.id})" class="text-rose-500 hover:underline font-bold">عكس</button>`
                                : o.status === 'draft'
                                  ? `<button onclick="window.ManufacturingUI.confirmDraft(${o.id})" class="text-emerald-600 hover:underline font-bold">تأكيد</button>`
                                  : '-'
                            }
                          </td>
                        </tr>`
                          )
                          .join('')
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  async function produceFromRecipe(recipeId) {
    const qtyStr = prompt('أدخل الكمية المراد إنتاجها الآن:', '1');
    const qty = parseFloat(qtyStr);
    if (!qty || qty <= 0) return;

    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.createAndConfirmOrder({
        recipe_id: Number(recipeId),
        planned_qty: qty,
        produced_qty: qty,
        confirmImmediately: true
      });
      await renderManufacturingView();
      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم تنفيذ أمر الإنتاج وإضافة الدفعة للمخزون بنجاح', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'تعذر تنفيذ أمر الإنتاج');
    }
  }

  async function deleteRecipe(recipeId) {
    if (!confirm('هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذه الوصفة؟')) return;
    await window.ManufacturingManager.removeRecipe(recipeId);
    await renderManufacturingView();
  }

  async function reverseOrder(orderId) {
    if (!confirm('هل تريد عكس أمر الإنتاج وإرجاع المواد الأولية للمخزون؟')) return;
    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.reverseOrder(orderId);
      await renderManufacturingView();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  }

  async function confirmDraft(orderId) {
    try {
      await window.ManufacturingManager.confirmDraftOrder(orderId);
      await renderManufacturingView();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message);
    }
  }

  function openRecipeModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('bom-recipe-modal');
    if (modal) {
      tempRecipeComponents = [];
      modal.classList.add('active');
    }
  }

  function openQuickProduceModal() {
    const recipes = (window.ManufacturingManager && window.ManufacturingManager.recipes) || [];
    if (recipes.length === 0) {
      alert('يرجى إنشاء وصفة تصنيع أولاً');
      return;
    }
    produceFromRecipe(recipes[0].id);
  }

  window.ManufacturingUI = {
    renderManufacturingView,
    produceFromRecipe,
    deleteRecipe,
    reverseOrder,
    confirmDraft,
    openRecipeModal,
    openQuickProduceModal
  };
})();
```

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/manufacturing.js
 * وحدة إدارة حالة التصنيع (BOM State & API Controller) في الواجهة الأمامية
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  const ManufacturingState = {
    recipes: [],
    orders: [],
    productsList: [],
    currentRecipe: null,
    currentAvailability: null,

    async fetchAllData(filters = {}) {
      if (!window.api) return;
      const [recipes, orders, products] = await Promise.all([
        window.api.getBomRecipes(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProductionOrders(filters).catch(() => []),
        window.api.getProducts({}).catch(() => [])
      ]);

      this.recipes = Array.isArray(recipes) ? recipes : [];
      this.orders = Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : [];
      this.productsList = Array.isArray(products) ? products : [];
      return {
        recipes: this.recipes,
        orders: this.orders,
        products: this.productsList
      };
    },

    async checkAvailability(recipeId, plannedQty = 1) {
      if (!window.api || !recipeId) return null;
      this.currentAvailability = await window.api.getRecipeAvailability({
        recipeId: Number(recipeId),
        plannedQty: Number(plannedQty || 1)
      });
      return this.currentAvailability;
    },

    async saveRecipe(recipePayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const saved = await window.api.saveBomRecipe(recipePayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return saved;
    },

    async removeRecipe(recipeId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      await window.api.deleteBomRecipe(Number(recipeId));
      await this.fetchAllData();
    },

    async createAndConfirmOrder(orderPayload) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.createProductionOrder(orderPayload);
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async confirmDraftOrder(orderId, producedQty) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.confirmProductionOrder({
        orderId: Number(orderId),
        produced_qty: producedQty ? Number(producedQty) : undefined
      });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    },

    async reverseOrder(orderId) {
      if (!window.api) return null;
      const res = await window.api.reverseProductionOrder({ orderId: Number(orderId) });
      await this.fetchAllData();
      return res;
    }
  };

  window.ManufacturingManager = ManufacturingState;
})();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\manufacturing\pos-produce.js`

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/pos-produce.js
 * محرك التصنيع الآلي الفوري عند البيع في شاشة الكاشير (يعمل في Node.js وفي المتصفح معاً)
 */

'use strict';

(function (root) {
  var isNode = typeof require === 'function' && typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  var productionGuard = isNode ? require('./production-guard') : null;

  async function autoProduceShortfallsForSale(db, saleItems, options) {
    if (!isNode || !productionGuard || !db) return [];
    saleItems = Array.isArray(saleItems) ? saleItems : [];
    options = options || {};

    var globalAutoSetting = await db.getSetting('manufacturing_auto_on_sale', 'false');
    var isGlobalAutoEnabled =
      String(globalAutoSetting).toLowerCase() === 'true' || globalAutoSetting === '1';

    var producedOrders = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < saleItems.length; i++) {
      var item = saleItems[i];
      var productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
      var requestedQty = Number(item.quantity || 0);
      if (!productId || requestedQty <= 0) continue;

      var stockRow = await db.dbGet(
        'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS current_stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
        [productId]
      );
      var currentStock = Number((stockRow && stockRow.current_stock) || 0);
      var shortfall = Number((requestedQty - currentStock).toFixed(6));

      if (shortfall <= 0.0001) continue;

      var recipe = await db.dbGet(
        'SELECT * FROM bom_recipes WHERE product_id = ? AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1',
        [productId]
      );

      if (!recipe) continue;
      if (!isGlobalAutoEnabled && !Number(recipe.auto_on_sale)) continue;

      var qtyToProduce = shortfall;
      if (recipe.auto_round === 'batch' && Number(recipe.output_qty) > 0) {
        var batchesNeeded = Math.ceil(shortfall / Number(recipe.output_qty));
        qtyToProduce = batchesNeeded * Number(recipe.output_qty);
      }

      try {
        var avail = await productionGuard.computeRecipeAvailability(db, {
          recipeId: recipe.id,
          plannedQty: qtyToProduce
        });

        if (avail && avail.can_produce) {
          var order = await productionGuard.createProductionOrder(db, {
            recipe_id: recipe.id,
            planned_qty: qtyToProduce,
            produced_qty: qtyToProduce,
            trigger_source: 'auto_pos_sale',
            sale_id: options.saleId || null,
            user_id: options.userId || null,
            confirmImmediately: true,
            note: 'إنتاج تلقائي لتغطية بيع الكاشير'
          });
          producedOrders.push(order);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[Auto-Produce POS] Skipped product #' + productId + ':', err.message);
      }
    }

    return producedOrders;
  }

  if (isNode) {
    module.exports = { autoProduceShortfallsForSale: autoProduceShortfallsForSale };
  } else if (root) {
    root.PosProduce = {
      openQuickProduceModal: function () {
        if (root.App && typeof root.App.openPosQuickProduceModal === 'function') {
          root.App.openPosQuickProduceModal();
        }
      }
    };
  }
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\manufacturing\production-guard.js`

```javascript
/**
 * manufacturing/production-guard.js
 * المحرك الشامل للتصنيع والإنتاج (BOM Recipes, Capacity Calculation, FIFO Component Deduction, Order Lifecycle)
 */

'use strict';

function resolveHelpers(ctx) {
  const db = ctx && ctx.db ? ctx.db : ctx;
  const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbGet === 'function') return ctx.dbGet(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  };
  const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbAll === 'function') return ctx.dbAll(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  };
  const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbRun === 'function') return ctx.dbRun(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbRun === 'function') return db.dbRun(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  };
  const withTx = (workFn) => {
    if (db && typeof db.withTransaction === 'function') {
      return db.withTransaction((tx) => workFn(tx));
    }
    return workFn({ db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun });
  };
  const nextNumber = async (docType = 'production') => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.nextNumber === 'function') return ctx.nextNumber(docType);
    if (db && typeof db.nextNumber === 'function') return db.nextNumber(docType);
    return `PRD-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;
  };
  const allowExpired = async () => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.allowExpired === 'function') return ctx.allowExpired();
    if (db && typeof db.allowExpired === 'function') return db.allowExpired();
    const r = await dbGet("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'manufacturing_allow_expired'");
    return r && (String(r.value).toLowerCase() === 'true' || r.value === '1');
  };

  return { db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun, withTx, nextNumber, allowExpired };
}

/**
 * 1. جلب قائمة وصفات التصنيع (BOM Recipes)
 */
async function listRecipes(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['r.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.productId || filters.product_id) {
    conds.push('r.product_id = ?');
    params.push(Number(filters.productId || filters.product_id));
  }
  if (filters.activeOnly || filters.is_active) {
    conds.push('r.is_active = 1');
  }
  if (filters.search) {
    conds.push('(r.name LIKE ? OR p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ?)');
    const q = `%${String(filters.search).trim()}%`;
    params.push(q, q, q);
  }

  const recipes = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      r.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      p.image AS product_image,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_components bc WHERE bc.recipe_id = r.id AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL) AS components_count
    FROM bom_recipes r
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY r.is_default DESC, r.id DESC
    `,
    params
  );

  for (const rec of recipes) {
    rec.components = await dbAll(
      `
      SELECT
        bc.*,
        cp.name AS component_name,
        cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
        cp.unit AS component_unit,
        COALESCE((
          SELECT SUM(ib.stock) FROM inventory_batches ib
          WHERE ib.product_id = bc.component_product_id
            AND (bc.component_variant_id IS NULL OR ib.variant_id = bc.component_variant_id)
            AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
        ), 0) AS available_stock
      FROM bom_components bc
      LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = bc.component_product_id
      WHERE bc.recipe_id = ? AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY bc.position ASC, bc.id ASC
      `,
      [rec.id]
    );
  }

  return recipes;
}

/**
 * 2. جلب وصفة واحدة مع كامل مكوناتها
 */
async function loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipe = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT
      r.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      p.image AS product_image
    FROM bom_recipes r
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id
    WHERE r.id = ? AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [Number(recipeId)]
  );
  if (!recipe) return null;

  recipe.components = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      bc.*,
      cp.name AS component_name,
      cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
      cp.unit AS component_unit,
      cp.wholesale_unit AS component_wholesale_unit,
      cp.wholesale_qty AS component_wholesale_qty,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(ib.stock) FROM inventory_batches ib
        WHERE ib.product_id = bc.component_product_id
          AND (bc.component_variant_id IS NULL OR ib.variant_id = bc.component_variant_id)
          AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
      ), 0) AS available_stock,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT AVG(ib2.cost_price) FROM inventory_batches ib2
        WHERE ib2.product_id = bc.component_product_id
          AND ib2.deleted_at IS NULL AND ib2.stock > 0
      ), 0) AS est_unit_cost
    FROM bom_components bc
    LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = bc.component_product_id
    WHERE bc.recipe_id = ? AND bc.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY bc.position ASC, bc.id ASC
    `,
    [recipe.id]
  );

  return recipe;
}

/**
 * 3. حفظ أو تحديث وصفة تصنيع (BOM Recipe) مع منع الحلقات الدائرية (Circular Dependency Check)
 */
async function saveRecipe(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbRun, withTx } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const productId = Number(payload.product_id || payload.productId);
  const variantId = payload.variant_id || payload.variantId ? Number(payload.variant_id || payload.variantId) : null;
  const name = String(payload.name || 'وصفة قياسية').trim();
  const outputQty = Math.max(0.0001, Number(payload.output_qty ?? payload.outputQty ?? 1));
  const extraCost = Math.max(0, Number(payload.extra_cost ?? payload.extraCost ?? 0));
  const extraCostType = payload.extra_cost_type || payload.extraCostType || 'per_batch';
  const isDefault = payload.is_default ?? payload.isDefault ? 1 : 0;
  const isActive = payload.is_active !== undefined ? (payload.is_active ? 1 : 0) : 1;
  const autoOnSale = payload.auto_on_sale ?? payload.autoOnSale ? 1 : 0;
  const autoRound = payload.auto_round || payload.autoRound || 'exact';
  const autoTarget = payload.auto_target || payload.autoTarget || 'shortfall';
  const sellPrice =
    payload.sell_price !== undefined && payload.sell_price !== null && payload.sell_price !== ''
      ? Number(payload.sell_price)
      : null;

  const components = Array.isArray(payload.components) ? payload.components : [];
  if (!productId) throw new Error('يرجى اختيار المنتج النهائي للوصفة');
  if (components.length === 0) throw new Error('يجب أن تحتوي الوصفة على مكون أولي واحد على الأقل');

  for (const comp of components) {
    const compProdId = Number(comp.component_product_id || comp.product_id || comp.productId);
    if (compProdId === productId) {
      throw new Error('لا يمكن أن يكون المنتج النهائي مكوناً داخل وصفته نفسها');
    }
  }

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    let recipeId = payload.id ? Number(payload.id) : null;

    if (isDefault) {
      await tx.dbRun(
        'UPDATE bom_recipes SET is_default = 0 WHERE product_id = ? AND COALESCE(variant_id, -1) = COALESCE(?, -1)',
        [productId, variantId]
      );
    }

    if (recipeId) {
      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        UPDATE bom_recipes
        SET product_id = ?, variant_id = ?, name = ?, output_qty = ?,
            extra_cost = ?, extra_cost_type = ?, is_default = ?, is_active = ?,
            auto_on_sale = ?, auto_round = ?, auto_target = ?, sell_price = ?
        WHERE id = ?
        `,
        [
          productId,
          variantId,
          name,
          outputQty,
          extraCost,
          extraCostType,
          isDefault,
          isActive,
          autoOnSale,
          autoRound,
          autoTarget,
          sellPrice,
          recipeId
        ]
      );
      await tx.dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_components WHERE recipe_id = ?', [recipeId]);
    } else {
      const existingDefault = await dbGet(
        'SELECT id FROM bom_recipes WHERE product_id = ? AND is_default = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1',
        [productId]
      );
      const effectiveDefault = isDefault || !existingDefault ? 1 : 0;

      const ins = await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO bom_recipes (
          product_id, variant_id, name, output_qty, extra_cost, extra_cost_type,
          is_default, is_active, auto_on_sale, auto_round, auto_target, sell_price
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [
          productId,
          variantId,
          name,
          outputQty,
          extraCost,
          extraCostType,
          effectiveDefault,
          isActive,
          autoOnSale,
          autoRound,
          autoTarget,
          sellPrice
        ]
      );
      recipeId = ins.lastID;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < components.length; i++) {
      const c = components[i];
      const compProdId = Number(c.component_product_id || c.product_id || c.productId);
      const compVarId = c.component_variant_id || c.variant_id ? Number(c.component_variant_id || c.variant_id) : null;
      const qty = Math.max(0.000001, Number(c.quantity ?? 1));
      const waste = Math.max(0, Number(c.waste_percent ?? c.wastePercent ?? 0));
      const unitLabel = c.unit_label || c.unitLabel || null;
      const unitQty = c.unit_qty !== undefined && c.unit_qty !== null ? Number(c.unit_qty) : qty;

      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO bom_components (
          recipe_id, component_product_id, component_variant_id,
          quantity, unit_label, unit_qty, waste_percent, position
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [recipeId, compProdId, compVarId, qty, unitLabel, unitQty, waste, i]
      );
    }

    return await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  });
}

/**
 * 4. حذف وصفة تصنيع
 */
async function deleteRecipe(ctx, recipeId) {
  const { dbRun } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(recipeId && typeof recipeId === 'object' ? recipeId.id || recipeId.recipeId : recipeId);
  await dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_components WHERE recipe_id = ?', [id]);
  await dbRun('DELETE FROM bom_recipes WHERE id = ?', [id]);
  return { success: true, id };
}

/**
 * 5. حساب توفر المكونات وأقصى كمية قابلة للتصنيع والتكلفة التقديرية (FIFO Simulation)
 */
async function computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbAll, allowExpired } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipeId = Number(payload.recipeId || payload.recipe_id || payload.id);
  const requestedOutputQty = Math.max(
    0.0001,
    Number(payload.plannedQty ?? payload.planned_qty ?? payload.quantity ?? 0) || 0
  );

  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('وصفة التصنيع غير موجودة');

  const canUseExpired = await allowExpired();
  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const effectivePlannedQty = requestedOutputQty > 0 ? requestedOutputQty : Number(recipe.output_qty || 1);
  const scaleFactor = effectivePlannedQty / Math.max(0.0001, Number(recipe.output_qty || 1));

  let maxBatchesPossible = Infinity;
  let totalComponentsCost = 0;
  const componentBreakdown = [];
  const shortages = [];

  for (const comp of recipe.components || []) {
    const wasteMultiplier = 1 + Math.max(0, Number(comp.waste_percent || 0)) / 100.0;
    const reqPerRecipeBatch = Number(comp.quantity || 0) * wasteMultiplier;
    const requiredTotalQty = Number((reqPerRecipeBatch * scaleFactor).toFixed(6));

    const batchConds = ['product_id = ?', 'deleted_at IS NULL', 'COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0'];
    const batchParams = [Number(comp.component_product_id)];

    if (comp.component_variant_id) {
      batchConds.push('variant_id = ?');
      batchParams.push(Number(comp.component_variant_id));
    }
    if (!canUseExpired) {
      batchConds.push("(expiry_date IS NULL OR TRIM(expiry_date) = '' OR date(expiry_date) >= date(?))");
      batchParams.push(todayIso);
    }

    const batches = await dbAll(
      `
      SELECT id, stock, cost_price, expiry_date
      FROM inventory_batches
      WHERE ${batchConds.join(' AND ')}
      ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
      `,
      batchParams
    );

    const totalAvail = batches.reduce((acc, b) => acc + Number(b.stock || 0), 0);
    const possibleRecipeBatches = reqPerRecipeBatch > 0 ? totalAvail / reqPerRecipeBatch : Infinity;
    if (possibleRecipeBatches < maxBatchesPossible) {
      maxBatchesPossible = possibleRecipeBatches;
    }

    // محاكاة السحب بطريقة FIFO لحساب التكلفة الدقيقة
    let remToCost = requiredTotalQty;
    let compCost = 0;
    let lastKnownCost = batches.length > 0 ? Number(batches[0].cost_price || 0) : Number(comp.est_unit_cost || 0);

    for (const b of batches) {
      if (remToCost <= 0) break;
      const take = Math.min(Number(b.stock || 0), remToCost);
      compCost += take * Number(b.cost_price || 0);
      lastKnownCost = Number(b.cost_price || lastKnownCost);
      remToCost -= take;
    }
    if (remToCost > 0) {
      compCost += remToCost * lastKnownCost;
    }

    totalComponentsCost += compCost;
    const shortage = Math.max(0, Number((requiredTotalQty - totalAvail).toFixed(6)));
    if (shortage > 0.0001) {
      shortages.push({
        component_product_id: comp.component_product_id,
        component_name: comp.component_name,
        required: requiredTotalQty,
        available: totalAvail,
        shortage
      });
    }

    componentBreakdown.push({
      component_product_id: comp.component_product_id,
      component_variant_id: comp.component_variant_id,
      component_name: comp.component_name,
      component_unit: comp.component_unit,
      required_qty: requiredTotalQty,
      available_qty: totalAvail,
      shortage_qty: shortage,
      estimated_cost: Number(compCost.toFixed(2)),
      sufficient: shortage <= 0.0001
    });
  }

  const maxOutputQty = Number.isFinite(maxBatchesPossible)
    ? Number((Math.max(0, maxBatchesPossible) * Number(recipe.output_qty || 1)).toFixed(4))
    : 0;

  const extraCostTotal =
    recipe.extra_cost_type === 'per_unit'
      ? Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * effectivePlannedQty
      : Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * scaleFactor;

  const totalCost = Number((totalComponentsCost + extraCostTotal).toFixed(2));
  const unitCost = Number((totalCost / Math.max(0.0001, effectivePlannedQty)).toFixed(2));

  return {
    recipe_id: recipe.id,
    product_id: recipe.product_id,
    product_name: recipe.product_name,
    planned_qty: effectivePlannedQty,
    max_manufacturable_qty: maxOutputQty,
    can_produce: shortages.length === 0,
    components_cost: Number(totalComponentsCost.toFixed(2)),
    extra_cost: Number(extraCostTotal.toFixed(2)),
    total_cost: totalCost,
    unit_cost: unitCost,
    components: componentBreakdown,
    shortages
  };
}

/**
 * 6. حساب القدرة الإنتاجية الفورية لمجموعة منتجات (في شاشة الكاشير POS)
 */
async function autoCapacityForProducts(ctx, productIds = []) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const ids = Array.isArray(productIds)
    ? productIds.map(Number).filter(Boolean)
    : productIds && Array.isArray(productIds.productIds)
      ? productIds.productIds.map(Number).filter(Boolean)
      : [];

  let recipesQuery = 'SELECT id, product_id, variant_id, auto_on_sale FROM bom_recipes WHERE is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL';
  const params = [];
  if (ids.length > 0) {
    recipesQuery += ` AND product_id IN (${ids.map(() => '?').join(',')})`;
    params.push(...ids);
  }

  const recipes = await dbAll(recipesQuery, params);
  const result = {};

  for (const r of recipes) {
    try {
      const avail = await computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, { recipeId: r.id, plannedQty: 1 });
      result[r.product_id] = {
        recipeId: r.id,
        maxManufacturableQty: avail.max_manufacturable_qty,
        unitCost: avail.unit_cost,
        autoOnSale: Boolean(r.auto_on_sale)
      };
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * 7. إنشاء مسودة أمر إنتاج (createDraft)
 */
async function createDraft(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbRun, nextNumber } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const recipeId = Number(payload.recipe_id || payload.recipeId);
  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, recipeId);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('وصفة التصنيع غير موجودة');

  const plannedQty = Math.max(0.0001, Number(payload.planned_qty ?? payload.plannedQty ?? recipe.output_qty ?? 1));
  const avail = await computeRecipeAvailability(ctx, { recipeId, plannedQty });
  const docNum = payload.number || (await nextNumber('production'));
  const orderDate = payload.order_date || payload.orderDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const ins = await dbRun(
    `
    INSERT INTO production_orders (
      number, recipe_id, product_id, variant_id, planned_qty, status,
      components_cost, extra_cost, unit_cost, output_expiry_date,
      output_selling_price, output_wholesale_price, trigger_source,
      sale_id, user_id, note, order_date
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `,
    [
      docNum,
      recipe.id,
      recipe.product_id,
      recipe.variant_id || null,
      plannedQty,
      avail.components_cost,
      avail.extra_cost,
      avail.unit_cost,
      payload.output_expiry_date || payload.outputExpiryDate || null,
      payload.output_selling_price ?? payload.outputSellingPrice ?? recipe.sell_price ?? null,
      payload.output_wholesale_price ?? payload.outputWholesalePrice ?? null,
      payload.trigger_source || payload.triggerSource || 'manual',
      payload.sale_id || payload.saleId || null,
      payload.user_id || payload.userId || null,
      payload.note || null,
      orderDate
    ]
  );

  return await getOrder(ctx, ins.lastID);
}

/**
 * 8. تأكيد أمر الإنتاج (خصم المكونات الأولية بـ FIFO وإنشاء دفعة المنتج النهائي)
 */
async function confirmOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll, withTx, allowExpired } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const orderId = Number(payload.orderId || payload.order_id || payload.id);
  const order = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM production_orders WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [orderId]);
  if (!order) throw new Error('أمر الإنتاج غير موجود');
  if (order.status === 'confirmed') return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);

  const recipe = await loadRecipeWithComponents(ctx, order.recipe_id);
  if (!recipe) throw new Error('الوصفة المرتبطة بأمر الإنتاج غير موجودة');

  const producedQty = Math.max(
    0.0001,
    Number(payload.produced_qty ?? payload.producedQty ?? order.planned_qty ?? recipe.output_qty ?? 1)
  );
  const scaleFactor = producedQty / Math.max(0.0001, Number(recipe.output_qty || 1));
  const canUseExpired = await allowExpired();
  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    let actualComponentsCost = 0;

    for (const comp of recipe.components || []) {
      const wasteMultiplier = 1 + Math.max(0, Number(comp.waste_percent || 0)) / 100.0;
      let remainingNeed = Number((Number(comp.quantity || 0) * wasteMultiplier * scaleFactor).toFixed(6));

      const batchConds = ['product_id = ?', 'deleted_at IS NULL', 'COALESCE(stock, 0) > 0'];
      const batchParams = [Number(comp.component_product_id)];
      if (comp.component_variant_id) {
        batchConds.push('variant_id = ?');
        batchParams.push(Number(comp.component_variant_id));
      }
      if (!canUseExpired) {
        batchConds.push("(expiry_date IS NULL OR TRIM(expiry_date) = '' OR date(expiry_date) >= date(?))");
        batchParams.push(todayIso);
      }

      const batches = await dbAll(
        `
        SELECT id, stock, cost_price
        FROM inventory_batches
        WHERE ${batchConds.join(' AND ')}
        ORDER BY (expiry_date IS NULL), expiry_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
        `,
        batchParams
      );

      for (const b of batches) {
        if (remainingNeed <= 0.000001) break;
        const avail = Math.max(0, Number(b.stock || 0));
        if (avail <= 0) continue;

        const take = Math.min(avail, remainingNeed);
        const unitCost = Number(b.cost_price || 0);
        const lineSub = Number((take * unitCost).toFixed(4));

        await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [take, b.id]);
        await tx.dbRun(
          `
          INSERT INTO production_order_items (
            order_id, component_product_id, component_variant_id,
            batch_id, quantity, unit_cost, subtotal
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
          `,
          [orderId, comp.component_product_id, comp.component_variant_id || null, b.id, take, unitCost, lineSub]
        );

        actualComponentsCost += lineSub;
        remainingNeed = Number((remainingNeed - take).toFixed(6));
      }

      if (remainingNeed > 0.0001) {
        throw new Error(`رصيد المكون "${comp.component_name}" غير كافٍ لإتمام الإنتاج (العجز: ${remainingNeed})`);
      }
    }

    const extraCostTotal =
      recipe.extra_cost_type === 'per_unit'
        ? Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * producedQty
        : Number(recipe.extra_cost || 0) * scaleFactor;

    const totalCost = Number((actualComponentsCost + extraCostTotal).toFixed(2));
    const unitCost = Number((totalCost / producedQty).toFixed(2));

    // تحديد سعر البيع للدفعة الناتجة
    let sellingPrice = order.output_selling_price ?? payload.output_selling_price ?? recipe.sell_price;
    if (sellingPrice === null || sellingPrice === undefined || sellingPrice === '') {
      const lastBatch = await dbGet(
        'SELECT selling_price FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',
        [order.product_id]
      );
      sellingPrice = lastBatch && Number(lastBatch.selling_price) > 0 ? Number(lastBatch.selling_price) : unitCost;
    }

    const batchIns = await tx.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO inventory_batches (
        product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price,
        wholesale_price, expiry_date, display_code
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [
        order.product_id,
        order.variant_id || null,
        producedQty,
        unitCost,
        Number(sellingPrice || 0),
        order.output_wholesale_price || null,
        order.output_expiry_date || payload.output_expiry_date || null,
        order.number
      ]
    );

    const outputBatchId = batchIns.lastID;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    await tx.dbRun(
      `
      UPDATE production_orders
      SET status = 'confirmed',
          produced_qty = ?,
          components_cost = ?,
          extra_cost = ?,
          unit_cost = ?,
          output_batch_id = ?,
          output_selling_price = ?,
          confirmed_at = ?
      WHERE id = ?
      `,
      [
        producedQty,
        Number(actualComponentsCost.toFixed(2)),
        Number(extraCostTotal.toFixed(2)),
        unitCost,
        outputBatchId,
        Number(sellingPrice || 0),
        nowIso,
        orderId
      ]
    );

    return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);
  });
}

/**
 * 9. عكس/إلغاء أمر إنتاج مؤكد (إرجاع المكونات الأولية للدفعات وسحب دفعة المنتج النهائي)
 */
async function reverseOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll, withTx } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const orderId = Number(payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload.orderId || payload.order_id || payload.id : payload);
  const order = await dbGet('SELECT * FROM production_orders WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL', [orderId]);
  if (!order) throw new Error('أمر الإنتاج غير موجود');
  if (order.status === 'reversed') return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);

  const items = await dbAll(
    'SELECT * FROM production_order_items WHERE order_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL',
    [orderId]
  );

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    for (const item of items) {
      await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = COALESCE(stock, 0) + ? WHERE id = ?', [
        Number(item.quantity || 0),
        item.batch_id
      ]);
    }

    if (order.output_batch_id) {
      const deductQty = Number(order.produced_qty || order.planned_qty || 0);
      await tx.dbRun(
        'UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = MAX(0, COALESCE(stock, 0) - ?) WHERE id = ?',
        [deductQty, order.output_batch_id]
      );
    }

    await tx.dbRun("UPDATE production_orders SET status = 'reversed' WHERE id = ?", [orderId]);
    return await getOrder(ctx, orderId);
  });
}

/**
 * 10. جلب قائمة أوامر الإنتاج أو تفاصيل أمر إنتاج واحد
 */
async function listOrders(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['po.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.status) {
    conds.push('po.status = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.status));
  }
  if (filters.productId || filters.product_id) {
    conds.push('po.product_id = ?');
    params.push(Number(filters.productId || filters.product_id));
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
    conds.push('date(po.order_date) >= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
  }
  if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
    conds.push('date(po.order_date) <= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
  }

  return await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      po.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      r.name AS recipe_name,
      u.name AS user_name
    FROM production_orders po
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = po.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_recipes r ON r.id = po.recipe_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = po.user_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY po.id DESC
    LIMIT 250
    `,
    params
  );
}

async function getOrder(ctx, orderId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(orderId && typeof orderId === 'object' ? orderId.id || orderId.orderId : orderId);
  const order = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT
      po.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode AS product_barcode,
      p.unit AS product_unit,
      r.name AS recipe_name,
      u.name AS user_name
    FROM production_orders po
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = po.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_recipes r ON r.id = po.recipe_id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = po.user_id
    WHERE po.id = ? AND po.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [id]
  );
  if (!order) return null;

  order.items = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      poi.*,
      cp.name AS component_name,
      cp.barcode AS component_barcode,
      cp.unit AS component_unit
    FROM production_order_items poi
    LEFT JOIN products cp ON cp.id = poi.component_product_id
    WHERE poi.order_id = ? AND poi.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY poi.id ASC
    `,
    [id]
  );

  return order;
}

/**
 * 11. تعيين دور المادة للمنتج (raw_material / semi_finished / finished_good)
 */
async function setMaterialRole(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbRun } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const productId = Number(payload.productId || payload.product_id || payload.id);
  const role = payload.materialRole ?? payload.material_role ?? null;
  const hideFromPos =
    payload.hideFromPos !== undefined
      ? payload.hideFromPos
        ? 1
        : 0
      : role === 'raw_material'
        ? 1
        : 0;

  await dbRun('UPDATE products SET material_role = ?, hide_from_pos = ? WHERE id = ?', [
    role,
    hideFromPos,
    productId
  ]);
  return { success: true, product_id: productId, material_role: role, hide_from_pos: hideFromPos };
}

/**
 * إنشاء أمر إنتاج مع خيار التأكيد الفوري المباشر
 */
async function createProductionOrder(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const draft = await createDraft(ctx, payload);
  if (payload && (payload.confirmImmediately || payload.confirm || payload.status === 'confirmed')) {
    return await confirmOrder(ctx, { orderId: draft.id, ...payload });
  }
  return draft;
}

module.exports = {
  listRecipes,
  getBomRecipes: listRecipes,
  loadRecipeWithComponents,
  getRecipe: loadRecipeWithComponents,
  getBomRecipe: loadRecipeWithComponents,
  saveRecipe,
  saveBomRecipe: saveRecipe,
  deleteRecipe,
  deleteBomRecipe: deleteRecipe,
  computeRecipeAvailability,
  getRecipeAvailability: computeRecipeAvailability,
  autoCapacityForProducts,
  getManufacturableCapacity: (ctx, payload = {}) =>
    autoCapacityForProducts(
      ctx,
      Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload.productIds || payload.product_ids || []
    ),
  createDraft,
  createProductionOrder,
  confirmOrder,
  confirmProductionOrder: confirmOrder,
  reverseOrder,
  reverseProductionOrder: reverseOrder,
  listOrders,
  getProductionOrders: listOrders,
  getOrder,
  getProductionOrder: getOrder,
  setMaterialRole
};
```
