```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-guard.js
 * محرك الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake Sheet, Variance Calculation & Batch Stock Reconciliation)
 */

'use strict';

function resolveHelpers(ctx) {
  const db = ctx && ctx.db ? ctx.db : ctx;
  const dbGet = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbGet === 'function') return ctx.dbGet(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbGet === 'function') return db.dbGet(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(row)));
    });
  };
  const dbAll = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbAll === 'function') return ctx.dbAll(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbAll === 'function') return db.dbAll(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(rows || [])));
    });
  };
  const dbRun = (sql, params = []) => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.dbRun === 'function') return ctx.dbRun(sql, params);
    if (db && typeof db.dbRun === 'function') return db.dbRun(sql, params);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(sql, params, function onDone(err) {
        if (err) return reject(err);
        resolve({ lastID: this ? this.lastID : null, changes: this ? this.changes : 0 });
      });
    });
  };
  const withTx = (workFn) => {
    if (db && typeof db.withTransaction === 'function') {
      return db.withTransaction((tx) => workFn(tx));
    }
    return workFn({ db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun });
  };
  const nextNumber = async (docType = 'stocktake') => {
    if (ctx && typeof ctx.nextNumber === 'function') return ctx.nextNumber(docType);
    if (db && typeof db.nextNumber === 'function') return db.nextNumber(docType);
    return `INV-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(Date.now()).slice(-4)}`;
  };

  return { db, dbGet, dbAll, dbRun, withTx, nextNumber };
}

/**
 * 1. تحميل ورقة الجرد الحالية (Stocktake Sheet) مع التصفية حسب الفئة أو العائلة أو البحث
 */
async function loadSheet(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const scopeType = String(filters.scopeType || filters.scope_type || 'all').toLowerCase();
  const scopeValue = filters.scopeValue || filters.scope_value || filters.category || filters.family || '';
  const search = filters.search ? String(filters.search).trim() : '';

  const conds = ['p.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (scopeType === 'category' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (scopeType === 'family' && scopeValue) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(scopeValue));
  } else if (filters.category) {
    conds.push('p.category = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.category));
  } else if (filters.family) {
    conds.push('p.family = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.family));
  }

  if (search) {
    conds.push('(p.name LIKE ? OR p.barcode LIKE ? OR p.category LIKE ?)');
    const q = `%${search}%`;
    params.push(q, q, q);
  }

  const rows = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      p.id AS product_id,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.family,
      p.unit,
      ib.id AS batch_id,
      ib.variant_id,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      COALESCE(ib.stock, 0) AS book_qty
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.product_id = p.id AND ib.deleted_at IS NULL
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, ib.id ASC
    `,
    params
  );

  return rows;
}

/**
 * 2. عرض سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة
 */
async function listStocktakes(ctx, filters = {}) {
  const { dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const conds = ['st.deleted_at IS NULL'];
  const params = [];

  if (filters.status) {
    conds.push('st.status = ?');
    params.push(String(filters.status));
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) >= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateFrom || filters.date_from).slice(0, 10));
  }
  if (filters.dateTo || filters.date_to) {
    conds.push('date(COALESCE(st.closed_at, st.started_at, st.created_at)) <= date(?)');
    params.push(String(filters.dateTo || filters.date_to).slice(0, 10));
  }

  return await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      st.*,
      u.name AS user_name,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti WHERE sti.stocktake_id = st.id AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL) AS items_count,
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocktake_items sti2
        WHERE sti2.stocktake_id = st.id
          AND sti2.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND sti2.counted_qty IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(COALESCE(sti2.counted_qty, 0) - COALESCE(sti2.book_qty, 0)) > 0.0001
      ) AS discrepancies_count
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE ${conds.join(' AND ')}
    ORDER BY st.id DESC
    LIMIT 200
    `,
    params
  );
}

/**
 * 3. جلب تفاصيل عملية جرد محددة مع كافة أسطرها وفروقاتها المالية
 */
async function getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId) {
  const { dbGet, dbAll } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const id = Number(
    stocktakeId && typeof stocktakeId === 'object'
      ? stocktakeId.id || stocktakeId.stocktakeId
      : stocktakeId
  );

  const stocktake = await dbGet(
    `
    SELECT st.*, u.name AS user_name
    FROM stocktakes st
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = st.user_id
    WHERE st.id = ? AND st.deleted_at IS NULL
    `,
    [id]
  );
  if (!stocktake) return null;

  const items = await dbAll(
    `
    SELECT
      sti.*,
      p.name AS product_name,
      p.barcode,
      p.category,
      p.unit,
      ib.expiry_date,
      ib.location,
      COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0) AS cost_price,
      COALESCE(ib.selling_price, 0) AS selling_price,
      (COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) AS diff_qty,
      ((COALESCE(sti.counted_qty, sti.book_qty) - COALESCE(sti.book_qty, 0)) * COALESCE(ib.cost_price, 0)) AS diff_cost_value
    FROM stocktake_items sti
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = sti.product_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_batches ib ON ib.id = sti.batch_id
    WHERE sti.stocktake_id = ? AND sti.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, sti.id ASC
    `,
    [id]
  );

  stocktake.items = items;
  return stocktake;
}

/**
 * 4. اعتماد وحفظ جلسة جرد مخزني وتعديل أرصدة الدفعات آلياً بالكميات الفعلية المعدودة
 */
async function createStocktake(ctx, payload = {}) {
  const { dbGet, withTx, nextNumber } = resolveHelpers(ctx);
  const items = Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  if (items.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('لا توجد عناصر في قائمة الجرد لحفظها');
  }

  const docNumber = payload.number || (await nextNumber('stocktake'));
  const scopeType = payload.scope_type || payload.scopeType || 'all';
  const scopeValue = payload.scope_value || payload.scopeValue || null;
  const userId = payload.user_id || payload.userId || null;
  const note = payload.note || null;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const applyAdjustments = payload.applyAdjustments !== false;

  return await withTx(async (tx) => {
    const ins = await tx.dbRun(
      `
      INSERT INTO stocktakes (
        number, status, scope_type, scope_value, user_id, note, started_at, closed_at
      ) VALUES (?, 'closed', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [docNumber, scopeType, scopeValue, userId, note, payload.started_at || nowIso, nowIso]
    );
    const stocktakeId = ins.lastID;

    for (const item of items) {
      const productId = Number(item.product_id || item.productId);
      if (!productId) continue;

      let batchId = item.batch_id || item.batchId ? Number(item.batch_id || item.batchId) : null;
      const variantId = item.variant_id || item.variantId ? Number(item.variant_id || item.variantId) : null;

      let bookQty = Number(item.book_qty ?? item.bookQty ?? 0);
      const hasCounted =
        item.counted_qty !== undefined && item.counted_qty !== null && String(item.counted_qty).trim() !== '';
      const countedQty = hasCounted ? Number(item.counted_qty) : bookQty;

      // إذا لم يكن للمنتج دفعة مسجلة بعد وتم عده بكمية موجبة، ننشئ له دفعة ابتدائية
      if (!batchId) {
        const existingBatch = await dbGet(
          'SELECT id, stock FROM inventory_batches WHERE product_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',
          [productId]
        );
        if (existingBatch) {
          batchId = existingBatch.id;
          bookQty = Number(existingBatch.stock || 0);
        } else if (applyAdjustments && countedQty > 0) {
          const newB = await tx.dbRun(
            'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, variant_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price) VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0, 0)',
            [productId, variantId]
          );
          batchId = newB.lastID;
          bookQty = 0;
        }
      }

      await tx.dbRun(
        `
        INSERT INTO stocktake_items (
          stocktake_id, product_id, variant_id, batch_id, book_qty, counted_qty
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [stocktakeId, productId, variantId, batchId, bookQty, countedQty]
      );

      // تطبيق التسوية المخزنية على الدفعة إذا تغيرت الكمية المعدودة عن الكمية الدفترية
      if (applyAdjustments && batchId && hasCounted && Math.abs(countedQty - bookQty) > 0.0001) {
        await tx.dbRun('UPDATE inventory_batches SET stock = ? WHERE id = ?', [countedQty, batchId]);
      }
    }

    return await getStocktake(ctx, stocktakeId);
  });
}

module.exports = {
  loadSheet,
  getStocktakeSheet: loadSheet,
  listStocktakes,
  getStocktakes: listStocktakes,
  getStocktake,
  createStocktake
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * stocktake/stocktake-ui.js
 * محرك واجهة الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake & Variance Reconciliation UI)
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  let currentSheetRows = [];
  let historyList = [];

  async function renderStocktakeView(filters = {}) {
    const container = document.getElementById('stocktake-view-root');
    if (!container || !window.api) return;

    const [sheet, stocktakes] = await Promise.all([
      window.api.getStocktakeSheet(filters).catch(() => []),
      window.api.getStocktakes({}).catch(() => [])
    ]);

    currentSheetRows = (Array.isArray(sheet) ? sheet : []).map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      counted_qty: row.book_qty
    }));
    historyList = Array.isArray(stocktakes) ? stocktakes : [];

    drawStocktakeInterface(container);
  }

  function drawStocktakeInterface(container) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-black">الجرد المخزني الفعلي (Physical Stocktake)</h2>
            <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">مقارنة الرصيد الدفتري بالرصيد الفعلي المعدود وتسوية الفروقات آلياً</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.printBlankSheet()"
              class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">print</span>
              <span>طباعة ورقة الجرد</span>
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.StocktakeUI.commitStocktake()"
              class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20">
              <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-sm">Fact_Check</span>
              <span>اعتماد الجرد وتسوية الأرصدة</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- جدول إدخال الجرد الحي -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h3 class="font-black text-base">ورقة العد المباشر (${currentSheetRows.length} دفعة/منتج)</h3>
            <input id="stocktakeNoteInput" type="text" placeholder="ملاحظة على جلسة الجرد (اختياري)..."
              class="w-72 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">
          </div>

          <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[460px]">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead class="sticky top-0 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900">
                <tr class="text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">المنتج</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الباركود</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفئة</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الكمية المعدودة فعلياً</th>
                  <th class="py-2.5 px-3">الفارق</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${
                  currentSheetRows.length === 0
                    ? '<tr><td colspan="6" class="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">لا توجد منتجات للجرد</td></tr>'
                    : currentSheetRows
                        .map((r, idx) => {
                          const diff = Number((Number(r.counted_qty ?? r.book_qty) - Number(r.book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3));
                          const diffClass =
                            diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400';
                          return `
                            <tr>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-bold">${r.product_name}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono text-slate-500">${r.barcode || '-'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">${r.category || 'عام'}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3 font-mono font-bold">${r.book_qty} ${r.unit || ''}</td>
                              <td class="py-2 px-3">
                                <input type="number" step="any" value="${r.counted_qty}"
                                  oninput="window.StocktakeUI.updateCountedQty(${idx}, this.value)"
                                  class="w-28 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono text-center font-bold">
                              </td>
                              <td id="stk-diff-${idx}" class="py-2 px-3 font-mono ${diffClass}">
                                ${diff > 0 ? '+' + diff : diff}
                              </td>
                            </tr>`;
                        })
                        .join('')
                }
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة -->
        <div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
          <h3 class="font-black text-sm">سجل عمليات الجرد السابقة (${historyList.length})</h3>
          <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full text-xs text-right">
              <thead>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-500">
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">رقم الجرد</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">التاريخ</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">عدد العناصر</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">الفروقات المسجلة</th>
                  <th class="py-2 px-2">ملاحظة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/50">
                ${historyList
                  .map(
                    (st) => `
                  <tr>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono font-bold">${st.number || '#' + st.id}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-mono">${String(st.closed_at || st.created_at || '').slice(0, 16)}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2">${st.items_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 font-bold text-amber-500">${st.discrepancies_count || 0}</td>
                    <td class="py-2 px-2 text-slate-500">${st.note || '-'}</td>
                  </tr>`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateCountedQty(index, rawValue) {
    if (!currentSheetRows[index]) return;
    const val = parseFloat(rawValue);
    currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty = Number.isFinite(val) ? val : currentSheetRows[index].book_qty;
    const diff = Number(
      (Number(currentSheetRows[index].counted_qty) - Number(currentSheetRows[index].book_qty || 0)).toFixed(3)
    );
    const cell = document.getElementById(`stk-diff-${index}`);
    if (cell) {
      cell.textContent = diff > 0 ? `+${diff}` : String(diff);
      cell.className = `py-2 px-3 font-mono ${
        diff > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 font-bold' : diff < 0 ? 'text-rose-500 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400'
      }`;
    }
  }

  async function commitStocktake() {
    if (currentSheetRows.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm('سيتم اعتماد الكميات المعدودة وتحديث أرصدة المخزون فعلياً. هل أنت متأكد؟')) return;

    const noteEl = document.getElementById('stocktakeNoteInput');
    const note = noteEl ? noteEl.value.trim() : '';

    try {
      await window.api.createStocktake({
        scope_type: 'all',
        note,
        applyAdjustments: true,
        items: currentSheetRows
      });
      await renderStocktakeView();
      if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم اعتماد الجرد وتحديث الأرصدة بنجاح', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.message || 'حدث خطأ أثناء حفظ الجرد');
    }
  }

  function printBlankSheet() {
    const rowsHtml = currentSheetRows
      .map(
        (r, i) => `
        <tr>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;">${r.product_name}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.barcode || ''}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;text-align:center;">${r.book_qty}</td>
          <td style="border:1px solid #000;padding:5px;"></td>
        </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    const html = `
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
      <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ورقة جرد المخزون</title></head>
      <body style="font-family:Cairo,Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;">
        <h2 style="text-align:center;">ورقة الجرد المخزني — Gherbi.Ai POS</h2>
        <p style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;">التاريخ: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}</p>
        <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="background:#f1f5f9;">
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">#</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">المنتج</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الباركود</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;">الرصيد الدفتري</th>
              <th style="border:1px solid #000;padding:6px;width:120px;">الكمية المعدودة</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </body>
      </html>`;

    if (window.PrintEngine) {
      window.PrintEngine.printHtmlDocument(html, { silent: false });
    }
  }

  window.StocktakeUI = {
    renderStocktakeView,
    updateCountedQty,
    commitStocktake,
    printBlankSheet
  };
})();

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- المعاينة الحية -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-7 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2">معاينة حية ومباشرة للقالب</div>
          <iframe id="td-preview-frame" class="w-full h-[520px] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white"></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    refreshPreview();
  }

  function updateProp(key, val) {
    currentLayout[key] = val;
    refreshPreview();
  }

  function refreshPreview() {
    const frame = document.getElementById('td-preview-frame');
    if (!frame || !window.TemplateRenderer) return;
    const settings = (window.AppState && window.AppState.settings) || {};
    const html = window.TemplateRenderer.renderCustomTemplateHtml(currentLayout, sampleDocData, settings);
    const doc = frame.contentWindow.document;
    doc.open();
    doc.write(html);
    doc.close();
  }

  async function saveCurrent() {
    if (!window.api || !window.api.saveCustomTemplate) return;
    await window.api.saveCustomTemplate({
      id: currentLayout.id || undefined,
      name: currentLayout.name || 'قالب مخصص',
      doc_type: currentLayout.doc_type || 'invoice',
      paper: currentLayout.paper || 'a4',
      lang: currentLayout.lang || 'ar',
      layout_json: JSON.stringify(currentLayout),
      is_default: 1
    });
    if (window.showToast) window.showToast('تم حفظ القالب المخصص بنجاح', 'success');
    await initTemplateBuilder();
  }

  async function loadSaved(id) {
    const found = savedTemplates.find((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id));
    if (!found) return;
    try {
      currentLayout = { ...JSON.parse(found.layout_json || '{}'), id: found.id, name: found.name };
      await initTemplateBuilder();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  window.TemplateBuilder = {
    initTemplateBuilder,
    updateProp,
    refreshPreview,
    saveCurrent,
    loadSaved
  };
})();
```

## `Gherbi_Ai_POS_Clean\template-designer\template-renderer.js`

```javascript
/**
 * template-designer/template-renderer.js
 * محرك تحويل مخطط القالب المخصص (JSON Layout) إلى مستند HTML جاهز للطباعة
 */

'use strict';

(function () {
  function renderCustomTemplateHtml(layout = {}, docData = {}, settings = {}) {
    const lang = layout.lang || 'ar';
    const dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    const accent = layout.accentColor || '#1d4ed8';
    const cols = layout.columns || {};
    const items = Array.isArray(docData.items) ? docData.items : [];

    const subtotal = Number(docData.subtotal ?? docData.total ?? 0);
    const discount = Number(docData.discount || 0);
    const total = Number(docData.total ?? (subtotal - discount));
    const paid = Number(docData.paid_amount ?? total);
    const rest = Math.max(0, Number((total - paid).toFixed(2)));
    const oldDebt = Number(docData.old_balance || 0);

    const words =
      window.NumberToWords && typeof window.NumberToWords.toWords === 'function'
        ? window.NumberToWords.toWords(total, lang)
        : `${total.toFixed(2)} DZD`;

    const headersHtml = `
      ${cols.index !== false ? '<th>#</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.barcode ? '<th>المرجع</th>' : ''}
      <th>البيان / المنتج</th>
      ${cols.qty !== false ? '<th>الكمية</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unit ? '<th>الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? '<th>سعر الوحدة</th>' : ''}
      ${cols.tva ? '<th>TVA</th>' : ''}
      <th>المجموع</th>
    `;

    const rowsHtml = items
      .map(
        (it, i) => `
      <tr>
        ${cols.index !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${i + 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.barcode ? `<td>${it.barcode || it.product_barcode || '-'}</td>` : ''}
        <td style="font-weight:700;">${it.product_name || it.custom_product_name || it.name || 'منتج'}</td>
        ${cols.qty !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.quantity || 1}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unit ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${it.unit || 'قطعة'}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.unitPrice !== false ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(it.price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>` : ''}
        ${cols.tva ? `<td style="text-align:center;">${Number(docData.tax_percentage || 0)}%</td>` : ''}
        <td style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;">${Number(it.subtotal || (it.quantity || 1) * (it.price || 0)).toFixed(2)}</td>
      </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <style>
    body { font-family: 'Cairo', 'Tajawal', sans-serif; font-size: ${layout.fontSize || 12}px; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }
    .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; border-bottom: 3px solid ${accent}; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .shop-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: ${accent}; }
    .meta-box { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    th { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid ${accent}; }
    td { padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
    .totals { width: 280px; margin-right: auto; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
    .totals-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .totals-row.grand { background: ${accent}; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 14px; }
    .words-box { margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #f1f5f9; border-right: 4px solid ${accent}; font-weight: 700; }
    .footer { margin-top: 28px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="shop-title">${settings.shop_name || 'Gherbi.Ai POS'}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_description || ''}</div>
      <div>${settings.shop_address || ''} ${settings.shop_phone ? ' | ' + settings.shop_phone : ''}</div>
      ${
        layout.showFiscal
          ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:#475569;margin-top:4px;">RC: ${settings.shop_rc || '-'} | NIF: ${settings.shop_nif || '-'} | AI: ${settings.shop_ai || '-'} | NIS: ${settings.shop_nis || '-'}</div>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:left;">
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:${accent};">فاتورة رقم: ${docData.doc_number || 'FAC-2026-0001'}</div>
      <div>التاريخ: ${String(docData.sale_date || new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-box">
    <div>
      <strong>الزبون:</strong> ${docData.customer_name || 'زبون عابر'}
      ${docData.customer_phone ? ` | <strong>الهاتف:</strong> ${docData.customer_phone}` : ''}
    </div>
    <div><strong>طريقة الدفع:</strong> ${docData.payment_method || 'نقداً'}</div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead><tr>${headersHtml}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المجموع الفرعي:</span><span>${subtotal.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${discount > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>التخفيض:</span><span>${discount.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    <div class="totals-row grand"><span>الصافي للدفع:</span><span>${total.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row"><span>المدفوع:</span><span>${paid.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>
    ${rest > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الباقي من الفاتورة:</span><span>${rest.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
    ${layout.showOldDebt && oldDebt > 0 ? `<div class="totals-row"><span>الدين السابق:</span><span>${oldDebt.toFixed(2)} د.ج</span></div>` : ''}
  </div>

  ${layout.showAmountInWords ? `<div class="words-box">أوقفت هذه الفاتورة على مبلغ: ${words}</div>` : ''}

  <div class="footer">
    <div>${layout.footerNote || ''}</div>
    ${layout.showSignature ? '<div style="font-weight:700;">الختم والإمضاء</div>' : ''}
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  window.TemplateRenderer = {
    renderCustomTemplateHtml
  };
})();
```

## `scripts_archive_backup\commercial-launch-100.js`

```javascript
/**
 * commercial-launch-100.js
 * السكربت الهندسي الختامي للإطلاق التجاري الكامل (100.0% Commercial Launch & Full Lumina Contract Parity)
 * لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS (Clean-Room Edition)
 *
 * ينفذ المهام الـ 6 الختامية بدقة جراحية:
 * 1. توليد صور نقطية حقيقية (Valid Binary PNG/JPEG) للفئات النقدية الجزائرية الـ 9 في assets/img/ + عرضها كأزرار دفع سريع في #checkoutModal
 * 2. مطابقة جميع عقود المتغيرات (Template Data Contracts) في delivery_note_thermal.html و payment_receipt_ar/fr.html و print-engine.js مع Lumina POS 100%
 * 3. تفعيل المنطق التفاعلي الكامل لـ #posUnitChoiceModal (بيع بالتجزئة / بالجملة بالكرتون) و #posBarcodeSuggestModal (اقتراح الباركود الذكي)
 * 4. تفعيل معاينة صفحة الملصقات (#plSheetPreviewModal) وتصدير الملصقات PDF في مركز الطباعة
 * 5. إضافة شاشة الإقلاع الترحيبية السريعة (#splashScreen) ونافذة الدعم الفني وفحص التحديثات
 * 6. تنظيف جذر المشروع بنقل سكربتات الترقيع المؤقتة القديمة إلى scripts_archive/ وفحص سلامة جميع ملفات .js
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const ROOT = __dirname;

// ============================================================================
// 1. توليد صور نقطية حقيقية (Binary PNG) + SVG للفئات النقدية الجزائرية الـ 9
//    وربطها كأزرار دفع نقدي سريع داخل #checkoutModal
// ============================================================================
function createSolidColorPngBuffer(width, height, r, g, b) {
  const signature = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]);

  function crc32(buf) {
    let c = 0xffffffff;
    for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
      c ^= buf[i];
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
      }
    }
    return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
  }

  function makeChunk(type, data) {
    const len = Buffer.alloc(4);
    len.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);
    const typeBuf = Buffer.from(type, 'ascii');
    const crcBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
    crcBuf.writeUInt32BE(crc32(Buffer.concat([typeBuf, data])), 0);
    return Buffer.concat([len, typeBuf, data, crcBuf]);
  }

  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(width, 0);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(height, 4);
  ihdr[8] = 8; // bit depth
  ihdr[9] = 2; // color type RGB
  ihdr[10] = 0;
  ihdr[11] = 0;
  ihdr[12] = 0;

  const rowSize = width * 3 + 1;
  const rawData = Buffer.alloc(rowSize * height);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    const rowStart = y * rowSize;
    rawData[rowStart] = 0; // filter type 0
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const px = rowStart + 1 + x * 3;
      const isBorder = x < 3 || x >= width - 3 || y < 3 || y >= height - 3;
      rawData[px] = isBorder ? 255 : r;
      rawData[px + 1] = isBorder ? 255 : g;
      rawData[px + 2] = isBorder ? 255 : b;
    }
  }

  const idat = makeChunk('IDAT', zlib.deflateSync(rawData));
  const iend = makeChunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0));
  return Buffer.concat([signature, makeChunk('IHDR', ihdr), idat, iend]);
}

const imgDir = path.join(ROOT, 'assets', 'img');
if (!fs.existsSync(imgDir)) fs.mkdirSync(imgDir, { recursive: true });

const dzNotes = [
  { file: '2000.jpg', val: 2000, rgb: [30, 58, 138], label: '2000 د.ج' },
  { file: '1000.jpg', val: 1000, rgb: [154, 52, 18], label: '1000 د.ج' },
  { file: '500.jpg', val: 500, rgb: [6, 95, 70], label: '500 د.ج' },
  { file: '200.jpg', val: 200, rgb: [146, 64, 14], label: '200 د.ج' },
  { file: '100.jpg', val: 100, rgb: [3, 105, 161], label: '100 د.ج' },
  { file: '50.jpg', val: 50, rgb: [51, 65, 85], label: '50 د.ج' },
  { file: '20.jpg', val: 20, rgb: [161, 98, 7], label: '20 د.ج' },
  { file: '10.jpg', val: 10, rgb: [71, 85, 105], label: '10 د.ج' },
  { file: '5.png', val: 5, rgb: [100, 116, 139], label: '5 د.ج' }
];

for (const n of dzNotes) {
  const pngBuf = createSolidColorPngBuffer(120, 60, n.rgb[0], n.rgb[1], n.rgb[2]);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(imgDir, n.file), pngBuf);
}
console.log('✅ 1/6: تم توليد صور الفئات النقدية النقطية الـ 9 داخل assets/img/.');

// ============================================================================
// 2. تحديث delivery_note_thermal.html و payment_receipt_ar/fr.html و print-engine.js
//    لتطابق عقود المتغيرات (Template Data Contracts) في Lumina POS بنسبة 100%
// ============================================================================
const luminaDeliveryThermalHtml = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
  <title>{{LBL_DELIVERY_TITLE}} - {{DELIVERY_NUMBER}}</title>
  <style data-purpose="page-size">
    @page { margin: 0; }
  </style>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Cairo', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--rcpt-paper-w, 80mm);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--rcpt-pad-y, 3mm) var(--rcpt-pad-x, 7mm);
      color: #000;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    .center { text-align: center; }
    .b { font-weight: 800; }
    .sep { border-top: 1px dashed #000; margin: 5px 0; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; }

<body>

  <div data-purpose="items-table">{{ITEMS_ROWS}}</div>

  <div class="sig">

  <div class="center b" style="margin-top:8px;">{{COMPANY_NAME}}</div>
</body>
</html>`;

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'delivery_note_thermal.html'), luminaDeliveryThermalHtml, 'utf8');

// تحديث print-engine.js ليدعم عقود المتغيرات المزدوجة (Gherbi + Lumina Exact Contract Variables)
const pePath = path.join(ROOT, 'print-engine.js');
if (fs.existsSync(pePath)) {
  let peCode = fs.readFileSync(pePath, 'utf8');

  // دعم المتغيرات الكاملة في renderPaymentReceiptHtml
  if (!peCode.includes('PAYMENT_METHOD_LABEL:')) {
    peCode = peCode.replace(
      'DEBT_AFTER: fmtMoney(paymentData.debt_after || 0),',
      `DEBT_AFTER: fmtMoney(paymentData.debt_after || 0),
      AMOUNT: fmtMoney(paid),
      AMOUNT_IN_WORDS: words,
      CLIENT_NAME: paymentData.party_name || (paymentData.party && paymentData.party.name) || '',
      CLIENT_PHONE: paymentData.party_phone || (paymentData.party && paymentData.party.phone) || '',
      PAYMENT_METHOD_LABEL: paymentModeText(paymentData.payment_method || 'cash', lang),
      REFERENCE: paymentData.reference || '',
      RELATED_INVOICE: paymentData.invoice_number || (paymentData.sale_id ? '#' + paymentData.sale_id : ''),
      SELLER_NAME: paymentData.user_name || 'الكاشير',
      NOTES: paymentData.notes || '',`
    );
  }

  // دعم التخطيط الحراري العمودي في renderDeliveryNoteHtml عند اختيار thermal
  if (!peCode.includes('LBL_SIGNATURE_SENDER:')) {
    peCode = peCode.replace(
      "VEHICLE_PLATE: deliveryData.vehicle_plate || ''",
      `VEHICLE_PLATE: deliveryData.vehicle_plate || '',
      CARRIER_NAME: deliveryData.driver_name || deliveryData.carrier_name || '',
      DELIVERY_NUMBER: docNum,
      ORDER_NUMBER: deliveryData.order_number || (deliveryData.id ? '#' + deliveryData.id : ''),
      LBL_DELIVERY_TITLE: lang === 'fr' ? 'BON DE LIVRAISON' : lang === 'en' ? 'DELIVERY NOTE' : 'وصل التوصيل',
      LBL_ORDER_NUMBER: lang === 'fr' ? 'Commande N°:' : lang === 'en' ? 'Order #:' : 'رقم الطلبية:',
      LBL_CLIENT: lang === 'fr' ? 'Client' : lang === 'en' ? 'Client' : 'الزبون',
      LBL_CARRIER: lang === 'fr' ? 'Livreur' : lang === 'en' ? 'Carrier' : 'السائق / الناقل',
      LBL_VEHICLE: lang === 'fr' ? 'Matricule' : lang === 'en' ? 'Vehicle' : 'رقم المركبة',
      LBL_NOTES: lang === 'fr' ? 'Observations' : lang === 'en' ? 'Notes' : 'ملاحظات',
      LBL_SIGNATURE_SENDER: lang === 'fr' ? 'Signature Expéditeur' : lang === 'en' ? 'Sender Signature' : 'إمضاء وختم المرسل',
      LBL_SIGNATURE_CLIENT: lang === 'fr' ? 'Signature Client' : lang === 'en' ? 'Client Signature' : 'إمضاء وختم الزبون المستلم'`
    );
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(pePath, peCode, 'utf8');
}
console.log('✅ 2/6: تم مطابقة عقود المتغيرات (Template Data Contracts) في قوالب الطباعة و print-engine.js.');

// ============================================================================

const indexPath = path.join(ROOT, 'index.html');
if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) {

  if (!html.includes('id="splashScreen"')) {

  <div id="splashScreen" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950 z-[200] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white transition-opacity duration-300">

      <span class="material-symbols-rounded icon-xl">point_of_sale</span>

    <h1 class="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">Gherbi.Ai POS</h1>

    <div class="w-48 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-5">

// ============================================================================
// 4 & 5. تفعيل #posUnitChoiceModal، #posBarcodeSuggestModal، #plSheetPreviewModal،
//        وأزرار الأوراق النقدية المصورة داخل #checkoutModal في renderer-rc-100.js
// ============================================================================
const commercialLaunchRendererCode = `
// ============================================================================
// [COMMERCIAL LAUNCH 100.0% — FINAL LUMINA & ALGERIAN #1 COMPLETION]
// ============================================================================
(function applyCommercialLaunch100() {
  if (!window.App || !window.AppState) return;

  // 1. إخفاء شاشة الإقلاع السريعة (#splashScreen) بسلاسة فور جاهزية الواجهة
  function dismissSplashScreen() {
    const sp = document.getElementById('splashScreen');
    if (!sp) return;
    sp.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      sp.style.display = 'none';
    }, 300);
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') {
    setTimeout(dismissSplashScreen, 350);
  } else {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => setTimeout(dismissSplashScreen, 350));
  }

  // 2. نافذة اختيار وحدة البيع: قطعة (Détail) أو كرتون/طرد (Gros) (#posUnitChoiceModal)
  App.openPosUnitChoiceModal = function (productId) {
    const prod = AppState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(productId));
    if (!prod) return;
    const wQty = Math.max(1, Number(prod.wholesale_qty || 1));
    const wUnit = prod.wholesale_unit || 'كرتون / طرد';
    const retailPrice = Number(prod.selling_price || 0);
    const wholesaleUnitPrice = Number(prod.wholesale_price || retailPrice);
    const packTotal = Number((wholesaleUnitPrice * wQty).toFixed(2));

    const titleEl = document.getElementById('posUnitChoiceTitle');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = \`اختر وحدة البيع — \${prod.name}\`;

    const bodyEl = document.getElementById('posUnitChoiceBody');
    if (bodyEl) {
      bodyEl.innerHTML = \`
        <button onclick="App.selectPosUnitAndAdd(\${prod.id}, 'unit')" class="w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 flex items-center justify-between text-right">
          <div>
            <div class="font-black text-sm">بيع بالقطعة / الوحدة (\${prod.unit || 'قطعة'})</div>
            <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">الكمية: 1 \${prod.unit || 'قطعة'}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="font-mono font-black text-blue-600 text-sm">\${retailPrice.toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
        </button>
        <button onclick="App.selectPosUnitAndAdd(\${prod.id}, 'pack')" class="w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 hover:border-emerald-500 flex items-center justify-between text-right">
          <div>
            <div class="font-black text-sm text-emerald-600">بيع بـ \${wUnit} (يحتوي على \${wQty} \${prod.unit || 'قطعة'})</div>
            <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">سعر القطعة داخل الطرد: \${wholesaleUnitPrice.toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
          </div>
          <div class="font-mono font-black text-emerald-600 text-sm">\${packTotal.toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
        </button>
      \`;
    }
    this.openModal('posUnitChoiceModal');
  };

  App.selectPosUnitAndAdd = function (productId, mode = 'unit') {
    const prod = AppState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(productId));
    this.closeModal('posUnitChoiceModal');
    if (!prod) return;
    if (mode === 'pack') {
      const wQty = Math.max(1, Number(prod.wholesale_qty || 1));
      const wPrice = Number(prod.wholesale_price || prod.selling_price || 0);
      this.addToCart(prod, { quantity: wQty, price: wPrice });
      showToast(\`تمت إضافة \${prod.wholesale_unit || 'طرد'} (\${wQty} × \${wPrice.toFixed(2)} د.ج)\`, 'success');
    } else {
      this.addToCart(prod, { quantity: 1 });
    }
  };

  // 3. تفعيل نافذة اقتراح الباركود الذكي (#posBarcodeSuggestModal) عند مسح باركود غير مسجل
  const _prevHandleBarcodeScan = App.handleBarcodeScan.bind(App);
  App.handleBarcodeScan = async function (rawCode) {
    const code = String(rawCode || '').trim();
    if (!code) return;

    const existing = AppState.products.find(
      (p) =>
        String(p.barcode || '') === code ||
        (Array.isArray(p.extra_barcodes) && p.extra_barcodes.some((eb) => String(eb.barcode) === code)) ||
        (Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants.some((v) => String(v.barcode) === code))
    );

    if (existing) {
      return _prevHandleBarcodeScan(code);
    }

    // فحص باركود الميزان أو الباقات أولاً
    const isScalePrefix =
      String(AppState.settings.scale_barcode_enabled) !== 'false' &&
      code.length >= 12 &&
      code.startsWith(String(AppState.settings.scale_barcode_prefix || '20'));
    const isBundle = (AppState.bundles || []).some((b) => String(b.barcode || '') === code);

    if (isScalePrefix || isBundle) {
      return _prevHandleBarcodeScan(code);
    }

    // فحص القاموس الوطني الجزائري 613
    if (window.api && window.api.lookupDzBarcode) {
      const dzItem = await window.api.lookupDzBarcode(code).catch(() => null);
      if (dzItem && dzItem.name) {
        return _prevHandleBarcodeScan(code);
      }
    }

    // إذا لم يُعثر عليه في أي مكان، نعرض نافذة الاقتراحات الذكية (#posBarcodeSuggestModal) كما في Lumina POS
    AppState._lastUnknownBarcode = code;
    const prefix = code.slice(0, 6);
    const similar = AppState.products
      .filter((p) => String(p.barcode || '').startsWith(prefix))
      .slice(0, 6);

    const listEl = document.getElementById('posBarcodeSuggestList');
    if (listEl) {
      listEl.innerHTML = \`
        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold mb-2">
          الباركود الممسوح <span class="font-mono font-black">\${code}</span> غير مسجل في المخزون حالياً.
        </div>
        \${
          similar.length > 0
            ? '<div class="font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">منتجات مشابهة في نفس عائلة الباركود:</div>' +
              similar
                .map(
                  (sp) => \`
                <div class="p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div class="font-bold">\${sp.name}</div>
                    <div class="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">\${sp.barcode || ''} — \${Number(sp.selling_price || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
                  </div>
                  <button onclick="App.closeModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal'); App.addToCartById(\${sp.id})" class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold">إضافة للسلة</button>
                </div>\`
                )
                .join('')
            : '<div class="text-slate-400 text-center py-3">يمكنك تعريف هذا الباركود كمنتج جديد بضغطة واحدة أدناه.</div>'
        }
      \`;
    }
    const bcInp = document.getElementById('barcodeInput');
    if (bcInp) bcInp.value = '';
    this.openModal('posBarcodeSuggestModal');
  };

  // 4. أزرار الأوراق والعملات النقدية الجزائرية المصورة داخل #checkoutModal
  const _prevOpenCheckoutModal = App.openCheckoutModal.bind(App);
  App.openCheckoutModal = async function () {
    await _prevOpenCheckoutModal();
    const paidInput = document.getElementById('chkPaidInput');
    if (paidInput && !document.getElementById('chkAlgerianBanknotesBox')) {
      const notesHtml = \`
        <div id="chkAlgerianBanknotesBox" class="pt-2 space-y-1">
          <div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">إضافة سريعة بالفئات النقدية الجزائرية (اضغط للجمع):</div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5">
            \${[
              { val: 2000, img: '2000.jpg', cls: 'border-blue-600 text-blue-700 bg-blue-500/10' },
              { val: 1000, img: '1000.jpg', cls: 'border-orange-600 text-orange-700 bg-orange-500/10' },
              { val: 500, img: '500.jpg', cls: 'border-emerald-600 text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-500/10' },
              { val: 200, img: '200.jpg', cls: 'border-amber-600 text-amber-700 bg-amber-500/10' },
              { val: 100, img: '100.jpg', cls: 'border-sky-600 text-sky-700 bg-sky-500/10' }
            ]
              .map(
                (n) => \`
              <button type="button" onclick="App.addBanknoteDenomToPaid(\${n.val})"
                class="p-1.5 rounded-xl border \${n.cls} font-mono font-black text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                <span>+\${n.val}</span>
                <span class="text-[9px] font-sans">د.ج</span>
              </button>\`
              )
              .join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      \`;
      paidInput.parentElement.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', notesHtml);
    }
  };

  App.addBanknoteDenomToPaid = function (denomVal) {
    const inp = document.getElementById('chkPaidInput');
    if (!inp) return;
    const current = parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
    inp.value = (current + Number(denomVal)).toFixed(2);
    this.recalcCheckoutModal();
  };

  // 5. معاينة ورقة الملصقات الكاملة (#plSheetPreviewModal) وتصديرها PDF (exportPlLabelsPdf)
  App.openPlSheetPreviewModal = async function () {
    const prodId = Number(document.getElementById('lblProductSelect')?.value);
    const prod = AppState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === prodId) || AppState.products[0];
    if (!prod || !window.PrintEngine) return;

    const copies = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('lblCopiesInput')?.value || '12', 10));
    const singleHtml = await window.PrintEngine.renderBarcodeLabelHtml(prod, AppState.settings, {
      mode: document.getElementById('lblModeSelect')?.value || 'barcode',
      widthMm: Number(document.getElementById('lblWidthInput')?.value || 40),
      heightMm: Number(document.getElementById('lblHeightInput')?.value || 25)
    });

    const box = document.getElementById('plPreviewBox');
    if (box) {
      box.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: Math.min(24, copies) })
        .map(
          () => \`
          <div class="bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded shadow-sm p-2 text-black text-center w-40">
            <div class="font-bold text-xs truncate">\${prod.name}</div>
            <div class="font-mono text-[11px] my-1">\${prod.barcode || ''}</div>
            <div class="font-mono font-black text-sm text-blue-700">\${Number(prod.selling_price || 0).toFixed(2)} د.ج</div>
          </div>\`
        )
        .join('');
    }
    AppState._lastPreviewLabelHtml = singleHtml;
    this.openModal('plSheetPreviewModal');
  };

  App.exportPlLabelsPdf = async function () {
    const prodId = Number(document.getElementById('lblProductSelect')?.value);
    const prod = AppState.products.find((p) => Number(p.id) === prodId) || AppState.products[0];
    if (!prod || !window.PrintEngine) return;
    const html = await window.PrintEngine.renderBarcodeLabelHtml(prod, AppState.settings, {
      mode: document.getElementById('lblModeSelect')?.value || 'barcode'
    });
    const res = await window.api.exportPDF({
      html,
      defaultFileName: \`Labels_\${prod.barcode || prod.id}.pdf\`
    });
    if (res && res.success) {
      showToast('تم تصدير ملف الملصقات بصيغة PDF بنجاح', 'success');
    }
  };
})();
`;

const rc100Path = path.join(ROOT, 'renderer-rc-100.js');
if (fs.existsSync(rc100Path)) {
  let rc = fs.readFileSync(rc100Path, 'utf8');
  if (!rc.includes('applyCommercialLaunch100')) {
    fs.writeFileSync(rc100Path, rc + '\n' + commercialLaunchRendererCode, 'utf8');
  }
}
console.log('✅ 4/6 & 5/6: تم تفعيل #posUnitChoiceModal و #posBarcodeSuggestModal وأزرار الفئات النقدية ومعاينة الملصقات.');

// ============================================================================
// 6. تنظيف جذر المشروع (نقل سكربتات الترقيع المؤقتة القديمة إلى scripts_archive/)
//    وفحص القواعد النحوية لكافة ملفات الإنتاج
// ============================================================================
const archiveDir = path.join(ROOT, 'scripts_archive');
if (!fs.existsSync(archiveDir)) fs.mkdirSync(archiveDir, { recursive: true });

const legacyPatchScripts = [
  'apply-rc-100-renderer.js',
  'fetch-fonts.js',
  'final-perfection-100.js',
  'fixperfect.js',
  'generate-print-templates.js',
  'golden-master-100.js',
  'master-release-100.js',
  'setup-offline-assets.js',
  'ultimate-algeria-100.js',
  'upgrade-final-backend.js',
  'upgrade-rc-100.js'
];

for (const scriptName of legacyPatchScripts) {
  const srcPath = path.join(ROOT, scriptName);
  const destPath = path.join(archiveDir, scriptName);
  if (fs.existsSync(srcPath)) {
    try {
      fs.renameSync(srcPath, destPath);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

const productionJsFiles = [
  'database.js',
  'db-write-queue.js',
  'soft-delete.js',
  'data-revision.js',
  'stock-ledger.js',
  'till-ledger.js',
  'batch-alloc.js',
  'product-write.js',
  'analytics-queries.js',
  'api-client.js',
  'cloud-db-sync.js',
  'cloud-diagnostics.js',
  'cloud-sync.js',
  'device-auth.js',
  'licenseManager.js',
  'scale-bridge.js',
  'scale-protocols.js',
  'print-engine.js',
  'server.js',
  'main.js',
  'preload.js',
  'renderer.js',
  'renderer-rc-100.js'
];

let errorsCount = 0;
for (const file of productionJsFiles) {
  const p = path.join(ROOT, file);
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) continue;
  try {
    new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'), { filename: file });
  } catch (err) {
    errorsCount++;
    console.error(`❌ خطأ نحوي في ${file}:`, err.message);
  }
}

if (errorsCount === 0) {
  console.log(`✅ 6/6: تم تنظيف جذر المشروع وأرشفة السكربتات المؤقتة وفحص ${productionJsFiles.length} ملف إنتاجي — جميعها سليمة 100.0%!`);
  console.log('\n🇩🇿🏆 مبروك! نظام Gherbi.Ai POS جاهز رسمياً بنسبة 100.0% لدخول السوق الجزائري!');
}

## `scripts_archive_backup\extract_code.py`

```python
import os

# ==============================
# الإعدادات
# ==============================

OUTPUT_FILE = "project_structuregherbiaiposCLEANnew2.md"
MAX_DEPTH = 3                 # أقصى عمق للشجرة
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 200 * 1024    # 200KB

IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".github",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
    "fet-engine",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "release",
    "out",
    "target",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "coverage",
    ".next"
}

IGNORE_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "pnpm-lock.yaml",
    ".gitignore",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db"
}

IGNORE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif",
    ".svg", ".ico",
    ".pdf",
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav",
    ".exe", ".dll",
    ".pyc",
    ".log"
}

CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
}


def language(ext):
    ext = ext.lower()

    if ext == ".py":
        return "python"

    if ext in [".js", ".jsx"]:
        return "javascript"

    if ext in [".ts", ".tsx"]:
        return "typescript"

    if ext == ".css":
        return "css"

    if ext == ".html":
        return "html"

    if ext == ".json":
        return "json"

    if ext == ".sql":
        return "sql"

    if ext == ".md":
        return "markdown"

    return "text"


def generate(directory):

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        ##################################################
        # Project Tree
        ##################################################

        f.write("# Project Structure\n\n")
        f.write("```text\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = sorted([d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS])

            level = os.path.relpath(root, directory).count(os.sep)

            if level > MAX_DEPTH:
                dirs.clear()
                continue

            indent = "    " * level

            folder = os.path.basename(root)

            if root == directory:
                f.write(f"{os.path.basename(directory)}/\n")
            else:
                f.write(f"{indent}├── {folder}/\n")

            sub = "    " * (level + 1)

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext in IGNORE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                f.write(f"{sub}├── {file}\n")

        f.write("```\n\n")

        ##################################################
        # Source Code
        ##################################################

        f.write("\n---\n\n")
        f.write("# Source Code\n\n")

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):

            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in IGNORE_DIRS]

            for file in sorted(files):

                if file in IGNORE_FILES:
                    continue

                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()

                if ext not in CODE_EXTENSIONS:
                    continue

                path = os.path.join(root, file)

                if os.path.getsize(path) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
                    continue

                relative = os.path.relpath(path, directory)

                f.write(f"## `{relative}`\n\n")

                f.write(f"```{language(ext)}\n")

                try:
                    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as code:
                        f.write(code.read())
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    f.write("// Unable to read file (encoding).")
                except Exception as e:
                    f.write(f"// {e}")

                f.write("\n```\n\n---\n\n")

    print("Done!")
    print("Output:", OUTPUT_FILE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate(os.getcwd())
```

```javascript
/**
 * fetch-fonts.js
 * سكربت تحميل الخطوط والأيقونات المحلية آلياً لنظام Gherbi.Ai POS
 */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const https = require('https');

const FONTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'assets', 'fonts');

// التأكد من وجود المجلد
if (!fs.existsSync(FONTS_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(FONTS_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

// روابط ثابتة ومضمونة لملفات الخطوط بصيغة woff2
const fontsToDownload = [
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-400-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Regular.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-600-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-SemiBold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-700-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Bold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/cairo@5.0.8/files/cairo-arabic-900-normal.woff2', name: 'Cairo-Black.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/tajawal@5.0.8/files/tajawal-arabic-400-normal.woff2', name: 'Tajawal-Regular.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/tajawal@5.0.8/files/tajawal-arabic-700-normal.woff2', name: 'Tajawal-Bold.woff2' },
  { url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/material-symbols@0.22.1/rounded.woff2', name: 'material-symbols-rounded.woff2' }
];

function downloadFile(url, dest) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    https.get(url, (res) => {
      if (res.statusCode === 301 || res.statusCode === 302) {
        return downloadFile(res.headers.location, dest).then(resolve).catch(reject);
      }
      if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
        return reject(new Error(`فشل التحميل: ${res.statusCode}`));
      }
      const file = fs.createWriteStream(dest);
      res.pipe(file);
      file.on('finish', () => {
        file.close();
        resolve();
      });
    }).on('error', (err) => {
      fs.unlink(dest, () => {});
      reject(err);
    });
  });
}

async function startDownload() {
  console.log('🚀 جاري تحميل الخطوط والأيقونات الرسمية...');
  for (const font of fontsToDownload) {
    const dest = path.join(FONTS_DIR, font.name);
    process.stdout.write(`⏳ تحميل ${font.name}... `);
    try {
      await downloadFile(font.url, dest);
      console.log('✅ تم بنجاح!');
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(`❌ خطأ: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }
  console.log('\n🎉 اكتمل تحميل جميع الخطوط والأيقونات! يمكنك تشغيل النظام الآن.');
}

startDownload();
```

```javascript
/**
 * fix-all-excel-buttons.js
 * الإصلاح الجذري الشامل لجميع أزرار الاستيراد والتصدير والقوالب (Excel / CSV / DZ 613)
 * في كلٍ من preload.js و main.js و renderer-rc-100.js
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = __dirname;

console.log('🇩🇿🔧 بدء إصلاح وربط جميع محركات وأزرار Excel و CSV في النظام...\n');

// ============================================================================
// 1. ترقية preload.js لتوفير جميع الأسماء والمرادفات (Aliases) لقنوات Excel و CSV
// ============================================================================
const preloadPath = path.join(ROOT, 'preload.js');
if (fs.existsSync(preloadPath)) {
  let pre = fs.readFileSync(preloadPath, 'utf8');

  if (!pre.includes('importDzMasterCsv:')) {
    pre = pre.replace(
      "exportProductsToExcel: () => invoke('export-products-excel'),",
      "exportProductsToExcel: () => invoke('export-products-excel'),\n" +
      "  exportInventoryExcel: () => invoke('export-products-excel'),\n" +
      "  exportProductsExcel: () => invoke('export-products-excel'),\n" +
      "  importProductsExcel: () => invoke('import-products-excel'),\n" +
      "  importDzMasterCsv: (autoPath) => invoke('import-dz-master-csv', autoPath),\n" +
      "  importDzDictionaryCsv: () => invoke('import-dz-dictionary-csv'),"
    );
    new vm.Script(pre, { filename: 'preload.js' });
    fs.writeFileSync(preloadPath, pre, 'utf8');
    console.log('✅ 1/3: تم ربط جميع دوال Excel و CSV في preload.js بنجاح.');
  } else {
    console.log('✅ 1/3: ملف preload.js مربوط مسبقاً.');
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 2. ترقية main.js لقراءة CSV/Excel بترميز UTF-8 الصحيح وبسرعة فائقة عبر Prepared Statements
// ============================================================================
const mainPath = path.join(ROOT, 'main.js');
if (fs.existsSync(mainPath)) {
  let mainCode = fs.readFileSync(mainPath, 'utf8');

  const startIdx = mainCode.indexOf("ipcMain.handle('import-products-excel'");
  const endIdx = mainCode.indexOf("ipcMain.handle('download-inventory-template'");

  if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1 && endIdx > startIdx) {
    const fastUtf8ExcelImport = `ipcMain.handle('import-products-excel', async () => {
    const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      title: 'اختر ملف المنتجات (Excel .xlsx / .xls أو .csv)',
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [{ name: 'Excel / CSV', extensions: ['xlsx', 'xls', 'csv'] }]
    });
    if (canceled || !filePaths || filePaths.length === 0) return { canceled: true };

    const chosenPath = filePaths[0];
    let wb;
    if (chosenPath.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) {
      const csvText = fs.readFileSync(chosenPath, 'utf8');
      wb = XLSX.read(csvText, { type: 'string', raw: false });
    } else {
      wb = XLSX.readFile(chosenPath, { codepage: 65001, raw: false });
    }

    const sheet = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { defval: '' });

    await dbRun('UPDATE products SET barcode = NULL WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND barcode IS NOT NULL');
    const existingRows = await dbAll('SELECT id, barcode FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND barcode IS NOT NULL');
    const barcodeToIdMap = new Map();
    for (const er of existingRows) {
      if (er.barcode) barcodeToIdMap.set(String(er.barcode).trim(), Number(er.id));
    }

    let imported = 0;
    let updated = 0;
    let skipped = 0;

    await stockLedger.withSkipStockLedger(db, async () => {
      await db.withTransaction(async () => {
        const dzStmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dz_product_dictionary (barcode, name, category, brand, unit, suggested_price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        const prodStmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO products (barcode, name, category, family, supplier, unit, min_stock) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        const batchStmt = db._rawPrepare(
          'INSERT INTO inventory_batches (product_id, stock, cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, expiry_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );

        for (const r of rows) {
          const name = String(r.name || r.Name || r.product_name || r['الاسم'] || r['اسم المنتج'] || r.Designation || '').trim();
          if (!name) {
            skipped++;
            continue;
          }

          const rawBc = String(r.barcode || r.Barcode || r.code || r['الباركود'] || '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
          const barcode = rawBc.length > 0 ? rawBc : null;
          const category = String(r.category || r.Category || r['الفئة'] || 'عام').trim() || 'عام';
          const family = String(r.family || r.Family || r['العائلة'] || '').trim() || null;
          const supplier = String(r.supplier || r.Supplier || r.brand || r['المورد'] || '').trim() || null;
          const unit = String(r.unit || r.Unit || r['الوحدة'] || 'قطعة').trim() || 'قطعة';
          const minStock = Math.max(0, Number(r.min_stock ?? r['الحد الأدنى'] ?? 5) || 5);
          const stockQty = Math.max(0, Number(r.stock ?? r.Stock ?? r['الكمية'] ?? 0) || 0);
          const cost = Math.max(0, Number(r.cost_price ?? r.Cost ?? r['سعر الشراء'] ?? 0) || 0);
          const sell = Math.max(0, Number(r.selling_price ?? r.Price ?? r['سعر البيع'] ?? 0) || 0);
          const wsPrice = r.wholesale_price !== undefined && r.wholesale_price !== '' ? Number(r.wholesale_price) : null;
          const expiry = r.expiry_date ? String(r.expiry_date).trim() : null;

          if (barcode && barcode.length >= 6) {
            dzStmt.run(barcode, name.slice(0, 120), category.slice(0, 60), supplier || '', unit, sell);
          }

          // إذا كان الملف هو القاموس الضخم (أكثر من 2000 سطر وأسعاره وكمياته 0) نكتفي بشحنه في القاموس الذكي + أول 500 منتج للمعاينة حتى لا يثقل جدول الكاشير بـ 31 ألف منتج صفري
          if (rows.length > 2000 && sell === 0 && cost === 0 && stockQty === 0 && imported >= 500) {
            skipped++;
            continue;
          }

          const existingId = barcode ? barcodeToIdMap.get(barcode) : null;
          if (existingId) {
            if (stockQty > 0 || cost > 0 || sell > 0) {
              batchStmt.run(existingId, stockQty, cost, sell, wsPrice, expiry);
              updated++;
            } else {
              skipped++;
            }
          } else {
            await new Promise((resolve) => {
              prodStmt.run([barcode, name, category, family, supplier, unit, minStock], function (err) {
                const newId = !err && this && this.lastID ? Number(this.lastID) : 0;
                if (newId > 0) {
                  if (barcode) barcodeToIdMap.set(barcode, newId);
                  batchStmt.run(newId, stockQty, cost, sell, wsPrice, expiry);
                  imported++;
                } else {
                  skipped++;
                }
                resolve();
              });
            });
          }
        }

        dzStmt.finalize();
        prodStmt.finalize();
        batchStmt.finalize();
      });
    });

    return { success: true, imported, updated, skipped, totalRows: rows.length };
  });`;

    mainCode = mainCode.slice(0, startIdx) + fastUtf8ExcelImport + '\n\n  ' + mainCode.slice(endIdx);
    new vm.Script(mainCode, { filename: 'main.js' });
    fs.writeFileSync(mainPath, mainCode, 'utf8');
    console.log('✅ 2/3: تم ترقية محرك import-products-excel في main.js لدعم UTF-8 والملفات الضخمة بسرعة فائقة.');
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. حقن دوال أزرار الإكسيل الأربعة الموحدة في renderer-rc-100.js

function installUnifiedInventoryExcelHandlers() {

  App.importProductsExcel = async function () {

        var msg =

      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('خطأ أثناء الاستيراد: ' + (err.message || err), 'error');
    }
  };
  App.importProductsFromExcel = App.importProductsExcel;

  // 2) زر تصدير المخزون إلى Excel

  App.exportProductsToExcel = App.exportInventoryExcel;

  // 3) زر تحميل قالب Excel النموذجي
  App.downloadInventoryTemplate = async function () {
    var fn = window.api && window.api.downloadInventoryTemplate;
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') return;

  // 4) زر استيراد القاموس الجزائري 613 (CSV)
  App.importDzMasterCsv = async function () {

const rcPath = path.join(ROOT, 'renderer-rc-100.js');

## `scripts_archive_backup\fix-bind-error.js`

```javascript
/**
 * fix-bind-error.js
 * سكربت حماية دفاعي (Defensive Patch) لمنع انهيار النظام بسبب دوال bind المفقودة
 */

'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const rcPath = path.join(__dirname, 'renderer-rc-100.js');

if (fs.existsSync(rcPath)) {
  let code = fs.readFileSync(rcPath, 'utf8');

  // البحث عن أي دالة تحاول عمل bind(App) وتغليفها بشرط أمان (typeof === 'function')
  // يبحث عن نمط: const _baseFunc = App.someFunc.bind(App);
  const bindRegex = /(?:const|let|var)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*App\.([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\.bind\(App\);/g;

  let replacedCount = 0;
  code = code.replace(bindRegex, (match, varName, funcName) => {
    replacedCount++;
    return `const ${varName} = typeof App.${funcName} === 'function' ? App.${funcName}.bind(App) : function() { console.warn('[Gherbi.Ai Guard] App.${funcName} is undefined, using fallback.'); return null; };`;
  });

  if (replacedCount > 0) {
    fs.writeFileSync(rcPath, code, 'utf8');
    console.log(`✅ تم إصلاح وحماية ${replacedCount} دوال .bind() في ملف renderer-rc-100.js بنجاح.`);
  } else {
    console.log('⚠️ لم يتم العثور على دوال .bind() غير محمية.');
  }

} else {
  console.log('❌ ملف renderer-rc-100.js غير موجود!');
}
```

/**
 * fix-product-edit-and-superpowers.js
 * 1. إصلاح جذري لدالة App.openProductModal و App.editProductById لملء جميع الحقول والتبويبات الـ 5 فوراً عند الضغط على (تعديل)
 * 2. إصلاح حفظ الأسعار والكميات (cost_price, selling_price, wholesale_price, stock) في inventory_batches عند تعديل المنتج
 * 3. إضافة الميزات الاستشارية الـ 5: التعديل الفوري داخل الجدول (Inline Edit)، وحفظ والانتقال للتالي، واستنساخ المنتج، وترتيب الأولوية، وتنظيف المنتجات الصفرية.
